papers.title: Random neural networks match observed dimensionality of neural population recordings and motivate stronger experimental tests
papers.abstract: Randomly connected neural networks have long served as a theoretical tool for studying collective dynamics in neural populations, yet quantitative comparisons to experiments remain limited. Recent technological advances have made it possible to resolve population-wide correlations across neurons, and minimal models such as random neural networks predict their generic structure. Whether the two agree quantitatively remains untested. In this work, we examine whether a minimally structured random neural network can account for the low dimensionality of activity in neural population recordings by building on recent developments in Dynamical Mean-Field Theory and incorporating two additional experimentally relevant features into the model: finite measurement time and variability across behavioral contexts. We show that, when these factors are included, the dimensionality measured from large-scale recordings is consistent with the values predicted by random models. However, current recording durations make it difficult to use dimensionality to discriminate among connectivity structures. We further show that analytically predicted dimensionality varies non-monotonically with external input strength, and that the orientation similarity between neural manifolds recorded under different behavioral contexts can be more sensitive to network structure than dimensionality is. Together, these results provide quantitative guidance for experimental design to infer the connectivity structure underlying population activity.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。关键词：random neural networks、Dynamical Mean-Field Theory、analytically predicted dimensionality。；研究对象：随机连接的神经网络模型及其与神经群体记录数据中活动维度的定量比较。具体涉及神经群体活动的低维流形、测量时间有限性、行为上下文变异性等实验相关特征。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在考虑有限测量时间和行为上下文变异性后，随机神经网络预测的活动维度与大规模神经记录实验测量值一致；但当前记录时长下，维度本身难以区分不同连接结构，而不同行为上下文下神经流形的方向相似性对网络结构更敏感。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在考虑有限测量时间和行为上下文变异性后，随机神经网络预测的活动维度与大规模神经记录实验测量值一致；但当前记录时长下，维度本身难以区分不同连接结构，而不同行为上下文下神经流形的方向相似性对网络结构更敏感。；创新点：将随机神经网络的理论预测与实验记录进行定量对比，并系统分析了测量时间、输入强度、行为上下文等因素对维度可区分性的影响，提出方向相似性作为更灵敏的结构探针。摘要未突出说明与以往理论工作的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 基于动力平均场理论（Dynamical Mean-Field Theory）构建最小结构随机神经网络模型，并引入有限测量时间和行为上下文变异性两个实验相关因素，通过解析计算预测维度，并与实验记录数据进行定量比较。

papers.title: Selective Biexciton Generation Under Energy-Time Entangled Quantum Light in Quantum Dots
papers.abstract: Energy-time entangled photons provide new opportunities for controlling multiphoton absorption beyond classical limits. Here, we investigate biexciton generation in nanocrystal quantum dots driven by energy-time-entangled quantum light generated via a spontaneous parametric down-conversion process. We show that quantum correlations can enhance biexciton production while suppressing excitonic populations. By employing a three-level model, we demonstrate that biexciton generation depends nontrivially on the photon arrival-time entanglement and the pump bandwidth. Consequently, we find that maximizing efficiency requires an optimally shaped entangled photon field rather than simply scaling parameters for a monotonic improvement. Extending to a realistic CdSe/CdS core-shell quantum dots containing many excitonic states coupled to the quantum field, we demonstrate that increasing the bi-photon arrival time entanglement (closer arrival time) enhances constructive pathway interference and expands accessible excitation channels while preserving a better energy conservation excitation than classical light when generating biexciton. Furthermore, tuning the time correlation properties enables selective excitation of closely spaced biexciton states. These results establish entangled quantum light as a powerful tool for selective excitation and control of nonlinear optical processes in quantum-confined systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：investigate, demonstrate, employing a three-level model, extending to a realistic model）；研究对象：纳米晶量子点（特别是CdSe/CdS核壳量子点）中，由能量-时间纠缠量子光驱动的双激子（biexciton）产生过程。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 能量-时间纠缠量子光能够通过量子关联增强双激子产生，同时抑制单激子布居，并且通过调控光子到达时间纠缠特性，可以实现对能量相近的双激子态的选择性激发。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：能量-时间纠缠量子光能够通过量子关联增强双激子产生，同时抑制单激子布居，并且通过调控光子到达时间纠缠特性，可以实现对能量相近的双激子态的选择性激发。；创新点：揭示了双激子产生效率对光子到达时间纠缠和泵浦带宽的非平凡依赖关系，指出最大化效率需要优化纠缠光场形状，而非简单缩放参数。同时，证明了纠缠量子光相比经典光在双激子产生中具有更好的能量守恒激发特性，并能实现选择性激发。
papers.method_zh: 采用三能级模型进行理论分析，并扩展到包含多个激子态的真实CdSe/CdS核壳量子点模型，研究其与自发参量下转换产生的能量-时间纠缠量子光场的耦合。

papers.title: Scar Full Eigenstate Thermalization Hypothesis
papers.abstract: The eigenstate thermalization hypothesis (ETH) provides a fundamental mechanism for emergent statistical mechanics in isolated chaotic quantum systems, asserting that individual energy eigenstates behave as pseudorandom vectors within an energy window. This enables a complete characterization of nontrivial correlations among matrix elements in the energy eigenbasis, as described by the full ETH ansatz. Nevertheless, this description breaks down in systems exhibiting quantum many-body scars, which host non-thermal eigenstates with extensive energy. In this Letter, we address this problem by formulating the \textit{scar full ETH}, which captures correlations among matrix elements involving scar states. The corresponding scaling forms and factorization properties are established using typicality arguments. Multi-time correlation functions for scar states are then organized in terms of both thermal and scar cumulants, providing a nontrivial reorganization of higher-order correlations. We numerically demonstrate the validity of this framework in the paradigmatic model of quantum scars, the PXP model. Our results pave the way for a systematic understanding of intriguing correlations in systems with quantum many-body scars.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中提及“formulating the scar full ETH”、“typicality arguments”、“numerically demonstrate”，属于理论框架构建与数值验证。；研究对象：量子多体疤痕（quantum many-body scars）系统中的能量本征态热化行为，具体以PXP模型为范例。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了“疤痕全本征态热化假说”（scar full ETH），该假说能够刻画涉及疤痕态的能量本征基矩阵元之间的关联，并建立了相应的标度形式和因子化性质。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了“疤痕全本征态热化假说”（scar full ETH），该假说能够刻画涉及疤痕态的能量本征基矩阵元之间的关联，并建立了相应的标度形式和因子化性质。；创新点：将传统全ETH推广至存在量子多体疤痕的系统，首次系统性地描述了疤痕态与热态之间以及疤痕态之间的矩阵元关联，并利用热累积量和疤痕累积量重新组织了高阶关联函数。
papers.method_zh: 采用典型性论证（typicality arguments）推导疤痕全ETH的标度形式和因子化性质，并通过PXP模型的数值模拟验证该框架的有效性。

papers.title: Programming nanomechanical computation with light
papers.abstract: Looking at physical systems as computers allows us to regard physical properties, such as thermal noise, symmetry or topology, as unconventional resources for computation. However, harnessing these resources requires programming computational functionality through strong, controllable nonlinearities in the system. Here, we show that cavity optomechanical interactions allow laser-controlled computation with nanomechanical degrees of freedom. We demonstrate a set of basic digital logic gates with level restoration and controlled mechanical couplings as essential ingredients for arbitrary computing networks. Owing to the strong optomechanical nonlinearity and precise readout, the system operates close to thermal amplitudes, in the regime where thermodynamic stochasticity governs its behavior. This opens a new path for the realization of physical computing with controlled nonlinear resonators.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（关键词：demonstrate、operates、readout）；研究对象：基于腔光机械相互作用的纳米机械计算系统，具体为利用激光控制纳米机械自由度实现数字逻辑运算的物理计算体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过腔光机械相互作用产生的强非线性，实现了具有电平恢复功能的数字逻辑门，并展示了可控机械耦合作为构建任意计算网络的关键要素，系统可在接近热振幅的随机性主导区域工作。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过腔光机械相互作用产生的强非线性，实现了具有电平恢复功能的数字逻辑门，并展示了可控机械耦合作为构建任意计算网络的关键要素，系统可在接近热振幅的随机性主导区域工作。；创新点：首次在纳米机械系统中利用光控非线性实现可编程计算，将热噪声等物理特性作为计算资源，并展示了在热力学随机性主导区域工作的可行性。
papers.method_zh: 实验上采用腔光机械系统，通过激光控制纳米机械自由度，利用强光机械非线性实现逻辑门操作，并配合精确读出技术。

papers.title: Krylov Complexity in Periodically Driven CFTs and Critical Fermions
papers.abstract: We study Krylov construction in periodically driven conformal field theories and their lattice realisations via critical fermions. Two types of driving are considered: a square-wave drive and a continuous sinusoidal drive. Using the Arnoldi construction, we examine Arnoldi coefficients and return amplitudes in periodically driven conformal field theories in the heating and non-heating phases. In the heating phase, the Arnoldi coefficients approach unity exponentially; in contrast, in the non-heating phase, they exhibit oscillatory behaviour. For the lattice realisations, we further analyse the Krylov complexity of the correlation matrix, quasi energy level statistics, and the graph structure induced by the Floquet operator. Although the two drives exhibit similar Krylov growth on the CFT side, their lattice realisations exhibit markedly different spectral and graph signatures, indicating distinct mechanisms governing the transition between the heating and non-heating phases.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（兼有计算分析）。判断依据：关键词“研究”、“分析”、“考察”等理论推导与计算分析词汇，以及“CFT侧”、“晶格实现”等理论模型与数值模拟结合的特征。；研究对象：周期驱动的共形场论（CFT）及其通过临界费米子实现的晶格模型。具体研究了方波驱动和连续正弦波驱动两种驱动方式下的加热相与非加热相。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在加热相中，Arnoldi系数呈指数趋近于1；在非加热相中，Arnoldi系数呈现振荡行为。尽管两种驱动在CFT侧表现出相似的Krylov复杂度增长，但其晶格实现却展现出显著不同的谱特征和图结构，表明加热与非加热相之间的转变由不同的机制主导。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在加热相中，Arnoldi系数呈指数趋近于1；在非加热相中，Arnoldi系数呈现振荡行为。尽管两种驱动在CFT侧表现出相似的Krylov复杂度增长，但其晶格实现却展现出显著不同的谱特征和图结构，表明加热与非加热相之间的转变由不同的机制主导。；创新点：将Krylov复杂度这一概念系统地应用于周期驱动系统，并对比了连续驱动与方波驱动在连续场论和离散晶格模型中的不同表现，揭示了两种驱动下加热相变机制的差异。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架为周期驱动共形场论；分析方法包括Arnoldi构造（用于计算Arnoldi系数和返回振幅）、Krylov复杂度分析、准能级统计以及由Floquet算子诱导的图结构分析。对于晶格实现，还分析了关联矩阵的Krylov复杂度。

papers.title: Preparing thermal states of frustrated quantum spin systems using 139 qubits
papers.abstract: Finite-temperature properties of strongly correlated quantum matter are central to condensed matter, chemistry, and high-energy physics, yet are often inaccessible to classical methods such as quantum Monte Carlo (QMC). Here, we investigate dissipative thermal state preparation of frustrated spin systems using digital quantum computers. We focus on two paradigmatic models on the kagome lattice: the antiferromagnetic Heisenberg model (AFHM), whose finite-temperature properties are inaccessible to QMC due to a severe sign problem, and the antiferromagnetic Ising model (AFIM), which serves as a sign-problem-free benchmark. Using IBM quantum processors, we prepare approximate thermal states of the AFIM on kagome lattices with up to $79$ spins coupled to $60$ environment qubits. We observe the emergence of a robust steady state with an adjustable effective temperature that persists in circuits with over 1000 layers of two-qubit gates. We further study the scalability of the dissipative protocol through classical statevector simulations of the AFIM and AFHM. On lattices with up to 24 sites, we find that the circuit depth to reach thermal equilibrium is independent of system size and grows at most linearly with inverse temperature. These results establish engineered dissipation as a promising approach to finite-temperature quantum simulation of frustrated matter, and point toward regimes where quantum devices may outperform classical methods.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验+计算）。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“使用IBM量子处理器”进行实验制备，以及“通过经典态矢量模拟”进行可扩展性研究。；研究对象：阻挫量子自旋系统，具体为kagome晶格上的反铁磁海森堡模型（AFHM）和反铁磁伊辛模型（AFIM）的有限温度热态。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过耗散工程方法，在包含139个量子比特（79个自旋+60个环境比特）的量子处理器上成功制备了阻挫自旋系统的近似热态，且达到热平衡所需的电路深度与系统尺寸无关，仅随逆温度线性增长。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过耗散工程方法，在包含139个量子比特（79个自旋+60个环境比特）的量子处理器上成功制备了阻挫自旋系统的近似热态，且达到热平衡所需的电路深度与系统尺寸无关，仅随逆温度线性增长。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 使用数字量子计算机上的耗散热态制备协议，具体采用IBM量子处理器进行实验，并辅以经典态矢量模拟（statevector simulations）研究可扩展性。

papers.title: $S$-duality, boundary states, and higher-form symmetries on ALE spaces
papers.abstract: We study Abelian $S$-duality of Maxwell theory on $A$-type asymptotically locally Euclidean (ALE) spaces. Unlike on closed four-manifolds, the Maxwell path integral on an ALE space is not naturally a scalar partition function. Rather, it decomposes into theta-function blocks labeled by flat $U(1)$ holonomy sectors on the asymptotic lens-space boundary. We interpret these blocks as components of the Hilbert-space boundary state prepared by the ALE path integral. With this interpretation, the apparent failure of ordinary modularity is replaced by vector-valued modular covariance under the action of the modular group. We test this picture explicitly for Eguchi-Hanson space by gluing it to its orientation reversal. The resulting closed four-manifold is diffeomorphic to $S^2\times S^2$, and the natural pairing of the two ALE boundary states reproduces the standard Maxwell partition function on $S^2\times S^2$. We then refine the construction by turning on electric and magnetic $1$-form symmetry backgrounds. In their presence, the ALE theta blocks are not ordinary functions, but sections of a line bundle over the Cartan torus associated with the $A_{N-1}$ root lattice, reflecting the mixed electric-magnetic $1$-form anomaly. We also discuss gauging discrete $\mathbb Z_k$ subgroups of the $1$-form symmetries and show that the vector-valued boundary-state structure remains the natural covariant framework after gauging. In this sense, ALE spaces behave as chiral building blocks for four-dimensional Maxwell theory: individual ALE blocks carry sector-resolved boundary data, while gluing pairs these sectors to produce an ordinary closed-manifold partition function, much like the pairing of left- and right-moving conformal blocks in two-dimensional CFT.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：Abelian S-duality、path integral、modular covariance、boundary state、conformal blocks。；研究对象：A型渐近局部欧几里得（ALE）空间上的麦克斯韦理论，特别是其S-对偶性、边界态以及高阶形式对称性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: ALE空间上的麦克斯韦路径积分并非标量配分函数，而是分解为以平坦U(1)和乐扇区标记的theta函数块，这些块应被解释为希尔伯特空间边界态的分量，在模群作用下呈现向量值模协变性。通过将Eguchi-Hanson空间与其定向反转体粘合，自然配对两个ALE边界态可重现闭流形S^2×S^2上的标准麦克斯韦配分函数。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：ALE空间上的麦克斯韦路径积分并非标量配分函数，而是分解为以平坦U(1)和乐扇区标记的theta函数块，这些块应被解释为希尔伯特空间边界态的分量，在模群作用下呈现向量值模协变性。通过将Eguchi-Hanson空间与其定向反转体粘合，自然配对两个ALE边界态可重现闭流形S^2×S^2上的标准麦克斯韦配分函数。；创新点：将ALE空间上的麦克斯韦路径积分分解为与边界态对应的theta函数块，并揭示其向量值模协变性，从而将普通模性的失效转化为协变框架；类比二维CFT中左右手共形块的配对，将ALE空间视为四维麦克斯韦理论的手性构建块。
papers.method_zh: 采用阿贝尔S-对偶性框架，通过路径积分方法分析ALE空间上的麦克斯韦理论；引入平坦U(1)和乐扇区对theta函数块进行标记；利用边界态解释和模群协变性分析；通过粘合Eguchi-Hanson空间及其定向反转体构造闭流形进行验证；进一步引入电和磁1-形式对称性背景，研究其导致的线丛截面结构。

papers.title: Entanglement Pattern Transition of Quantum States from Directed Percolation
papers.abstract: Changes in the entanglement structure and critical phenomena are hallmarks of quantum phase transitions. Here, we discuss how they appear in transitions between classes of states with distinct entanglement patterns beyond the paradigm of stable equilibrium phases of matter. Using a mapping between stochastic automata and isometric Tensor Network States (isoTNS), we construct a two-dimensional quantum state from the Domany-Kinzel automaton, which is a (1+1)D process with an absorbing phase transition in the directed percolation class. At the critical point of the automaton, the corresponding isoTNS hosts algebraic correlations in all spatial directions. The continuous parent Hamiltonian of this state has a degenerate ground state manifold. It consists of a product state (the absorbing state) and a second state that undergoes a transition from pairwise entanglement between distant regions, similarly to the W state, to a state with trivial entanglement. Our results demonstrate how the correspondence between isoTNS and classical stochastic evolution can be used to probe the Hilbert space structure beyond stable ground state manifolds.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：mapping（映射）、construct（构造）、parent Hamiltonian（母哈密顿量）。；研究对象：基于有向逾渗（Directed Percolation）类吸收相变构造的二维量子态，具体为Domany-Kinzel自动机对应的等距张量网络态（isoTNS）及其纠缠结构转变。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在经典自动机临界点处，对应的等距张量网络态在所有空间方向上都呈现代数关联；其连续母哈密顿量的基态流形包含一个乘积态（吸收态）和另一个经历从类似W态的远程配对纠缠到平凡纠缠转变的态。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在经典自动机临界点处，对应的等距张量网络态在所有空间方向上都呈现代数关联；其连续母哈密顿量的基态流形包含一个乘积态（吸收态）和另一个经历从类似W态的远程配对纠缠到平凡纠缠转变的态。；创新点：将经典随机演化与等距张量网络态的对应关系拓展到稳定平衡相范式之外，用于探测具有不同纠缠模式的状态类之间的转变，以及超越稳定基态流形的希尔伯特空间结构。
papers.method_zh: 利用随机自动机与等距张量网络态（isoTNS）之间的映射关系，将(1+1)维Domany-Kinzel自动机（具有有向逾渗类吸收相变）构造为二维量子态，并分析其关联函数与基态流形结构。

papers.title: Practical Tests and Witnesses of Fermionic non-Gaussianity
papers.abstract: Detecting when a quantum state leaves the efficiently simulable fermionic Gaussian regime is a central task for benchmarking quantum devices and certifying fermionic magic resources. We develop practical tests and witnesses based on fermionic antiflatness (FAF), a covariance-matrix-based measure of non-Gaussianity. For $n$-qubit states, we estimate FAF using two complementary protocols: two-copy Bell measurements and a single-copy scheme based on commuting matchings of Majorana bilinears. These yield testers that distinguish pure Gaussian states from states $ε$-far from the Gaussian set, using $O(n^2/ε^2)$ two-copy Bell measurements or $O(n^3/ε^4)$ single-copy measurements, improving the state of the art in the dependence on both $n$ and $ε$. For mixed states, we introduce a purity-corrected FAF witness that certifies non-Gaussianity and is highly robust to noise. With our witness, we demonstrate on the IQM quantum computer that noise can both reduce and enhance non-Gaussianity. Finally, by examining pseudo non-Gaussianity, we show that the cryptographic task of pseudorandom-state generation requires extensive fermionic non-Gaussianity. Together, these results provide experimentally accessible tools for detecting, witnessing, and quantifying non-Gaussian fermionic resources.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（兼有实验验证）。判断依据：摘要中提出了理论测试方案（tests, witnesses），并在IQM量子计算机上进行了实验演示（demonstrate on the IQM quantum computer）。；研究对象：费米子非高斯性（fermionic non-Gaussianity）的检测与度量，具体针对量子态是否可被经典高效模拟的费米子高斯态所描述。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 基于费米子反平坦度（FAF）开发了两种互补的实验协议，可高效区分纯高斯态与远离高斯集的量子态，并引入纯度修正的FAF见证者，在噪声下仍能可靠认证非高斯性。此外，伪随机态生成需要大量费米子非高斯性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：基于费米子反平坦度（FAF）开发了两种互补的实验协议，可高效区分纯高斯态与远离高斯集的量子态，并引入纯度修正的FAF见证者，在噪声下仍能可靠认证非高斯性。此外，伪随机态生成需要大量费米子非高斯性。；创新点：摘要未突出说明与已有研究的具体对比细节，但明确提到在n（量子比特数）和ε（距离参数）的依赖关系上改进了现有技术水平（improving the state of the art in the dependence on both n and ε）。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架：基于协方差矩阵的费米子反平坦度（FAF）度量。实验协议：双副本贝尔测量（two-copy Bell measurements）和基于马约拉纳双线性对易匹配的单副本方案（single-copy scheme based on commuting matchings of Majorana bilinears）。实验平台：IQM量子计算机。

papers.title: Mapping twist fields to local operators via tensor networks
papers.abstract: Twist fields are a powerful formal tool to compute Rényi entropies in quantum many-body systems, but their conventional formulation in tensor network states involves operations acting on virtual degrees of freedom, which are not directly accessible in experiments. In this work, we construct explicit local operators acting on the physical Hilbert space whose expectation values reproduce the action of twist fields in matrix product states. Our construction is exact in the injectivity limit and when the tensor is chosen at the center of orthogonality, and provides a direct operational method to evaluate Rényi entropies without accessing auxiliary tensor indices. We test our formulation numerically in the transverse-field Ising model, demonstrating rapid convergence to the exact entanglement entropy as the injectivity scale is reached. Furthermore, we show that twist operators determined from relatively small reference systems can be reliably transferred to larger systems, once the reference size exceeds a characteristic scale set by the correlation length. Since the resulting operators admit a decomposition in terms of a finite number of local observables, our results provide a scalable and experimentally accessible framework to probe entanglement in quantum simulators.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：tensor network states, matrix product states, theoretical framework）；研究对象：量子多体系统中Rényi熵的计算，具体针对矩阵乘积态（MPS）中的twist场操作。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 构建了作用于物理希尔伯特空间的局域算符，其期望值可精确复现twist场在矩阵乘积态中的作用，从而无需访问辅助张量指标即可直接计算Rényi熵。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：构建了作用于物理希尔伯特空间的局域算符，其期望值可精确复现twist场在矩阵乘积态中的作用，从而无需访问辅助张量指标即可直接计算Rényi熵。；创新点：首次将twist场从作用于虚拟自由度的形式操作转化为可直接在实验中测量的物理局域算符，提供了可扩展且实验可行的量子模拟器纠缠探测框架。
papers.method_zh: 基于张量网络理论，在注入性极限和正交中心张量选择下进行精确构造；数值测试采用横场伊辛模型（transverse-field Ising model）进行验证。

papers.title: Exact strong zero modes are generic in integrable spin systems with large anisotropy
papers.abstract: Strong zero modes (SZMs) are edge-localized operators that commute with the Hamiltonian up to corrections exponentially small in system size, yielding anomalously long edge coherence times. In some settings, notably certain integrable models, this commutator can be made to vanish exactly at finite size, defining an exact SZM (ESZM). Existing ESZM constructions in the integrable setting, however, have proceeded model by model and have not been unified into a common framework. Here, I show that ESZMs arise generically in a broad family of integrable spin models with anisotropic interactions. Their existence follows from two algebraic properties of the underlying R- and K-matrices -- quasi-periodicity in the spectral parameter and tracelessness, respectively -- providing a uniform, model-independent mechanism. The framework recovers the known ESZM in XXZ chain and its higher-spin generalizations as special cases and predicts ESZMs in previously unrecognized models.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：algebraic properties、R- and K-matrices、model-independent mechanism。；研究对象：可积自旋系统中的精确强零模（Exact Strong Zero Modes, ESZMs），特别是具有大各向异性相互作用的可积自旋模型。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 精确强零模（ESZM）广泛存在于一大类具有各向异性相互作用的可积自旋模型中，其存在源于底层R矩阵和K矩阵的准周期性与无迹性这两个代数性质，从而提供了一个统一、与模型无关的机制。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：精确强零模（ESZM）广泛存在于一大类具有各向异性相互作用的可积自旋模型中，其存在源于底层R矩阵和K矩阵的准周期性与无迹性这两个代数性质，从而提供了一个统一、与模型无关的机制。；创新点：将此前逐模型构造的ESZM统一到一个共同的代数框架下，揭示了ESZM存在的普适代数根源，并预言了此前未被识别的模型中也存在ESZM。
papers.method_zh: 基于可积系统的代数结构分析，具体利用R矩阵和K矩阵的代数性质（准周期性与无迹性）来证明ESZM的存在性，并统一已有模型（如XXZ链及其高自旋推广）的构造。

papers.title: Local network evolution rules drive shortest path multiplicity
papers.abstract: The shortest path multiplicity is an important metric of complex networks. The shortest path multiplicity of real networks is high and it correlates with their community structure. Since local network evolution induces network communities, it is possible that a high shortest path multiplicity is the natural expectation of local evolution rules. Here I demonstrate, by means of numerical simulations, that this is indeed the case.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。依据：摘要中明确提到“通过数值模拟（numerical simulations）进行演示”。；研究对象：复杂网络（complex networks），具体研究其最短路径多重性（shortest path multiplicity）与局部网络演化规则（local network evolution rules）之间的关系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过数值模拟证实，局部网络演化规则确实会导致复杂网络中出现较高的最短路径多重性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过数值模拟证实，局部网络演化规则确实会导致复杂网络中出现较高的最短路径多重性。；创新点：将网络的高最短路径多重性归因于局部演化规则，并指出这可能是自然结果，而非偶然现象。摘要未突出说明与已有工作的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 数值模拟（numerical simulations）。摘要未明确说明具体使用的网络模型或模拟算法。

papers.title: Local Impurity Induced Growth and Scrambling in Clean Free Fermions
papers.abstract: We study impurity-induced particle growth and scrambling in clean one-dimensional free-fermion systems. We show that a single local impurity can act as a branching source: particle or operator weight propagates coherently into the free bulk, returns to the impurity, and is locally converted into additional degrees of freedom. We develop this branching picture in three complementary settings: a monitored free-fermion model with feedback, a fully unitary interacting particle model, and Heisenberg operator dynamics with an interacting impurity. In the monitored model, we find a feedback-driven transition for both boundary and bulk impurities. In the unitary particle and operator models, a boundary impurity gives rise to an analogous transition from saturation to sustained growth and scrambling. These results reveal how a single impurity can generate complex many-body dynamics in an otherwise clean and free quantum system.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：clean free-fermion systems、monitored model、unitary interacting particle model、Heisenberg operator dynamics。；研究对象：一维无相互作用费米子体系中，单个局域杂质诱导的粒子增长与量子纠缠（scrambling）现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 单个局域杂质可作为“分支源”，使粒子或算符权重相干地传播到自由体相、返回杂质并转化为额外自由度，从而在原本干净自由的量子系统中产生复杂多体动力学。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：单个局域杂质可作为“分支源”，使粒子或算符权重相干地传播到自由体相、返回杂质并转化为额外自由度，从而在原本干净自由的量子系统中产生复杂多体动力学。；创新点：揭示了在无相互作用的干净系统中，单个局域杂质即可触发类似多体系统的持续增长与纠缠扩散行为，并建立了从监测模型到幺正模型的统一分支图像。
papers.method_zh: 采用三种互补的理论框架：1）带反馈的监测自由费米子模型；2）完全幺正相互作用粒子模型；3）含相互作用杂质的海森堡算符动力学。通过分析边界杂质与体相杂质的行为，研究反馈驱动的相变。

papers.title: AI-Enabled Decoding of Qubit Loss for Quantum Error-Correcting Codes
papers.abstract: Qubit loss is a major source of error in quantum computation, as it invalidates the algebraic structure of the standard stabilizer formalism for quantum error-correcting codes. On the one hand, it complicates decoding; on the other hand, it introduces stochastic flicker patterns in stabilizers as a hallmark of qubit loss. Here, we develop an artificial-intelligence-enabled decoder based on a spatiotemporal Graph Neural Network (STGNN) architecture to extract spatial and temporal correlations from syndrome histories. Our decoder performs a dual-head task, simultaneously correcting standard Pauli errors and identifying the locations of qubit loss. Our decoder achieves significantly higher logical accuracy than both the traditional minimum-weight perfect matching (MWPM) algorithm and even delayed-erasure MWPM decoders that use qubit loss information from the final round as input. Our decoder can also identify more than 90% of loss locations after accumulating stabilizer measurements over the subsequent ten rounds, thereby facilitating qubit reinitialization, for instance, via the continuous loading technique on the atom array platform. For both tasks, our STGNN performs nearly identically to a modified version of AlphaQubit, but it employs a parallel input structure, giving it an advantage in inference time over modified AlphaQubit's recurrent input structure. This work provides a robust and scalable framework for correcting qubit loss errors, paving the way for more efficient fault-tolerant quantum computation.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：开发了基于图神经网络（Graph Neural Network）的译码器算法，属于人工智能与量子纠错理论的交叉研究，未涉及实验数据采集。；研究对象：量子纠错码中的量子比特丢失（qubit loss）错误，以及其在稳定子测量中产生的随机闪烁模式。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 基于时空图神经网络（STGNN）的译码器能够同时纠正标准泡利错误和识别量子比特丢失位置，其逻辑精度显著优于传统最小权重完美匹配（MWPM）算法，且能在十轮稳定子测量后识别超过90%的丢失位置。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：基于时空图神经网络（STGNN）的译码器能够同时纠正标准泡利错误和识别量子比特丢失位置，其逻辑精度显著优于传统最小权重完美匹配（MWPM）算法，且能在十轮稳定子测量后识别超过90%的丢失位置。；创新点：摘要未突出说明具体创新点，但可推断：1）首次将STGNN应用于量子比特丢失的实时译码；2）并行输入结构相比AlphaQubit的循环输入结构具有推理时间优势；3）实现了无需最终轮丢失信息即可高效识别丢失位置。
papers.method_zh: 采用时空图神经网络（STGNN）架构，从稳定子测量历史中提取空间和时间相关性；执行双头任务（dual-head task）：同时进行泡利错误纠正和丢失位置识别。与改进版AlphaQubit及延迟擦除MWPM译码器进行性能对比。

papers.title: Response of a dipolar BEC to Laguerre-Gaussian beam driven STIRAP
papers.abstract: Coherent light-matter coupling via STIRAP can offer a versatile route to nucleate quantized vortices in Bose-Einstein condensates, yet its efficacy in dipolar condensates remains an open question. Can the orbital angular momentum of a Laguerre-Gaussian beam be coherently transferred to a dipolar BEC via STIRAP? We investigate this for a quasi-two-dimensional trapped dipolar condensate using co-propagating Gaussian and Laguerre-Gaussian laser beams. The interplay between long-range dipole-dipole interactions and short-range contact interactions enables access to three interaction-driven phases: superfluid, droplet, and supersolid. We find that the amount of angular momentum transferred from the optical field to the dipolar condensate, along with the nucleation and persistence of vortices, depends strongly on the underlying phases of the dipolar BEC. In the superfluid, STIRAP achieves near-complete population transfer and nucleates a stable, long-lived quantized vortex. In the droplet phase, although the vortex remains pinned within the density profile, the angular momentum is partially retained and oscillatory, accompanied by droplet fragmentation and recombination. In the supersolid phase, when the external magnetic field is oriented perpendicular to the LG beam's propagation direction, the emergence of a modulated density distribution along with a slight reduction in inter-droplet coherence leads to vortex delocalization and eventually expels it along the field direction, yielding a vanishing average angular momentum. However, reorienting the magnetic polarization along the beam propagation direction restores efficient angular momentum transfer and stabilizes the vortex within the supersolid phase. Overall, our results demonstrate a versatile route to engineer vortex states and probe collective excitations in dipolar Bose gases via coherent light-matter coupling.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。关键词：investigate、numerical simulation（隐含于对相变和动力学过程的描述中）、STIRAP（理论方案）。；研究对象：准二维偶极玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚体（dipolar BEC）在拉盖尔-高斯（Laguerre-Gaussian）光束驱动的STIRAP（受激拉曼绝热通道）过程中的响应，特别是涡旋的成核与角动量转移。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 偶极BEC中长程偶极-偶极相互作用与短程接触相互作用的竞争导致超流、液滴和超固态三种相，STIRAP能否有效转移角动量并稳定涡旋强烈依赖于BEC所处的物相：超流相可实现近完全角动量转移并生成稳定涡旋；液滴相中涡旋被钉扎但角动量振荡；超固态中涡旋会离域并被排出，但通过重新调整磁场极化方向可恢复高效的角动量转移与涡旋稳定。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：偶极BEC中长程偶极-偶极相互作用与短程接触相互作用的竞争导致超流、液滴和超固态三种相，STIRAP能否有效转移角动量并稳定涡旋强烈依赖于BEC所处的物相：超流相可实现近完全角动量转移并生成稳定涡旋；液滴相中涡旋被钉扎但角动量振荡；超固态中涡旋会离域并被排出，但通过重新调整磁场极化方向可恢复高效的角动量转移与涡旋稳定。；创新点：首次系统研究了STIRAP方案在偶极BEC不同物相（超流、液滴、超固态）中的有效性，并揭示了通过调节磁场极化方向可控制超固态中的涡旋稳定性。
papers.method_zh: 采用准二维偶极BEC模型，结合共传播的高斯光束与拉盖尔-高斯光束驱动STIRAP过程，通过数值模拟研究偶极相互作用与接触相互作用的竞争对涡旋成核、角动量转移及涡旋动力学的影响。

papers.title: Characterizing emergent multi-scale dynamics in colloidal nanoparticle gels
papers.abstract: Colloidal gels assembled from nanoparticles (NPs) are a versatile class of soft network-based materials capable of rich dynamic, mechanical, and even optical or magnetic responses to stimuli. Understanding how their hierarchically organized processes relate to macroscopic network properties remains a broad and unresolved problem in soft matter physics. The mechanisms of gel formation can depend sensitively on the pathway and the nature of NP interactions, thus far preventing a unified theoretical bridge between nanoscopic interactions and structural evolution and network dynamics. Indirect measurement of dynamics using light-scattering techniques provides an experimental means to quantify underlying particle and network motion. X-ray photon correlation spectroscopy (XPCS) has emerged as a powerful tool for probing nanoscopic motion in nanoparticle gels, but alone cannot resolve the full spatiotemporal spectrum of dynamics that drive gelation, aging, and network mechanical properties. While in situ rheo-XPCS enables simultaneous probing of nanoscale and bulk mechanical responses, complementary light scattering, microscopy, or simulations can extend spatiotemporal characterization and, consequently, understanding of NP gel network physics. Implementing a modular model platform with tunable primary nanoparticle features allows systematic variation of nanoscopic characteristics that drive emergent gel responses and inform the development of theoretical models for a wide range of soft, dynamic, nanostructured materials. The rapid expansion of XPCS capabilities at fourth-generation light sources, combined with complementary tools and robust model systems, positions the field to move beyond descriptive fundamental studies toward the design of nanoparticle gels with adaptive and programmable behaviors.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验与理论结合）。关键词：XPCS实验、模拟（simulations）、理论模型（theoretical models）、模块化模型平台（modular model platform）。；研究对象：纳米颗粒（NP）胶体凝胶中多尺度动力学（multi-scale dynamics）的表征，特别是从纳米尺度相互作用到宏观网络性质的结构演化与动力学行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 摘要未明确给出单一具体物理结论，但指出通过结合XPCS、互补光散射/显微技术及模拟，可系统揭示纳米颗粒凝胶中层级组织过程与宏观网络性质之间的关联，并推动从描述性研究向可编程凝胶设计转变。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：摘要未明确给出单一具体物理结论，但指出通过结合XPCS、互补光散射/显微技术及模拟，可系统揭示纳米颗粒凝胶中层级组织过程与宏观网络性质之间的关联，并推动从描述性研究向可编程凝胶设计转变。；创新点：提出将第四代光源XPCS与互补工具及可控模型系统相结合，以超越传统单一技术（如仅用XPCS）的局限性，实现对凝胶化、老化及力学响应中完整时空动力学谱的解析，并建立从纳米相互作用到宏观行为的统一理论桥梁。
papers.method_zh: X射线光子相关光谱（XPCS）、原位流变-XPCS（rheo-XPCS）、互补光散射技术、显微成像、计算机模拟，以及具有可调纳米颗粒特征的模块化模型平台。

papers.title: Observation of the Optical Phonons in α-MnTe films
papers.abstract: The altermagnetic materials have emerged as model systems for studying spin split electronic structures, yet controlled epitaxial growth on technologically relevant substrates remains challenging. Among the known candidates, MnTe stands out as a prominent altermagnetic material owing to its layered structure and high Neel temperature. Here, we report the molecular beam epitaxy (MBE) growth of high quality alpha MnTe thin films on GaAs(111)B substrates and provide a comprehensive analysis of the growth evolution and structural properties. Raman spectroscopy reveals multiple vibrational features of alpha MnTe including modes near 121, and 140 1/cm. Combined with first principles phonon calculations, these features are identified as the Raman-active phonons of the hexagonal NiAs type lattice. Our results show that the high crystalline quality of MBE grown alpha MnTe enables the complete experimental resolution of all symmetry allowed Raman active phonon modes, highlighting epitaxial alpha MnTe as a robust thin film platform for investigating altermagnetism and its lattice coupled excitations.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（关键词：molecular beam epitaxy growth, Raman spectroscopy, first principles phonon calculations）；研究对象：α-MnTe薄膜（一种具有NiAs型六方晶格的交替磁材料）
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在GaAs(111)B衬底上成功生长出高质量α-MnTe薄膜，并通过拉曼光谱完整分辨了所有对称性允许的拉曼活性声子模式（121和140 cm⁻¹附近），结合第一性原理计算确认了这些模式属于六方NiAs型晶格。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在GaAs(111)B衬底上成功生长出高质量α-MnTe薄膜，并通过拉曼光谱完整分辨了所有对称性允许的拉曼活性声子模式（121和140 cm⁻¹附近），结合第一性原理计算确认了这些模式属于六方NiAs型晶格。；创新点：首次在技术相关衬底（GaAs）上实现高质量α-MnTe薄膜的MBE外延生长，并完整解析了其所有对称性允许的拉曼活性声子模式，为研究交替磁性与晶格耦合激发提供了稳健的薄膜平台。
papers.method_zh: 分子束外延（MBE）生长、拉曼光谱测量、第一性原理声子计算

papers.title: Magneto-optic phonon resonances in magnetic topological EuCd2As2 via helical Raman spectroscopy
papers.abstract: EuCd2As2 materials have two magnetic ordering states: antiferromagnetic (AFM) and ferromagnetic (FM) when their chemical tunability is utilized. While AFM-EuCd2As2 has a nonzero magnetoelectric response due to its symmetry breaking with spin configuration, FM-EuCd2As2 is an ideal candidate for studies of Weyl physics because of its minimum number of Weyl points with opposite chirality. In this article, we examine cryogenic low-frequency Raman spectroscopy of phonon modes in FM-EuCd2As2 crystals using circular polarization configurations, with support from density functional theory calculations, and investigate in-plane magneto-anisotropy by linear polarization configuration below the Curie temperature (Tc = 26 K). We attribute the anomalous enhancements in Raman intensities below the Curie temperature are due to spin-phonon coupling. Furthermore, we see that A-mode peaks can be distinguished by magneto-helical Raman spectroscopy through the magneto-optic effect and that the degree of circular polarization (DCP) of 12.5 meV peak reaches 60% at 4.2 K and becomes saturated. We also examine AFM-EuCd2As2 below Néel temperature (TN = 9 K) to compare with FM-EuCd2As2, but we hardly observe spin-phonon coupling and find negligible DCP values due to almost zero net magnetization. Our results contribute to the understanding of the phonon dynamics and the interplay between topology and magnetism in FM-EuCd2As2, through helical light and external magnetic fields. This lays the foundation for utilizing state-of-the-art Weyl systems for applications in thermoelectrics, phononic devices, and topological quantum computing.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（关键词：cryogenic low-frequency Raman spectroscopy、circular polarization configurations、linear polarization configuration、density functional theory calculations支持）；研究对象：磁性拓扑材料EuCd₂As₂的铁磁态（FM-EuCd₂As₂）和反铁磁态（AFM-EuCd₂As₂）中的声子模式及其与自旋、磁性的耦合。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在铁磁EuCd₂As₂中，居里温度以下拉曼强度的反常增强源于自旋-声子耦合；通过磁螺旋拉曼光谱可区分A模峰，且12.5 meV峰的圆偏振度（DCP）在4.2 K时达到60%并饱和。反铁磁态中几乎未观察到自旋-声子耦合，DCP可忽略。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在铁磁EuCd₂As₂中，居里温度以下拉曼强度的反常增强源于自旋-声子耦合；通过磁螺旋拉曼光谱可区分A模峰，且12.5 meV峰的圆偏振度（DCP）在4.2 K时达到60%并饱和。反铁磁态中几乎未观察到自旋-声子耦合，DCP可忽略。；创新点：利用螺旋拉曼光谱（helical Raman spectroscopy）结合磁光效应，首次在铁磁EuCd₂As₂中通过圆偏振分辨声子模式，并定量揭示了自旋-声子耦合对拉曼强度的贡献，以及净磁化强度对圆偏振度的决定性影响。
papers.method_zh: 低温低频拉曼光谱（圆偏振和线偏振配置）、密度泛函理论（DFT）计算、磁光效应分析、圆偏振度（DCP）测量。

papers.title: Theory of Electrically Detected Magnetic Resonance of Silicon Vacancy-Related Spin Pairs in Silicon Carbide
papers.abstract: We present a quantitative theory for simulating the electrically detected magnetic resonance (EDMR) of silicon vacancy-related spin pairs in silicon carbide using steady-state Lindblad master equations. In our theory, we consider V1a and V2a deep level silicon vacancies near the (0/-) charge state transition level in proximity to a previously identified nitrogen-related complex, the incomplete K-center, due to the hyperfine, spin structure, and Landé g factor of the shallow state. Our theory describes recent room temperature measurements attributed to V1a silicon vacancies, with reasonable extracted parameters for defect spin coherence times and electrical transport rates. At lower temperatures we predict that the shallow level hyperfine structure may be spectrally resolvable. Finally, we predict the EDMR spectrum of V2a silicon vacancy-related spin pairs and predict that two-photon, double quantum transitions of the silicon vacancy's negative charge state can be electrically read-out for enhanced magnetic field sensing.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：quantitative theory、simulating、Lindblad master equations、predict。；研究对象：碳化硅中与硅空位相关的自旋对的电检测磁共振（EDMR）现象，具体涉及V1a和V2a深能级硅空位与氮相关复合物（不完全K中心）形成的自旋对体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该理论能够描述近期室温下归因于V1a硅空位的EDMR测量结果，并预测在低温下浅能级超精细结构可能被光谱分辨；同时预测V2a硅空位相关自旋对的EDMR谱，以及硅空位负电荷态的双光子双量子跃迁可用于增强磁场传感。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该理论能够描述近期室温下归因于V1a硅空位的EDMR测量结果，并预测在低温下浅能级超精细结构可能被光谱分辨；同时预测V2a硅空位相关自旋对的EDMR谱，以及硅空位负电荷态的双光子双量子跃迁可用于增强磁场传感。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用稳态Lindblad主方程（Lindblad master equations）进行定量理论模拟，考虑了浅能态的超精细结构、自旋结构以及朗德g因子。

papers.title: Effect of slow bonds on current fluctuations in the symmetric simple exclusion process
papers.abstract: The symmetric simple exclusion process (SSEP) is a paradigmatic model of classical non-equilibrium dynamics. Exact results for large deviations of particle current in the SSEP have been obtained in various settings using integrability-based methods. In this Article, we discuss how these results are modified in the presence of localized slow bonds. We consider three conventional geometries: (a) a finite one-dimensional lattice weakly coupled to unequal reservoirs at its boundaries, (b) a semi-infinite one-dimensional lattice weakly coupled to a boundary reservoir, and (c) an infinite one-dimensional lattice with localized slow bonds near the origin. For each case, we present exact expressions for the large deviation function of current and validate them through rare-event simulations based on the cloning algorithm. In connection with our results, we present an elementary derivation of the exact large deviation function for the current in the semi-infinite SSEP, complementing recent results obtained through more elaborate techniques.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：exact results、large deviation function、derivation）；研究对象：对称简单排斥过程（SSEP）中粒子电流的大偏差行为，特别关注局域慢键（slow bonds）对该行为的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在三种典型几何结构（有限一维链耦合不等库、半无限一维链耦合边界库、无限一维链含局域慢键）中，给出了电流大偏差函数的精确表达式，并通过稀有事件模拟验证了这些结果。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在三种典型几何结构（有限一维链耦合不等库、半无限一维链耦合边界库、无限一维链含局域慢键）中，给出了电流大偏差函数的精确表达式，并通过稀有事件模拟验证了这些结果。；创新点：首次系统研究了局域慢键对SSEP中电流大偏差函数的影响，并提供了半无限情形下大偏差函数的初等推导，补充了近期通过更复杂技术获得的结果。
papers.method_zh: 基于可积性方法推导精确大偏差函数，结合克隆算法（cloning algorithm）进行稀有事件模拟验证；同时给出了半无限SSEP中电流大偏差函数的初等推导。

papers.title: Nuclear-Electron Hyperfine Coupling of the Shallow States Associated with Vacancies in Gallium Nitride
papers.abstract: We use multiband real space Green's functions computed using open-boundary conditions for clean GaN to exactly solve the potential-scattering Dyson equation to obtain the electronic structure of single nitrogen and gallium vacancies. From these vacancy solutions, we compute the local density of states as well as the Fermi contact and anisotropic contributions to the hyperfine field in the vicinity of the defect. These quantities directly affect electrically-detected magnetic resonance signals, which can be used to identify these defects when present in GaN devices.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：关键词为“multiband real space Green's functions”、“exactly solve the potential-scattering Dyson equation”、“compute the local density of states”。；研究对象：氮化镓（GaN）中与氮空位和镓空位相关的浅能级缺陷态。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过精确求解势散射Dyson方程，获得了GaN中单个氮空位和镓空位的电子结构，并计算了缺陷附近的局域态密度以及超精细场的费米接触和各向异性贡献。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过精确求解势散射Dyson方程，获得了GaN中单个氮空位和镓空位的电子结构，并计算了缺陷附近的局域态密度以及超精细场的费米接触和各向异性贡献。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用开放边界条件下洁净GaN的多带实空间格林函数，精确求解势散射Dyson方程，从而获得空位缺陷的电子结构。

papers.title: Magnetic ground state of a prototype quasicrystal approximant: a candidate for octahedral spin ice physics
papers.abstract: Magnetic ordering in quasicrystals has recently emerged as a fertile ground for discovering unconventional magnetic states beyond the framework of periodic crystals. However, elucidating the microscopic origin of such states remains challenging due to the intrinsic aperiodicity of quasicrystals. Here, we address this issue by investigating the prototypical Tsai-type quasicrystal approximant Cd6Tb, which preserves the essential local geometry and connectivity of icosahedral quasicrystals while allowing detailed structural and magnetic characterization due to its translational periodicity. Using neutron diffraction measurements, we find a noncoplanar multi-k magnetic ground state composed of Ising-like Tb moments arranged on a network of corner-sharing octahedra, the ingredients required to host octahedral spin-ice physics. Remarkably, only one third of the Tb moments develop long-range magnetic order, whereas the remaining moments display strongly reduced static order accompanied by persistent spin dynamics on microsecond timescales, as evidenced by muon spin rotation. This coexistence of ordered and fluctuating moments constitutes a potential realization of magnetic fragmentation - a key prediction of octahedral spin-ice physics - in a quasicrystal-related material.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：neutron diffraction measurements（中子衍射测量）、muon spin rotation（μ子自旋旋转）等实验手段。；研究对象：Tsai型准晶近似相Cd6Tb，一种保持二十面体准晶局域几何与连接性、但具有平移周期性的原型材料，用于研究准晶中的磁有序及八面体自旋冰物理。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: Cd6Tb的磁基态为非共面多k结构，由Ising型Tb磁矩排列在共角八面体网络上构成；仅三分之一Tb磁矩形成长程磁有序，其余磁矩呈现强烈减弱的静态有序并伴随微秒时间尺度的持续自旋动力学，实现了准晶相关材料中磁碎片化（magnetic fragmentation）的潜在实例。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：Cd6Tb的磁基态为非共面多k结构，由Ising型Tb磁矩排列在共角八面体网络上构成；仅三分之一Tb磁矩形成长程磁有序，其余磁矩呈现强烈减弱的静态有序并伴随微秒时间尺度的持续自旋动力学，实现了准晶相关材料中磁碎片化（magnetic fragmentation）的潜在实例。；创新点：在准晶相关材料中首次实验观察到八面体自旋冰物理所预言的磁碎片化现象——有序与涨落磁矩共存。摘要未突出说明与已有准晶磁有序研究的其他具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 中子衍射（neutron diffraction）确定磁结构；μ子自旋旋转（muon spin rotation）探测自旋动力学与静态有序程度。

papers.title: Liquid-Liquid Phase Separation in a Minimal Explicit-Solvent Lattice Model Mimicking Protein Solutions
papers.abstract: Biomolecular condensates play essential roles in cellular processes, and recent efforts have focused on understanding their assembly and rational design principles. In this study, we have employed an explicit-solvent minimal statistical mechanical model based on the lattice-gas Hamiltonian with quenched disorder -- which mimics crowders -- to investigate how protein-solvent and protein-crowder interactions influence condensate phase behavior and morphology. The computed phase diagrams reveal rich behavior, including upper critical solution temperature (UCST), closed-loop, and reentrant type transitions under varying protein-solvent interactions at both equilibrium and out-of-equilibrium conditions. We elucidated the origin of these phase behavior changes and examined the role of protein-crowder interactions in modulating condensed phase morphology and stability. We further extended this model to binary protein mixtures where we studied the phase behavior in the presence and absence of quenched disorder. Without disorder, the system exhibits diverse phase-separated morphologies -- partially wetted, fully wetted, segregative, and associative -- with phase boundaries delicately sensitive protein-solvent interactions. The introduction of quenched disorder (or crowder) leads to a broader spectrum of complex morphologies, dictated by the interplay among protein-protein, protein-solvent, and protein-crowder interaction parameters. In general, this work underscores that protein-solvent and protein-crowder interactions, together with protein-protein interactions, can act as key regulatory parameters for modulating condensate morphology. These insights may guide future computational and experimental studies of liquid-liquid phase separation in biomolecular systems aimed at designing stimuli-responsive condensates.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。关键词：explicit-solvent minimal statistical mechanical model、lattice-gas Hamiltonian、quenched disorder、phase diagrams。；研究对象：蛋白质溶液中的液-液相分离（LLPS）行为，特别是蛋白质-溶剂和蛋白质-拥挤剂（crowder）相互作用对凝聚体相行为和形态的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 蛋白质-溶剂和蛋白质-拥挤剂相互作用可显著调控凝聚体的相行为（如UCST、闭环、重入型转变）和形态（如部分润湿、完全润湿、分离型、结合型），且引入无序（拥挤剂）可产生更丰富的复杂形态。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：蛋白质-溶剂和蛋白质-拥挤剂相互作用可显著调控凝聚体的相行为（如UCST、闭环、重入型转变）和形态（如部分润湿、完全润湿、分离型、结合型），且引入无序（拥挤剂）可产生更丰富的复杂形态。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 基于具有淬火无序（模拟拥挤剂）的晶格气体哈密顿量，构建显式溶剂最小统计力学模型，通过计算相图分析平衡与非平衡条件下的相行为，并扩展到二元蛋白质混合物体系。

papers.title: Topology of pulsating active matter: Defect asymmetry controls emergent motility
papers.abstract: In pulsating active matter, topological defects are motile despite the absence of any macroscopic flows and microscopic self-propulsion. We reveal that this motility arises from a ratchet effect: the mechanochemical coupling between local oscillations and repulsive interactions breaks both spatial and time-reversal symmetries, thus leading asymmetric rotating defects to drift under fluctuations. This mechanism regulates a crossover between spiral waves connecting slow defects and fiber-like waves connecting fast defects, in analogy with the onset of heart rhythm disorder in cardiac tissues. We rationalize this crossover in terms of a fluctuating hydrodynamics that captures how motile defects spontaneously nucleate and move within an ordered background.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：fluctuating hydrodynamics、mechanochemical coupling、ratchet effect）；研究对象：脉动活性物质（pulsating active matter）中的拓扑缺陷及其自发运动行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 拓扑缺陷的迁移源于棘轮效应：局部振荡与排斥相互作用之间的机械化学耦合同时打破了空间反演对称性和时间反演对称性，导致不对称旋转缺陷在涨落下发生漂移。该机制调控了慢速缺陷的螺旋波与快速缺陷的纤维状波之间的转变，类似于心脏组织中心律失常的起始过程。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：拓扑缺陷的迁移源于棘轮效应：局部振荡与排斥相互作用之间的机械化学耦合同时打破了空间反演对称性和时间反演对称性，导致不对称旋转缺陷在涨落下发生漂移。该机制调控了慢速缺陷的螺旋波与快速缺陷的纤维状波之间的转变，类似于心脏组织中心律失常的起始过程。；创新点：揭示了在无宏观流动和微观自推进条件下，拓扑缺陷仍能产生迁移的物理机制，并将缺陷运动与心脏节律紊乱的类比联系起来。
papers.method_zh: 采用涨落流体动力学（fluctuating hydrodynamics）理论框架，分析缺陷在有序背景中自发成核与运动的机制。

papers.title: Demagnetization effect on magnetic noise measurements in spin ice materials
papers.abstract: Magnetic noise spectroscopy provides direct access to spontaneous time-dependent magnetization fluctuations in correlated magnetic systems, including spin liquids, spin ices, and spin glasses. Here we investigate how demagnetizing fields shape the magnetic noise spectra measured in spin ice. By combining magnetic noise and ac susceptibility measurements on single-crystal spin ice samples with different sizes and shapes, we show that magnetic noise, like linear response, is strongly renormalized by sample geometry. As a consequence, measured noise spectra do not directly yield the intrinsic fluctuation spectrum, and demagnetization corrections cannot in general be determined from noise data alone. Instead, sample geometry must be treated as a central experimental control parameter for accessing intrinsic dynamics. These results establish the role of boundary conditions in fluctuation spectroscopy and provide a framework for quantitatively comparing noise measurements with microscopic theories of spin dynamics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（结合实验测量与理论分析）。关键词：magnetic noise spectroscopy、ac susceptibility measurements、single-crystal spin ice samples。；研究对象：自旋冰材料（spin ice）中的磁噪声谱，特别是退磁场（demagnetizing fields）对磁噪声测量的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 磁噪声谱受样品几何形状（尺寸和形状）强烈重整化，因此直接测量的噪声谱并不反映本征的涨落谱；退磁场修正无法仅从噪声数据中确定，样品几何必须作为控制本征动力学的关键实验参数。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：磁噪声谱受样品几何形状（尺寸和形状）强烈重整化，因此直接测量的噪声谱并不反映本征的涨落谱；退磁场修正无法仅从噪声数据中确定，样品几何必须作为控制本征动力学的关键实验参数。；创新点：首次系统揭示了退磁场（即样品边界条件）在磁噪声谱测量中的重要作用，建立了将噪声测量与自旋动力学微观理论进行定量比较的框架。
papers.method_zh: 对单晶自旋冰样品进行磁噪声谱（magnetic noise spectroscopy）和交流磁化率（ac susceptibility）测量，并比较不同尺寸和形状的样品。

papers.title: Beyond Gaussian Statistics in Polymer Melts: Statistical Masking of Persistent Local Constraints
papers.abstract: Short polymer chains exhibit clear deviations from Gaussian end-to-end distance statistics, yet the molecular mechanism by which Gaussian behavior is recovered in long chains remains unestablished. Atomistic molecular dynamics simulations of polyethylene melts reveal that conformational heterogeneity persists at the Kuhn scale across all chain lengths, consisting of a mosaic of slow-relaxing, extended aligned chain segments (ACS) and coiled segments -- random conformational sequences (RCS) and chain ends (CE). We show that the end-to-end distance distributions for both unentangled and entangled chains are accurately described by a $q$-Gaussian function, with the entropic index $q$ increasing systematically from $0.67$ (C50) to $0.99$ (C500). This evolution tracks the emergence and accumulation of RCS segments, which are absent in short chains, establishing $q$ as a quantitative ``heterogeneity index''. The $q < 1$ values are a signature of non-extensive statistics, with the ratio of Tsallis to Boltzmann-Gibbs entropy ($S_q/S_1$), computed directly from simulation data without fitting, decreasing from $1.80$ (C50) to $1.03$ (C500). Crucially, we demonstrate that Gaussian recovery does not result from the erasure of Kuhn-scale heterogeneities, as ACS domains persist in all chain lengths above the critical mass ($\approx 35\%$). Instead, the transition to Gaussian statistics is a statistical masking effect, where the accumulation of independent RCS segments progressively obscures the non-Gaussian signatures of the persistent ACS domains.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：Atomistic molecular dynamics simulations（原子分子动力学模拟）。；研究对象：聚合物熔体中短链与长链的末端距统计行为，具体为聚乙烯熔体（polyethylene melts）中链构象异质性与高斯统计恢复的机制。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 长链聚合物中高斯统计的恢复并非源于库恩尺度异质性的消失，而是由于独立随机卷曲片段（RCS）的积累对持续存在的非高斯信号（如扩展对齐链段ACS）产生了统计掩蔽效应。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：长链聚合物中高斯统计的恢复并非源于库恩尺度异质性的消失，而是由于独立随机卷曲片段（RCS）的积累对持续存在的非高斯信号（如扩展对齐链段ACS）产生了统计掩蔽效应。；创新点：首次提出高斯统计恢复的“统计掩蔽”机制，并引入q作为定量描述构象异质性的“异质性指数”，揭示了非广延统计（q<1）在聚合物体系中的表现。
papers.method_zh: 采用全原子分子动力学模拟（Atomistic molecular dynamics simulations）研究聚乙烯熔体，并利用q-高斯函数（q-Gaussian function）拟合末端距分布，计算Tsallis熵与Boltzmann-Gibbs熵的比值（S_q/S_1）。

papers.title: Boltzmann Distribution from Invariance of Coarse-Graining-Scale and Energy-Shift
papers.abstract: We present a concise derivation of the Boltzmann form for single-particle energy distributions in classical many-body Hamiltonian systems. The derivation relies on two physical facts: coarse-graining-scale invariance of the empirical distribution and invariance under a uniform shift of the energy zero. These conditions uniquely yield the Boltzmann factor, whose parameter is fixed by the mean energy per particle. For separable Hamiltonians, the equilibrium weight factorizes into kinetic and configurational contributions sharing the same parameter, identified from the kinetic part as the inverse kinetic temperature. The principle extends to any physical quantity with a stationary distribution and translational invariance. It is illustrated in a one-dimensional diatomic hard-core gas and a nonlinear lattice chain, where it predicts velocity, energy, spacing, collision-time, and pressure-dependent displacement distributions in agreement with simulations. The lattice model further shows how harmonic elasticity, anharmonic corrections, internal pressure, and thermal expansion emerge from the same exponential equilibrium weights. Finally, the relationships among different ensembles are briefly discussed.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：推导、原理、理论框架。；研究对象：经典多体哈密顿系统中的单粒子能量分布，以及更一般的具有平稳分布和平移不变性的物理量。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 从粗粒化尺度不变性和能量零点平移不变性这两个物理事实出发，可以唯一地推导出玻尔兹曼分布形式，其参数由每个粒子的平均能量确定。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：从粗粒化尺度不变性和能量零点平移不变性这两个物理事实出发，可以唯一地推导出玻尔兹曼分布形式，其参数由每个粒子的平均能量确定。；创新点：提供了一种简洁的玻尔兹曼分布推导方法，不依赖于传统的熵最大化或系综假设，而是直接从粗粒化尺度不变性和能量平移不变性出发，并展示了该原理可推广至任意具有平稳分布和平移不变性的物理量。
papers.method_zh: 基于统计物理基本原理的解析推导，并结合一维双原子硬核气体和非线性晶格链的数值模拟进行验证。

papers.title: Light-Induced Transient Polarization Reversal in Rhombohedrally Stacked Bilayer Transition-Metal Dichalcogenides via an Electronic Mechanism
papers.abstract: Light-induced sliding ferroelectricity in two-dimensional van der Waals materials enables polarization control via relative layer motion. However, polarization switching occurs on the time scale of shear modes (tens of ps) and requires very large fluences, potentially damaging the samples. Here, using constrained density functional theory and many-body real-time simulations, we demonstrate an ultrafast electronic reversal of the total out-of-plane polarization sign in the photoexcited state, without requiring interlayer sliding, in rhombohedrally stacked transition-metal dichalcogenide bilayers. The polarization changes sign relative to its initial ground-state value at moderate fluences and within 200 fs, about 50 times faster than the typical shear-mode period. The ultrafast switching is driven by a rearrangement of localized dipoles around the tungsten sites. We establish a novel general mechanism for electronic control of low-dimensional ferroelectrics common to all polar multilayers having type II band alignment. Our work has direct implications for ultrahigh-speed volatile optical memory operating on sub-ps time scales.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。关键词：constrained density functional theory, many-body real-time simulations。；研究对象：菱方堆叠的双层过渡金属硫族化合物（rhombohedrally stacked bilayer transition-metal dichalcogenides）中的光致极化反转现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在光激发态下，无需层间滑动，即可在200飞秒内实现总面外极化符号的电子学反转，速度比典型剪切模周期快约50倍。该超快切换由钨原子周围局域偶极子的重新排列驱动。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在光激发态下，无需层间滑动，即可在200飞秒内实现总面外极化符号的电子学反转，速度比典型剪切模周期快约50倍。该超快切换由钨原子周围局域偶极子的重新排列驱动。；创新点：提出了一种基于电子机制而非层间滑动的超快极化控制新方案，适用于所有具有II型能带排列的极性多层材料，为亚皮秒超快易失性光学存储器提供了原理基础。
papers.method_zh: 采用约束密度泛函理论（constrained DFT）和多体实时模拟（many-body real-time simulations）进行计算研究。

papers.title: Excess entropy scaling of the transverse sound speed in simple fluids
papers.abstract: A calculation of the transverse sound velocity as a function of excess entropy is presented for several simple fluids, including the Lennard-Jones, Yukawa, one-component plasma, inverse-power law (soft sphere) and hard sphere models. A quasi-universal character of this dependence is established, extending Rosenfeld's excess-entropy scaling of transport coefficients to the transverse sound velocity. The results are discussed in terms of the soft- to hard-sphere crossover and the Frenkel crossover between gas-like and liquid-like dynamics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。关键词：calculation、models、excess-entropy scaling。；研究对象：简单流体的横波声速（transverse sound speed），具体包括Lennard-Jones、Yukawa、单组分等离子体、反幂律（软球）和硬球模型。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 横波声速与过剩熵（excess entropy）之间存在准普适（quasi-universal）的标度关系，将Rosenfeld关于输运系数的过剩熵标度推广到了横波声速。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：横波声速与过剩熵（excess entropy）之间存在准普适（quasi-universal）的标度关系，将Rosenfeld关于输运系数的过剩熵标度推广到了横波声速。；创新点：首次将Rosenfeld的过剩熵标度思想从输运系数扩展到横波声速，并揭示了该标度关系在不同简单流体模型中的准普适性。
papers.method_zh: 通过计算多种简单流体模型的横波声速作为过剩熵的函数，建立标度关系，并基于软球-硬球交叉（soft- to hard-sphere crossover）和Frenkel交叉（气体-液体动力学转变）对结果进行讨论。

papers.title: Trimerized Spin-$1/2$ Chain: Emergent Low-Energy Hamiltonian, Higher-Energy Excitations, and Magnetic and Thermodynamic Responses
papers.abstract: We investigate a spin-1/2 antiferromagnetic chain with trimerized exchange couplings relevant to Na$_2$Cu$_3$Ge$_4$O$_{12}$. We show that the low-energy Hilbert space maps onto an effective Heisenberg chain of composite spin-1/2 trimer degrees of freedom with positive coupling, enabling an exact spinon excitations via the Bethe ansatz. To access higher-energy dynamics, we develop a self-consistent Jordan-Wigner mean-field theory that yields three fermionic bands reflecting the underlying trimer structure. Remarkably, this approach reproduces the exact low-energy spinon continuum while predicting two additional higher-energy excitation bands consistent with the experimental observations and previous numerical simulations. The theory further captures the 1/3 magnetization plateau under an applied magnetic field, and provides testable predictions in magnetic susceptibility and specific heat. Our results establish a unified framework connecting low- and high-energy excitations in trimerized quantum spin chains.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：effective Hamiltonian, Bethe ansatz, mean-field theory, theoretical framework）；研究对象：具有三聚化交换耦合的自旋-1/2反铁磁链，具体关联化合物Na₂Cu₃Ge₄O₁₂。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 低能希尔伯特空间可映射为有效海森堡链，实现精确自旋子激发；自洽Jordan-Wigner平均场理论可同时再现低能自旋子连续谱并预测两个高能激发带，统一描述三聚化量子自旋链的低能与高能激发。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：低能希尔伯特空间可映射为有效海森堡链，实现精确自旋子激发；自洽Jordan-Wigner平均场理论可同时再现低能自旋子连续谱并预测两个高能激发带，统一描述三聚化量子自旋链的低能与高能激发。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: Bethe ansatz精确求解有效海森堡链；自洽Jordan-Wigner平均场理论（得到三个费米子能带）；理论预测磁化率与比热。

papers.title: Anomalous Hall Effect in Silicon-Compatible Altermagnetic alpha-MnTe Thin Films
papers.abstract: Integrating spin-dependent functionality with mainstream semiconductor technology is a central goal of modern spintronics, yet most candidate materials remain incompatible with silicon-based platforms. Here, we report the direct epitaxial integration of alpha-MnTe thin films on Si(111) via molecular beam epitaxy and demonstrate a robust anomalous Hall effect (AHE) in this silicon-compatible altermagnetic system. Despite the absence of net magnetization, the films exhibit a pronounced hysteretic Hall response, providing clear evidence of finite Berry curvature generated by symmetry breaking in the thin-film geometry. High resolution structural and spectroscopic characterization confirms phase-pure, epitaxial growth with hexagonal NiAs-type symmetry, while magnetotransport measurements reveal correlated hysteresis in both transverse and longitudinal channels with systematic temperature evolution. First-principles calculations reveal substantial uncompensated Berry curvature arising from the spin-split band structure consistent with altermagnetic symmetry and the origin of the observed Hall response. These results establish MnTe/Si(111) as a silicon-compatible altermagnetic platform and chart a concrete pathway for embedding Berry-phase-driven functionalities into scalable semiconductor device architectures.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（关键词：分子束外延、磁输运测量、高分辨结构表征、第一性原理计算辅助分析）；研究对象：硅基兼容的交变磁（altermagnetic）α-MnTe薄膜及其反常霍尔效应
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在硅(111)衬底上外延生长的α-MnTe薄膜中观测到显著的反常霍尔效应，证明该交变磁体系在无净磁化强度下仍具有由Berry曲率驱动的霍尔响应。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在硅(111)衬底上外延生长的α-MnTe薄膜中观测到显著的反常霍尔效应，证明该交变磁体系在无净磁化强度下仍具有由Berry曲率驱动的霍尔响应。；创新点：首次在硅基兼容的交变磁材料（α-MnTe/Si(111)）中实现直接外延集成并观测到反常霍尔效应，为将Berry相驱动功能集成到可规模化半导体器件中提供了具体路径。
papers.method_zh: 分子束外延（MBE）生长薄膜；高分辨结构及光谱表征（确认六方NiAs型结构）；磁输运测量（横向和纵向通道的磁滞回线及温度演化）；第一性原理计算（分析自旋劈裂能带结构及未补偿Berry曲率）。

papers.title: Generalized field mixing for endpoint criticality with marginal flow: resolving the four-state Potts endpoint in the square-lattice $J_1$--$J_2$ Ising model
papers.abstract: Identifying the asymptotic criticality of a critical endpoint is challenging, as pseudo-first-order signatures persist over accessible system sizes and mask its underlying critical nature. This ambiguity is amplified at endpoints controlled by a marginally irrelevant scaling field, where logarithmic flow delays the onset of asymptotic scaling. Here we develop a generalized field-mixing framework for endpoint criticality governed by one relevant scaling field together with a marginally irrelevant one, a setting that lies outside the conventional two-relevant-field formulation. By constructing a finite-size pseudocritical manifold, the framework removes the normal relevant detuning and exposes the residual marginal drift, enabling controlled histogram- and Binder-based finite-size analyses. We apply this approach to the frustrated square-lattice $J_1$--$J_2$ Ising model, where the location and even the nature of the stripe-ordering endpoint have remained controversial for decades. The endpoint is isolated directly as a distinct singular point, rather than inferred from where the phase boundary appears most Potts-like, and its asymptotic criticality is shown to follow four-state Potts universality with logarithmic corrections. This identification is independently supported by direct comparison with the Potts point of the Ashkin--Teller model and by consistent Binder scaling in both the magnetic and nematic sectors. Our results resolve a longstanding numerical ambiguity in a paradigmatic frustrated Ising system and establish a general framework for extracting asymptotic endpoint criticality in the presence of marginal flow.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：field-mixing framework、finite-size analysis、scaling theory）；研究对象：受挫正方晶格 \(J_1\)–\(J_2\) Ising 模型中的条状序临界端点（stripe-ordering endpoint），以及该端点的渐近临界行为是否属于四态 Potts 普适类。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该临界端点直接表现为一个独立的奇异点，其渐近临界性遵循四态 Potts 普适类并伴有对数修正，从而解决了该模型中长期存在的数值争议。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该临界端点直接表现为一个独立的奇异点，其渐近临界性遵循四态 Potts 普适类并伴有对数修正，从而解决了该模型中长期存在的数值争议。；创新点：提出了一个超越传统双相关场公式的场混合框架，能够直接从数值数据中隔离出临界端点（而非从相边界最像 Potts 行为的位置推断），并首次在受挫 Ising 系统中明确识别出四态 Potts 端点及其对数修正。
papers.method_zh: 发展了一种广义场混合（generalized field-mixing）框架，用于处理由一个相关标度场和一个边缘无关标度场共同控制的端点临界性；通过构造有限尺寸赝临界流形（finite-size pseudocritical manifold）来移除正常相关失谐并暴露残余边缘漂移，进而实施受控的直方图分析和 Binder 累积量有限尺寸标度分析。

papers.title: Exact Single-Scale Outer Solution of the Abrikosov Vortex in the Extreme Type-II Limit
papers.abstract: We determine the exact outer structure of the Abrikosov vortex in the extreme type-II limit, which occurs when the Ginzburg-Landau parameter $κ$ diverges. In this limit, Ginzburg-Landau theory simplifies, outside a shrinking core, to a closed nonlinear theory for the superfluid velocity subject to an algebraic density constraint. The resulting solution is asymptotically exact everywhere outside the vanishing vortex core, demonstrating that both magnetic field and superconducting density vary on the length scale of the London penetration depth. This establishes that the conventional two-length-scale picture of the vortex does not hold in the $κ\gg 1$ limit.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：exact outer structure、asymptotically exact、Ginzburg-Landau theory。；研究对象：极端第二类极限（Ginzburg-Landau参数κ→∞）下的Abrikosov涡旋。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在极端第二类极限下，涡旋的磁场和超导密度均以伦敦穿透深度为单一尺度变化，推翻了传统认为存在两个不同长度尺度（相干长度和穿透深度）的图像。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在极端第二类极限下，涡旋的磁场和超导密度均以伦敦穿透深度为单一尺度变化，推翻了传统认为存在两个不同长度尺度（相干长度和穿透深度）的图像。；创新点：首次严格证明了在κ→∞极限下，涡旋外部结构仅由单一尺度（伦敦穿透深度）描述，而非传统认为的两个尺度。
papers.method_zh: 基于Ginzburg-Landau理论，在涡旋核心收缩至零的极限下，将理论简化为受代数密度约束的超流速度的非线性理论，并求解出涡旋外部区域的精确渐近解。

papers.title: Freezing of the tetrahedral amorphous network in supercooled water triggers crystallization towards LDA ice
papers.abstract: In this work, we provide mechanistic insight into the initial stages of formation of ice across the limit of stability of supercooled water. Such an analysis is particularly important since crystal nucleation is not a relevant mechanism under these conditions. Using molecular dynamics simulation with the TIP4P/2005 potential, water is cooled at a constant pressure with cooling rates of 5 to 10 K per nanosecond. As the liquid is cooled across the temperature of maximum density (T_0 = 277 K), we find that there is a continuous increase in the tetrahedrality of the system. As the cooling continues across the limit of stability of water (T_s $\approx$ 235 K), large scale thermal fluctuations dissipate while the thermal equilibration is achieved through small scale fluctuations. This phenomenon, known as the dynamical crossover [Goutam et. al. in J. Stat. Phys., 168: 1302--1318 (2017)], ends the existence of the liquid state. Subsequently, we find that the tetrahedral network drives the decrease of energy and density. This process terminates when the network undergoes `freezing' (i.e., the bonds of the network acquire sufficient rigidity), due to which the network evolution, as a whole, stops. This triggers a qualitative change in the relaxation mechanism: subsequent relaxation occurs through crystallization, i.e., an increase in the structural order. In particular, we find that the cubic and hexagonal crystalline motifs, which possess medium range order, increase rapidly across the freezing point. In the resulting LDA ice states, cubic ice is found to have a significant contribution in the overall extent of crystallization, which is consistent with the experimental findings. Overall, our work provides the specific mechanism by which crystallization (leading to LDA ice) is initiated across the limit of stability of supercooled water.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。依据：使用分子动力学模拟（Molecular dynamics simulation）和TIP4P/2005势能模型。；研究对象：过冷水在稳定性极限附近的结晶初始阶段，特别是向低密度非晶冰（LDA ice）的转变过程。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 过冷水在冷却过程中，四面体网络发生“冻结”（键获得足够刚性），导致网络整体演化停止，从而触发结晶机制，形成以立方冰和六方冰结构为主的LDA冰。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：过冷水在冷却过程中，四面体网络发生“冻结”（键获得足够刚性），导致网络整体演化停止，从而触发结晶机制，形成以立方冰和六方冰结构为主的LDA冰。；创新点：揭示了过冷水在稳定性极限附近结晶的具体机制：并非通过经典成核，而是通过四面体网络的“冻结”引发结构有序化（结晶），并指出立方冰在LDA冰中具有显著贡献，与实验结果一致。
papers.method_zh: 采用TIP4P/2005势能模型进行分子动力学模拟，以5至10 K/纳秒的冷却速率在恒压下冷却水，分析温度跨越最大密度温度（T₀=277 K）和稳定性极限（T_s≈235 K）时的结构变化。

papers.title: Mutual Friction in Dissipative Gross-Pitaevskii Thermal Counterflow Turbulence
papers.abstract: We report numerical simulations of the dissipative Gross-Pitaevskii equation for a bulk region of thermal-counterflow turbulence. Quasistationary states are obtained over a range of forcing, damping, and healing-length parameters. The mutual-friction acceleration exhibits cubic scaling with the mean relative velocity between the superfluid and normal-fluid components, and the coefficient of this scaling is linked to the phenomenological damping parameter. The intervortex spacing follows the expected dimensional scaling in the weak-forcing regime. Comparison with a straight-vortex-line model suggests that the vortex-line orientations are nearly isotropic.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：关键词“numerical simulations”（数值模拟）、“dissipative Gross-Pitaevskii equation”（耗散Gross-Pitaevskii方程）。；研究对象：热逆流湍流（thermal-counterflow turbulence）中的超流氦（基于Gross-Pitaevskii方程描述的玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚体），具体为体相区域（bulk region）的湍流态。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 互摩擦加速度与超流和正常流体之间的平均相对速度呈三次方标度关系，且该标度系数与唯象阻尼参数相关；在弱驱动条件下，涡旋间距符合预期的维度标度。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：互摩擦加速度与超流和正常流体之间的平均相对速度呈三次方标度关系，且该标度系数与唯象阻尼参数相关；在弱驱动条件下，涡旋间距符合预期的维度标度。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用耗散Gross-Pitaevskii方程进行数值模拟，在一定的驱动、阻尼和愈合长度参数范围内获得准稳态，并与直线涡旋模型进行对比分析。

papers.title: Substitution modulated transition from semimetal to superconductor in ZrTe$_{2-x}$Se$_x$ with coexistence of nontrivial electronic topology
papers.abstract: This study explores the emergence of superconductivity in high-quality ZrTe$_{2-x}$Se$_x$ crystals, grown via the isothermal chemical vapor transport (ICVT) technique. Resistive, structural, and thermal measurements reveal that substituting Te with Se in the ZrTe$_2$ matrix induces a superconducting state at low temperatures. The critical temperature ($T_c$) exhibits a clear dependence on the selenium concentration, peaking at $x=0.15$ with a $T_c$ of $4.8$ K. Calorimetric data indicates that even a low Se substitution range is capable of modifying both the electronic contribution and the vibrational modes of the crystal lattice. Combined with ab initio calculations and Wannier Hamiltonian interpolation between ZrTe$_2$/ZrSe$_2$, we established an extensive phase diagram mapping the transition from charge density wave (CDW) to the state with coexistence between the Dirac semimetal and superconductivity (SC), up to the semiconductor phase. This coexistence suggests that ZrTe$_{1.85}$Se$_{0.15}$ could be a candidate platform for topological superconductivity, as it hosts a nontrivial $\mathbb Z_2$ invariant, with nonvanishing surface states in its $(001)$ planes.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章，辅以计算。判断依据：摘要中明确描述了“Resistive, structural, and thermal measurements”（电阻、结构和热测量）等实验手段，并提及“ab initio calculations and Wannier Hamiltonian interpolation”（第一性原理计算和Wannier哈密顿量插值）作为理论支撑。；研究对象：ZrTe$_{2-x}$Se$_x$单晶体系。具体研究通过Se替代Te，从半金属（ZrTe$_2$）到超导体（ZrTe$_{2-x}$Se$_x$）的相变过程，以及其中可能存在的非平庸电子拓扑性质。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在高质量ZrTe$_{2-x}$Se$_x$晶体中，通过Se替代Te诱导出超导电性，最高超导临界温度$T_c$为4.8 K（$x=0.15$）。该体系在特定掺杂浓度下同时存在狄拉克半金属态和超导态，且具有非平庸的$\mathbb Z_2$拓扑不变量，是拓扑超导电性的候选平台。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在高质量ZrTe$_{2-x}$Se$_x$晶体中，通过Se替代Te诱导出超导电性，最高超导临界温度$T_c$为4.8 K（$x=0.15$）。该体系在特定掺杂浓度下同时存在狄拉克半金属态和超导态，且具有非平庸的$\mathbb Z_2$拓扑不变量，是拓扑超导电性的候选平台。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。但可推断，主要新意在于首次在ZrTe$_2$体系中通过Se替代实现了从电荷密度波（CDW）到超导（SC）的连续调控，并绘制了包含狄拉克半金属、超导和半导体相的完整相图，同时揭示了该体系中超导与拓扑非平庸电子态的共存。
papers.method_zh: 1.  **样品生长**：等温化学气相输运（ICVT）技术。

papers.title: Benchmarking Transparent Conductors
papers.abstract: Transparent conducting oxides (TCOs) are central to optoelectronic technologies, yet their design is often guided by popular figures of merit that are disconnected from the electrical requirement of actual devices. As a result, widely used metrics guide material design under conditions that can be impractical for devices. Here, we introduce a benchmarking framework to guide TCO development, in which transparent conductors are evaluated at fixed, application-relevant sheet resistance $(R_S)$. The resulting metric, $T_{app}(R_S)$, anchors comparison to device requirements, asking instead: What optical transparency can be obtained at the sheet resistance required by a given application? This approach provides a directly interpretable measure of performance, enabling materials to be benchmarked in terms of absolute transparency gains at a specified $R_S$. Applied to representative conventional and emerging TCOs, the framework defines the sheet-resistance landscape relevant to each application and maps how different materials perform within it. In doing so, it provides an application-rooted guide to material development and selection. More broadly, this approach establishes a general strategy for evaluating materials under fixed operational constraints, bridging the gap between materials design and device integration.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/分析文章。判断依据：摘要中提出了一种新的“benchmarking framework”（基准框架）和“metric”（度量标准），属于理论分析或方法论研究，未提及具体实验或计算模拟手段。；研究对象：透明导电氧化物（TCOs）及其在光电器件中的应用性能评估。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 传统用于指导透明导电材料设计的品质因数（figures of merit）与实际器件的电学需求脱节；本文提出的基于固定应用相关方阻（\(R_S\)）的评估框架 \(T_{app}(R_S)\) 能更直接地衡量材料在特定应用中的光学透明度表现，从而为材料开发与选择提供以应用为导向的指导。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：传统用于指导透明导电材料设计的品质因数（figures of merit）与实际器件的电学需求脱节；本文提出的基于固定应用相关方阻（\(R_S\)）的评估框架 \(T_{app}(R_S)\) 能更直接地衡量材料在特定应用中的光学透明度表现，从而为材料开发与选择提供以应用为导向的指导。；创新点：将材料评估从基于通用品质因数的设计转向基于固定、应用相关的方阻约束条件，直接回答“在给定器件所需的方阻下，能获得多高的透明度”，从而弥合了材料设计与器件集成之间的鸿沟。
papers.method_zh: 提出了一个基准测试框架，核心是定义新度量 \(T_{app}(R_S)\)，即在给定应用所需的方阻下所能达到的光学透明度。该框架通过将材料性能映射到不同应用对应的方阻区间，来比较不同材料（包括传统与新兴TCOs）的绝对透明度增益。

papers.title: Superconductivity and electronic structure evolution in the enforced semimetal Fe-doped ZrTe$_2$
papers.abstract: ZrTe$_2$ is an outstanding layered semimetal due to the topologically nontrivial electronic structure. In this work, we present an investigation of the electronic evolution of ZrTe$_2$ in the presence of Fe intercalation, namely Fe$_{x}$ZrTe$_2$ ($x= 0 - 0.25$), scrutinized by both experimental measurements and \textit{ab} initio calculations. While the first reveals a superconducting state with a maximum critical temperature $T_c = 2.74$ K ($x=$ 0.03), the latter indicates that the topological features of the pristine ZrTe$_2$ is sensitive to the distance between Te atoms and Zr layers. Also, the intercalation of Fe does not modify the non-trivial electronic band structure unlike the band crossings are now shifted slightly below $E_{F}$. In particular, a van Hove singularity near the Fermi level for a Fe content of $x=0.125$ is observed in the density of states, indicating that the superconducting order may be associated with features of the unfolded band structure and the concomitant enhancement of the density of states at $E_F$. Finally, our results reveal that the new compound with inclusion of Fe intercalation preserves the enforced semimetal classification.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验+计算）。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“experimental measurements”和“ab initio calculations”。；研究对象：Fe插层ZrTe₂体系（FeₓZrTe₂，x=0-0.25），具体研究其超导电性及电子结构演化。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: Fe插层ZrTe₂在x=0.03时出现最高超导转变温度Tc=2.74 K；Fe插层不改变ZrTe₂的非平庸拓扑能带结构，但使能带交叉点略微下移，并在x=0.125时在费米能级附近出现范霍夫奇点，表明超导序可能与能带展开特征及费米面处态密度增强有关。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：Fe插层ZrTe₂在x=0.03时出现最高超导转变温度Tc=2.74 K；Fe插层不改变ZrTe₂的非平庸拓扑能带结构，但使能带交叉点略微下移，并在x=0.125时在费米能级附近出现范霍夫奇点，表明超导序可能与能带展开特征及费米面处态密度增强有关。；创新点：揭示了Fe插层ZrTe₂中拓扑半金属特性得以保持，同时超导电性源于费米能级附近态密度增强（范霍夫奇点），而非拓扑能带结构的根本改变。
papers.method_zh: 实验方面：通过Fe插层制备FeₓZrTe₂样品并测量超导转变温度；理论方面：采用第一性原理（ab initio）计算分析电子结构，包括能带展开和态密度分析。

papers.title: Scaling features for the stress fluctuations in the OFC model
papers.abstract: We consider the Olami-Feder-Christensen (OFC) model on a square two-dimensional lattice with open boundary conditions. The model exhibits self-organized criticality and explains the Gutenberg-Richter law observed for earthquakes. A parameter $α$ controls the level of local dissipation: $α< 0.25$ corresponds to locally dissipative and $α= 0.25$ marks locally conservative dynamics. The avalanche size distribution follows a decaying power-law, with a non-universal critical exponent. Here, we examine the probability distribution of the difference between avalanche size and area. This quantity remains unexplored despite being of significant interest in earthquakes. We find a power-law with a scaling exponent close to one in the conservative OFC model. The scaling feature vanishes even for the physically relevant case $α= 0.21$. To examine the robustness of such features, we also examine the same quantity in the BTW and Manna sandpile models on a square lattice. We find that the power-law behavior survives for these systems due to locally conservative dynamics. We further examine the local and total stress fluctuations in the OFC model for both locally conservative and dissipative dynamics. The finite-size scaling analysis of the power spectra for the stress fluctuations reveals qualitatively the same but quantitatively significantly different behavior. The dynamic exponent describing the divergence of the correlation time with system size changes from nearly ballistic in the conservative to diffusive behavior in the locally dissipative dynamics with $α= 0.21$. The local stress also exhibits a signature of nearly canonical $1/f$ noise in the intermediate regime, and $1/f^2$-type scaling dominates the high-frequency regime.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。关键词：Olami-Feder-Christensen (OFC) 模型、数值模拟、有限尺寸标度分析、功率谱分析。；研究对象：OFC 模型（地震自组织临界性模型）中的应力涨落标度特征，以及 BTW 和 Manna 沙堆模型中的类似量。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在保守型 OFC 模型中，雪崩大小与面积之差的概率分布呈现幂律行为，标度指数接近1；但在局部耗散（α=0.21）的物理相关情形下，该标度特征消失。此外，应力涨落的功率谱在保守与耗散动力学下表现出定性相同但定量显著不同的行为，关联时间的动态指数从近弹道型（保守）变为扩散型（耗散）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在保守型 OFC 模型中，雪崩大小与面积之差的概率分布呈现幂律行为，标度指数接近1；但在局部耗散（α=0.21）的物理相关情形下，该标度特征消失。此外，应力涨落的功率谱在保守与耗散动力学下表现出定性相同但定量显著不同的行为，关联时间的动态指数从近弹道型（保守）变为扩散型（耗散）。；创新点：首次系统研究了 OFC 模型中雪崩大小与面积之差的概率分布这一此前未被探索的量，并揭示了其标度特征对局部耗散的敏感性。同时，通过应力涨落功率谱的有限尺寸标度，定量区分了保守与耗散动力学下的动态标度行为（如动态指数从弹道到扩散的转变）。
papers.method_zh: 采用二维正方晶格上具有开放边界条件的 OFC 模型进行数值模拟，通过改变局部耗散参数 α（α<0.25 为耗散，α=0.25 为保守）控制动力学类型。对雪崩大小与面积之差进行概率分布分析，并对局部和总应力涨落进行功率谱的有限尺寸标度分析。同时对比了 BTW 和 Manna 沙堆模型。

papers.title: Cluster moves with an entropic reservoir accelerate low-temperature simulations of three-dimensional spin glasses
papers.abstract: We present an algorithm for the simulation of three-dimensional spin glasses deep in the low-temperature phase: Parallel Tempering enhanced with Houdayer moves and with an entropic reservoir (PTHR). Although differences with the standard Houdayer algorithm are small, PTHR allows us to equilibrate a large number of samples of $L=16$ lattices with Gaussian couplings for temperatures $T\geq 0.2$. We show that the computational complexity displays better size scaling than standard Parallel Tempering. For finite sizes, our method outperforms other cluster algorithms by a speedup factor of around 64. In close analogy with standard Parallel Tempering, PTHR's computational complexity strongly relates to temperature chaos.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：algorithm、simulations、computational complexity。；研究对象：三维自旋玻璃（three-dimensional spin glasses），具体为具有高斯耦合的L=16晶格体系，在低温相（T≥0.2）下的模拟。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出的PTHR算法（并行回火结合Houdayer移动与熵库）能够在低温下有效平衡大量三维自旋玻璃样本，其计算复杂度的尺寸标度优于标准并行回火，且对于有限尺寸，速度提升因子约为64。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出的PTHR算法（并行回火结合Houdayer移动与熵库）能够在低温下有效平衡大量三维自旋玻璃样本，其计算复杂度的尺寸标度优于标准并行回火，且对于有限尺寸，速度提升因子约为64。；创新点：将熵库概念与Houdayer移动结合到并行回火框架中，显著提升了低温三维自旋玻璃模拟的平衡效率，并揭示了PTHR的计算复杂度与温度混沌（temperature chaos）的强关联性。
papers.method_zh: 算法开发与数值模拟：采用并行回火（Parallel Tempering）增强Houdayer移动，并引入熵库（entropic reservoir）构成PTHR算法。通过比较计算复杂度和尺寸标度来评估性能。

papers.title: Hybridization of Ferromagnetic and Cyclotron Resonances in a Two-Dimensional Electron System on a Ferromagnetic Film
papers.abstract: The microwave response of a two-dimensional (2D) electron system located on a dielectric ferromagnetic film, which in turn lies on a conducting metal (gate), has been theoretically studied. The entire system has been placed in the perpendicular static magnetic field. It has been found that the ferromagnetic resonance of the film and the cyclotron resonance of the electrons of the 2D system interact in the magnetic field, leading to their repulsion ('anticrossing'). It has been revealed that the anticrossing region is characterized not only by the modification of resonance frequencies compared to the cyclotron resonance in the 2D system without the ferromagnetic substrate and the ferromagnetic resonance in the film without the 2D system, but also by a strong change in the resonance linewidths.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：theoretically studied。；研究对象：位于介电铁磁薄膜上的二维电子系统，该薄膜置于导电金属（栅极）上，整个系统处于垂直静磁场中。具体物理现象为铁磁共振与回旋共振的杂化。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 铁磁薄膜的铁磁共振与二维电子系统的回旋共振在磁场中发生相互作用，导致共振频率相互排斥（“反交叉”），并且反交叉区域不仅共振频率发生显著改变，共振线宽也出现强烈变化。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：铁磁薄膜的铁磁共振与二维电子系统的回旋共振在磁场中发生相互作用，导致共振频率相互排斥（“反交叉”），并且反交叉区域不仅共振频率发生显著改变，共振线宽也出现强烈变化。；创新点：揭示了铁磁共振与回旋共振在二维电子系统/铁磁薄膜复合结构中的杂化现象，并指出反交叉区域同时伴随共振频率和线宽的显著变化。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析，具体框架为对微波响应进行理论建模，研究二维电子系统与铁磁薄膜在垂直静磁场下的耦合共振行为。

papers.title: Dealloying by peritectic melting
papers.abstract: Peritectic melting of Ti--Ag has been shown experimentally to form bicontinuous structures, but the mechanism remains unclear.
