Here we use phase-field simulations to show that these structures arise from a morphological instability of liquid film migration in three dimensions: a Ti-rich solid growing through an Ag-rich liquid film develops a branched seaweed or dendritic structure whose side branches coalesce to form handles, generating a high-genus bicontinuous topology. A sharp-interface theory predicts a solidification-front velocity and an initial ligament width that are constant in time, in contrast to liquid metal dealloying; subsequent $t^{1/3}$ coarsening reproduces the experimentally observed final ligament width.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算与理论混合类型。判断依据：使用了“phase-field simulations”（相场模拟）和“sharp-interface theory”（尖锐界面理论），并结合了实验观察（“shown experimentally”）。；研究对象：Ti-Ag合金在包晶熔化（peritectic melting）过程中形成的双连续结构（bicontinuous structures）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 包晶熔化形成的双连续结构源于三维液膜迁移的形态不稳定性：富Ti固相在富Ag液相中生长时形成分支海藻状或枝晶结构，其侧枝合并形成手柄状拓扑，最终产生高亏格的双连续结构。与液态金属脱合金不同，该过程的凝固前沿速度和初始韧带宽度在时间上恒定，后续以t^{1/3}规律粗化。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：包晶熔化形成的双连续结构源于三维液膜迁移的形态不稳定性：富Ti固相在富Ag液相中生长时形成分支海藻状或枝晶结构，其侧枝合并形成手柄状拓扑，最终产生高亏格的双连续结构。与液态金属脱合金不同，该过程的凝固前沿速度和初始韧带宽度在时间上恒定，后续以t^{1/3}规律粗化。；创新点：揭示了包晶熔化形成双连续结构的具体机制——三维液膜迁移的形态不稳定性，并指出其动力学行为（恒定速度与初始韧带宽度）与液态金属脱合金过程存在本质区别。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 相场模拟（phase-field simulations）和尖锐界面理论（sharp-interface theory）。

papers.title: Equivalent-neighbor $k$-core percolation in two dimensions
papers.abstract: We perform large-scale numerical simulations to investigate the critical behavior of $k$-core percolation in two dimensions with an extended interaction range $r$. By systematically varying both the core index $k$ and the interaction range $r$, we construct a comprehensive phase diagram in the $(k,r)$ plane. In contrast to $k$-core percolation in infinite dimensions, no hybrid transition is observed in two dimensions: the phase diagram contains only a continuous transition regime and a strictly first-order regime, separated by a tricritical or critical-end point $(k_s,r_s)$. For $k<k_s$ and $r<r_s$, the transition is continuous and belongs to the universality class of standard two-dimensional (2D) percolation. For $k>k_s$ and finite $r>r_s$, the transition is discontinuous, with no hybrid features or critical singularities. In this first-order regime, the pseudocritical point approaches the critical point as $1/\ln L$, where $L$ is the linear system size, distinct from the $L^{-d}$ scaling typical of conventional thermodynamic first-order transitions in $d$ dimensions. This logarithmic finite-size drift is consistent with a nucleation-driven mechanism, in which rare voids trigger the collapse of the finite-range $k$-core. These results demonstrate that geometric constraints can fundamentally alter the nature of $k$-core percolation found in finite dimensions.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。关键词：large-scale numerical simulations、critical behavior、phase diagram。；研究对象：二维空间中具有扩展相互作用范围 \( r \) 的 \( k \)-core 逾渗（\( k \)-core percolation）的临界行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在二维 \( k \)-core 逾渗中，未观察到混合型相变，相图仅包含连续相变区和严格一级相变区，两者由三临界点或临界端点分隔；在一级相变区，伪临界点随系统尺寸 \( L \) 以 \( 1/\ln L \) 方式漂移，而非传统热力学一级相变的 \( L^{-d} \) 标度。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在二维 \( k \)-core 逾渗中，未观察到混合型相变，相图仅包含连续相变区和严格一级相变区，两者由三临界点或临界端点分隔；在一级相变区，伪临界点随系统尺寸 \( L \) 以 \( 1/\ln L \) 方式漂移，而非传统热力学一级相变的 \( L^{-d} \) 标度。；创新点：揭示了二维几何约束从根本上改变了 \( k \)-core 逾渗的相变性质：与无限维结果不同，二维中不存在混合型相变，且一级相变区的有限尺寸漂移行为（\( 1/\ln L \)）与由稀有空洞驱动的成核机制一致，区别于传统一级相变。
papers.method_zh: 大规模数值模拟，系统变化核心指数 \( k \) 和相互作用范围 \( r \)，构建 \( (k, r) \) 平面上的相图，并分析有限尺寸标度行为。

papers.title: Topological fragility and bilinear magnetoelectric resistance in gapless edge states
papers.abstract: In time-reversal symmetric systems such as topological and higher-order topological insulators, 1D spin-momentum locked edge and hinge states are theoretically ``perfectly conducting'', being immune to backscattering by non-magnetic disorder. Here, we reveal a fundamental ``topological fragility'': these states exhibit a bilinear magnetoelectric resistance significantly larger than in 2D systems. This effect requires two ingredients: (i) spin-momentum locking, which maximizes time-reversal symmetry breaking in the non-linear regime, and (ii) random spin-orbit interaction -- the same mechanism behind Elliott - Yafet spin relaxation in heavy elements. Together, these generate a robust backscattering channel when a modest external magnetic field is applied. Our theory requires no gap opening or complex many-body effects, offering a simple and general mechanism that quantitatively explains recent observations in Bismuth hinge states.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“Our theory requires...”、“We reveal...”，并构建了理论机制来解释实验现象。；研究对象：拓扑绝缘体（包括高阶拓扑绝缘体）中一维自旋-动量锁定的边缘态和铰链态，以及在这些态中出现的“双线性磁电电阻”输运现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 揭示了拓扑边缘态存在一种“拓扑脆弱性”：在施加微弱外磁场时，由于自旋-动量锁定与随机自旋-轨道相互作用的共同作用，这些原本被认为对非磁性无序背散射免疫的“完美导电”态会产生巨大的双线性磁电电阻，其效应远大于二维系统。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：揭示了拓扑边缘态存在一种“拓扑脆弱性”：在施加微弱外磁场时，由于自旋-动量锁定与随机自旋-轨道相互作用的共同作用，这些原本被认为对非磁性无序背散射免疫的“完美导电”态会产生巨大的双线性磁电电阻，其效应远大于二维系统。；创新点：提出了一个简单且普适的机制来解释拓扑边缘态在磁场下的巨大电阻响应，该机制不依赖于能隙打开或强关联效应，揭示了拓扑保护性在非线性输运条件下的“脆弱性”。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析。具体框架包括：利用对称性分析（时间反演对称性在非线性区间的破缺）和自旋弛豫机制（Elliott-Yafet机制）构建了一个无需能隙打开或复杂多体效应的通用理论模型，并定量解释了近期在铋（Bismuth）铰链态上的实验观测。

papers.title: Collective deformation of anisotropic particles with internal pulsation
papers.abstract: Capturing the emergence of deformation waves in contractile living tissues is a challenge that has recently been tackled with models of actively deformable particles. Inspired by the anisotropic deformation of cardiomyocytes in cardiac tissues, we examine how the pulsation of elliptical particles affects their collective properties in dense assemblies. We introduce two types of deformation where the eccentricity of each particle is subject to a periodic drive, and examine the interplay between nematic order and synchronized deformation via a systematic phase diagram. We derive a hydrodynamic description through a coarse-graining procedure, and show that it qualitatively captures the main collective states of the microscopic dynamics. Overall, our model provides key insights into how an active anisotropic deformation yields waves that self-organize into various dynamical patterns.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到了“通过粗粒化过程推导出流体力学描述”，并研究了“微观动力学的相图”，这表明主要采用了理论建模和数值模拟的方法。；研究对象：具有内部脉动的各向异性（椭圆形）活性粒子在密集堆积下的集体变形行为。具体物理现象是：受心脏组织中心肌细胞各向异性变形启发的、由粒子主动脉动驱动的变形波和自组织动力学图案。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该模型揭示了主动各向异性变形如何产生自组织成各种动力学图案的波。通过系统相图，阐明了向列序与同步脉动之间的相互作用。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该模型揭示了主动各向异性变形如何产生自组织成各种动力学图案的波。通过系统相图，阐明了向列序与同步脉动之间的相互作用。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。但根据内容推断，其创新点在于将心肌细胞收缩的各向异性特性抽象为椭圆粒子的周期性偏心变形，并系统研究了这种主动各向异性变形如何导致集体变形波和自组织图案，而不仅仅是各向同性收缩。
papers.method_zh: 理论建模与数值模拟。具体包括：1. 构建了椭圆形粒子的微观动力学模型，其中每个粒子的偏心率受到周期性驱动（两种变形类型）。2. 通过系统扫描参数绘制相图，研究向列序与同步变形的耦合。3. 采用粗粒化（coarse-graining）方法推导出体系的流体力学描述。

papers.title: Spectral properties of non-Hermitian real random matrices with long-range correlations
papers.abstract: We investigate the spectral properties of non-Hermitian real random matrices whose entries exhibit long-range correlations decaying as~$|r-r'|^{-α}$. We find a progressive breakdown of the circular law, controlled by the decrease of~$α$. In all cases, the radial eigenvalue density decreases away from the origin. At~$α>1$, an effective radius, reminiscent of the circular law, is retrieved, while instead, for~$α<1$, the eigenvalue distribution broadens with matrix size and its spectral radius grows like a power law, with exponents numerically close to the exponents controlling the magnitude of fluctuations in the extended central limit theorem. The case~$α=1$ appears as a case with self-similar eigenvalue density, and slowly growing spectral radius. Long-range correlations also enhance clustering of real eigenvalues and slow the resorption of the Saturn effect. These results reveal a correlation-driven transition and suggest the emergence of a new universality class for correlated non-Hermitian random matrices.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中使用了“investigate”“find”“suggest”等理论分析词汇，未提及实验或计算模拟细节。；研究对象：非厄米实随机矩阵，其矩阵元具有长程相关性（衰减指数为α），研究该体系的谱性质。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 长程相关性导致圆律的逐步失效：当α>1时，谱分布仍具有有效半径（类似圆律）；当α<1时，谱半径随矩阵尺寸幂律增长，且增长指数与扩展中心极限定理中的涨落指数数值接近；α=1时出现自相似特征。此外，长程相关性增强了实本征值的聚集并延缓了“土星效应”的消失。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：长程相关性导致圆律的逐步失效：当α>1时，谱分布仍具有有效半径（类似圆律）；当α<1时，谱半径随矩阵尺寸幂律增长，且增长指数与扩展中心极限定理中的涨落指数数值接近；α=1时出现自相似特征。此外，长程相关性增强了实本征值的聚集并延缓了“土星效应”的消失。；创新点：揭示了长程相关性驱动的非厄米随机矩阵谱性质从圆律到新标度行为的转变，暗示存在一个关联非厄米随机矩阵的新普适类。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析，基于随机矩阵理论，通过改变长程相关性衰减指数α（|r-r'|^{-α}）来研究谱密度、谱半径及本征值聚类的标度行为，并与扩展中心极限定理的涨落指数进行数值对比。

papers.title: The Remodeling of Fiber Distributions in Biological Tissues: Rotation without Rotation
papers.abstract: Collagen remodeling in living tissues exhibits anisotropic orientation patterns commonly described by Von Mises distributions, yet the physical origin of such nonequilibrium organization remains unresolved. In the present work, we demonstrate analytically that the combined action of Malthusian growth dynamics and the introduction of linear relations governing mechanical remodeling naturally gives rise to generalized bimodal Von Mises distributions as emergent states of living matter. The theory reveals a {\it rotation without rotation} mechanism, in which fibers progressively reorient in the absence of angular mechanical coupling via selective deposition and removal along preferred directions. The resulting analytical solutions quantitatively reproduce experimentally observed distributions and establish a direct mechanobiological origin for directional statistics in biological tissues. By interpreting the evolving normalized fiber density as a probability distribution function, we formulate a dynamical Shannon entropy framework that captures the temporal emergence of microstructural organization. The theory further yields closed-form expressions for the drift of the associated Fokker--Planck equation, enabling the corresponding stochastic differential equation to be derived, thus revealing that tissue remodeling is the collective outcome of noisy single-fiber dynamics. These results establish a minimal theoretical framework that connects biomechanics, stochastic processes, and nonequilibrium statistical organization in living matter.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据关键词：demonstrate analytically、theory reveals、analytical solutions、formulate a dynamical Shannon entropy framework、closed-form expressions。；研究对象：生物组织中胶原纤维的取向分布重塑现象，具体为纤维在无角向机械耦合条件下通过选择性沉积与移除实现重新定向的非平衡组织过程。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 发现了一种“无旋转的旋转”机制：纤维在缺乏角向机械耦合的情况下，通过马尔萨斯增长动力学与线性机械重塑关系的联合作用，自发产生广义双峰冯·米塞斯分布，定量复现实验观测的纤维取向模式。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：发现了一种“无旋转的旋转”机制：纤维在缺乏角向机械耦合的情况下，通过马尔萨斯增长动力学与线性机械重塑关系的联合作用，自发产生广义双峰冯·米塞斯分布，定量复现实验观测的纤维取向模式。；创新点：首次从解析层面揭示马尔萨斯增长与线性机械重塑共同作用如何自然产生广义双峰冯·米塞斯分布，并建立“无旋转的旋转”机制，将生物组织重塑解释为噪声驱动的单纤维动力学集体结果，连接了生物力学、随机过程与非平衡统计组织。
papers.method_zh: 采用解析理论框架：结合马尔萨斯增长动力学与线性机械重塑关系推导广义双峰冯·米塞斯分布；构建动态香农熵框架描述微观结构的时间涌现；推导福克-普朗克方程的漂移项闭式解，进而导出对应的随机微分方程。

papers.title: kikuchipy: an open-source toolbox for analysis of EBSD patterns
papers.abstract: We present kikuchipy, an open-source toolbox for analysis of electron backscatter diffraction patterns, written in Python. The software is capable of both Hough and dictionary indexing and orientation and/or projection center refinement of patterns stored in file formats from all major vendors. Indexing results can be validated using maps independent of indexing and by visually comparing experimental and simulated patterns. By leveraging scientific packages in the Python ecosystem, emphasis is put on making the indexing workflow flexible and improve results through fast iteration. The software's capabilities are demonstrated on three application examples: analysis of orientation relationships in a super duplex stainless steel, phase differentiation of aluminium and silicon in a cast modified Al-Si alloy, and phase differentiation of particles in an Al-Mn alloy as Al6Mn or alpha-AlMnSi. The diffraction patterns and analysis workflows are made publicly available. kikuchipy was created and is developed as a resource for the electron microscopy community, allowing anyone to improve the software or include it into their own analysis workflows or softwares.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/软件工具文章。判断依据关键词：open-source toolbox、analysis、Python、indexing。；研究对象：电子背散射衍射（EBSD）图案的分析与处理，具体应用于超双相不锈钢、改性Al-Si合金及Al-Mn合金中的相鉴别与取向关系分析。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 开发了一个基于Python的开源工具箱kikuchipy，能够实现EBSD图案的Hough索引与字典索引，以及取向/投影中心精修，并通过快速迭代提高索引工作流的灵活性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：开发了一个基于Python的开源工具箱kikuchipy，能够实现EBSD图案的Hough索引与字典索引，以及取向/投影中心精修，并通过快速迭代提高索引工作流的灵活性。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用Python编程语言，利用Python生态中的科学计算包，实现Hough变换索引、字典索引、取向与投影中心精修，并通过独立于索引的验证图及实验与模拟图案的视觉对比来验证索引结果。

papers.title: Alignment-free ultra-broadband parametric frequency conversion in lead-halide perovskites
papers.abstract: Lead-halide perovskites were demonstrated to exhibit some of the largest known optical nonlinearities, yet their potential for frequency conversion remains largely untapped. Here we demonstrate ultra-broadband four-wave mixing of near- and mid-infrared femtosecond pulses in thick single-crystal LHPs, generating bright, coherent, and highly collimated emission across an exceptionally wide continuous tuning range without phase-matching engineering, angular alignment, or dispersion optimization. Time resolved measurements reveal that the emission originates near the crystal surfaces, where phase-matching constraints are relaxed, while the unusually large intrinsic $χ^{(3)}$ response preserves efficient and directional frequency conversion despite the strongly localized interaction volume. These results position LHPs as a powerful bulk platform for ultra-broadband nonlinear photonics, opening a pathway toward compact, alignment-free architectures for ultrafast frequency conversion.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确描述了实验演示（“demonstrate”）、时间分辨测量（“Time resolved measurements”）以及实验现象（“generating bright, coherent, and highly collimated emission”）。；研究对象：铅卤钙钛矿（Lead-halide perovskites, LHPs）单晶中的超宽带参量频率转换现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在未进行相位匹配工程、角度对准或色散优化的条件下，利用铅卤钙钛矿单晶实现了近红外到中红外飞秒脉冲的超宽带四波混频，产生了覆盖极宽连续调谐范围的明亮、相干、准直发射。该发射源于晶体表面附近，此处相位匹配约束被放宽，而材料巨大的本征三阶非线性（χ(3)）响应保证了高效定向的频率转换。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在未进行相位匹配工程、角度对准或色散优化的条件下，利用铅卤钙钛矿单晶实现了近红外到中红外飞秒脉冲的超宽带四波混频，产生了覆盖极宽连续调谐范围的明亮、相干、准直发射。该发射源于晶体表面附近，此处相位匹配约束被放宽，而材料巨大的本征三阶非线性（χ(3)）响应保证了高效定向的频率转换。；创新点：首次在铅卤钙钛矿这种厚块状晶体中，无需任何相位匹配工程、角度对准或色散优化，即实现了超宽带、高效率的参量频率转换。这为构建紧凑、免对准的超快频率转换架构提供了新的平台。
papers.method_zh: 实验手段包括：使用近红外和中红外飞秒脉冲进行超宽带四波混频实验；通过时间分辨测量（Time resolved measurements）来探究发射的起源位置。

papers.title: Chain conformations in adsorbed layer during polymer capillary imbibition
papers.abstract: We conducted molecular dynamics simulations to investigate chain conformations in adsorbed layers during polymer capillary imbibition. While the imbibition length adheres to the classical Lucas-Washburn equation, a notable deviation in mobile bead density emerges under strong confinement, consistent with \emph{in situ} dielectric spectroscopy experiments. The proportion of loop structures within adsorbed layers progressively increases during capillary infiltration, attributed to the relaxation of initially stretched chains toward equilibrium configurations. Furthermore, systematic analysis revealed that chain relaxation dynamics exhibit length-dependent retardation, especially under high confinement. The characteristic desorption time demonstrates chain-length dependence in quantitative agreement with scaling predictions.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：关键词“molecular dynamics simulations”（分子动力学模拟）。；研究对象：聚合物毛细管吸入过程中吸附层内的链构象（chain conformations in adsorbed layers during polymer capillary imbibition）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在强受限条件下，移动珠密度出现显著偏差，与原位介电谱实验一致；毛细渗入过程中吸附层内环状结构比例逐渐增加，归因于初始拉伸链向平衡构象的松弛；链松弛动力学表现出长度依赖的延迟效应，特征解吸时间与标度预测定量吻合。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在强受限条件下，移动珠密度出现显著偏差，与原位介电谱实验一致；毛细渗入过程中吸附层内环状结构比例逐渐增加，归因于初始拉伸链向平衡构象的松弛；链松弛动力学表现出长度依赖的延迟效应，特征解吸时间与标度预测定量吻合。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 分子动力学模拟（molecular dynamics simulations），并结合与实验（原位介电谱）的对比分析。

papers.title: Near-Room-Temperature Antiferromagnetic Ordering in the Quadruple Perovskite Sr4NaRu3O12
papers.abstract: We report the synthesis, structure and magnetic properties of two 1:3 ordered quadruple perovskites Sr4MRu3O12 (M = Li and Na). Sr4NaRu3O12 crystallizes in the centrosymmetric space group R-3 and Sr4LiRu3O12 appears to be isostructural to the Na compound based on the PXRD data. In Sr4NaRu3O12, both Na and Ru are predominantly ordered at the B sites (here Na/Li and Ru) and the structure contains only corner-connected RuO6 and NaO6 octahedra. This atomic ordering also leads to a rather large unit cell with a = 11.25 Å and c = 27.6 Å compared to the basic 12R structure (a = 5.5 Å and c ~ 27 Å). Magnetic measurements reveal that Sr4NaRu3O12 undergoes a magnetic transition to an antiferromagnetic state below TN ~ 265 K which is confirmed by DSC and neutron diffraction. The Ru moments show a collinear antiferromagnetic spin alignment along the hexagonal c axis with a propagation vector k = (0, 0, 1.5). Interestingly, those Ru moments lying on the three-fold roto-inversion do not significantly contribute to the magnetic order, since they are located between antiferromagnetically coupled Ru atoms and are therefore probably highly frustrated. Band structure calculations on Sr4NaRu3O12 complement the observed magnetic ground state and a semiconducting behavior in the compound. Sr4LiRu3O12 shows a magnetic anomaly below 110 K, possibly associated with competing ferromagnetic and antiferromagnetic interactions.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（关键词：synthesis, structure, magnetic measurements, neutron diffraction, DSC, PXRD，辅以计算：band structure calculations）；研究对象：两种1:3有序四重钙钛矿材料 Sr₄MRu₃O₁₂（M = Li 和 Na），重点研究 Sr₄NaRu₃O₁₂ 的晶体结构与磁性质。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: Sr₄NaRu₃O₁₂ 在约265 K发生反铁磁有序转变，Ru磁矩沿六方c轴呈共线反铁磁排列，传播矢量为 k = (0, 0, 1.5)；位于三重反演轴上的Ru原子因高度阻挫而对磁有序贡献微弱。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：Sr₄NaRu₃O₁₂ 在约265 K发生反铁磁有序转变，Ru磁矩沿六方c轴呈共线反铁磁排列，传播矢量为 k = (0, 0, 1.5)；位于三重反演轴上的Ru原子因高度阻挫而对磁有序贡献微弱。；创新点：首次报道了 Sr₄NaRu₃O₁₂ 在近室温（~265 K）下的反铁磁有序，并揭示了其独特的磁结构——部分Ru原子因几何阻挫不参与长程磁有序。摘要未突出说明与已有四重钙钛矿磁性的系统性对比。
papers.method_zh: 粉末X射线衍射（PXRD）确定晶体结构；磁化率测量、差示扫描量热法（DSC）和中子衍射确定磁转变温度与磁结构；能带结构计算（band structure calculations）辅助解释磁基态与半导体行为。

papers.title: Analysis of Critical Points in a Permutation Model on Hierarchical Lattices by Real-Space Renormalization Group
papers.abstract: The permutation model is a classical spin system where elements of the symmetric group interact with one another. The partition function of this model is directly related to the entanglement structure of random quantum circuits and random tensor networks. In these contexts, the entanglement entropy undergoes a transition between area-law and volume-law scaling, depending on the model parameters. This transition point has attracted considerable attention. In the present work, we investigate the ferromagnetic-paramagnetic phase transition of the permutation model, which corresponds to the entanglement entropy transition. Using exact real-space renormalization group calculations on self-dual hierarchical lattices, we numerically determine finite-replica critical points for (q=mn=2,...,6). We compare the results with the duality prediction based on the Fourier transform of the symmetric group and then extrapolate the b=3 data toward the replica limit $mn\to0$, where the effective dimension is two. The comparison supports the duality-based estimate while also clarifying the systematic uncertainty associated with the extrapolation formula.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：real-space renormalization group、duality prediction、extrapolation。；研究对象：排列模型（permutation model）在自对偶层级晶格上的铁磁-顺磁相变，该相变对应于随机量子电路和随机张量网络中的纠缠熵面积律-体积律转变。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过实空间重整化群计算，数值确定了有限副本数（q=mn=2,...,6）下的临界点，并将b=3的数据外推至副本极限（mn→0，有效维度为二维），结果支持基于对偶性的估计，同时揭示了外推公式带来的系统不确定性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过实空间重整化群计算，数值确定了有限副本数（q=mn=2,...,6）下的临界点，并将b=3的数据外推至副本极限（mn→0，有效维度为二维），结果支持基于对偶性的估计，同时揭示了外推公式带来的系统不确定性。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用精确实空间重整化群（real-space renormalization group）计算，在自对偶层级晶格（self-dual hierarchical lattices）上对排列模型进行数值分析，并与基于对称群傅里叶变换的对偶性预测进行比较，最后通过外推法逼近副本极限。

papers.title: The evolution of pairing correlation with $3d_{z^{2}}$ electron filling in a bilayer two-orbital model for La$_3$Ni$_2$O$_7$
papers.abstract: The discovery of high-${T_c}$ superconductivity in pressurized bilayer nickelate La$_3$Ni$_2$O$_7$ presents a new arena for exploring unconventional pairing mechanisms. A pivotal yet unresolved issue is the specific role of the $3d_{z^{2}}$ orbital of Ni. While its inter-layer super-exchange antiferromagnetic coupling is widely considered crucial for superconductivity, the role of its itinerancy remains undetermined. Early studies showed that the superconductivity is accompanied by the emergence of a small Fermi pocket of the $3d_{z^{2}}$ orbitals. However, recent experiments show controversial results on the role of the $3d_{z^{2}}$ Fermi pocket on superconductivity. Motivated by these experimental results, we investigate an effective bilayer two-orbital model for La$_3$Ni$_2$O$_7$ using density-matrix renormalization group (DMRG) on a minimal one-dimensional geometry. By systematically varying the $3d_{z^{2}}$ orbital filling from $1/12$ doping to half-filling, we observe a pronounced suppression of superconducting correlations near half-filling. Our results demonstrate the itinerancy of $3d_{z^{2}}$ orbital is favorable for the pairing in the bilayer two-orbital model for La$_3$Ni$_2$O$_7$. Moreover, we observe that the pairing correlation is enhanced in regions where charge fluctuations are large, suggesting a competition between charge order and superconductivity in the model.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：density-matrix renormalization group (DMRG)、模型计算。；研究对象：加压双层镍氧化物 La₃Ni₂O₇ 中的超导配对机制，具体聚焦于 Ni 的 3d_{z²} 轨道电子填充对配对关联的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在双层双轨道模型中，3d_{z²} 轨道的巡游性有利于超导配对；当该轨道填充接近半满时，超导关联被显著抑制。此外，配对关联在电荷涨落较大的区域得到增强，表明电荷序与超导电性之间存在竞争。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在双层双轨道模型中，3d_{z²} 轨道的巡游性有利于超导配对；当该轨道填充接近半满时，超导关联被显著抑制。此外，配对关联在电荷涨落较大的区域得到增强，表明电荷序与超导电性之间存在竞争。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 使用密度矩阵重正化群（DMRG）方法，在一维最小几何结构上求解有效双层双轨道模型，通过系统改变 3d_{z²} 轨道填充（从 1/12 掺杂到半满）来研究配对关联的演化。

papers.title: On the Relation Between String Order Parameters, Entanglement, and Dynamical Quantum Phase Transitions in Topological Dynamics
papers.abstract: Topological order is defined by topological invariants, rather than symmetries and local order parameters. Nonetheless some topological phases can be characterized by string order parameters and entanglement. In this article we study how string order parameters and entanglement spectra behave out-of-equilibrium following quenches in one dimensional topological models with $\mathbb{Z}$ invariants. Previously it has been suggested that string order parameters could serve as an experimental probe of dynamical quantum phase transitions. Despite the existence of clear zeroes in the order parameters at critical times, we show that in general there is no exact quantitative or qualitative connection with the critical times of dynamical quantum phase transitions. Another possible connection is of dynamical string order parameter zeroes and dynamical crossings at the center of entanglement spectra. Here we see that there can sometimes be a connection, but it is not typical. Again there is no general quantitative or qualitative connection. Each dynamical form of criticality behaves independently, though we do see that critical times tend to be of the same order of magnitude and give an argument for why this is the case. We also find that a string order parameter which labels one topological phase can undergo non-trivial dynamics even following a quench between \emph{other} topological phases. We elucidate where connections can be made, and where they result from a consideration of insufficiently general models. These results cast doubt on the idea of genuine dynamical phases following quenches in such models.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：研究（study）、理论分析、模型（topological models）、quenches（淬火）。；研究对象：一维具有Z拓扑不变量的拓扑模型中的非平衡动力学，具体关注弦序参量、纠缠谱与动力学量子相变之间的关系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 弦序参量在临界时间出现零点，但通常与动力学量子相变的临界时间没有精确的定量或定性联系；弦序参量零点与纠缠谱中心交叉之间有时存在联系，但并非典型情况。每种动力学临界行为独立演化，质疑了此类模型中淬火后存在真正动力学相的观点。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：弦序参量在临界时间出现零点，但通常与动力学量子相变的临界时间没有精确的定量或定性联系；弦序参量零点与纠缠谱中心交叉之间有时存在联系，但并非典型情况。每种动力学临界行为独立演化，质疑了此类模型中淬火后存在真正动力学相的观点。；创新点：系统性地揭示了弦序参量零点、纠缠谱中心交叉与动力学量子相变临界时间之间缺乏普遍、精确的定量或定性联系，并指出先前研究中可能因模型不够一般化而得出误导性结论。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析，基于一维拓扑模型（具有Z拓扑不变量）的淬火动力学，通过计算弦序参量、纠缠谱以及动力学量子相变的临界时间，进行对比研究。

papers.title: A sweeping twist defect as a topological flagellum that drives colloid motion
papers.abstract: Nematic liquid crystals can dramatically reconfigure under dynamic forcing, providing exciting opportunities in active matter. Here, we study a hybrid disk colloid rotated by an external field which generates a dynamic companion topological defect. The disk moves faster when the defect sweeps across the disk's face. We identify the defect as a non-singular twist wall, characterize the twist energy landscape, and identify the sweeping motion as a topological instability. As the defect sweeps, it reverses the handedness of twist and lowers the free energy in the fluid in the gap above the disk. Landau-de Gennes modeling shows that the sweeping wall behaves as a propagating director texture: the director field is nearly stationary in the wall frame, while nematogens rotate locally as the wall passes. The nematogens' rotation generates a viscous stress on the surface of the disk that hastens its propulsion. Thus, the defect acts as a flagellum that powers colloid swimming, providing an example of a dissipative topological structure whose dynamics can be harnessed to perform useful work.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验+理论建模）。判断依据：摘要中提及“研究混合盘状胶体”、“Landau-de Gennes建模”以及“识别为拓扑不稳定性”，表明结合了实验观测与理论模拟。；研究对象：向列相液晶中由旋转外场驱动的混合盘状胶体，及其产生的动态伴随拓扑缺陷（非奇异扭曲壁）对胶体运动的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 发现一种非奇异扭曲壁缺陷在盘面上扫过时，会反转扭曲手性并降低间隙流体的自由能，同时通过向列基元的局部旋转在盘表面产生粘性应力，从而加速胶体推进，该缺陷起到类似“拓扑鞭毛”的作用。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：发现一种非奇异扭曲壁缺陷在盘面上扫过时，会反转扭曲手性并降低间隙流体的自由能，同时通过向列基元的局部旋转在盘表面产生粘性应力，从而加速胶体推进，该缺陷起到类似“拓扑鞭毛”的作用。；创新点：首次将动态拓扑缺陷（非奇异扭曲壁）识别为一种“拓扑鞭毛”，证明其扫动行为可被利用来驱动胶体游泳，为耗散拓扑结构执行有用功提供了新范例。
papers.method_zh: 实验上通过外场旋转混合盘状胶体产生动态缺陷；理论上采用Landau-de Gennes模型模拟指向矢纹理的传播行为，并分析扭曲能量景观及粘性应力机制。

papers.title: Nitrogen-doped W0.75Re0.25 Superconducting Nanowire Single Photon Detectors
papers.abstract: Nitrogen-doped Tungsten-Rhenium superconducting alloys were recently proposed as a promising material platform for superconducting nanowire single-photon detectors (SNSPDs), offering a favorable balance between high normal state resistivity and tunable superconducting properties. In this work, we report on the fabrication and characterization of SNSPDs based on ultrathin W0.75Re0.25 films deposited by reactive DC magnetron sputtering in a mixed Ar/N2 atmosphere. Meander detectors with 70 nm linewidth exhibit saturated internal detection efficiency up to 1310 nm at 2.5 K, with sub-nanosecond rise times, decay times of the order of a few nanoseconds, and timing jitter of 73.2 ps measured with room temperature amplifiers.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：关键词“fabrication and characterization”（制备与表征）、“deposited by reactive DC magnetron sputtering”（反应直流磁控溅射沉积）、“exhibit saturated internal detection efficiency”（展示饱和内探测效率）。；研究对象：氮掺杂钨铼（W₀.₇₅Re₀.₂₅）超导纳米线单光子探测器（SNSPD）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 基于超薄W₀.₇₅Re₀.₂₅薄膜制备的70 nm线宽蛇形纳米线探测器，在2.5 K温度下对1310 nm波长光子实现了饱和内探测效率，并具有亚纳秒上升时间、数纳秒衰减时间和73.2 ps的时间抖动。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：基于超薄W₀.₇₅Re₀.₂₅薄膜制备的70 nm线宽蛇形纳米线探测器，在2.5 K温度下对1310 nm波长光子实现了饱和内探测效率，并具有亚纳秒上升时间、数纳秒衰减时间和73.2 ps的时间抖动。；创新点：首次将氮掺杂钨铼（W₀.₇₅Re₀.₂₅）超导合金应用于纳米线单光子探测器的实际制备与性能表征，验证了该材料体系在兼顾高正常态电阻率与可调超导特性方面的优势。
papers.method_zh: 反应直流磁控溅射（在Ar/N₂混合气氛中沉积超薄W₀.₇₅Re₀.₂₅薄膜）；光刻与刻蚀工艺制备70 nm线宽蛇形纳米线；低温光电测试（2.5 K下测量内探测效率、时间响应特性）；室温放大器配合时间抖动测量。

papers.title: Sensitivity to perturbations in the three-dimensional Anderson model
papers.abstract: We investigate the fidelity susceptibility, which quantifies the sensitivity of single-particle eigenstates to perturbations, in the three-dimensional Anderson model. As a function of disorder strength $W$, it exhibits two distinct peaks. The first peak signals a crossover at weak disorder strength from plane-wave states to single-particle quantum chaos, and its position shifts toward $W\to 0$ in the thermodynamic limit. The second peak emerges, to high numerical accuracy, at the critical disorder strength associated with the Anderson localization transition. We further show that the divergence of the first peak is maximal, scaling as the square of the inverse frequency cutoff, whereas the divergence of the second peak is submaximal. We relate the latter suppression to the fractal structure of single-particle eigenstates at criticality. We discuss two distinct scenarios that give rise to the peaks in the fidelity susceptibilities. Moreover, studying the scaling of typical fidelity susceptibilities above the Anderson transition, we find evidence of two distinct regimes of nonergodic behavior.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：摘要中提及“数值精度”（numerical accuracy）、“标度”（scaling）等关键词，表明主要采用数值计算与理论分析相结合的方法。；研究对象：三维安德森模型（three-dimensional Anderson model）中单粒子本征态对扰动的敏感性，具体关注保真度磁化率（fidelity susceptibility）随无序强度变化的峰值行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 保真度磁化率随无序强度呈现两个不同峰值：第一个峰值对应从平面波态到单粒子量子混沌的弱无序交叉，在热力学极限下峰值位置趋近于零无序；第二个峰值精确对应安德森局域化转变的临界无序强度。第一个峰的发散是最大化的（与频率截止的平方成反比），而第二个峰的发散是次最大化的，后者与临界点处单粒子本征态的分形结构有关。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：保真度磁化率随无序强度呈现两个不同峰值：第一个峰值对应从平面波态到单粒子量子混沌的弱无序交叉，在热力学极限下峰值位置趋近于零无序；第二个峰值精确对应安德森局域化转变的临界无序强度。第一个峰的发散是最大化的（与频率截止的平方成反比），而第二个峰的发散是次最大化的，后者与临界点处单粒子本征态的分形结构有关。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 通过数值计算三维安德森模型中的保真度磁化率，分析其随无序强度变化的峰值行为；利用标度分析研究峰值发散行为；通过典型保真度磁化率的标度行为，识别安德森转变以上非遍历行为的两个不同区域。

papers.title: Magnetoelastic effects in the metallic frustrated antiferromagnet CrB$_2$
papers.abstract: Hexagonal chromium diboride CrB$_2$ is a metallic frustrated antiferromagnet with a Néel temperature $T_N \sim$ 88 K. In CrB$_2$, Cr 3$d$ electrons not only give rise to localized magnetic moments but also contribute to metallic conduction. We perform ultrasound velocity measurements on a single crystal of hexagonal CrB$_2$ to determine its elastic properties. The temperature dependence of the $ab$-plane shear elastic modulus exhibits Curie-type softening upon cooling from $\sim$120 K down to $T_N$. This behavior is interpreted as a precursor to a symmetry-lowering lattice distortion at $T_N$, indicating that magnetic frustration is relieved via transverse magnetoelastic coupling. In addition, the $a$-axis and $c$-axis compressive elastic moduli show unusual softness and their suppression upon cooling, which are naturally explained by Fermi-surface nesting and its suppression upon cooling. The present results suggest that, in CrB$_2$, longitudinal magnetoelastic coupling suppresses Fermi-surface nesting and enhances frustrated exchange interactions, while transverse magnetoelastic coupling plays a key role in relieving the frustration.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：关键词“ultrasound velocity measurements”（超声速度测量）、“single crystal”（单晶）、“elastic properties”（弹性性质）。；研究对象：六方二硼化铬（CrB₂），一种金属阻挫反铁磁体，其Cr 3d电子同时贡献局域磁矩和金属导电性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在CrB₂中，横向磁弹耦合在奈尔温度（T_N ~ 88 K）附近释放磁阻挫，导致ab面剪切弹性模量出现居里型软化；纵向磁弹耦合则抑制费米面嵌套并增强阻挫交换相互作用。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在CrB₂中，横向磁弹耦合在奈尔温度（T_N ~ 88 K）附近释放磁阻挫，导致ab面剪切弹性模量出现居里型软化；纵向磁弹耦合则抑制费米面嵌套并增强阻挫交换相互作用。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 对六方CrB₂单晶进行超声速度测量，测定其弹性模量（包括ab面剪切模量、a轴和c轴压缩模量）随温度的变化。

papers.title: Transition from Homogeneous to Domain-Wall-Mediated Polarization Switching in BaTiO3: A Machine-Learning Molecular Dynamics Study
papers.abstract: Polarization switching in ferroelectric BaTiO3 can proceed through fundamentally different mechanisms - yet the conditions that determine which pathway is realized remain poorly understood. Using machine-learning potential-based molecular dynamics with the MACEField model, we systematically vary supercell size to reveal a clear transition from homogeneous polarization switching to domain-wall-mediated switching, accompanied by a coercive field increase of over 50%. Shannon entropy analysis demonstrates that this transition is driven by size-dependent polarization fluctuations that promote 180 degree domain-wall nucleation - establishing a direct, quantitative link between local configurational disorder and macroscopic switching behavior. Furthermore, the switching pathway and hysteresis response are shown to depend critically on supercell geometry and the relative orientation of applied stress and electric field. These findings reveal that homogeneous and domain-wall-mediated switching are distinct physical regimes in BaTiO3, and that atomistic simulations must account for system size to correctly capture the operative switching mechanism.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：machine-learning potential-based molecular dynamics（基于机器学习势的分子动力学）、MACEField模型、atomistic simulations（原子尺度模拟）。；研究对象：铁电体BaTiO₃（钛酸钡）中的极化翻转机制，具体研究从均匀极化翻转到畴壁介导翻转的转变过程。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在BaTiO₃中，通过改变超胞尺寸，可以观察到从均匀极化翻转到畴壁介导翻转的清晰转变，伴随矫顽场增加超过50%；该转变由尺寸依赖的极化涨落驱动，建立了局域构型无序与宏观翻转行为之间的定量联系。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在BaTiO₃中，通过改变超胞尺寸，可以观察到从均匀极化翻转到畴壁介导翻转的清晰转变，伴随矫顽场增加超过50%；该转变由尺寸依赖的极化涨落驱动，建立了局域构型无序与宏观翻转行为之间的定量联系。；创新点：首次通过原子尺度模拟揭示了BaTiO₃中均匀翻转与畴壁介导翻转是截然不同的物理区间，并定量证明了系统尺寸对翻转机制的决定性影响，强调了原子模拟必须考虑系统尺寸才能正确捕捉实际运作的翻转机制。
papers.method_zh: 采用基于MACEField模型的机器学习势分子动力学模拟，通过系统改变超胞尺寸，并结合Shannon熵分析来研究极化涨落与翻转路径的关系。

papers.title: Spin layer groups and their corepresentations
papers.abstract: Spin layer groups are the crystallographic symmetry groups with a periodic plane, and their symmetry operations are inherited from three-dimensional (3D) spin space groups. However, the direct application of 3D symmetry groups to two-dimensional systems is often inadequate due to anisotropic axes and dimensional reduction. In this work, we systematically classify inequivalent spin layer groups and analytically derive their irreducible corepresentations. This classification establishes a foundational framework for investigating symmetry-protected properties and novel quantum states in low-dimensional magnetic materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：classify（分类）、analytically derive（解析推导）、corepresentations（共表示）。；研究对象：自旋层群（spin layer groups）及其不可约共表示，即具有周期性平面的二维磁性材料的晶体学对称群。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 系统分类了不等价的自旋层群，并解析推导了其不可约共表示，为低维磁性材料中对称性保护的性质和新型量子态建立了基础框架。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：系统分类了不等价的自旋层群，并解析推导了其不可约共表示，为低维磁性材料中对称性保护的性质和新型量子态建立了基础框架。；创新点：首次系统性地对自旋层群进行不等价分类并解析推导其不可约共表示，弥补了直接应用三维对称群到二维体系时的不足。
papers.method_zh: 基于三维自旋空间群的对称操作，通过考虑各向异性轴和维度约化，对二维体系的自旋层群进行系统分类和解析推导。

papers.title: AI-Driven SERS for Non-invasive and Label-Free Extracellular Vesicle Detection Across Cellular Origins in Tears and Sweat
papers.abstract: Wearable sensing technology capable of point-of-care, continuous and non-invasive analysis of exosomes in biofluid such as tears and sweat is an essential part for future personalized medicine. Major detection and identification methods of cell secreted Extracellular Vesicles (EVs) often require labeling and are time-consuming, resulting in low efficiency in EV mechanism research and disease diagnosis. While the label-free Surface-enhanced Raman spectroscopy (SERS) has been combined with deep learning model for EV identification in blood, their application to non-invasive detection of EVs in tears and sweat are missing. Here, we filled this gap by developing an artificial intelligence (AI)-assisted Surface-enhanced Raman spectroscopy (SERS) method based on salt-induced nanoparticle aggregation for fast EV identification in tears and sweat with high accuracy. Significantly, our label-free detection and AI differentiation of EVs from 6 cell lines (HepG2, Hela, 143B, LO-2, BMSC, H8) achieved the identification of EVs in tear fluids from 7 different disease sources with accuracies >92%. Our results showed that this platform can not only distinguish EVs from multiple cell sources but also generate highly reproducible and selective EV signals in tear fluids without a need for chemical labeling or separation steps. Molecular dynamics simulations revealed that silver atoms (Ag) form electrostatic interactions with oxygen atoms of multiple amino acid residues in proteins, suggesting a high affinity. This strategy realizes ultra-sensitive and anti-interference detection of EVs, providing a new idea for the rapid diagnosis of clinical diseases.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（关键词：AI-driven SERS、salt-induced nanoparticle aggregation、molecular dynamics simulations，结合实验与模拟）；研究对象：基于表面增强拉曼光谱（SERS）技术，对泪液和汗液中的细胞外囊泡（Extracellular Vesicles, EVs）进行无标记、非侵入性检测。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 开发了一种基于盐诱导纳米颗粒聚集的人工智能辅助SERS方法，能够高精度（>92%）识别来自6种不同细胞系及7种疾病来源泪液中的EVs，实现了无需化学标记或分离步骤的快速、高选择性检测。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：开发了一种基于盐诱导纳米颗粒聚集的人工智能辅助SERS方法，能够高精度（>92%）识别来自6种不同细胞系及7种疾病来源泪液中的EVs，实现了无需化学标记或分离步骤的快速、高选择性检测。；创新点：首次将无标记SERS与AI深度学习模型应用于泪液和汗液中EV的非侵入性检测，填补了该领域在非血液体液（如泪液、汗液）中EV快速识别的研究空白。
papers.method_zh: 实验上采用盐诱导银纳米颗粒聚集增强拉曼信号，结合深度学习模型进行EV识别；理论上利用分子动力学模拟揭示银原子与蛋白质氨基酸残基中氧原子之间的静电相互作用。

papers.title: Non-equilibrium pathway to mesoscale ordering in ethanol-water binary liquid
papers.abstract: Ethanol-water mixtures are a classic example of thermodynamic non-ideality, yet the structural origin of their pronounced anomalies, such as volume contraction and a large negative excess entropy, has remained a long-standing puzzle. Here, we demonstrate these anomalies are not equilibrium properties but calorimetric fingerprint of an arrested phase transition. By imposing periodic thermal oscillations, we drive a 50% (v/v) ethanol-water system along a complete hierarchical self-assembly pathway that progressed from ethanol clusters to water-containing droplets, then to acicular flakes, and finally to micron-scale ordered ethanol aggregates. Fluorescence spectroscopy, two-dimensional correlation analysis and nuclear magnetic resonance revealed the underlying non-equilibrium molecular mechanism: a periodic perturbation of the water-dominated hydrogen-bond network initiates a ethanol-water coexistence intermediate, ultimately leading to the stable ordered assembly of an ethanol-rich phase. Our finding demonstrated that periodic physical perturbations capable drive spontaneous ordering across multiple length scales in a simple binary mixture, providing a kinetic perspective on the structural origin of solution non-ideality, and carry general implications for self-assembly strategies in soft matter.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到了“荧光光谱”、“二维相关分析”和“核磁共振”等具体实验手段。；研究对象：乙醇-水二元液体混合物，具体为50%（体积比）的乙醇-水体系。研究其非理想性（如体积收缩、负过剩熵）的结构起源以及在外界周期性扰动下的非平衡自组装行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 乙醇-水混合物的热力学反常（如体积收缩、负过剩熵）并非平衡态性质，而是一种受阻相变的量热学特征。通过施加周期性热振荡，可以驱动该体系沿一条完整的分级自组装路径，最终形成微米尺度的有序乙醇聚集体。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：乙醇-水混合物的热力学反常（如体积收缩、负过剩熵）并非平衡态性质，而是一种受阻相变的量热学特征。通过施加周期性热振荡，可以驱动该体系沿一条完整的分级自组装路径，最终形成微米尺度的有序乙醇聚集体。；创新点：该工作首次证明，简单的周期性物理扰动（热振荡）能够驱动一个简单的二元液体混合物在多个长度尺度上实现自发有序化，为溶液非理想性的结构起源提供了一个动力学视角，并对软物质的自组装策略具有普遍意义。
papers.method_zh: 实验方法包括：施加周期性热振荡作为外部驱动；使用荧光光谱、二维相关分析以及核磁共振（NMR）来探测分子层面的非平衡机制和结构演化。

papers.title: Local Structural Signatures of Shear Bands in Metallic Glasses via Electron Nanodiffraction
papers.abstract: Structural changes in a glass due to deformation are subtle and difficult to quantify using conventional imaging and diffraction techniques. Additionally, transmission electron microscopy (TEM) sample preparation using energetic ions often causes structural modifications that are challenging to detect in disordered materials. By preparing inverted cross-sectional transmission electron microscopy lamellae of shear bands formed during bending, and employing cryogenic ion polishing to minimize preparation artefacts, we preserve the intrinsic atomic structure. Using sensitive, new parameters derived from electron nano-diffraction, we directly probe the local nano-scale structure in the plastic zone beneath surface shear steps in metallic glasses. Mapping of local centrosymmetry and strain reveals nanoscale, stripe-like regions oriented at 45 degree to the applied strain where strain has localized. These regions exhibit a high density of local atomic structures that have transformed to configurations with reduced centrosymmetry and increased magnitudes of shear and normal strain. Our results demonstrate that plastic deformation in metallic glasses arises from coordinated nanoscale structural transformations, providing direct experimental insight into a long-standing problem.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键词：electron nanodiffraction（电子纳米衍射）、transmission electron microscopy（透射电子显微镜）、cryogenic ion polishing（低温离子抛光）。；研究对象：金属玻璃（metallic glasses）中剪切带（shear bands）的局部结构变化，特别是塑性变形区（plastic zone）的纳米尺度原子结构。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 金属玻璃的塑性变形源于纳米尺度上原子结构的协同转变，这些转变表现为局部中心对称性降低、剪切应变和正应变增大的条纹状区域，且这些区域与外加应变方向呈45度角。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：金属玻璃的塑性变形源于纳米尺度上原子结构的协同转变，这些转变表现为局部中心对称性降低、剪切应变和正应变增大的条纹状区域，且这些区域与外加应变方向呈45度角。；创新点：通过改进样品制备方法（低温离子抛光）和开发基于电子纳米衍射的敏感结构参数，首次直接实验观测到金属玻璃中剪切带下方纳米尺度的有序结构转变特征，为长期存在的塑性变形机制问题提供了直接实验证据。
papers.method_zh: 采用倒置横截面透射电镜（inverted cross-sectional TEM）样品制备技术，结合低温离子抛光（cryogenic ion polishing）以减少制样损伤；利用电子纳米衍射（electron nanodiffraction）提取新的结构参数（如局部中心对称性和应变），直接探测剪切台阶下方塑性区的纳米尺度结构。

papers.title: Disentangling the contributions of individual cations to magnetic order in a spinel high entropy oxide
papers.abstract: High entropy oxides (HEOs) can possess long-range ordered magnetic states despite their extreme chemical disorder. Very little is known about how the different chemical constituents in HEOs contribute to the emergence of these magnetic states. In this work, we leverage element-specific magnetometry attained via x-ray magnetic circular dichroism (XMCD) to understand how magnetic order is driven in two ferrimagnetic spinel-structured HEOs with compositions (Cr,Mn,Fe,Co,Ni)$_3$O$_4$ and (Cr,Mn,Fe,Co,Ni)$_{2.4}$Ga$_{0.6}$O$_4$. We find that while the magnetic transition is simultaneous for all chemical species, the rate at which their magnetic moments grow is strongly cation dependent. This behavior is explained by the varying $\textit{3d}$ crystal field level fillings of the magnetic cations, which in turn determine their ability to participate in the different magnetic exchange pathways available in the spinel structure. Dominant $A$-$B$ sublattice exchange enables some species to harden rapidly ($\textit{e.g.}$ tetrahedral Fe$^{3+}$ and octahedral Ni$^{2+}$) while others exhibit a sluggish transition due to frustration from competing interactions ($\textit{e.g.}$ octahedral Fe$^{3+}$ and Cr$^{3+}$). Non-magnetic substitution suppresses these differences, introducing broken magnetic linkages that relieve frustration. Tailoring the magnetism of HEO spinels therefore requires detailed knowledge of both their site selectivities and their exchange pathways.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据关键词：element-specific magnetometry、x-ray magnetic circular dichroism (XMCD)。；研究对象：两种铁磁亚稳态尖晶石结构的高熵氧化物（HEOs）：(Cr,Mn,Fe,Co,Ni)₃O₄ 和 (Cr,Mn,Fe,Co,Ni)₂.₄Ga₀.₆O₄，以及其中单个阳离子对磁有序的贡献。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 尽管所有化学物种的磁转变同时发生，但不同阳离子的磁矩增长速度强烈依赖于其种类，这由阳离子的3d晶体场能级填充及其在尖晶石结构中参与不同磁交换路径的能力决定。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：尽管所有化学物种的磁转变同时发生，但不同阳离子的磁矩增长速度强烈依赖于其种类，这由阳离子的3d晶体场能级填充及其在尖晶石结构中参与不同磁交换路径的能力决定。；创新点：首次通过元素分辨的磁测量，揭示了高熵氧化物中不同阳离子对磁有序贡献的差异，并解释了其物理根源（晶体场填充与交换路径），而非仅关注整体磁性质。
papers.method_zh: 利用X射线磁圆二色性（XMCD）实现元素特异性磁测量，分析不同阳离子在磁有序过程中的行为。

papers.title: Experimental and computational diffusion analysis in Ni-X binary and Ni-Al-X (X = Cr, Mo, Ta, W, Re) ternary systems
papers.abstract: An extensive diffusion analysis is presented for binary Ni-X and ternary Ni-Al-X (X = Cr, Mo, Ta, W, Re) systems, which play a crucial role in microstructural evolution and phase stability in Ni-Al-based superalloys. Specifically, we highlight changes in the diffusion coefficients of X in the presence of Al and compare diffusional interactions across systems considered. First-principles calculations, combined with activation energies derived from temperature-dependent experiments, reveal consistent trends in Ni-X systems, with variations in activation energies largely attributed to differences in migration energies. In ternary systems, diffusion coefficients estimated from intersecting diffusion profiles show that the main interdiffusion coefficient of X is comparable to its binary counterpart, with similar activation energies. However, cross-diffusion coefficients are shown to significantly influence fluxes, either enhancing or reducing diffusion lengths depending on the relative directions of diffusing elements. For Ni-Al-Re, a single-profile method is employed to overcome uncertainties in estimating composition gradients at the near-end-member intersecting composition. The diffusion coefficients obtained correlate well with the nature of diffusion paths when represented on Gibbs triangles. To extend these findings, a physics-informed neural network (PINN) optimization method is applied to extract composition-dependent diffusion coefficients across the full composition range. The analysis demonstrates the necessity of incorporating experimentally estimated diffusion coefficients as equality constraints, without which optimization reliability is compromised. Overall, the results establish a robust framework for diffusion studies in Ni-Al-X systems, highlighting the critical role of cross-diffusion effects and constraint-enhanced numerical methods.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验与计算结合）。关键词：experimental diffusion analysis、first-principles calculations、physics-informed neural network (PINN) optimization method。；研究对象：Ni-Al基高温合金中的二元Ni-X和三元Ni-Al-X（X = Cr, Mo, Ta, W, Re）体系的扩散行为，重点关注Al存在时X元素扩散系数的变化以及扩散相互作用。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在三元体系中，X的主互扩散系数与其二元体系中的值相当且激活能相似，但交叉扩散系数会显著影响扩散通量，可增强或缩短扩散长度；基于物理信息的神经网络（PINN）优化方法需将实验估计的扩散系数作为等式约束，否则优化可靠性受损。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在三元体系中，X的主互扩散系数与其二元体系中的值相当且激活能相似，但交叉扩散系数会显著影响扩散通量，可增强或缩短扩散长度；基于物理信息的神经网络（PINN）优化方法需将实验估计的扩散系数作为等式约束，否则优化可靠性受损。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 实验上采用温度依赖的扩散实验提取激活能；计算上使用第一性原理计算（first-principles calculations）分析迁移能差异；对于三元体系，通过交叉扩散剖面估计扩散系数；对Ni-Al-Re体系采用单剖面法（single-profile method）克服近端元成分梯度估计的不确定性；最后应用物理信息神经网络（PINN）优化方法提取全成分范围内的成分依赖扩散系数。

papers.title: Three-Dimensional Atomic-Scale Structural Transformation in a SrTiO3 Grain Boundary
papers.abstract: Grain boundaries (GBs) in complex oxides play critical roles in governing their functional properties, which are intrinsically linked to their three-dimensional (3D) atomic configurations and local chemical environments that can deviate markedly from those of the bulk. However, the 3D atomic structures of GBs remain poorly understood due to the projection limitations of conventional (S)TEM. Here, using multislice electron ptychography, we resolve the 3D atomic structure of a Σ13(510)/[001] tilt GB in SrTiO3 with simultaneous visualization of both cation and oxygen columns. Depth-resolved reconstruction reveals pronounced structural inhomogeneity along the GB, uncovering a transition from the canonical symmetric configuration (STR1) to an asymmetric configuration (STR2) that is hidden in conventional projection imaging. Quantitative analysis of atomic-column intensities demonstrates that these two GB configurations possess distinct local chemical and vacancy distributions. By further mapping the atomic displacement fields, we reveal that the transformation between STR1 and STR2 proceeds via local atomic shuffling at the GB core and collective shear displacement in the adjoining grains, mediated by the step and dislocation character of the junction, respectively. Moreover, analysis of oxygen octahedral rotations reveals a strong dependence on the local atomic structure with pronounced asymmetry around the STR2 region. These findings establish a direct link among the 3D atomic structure, local chemical composition, and lattice order parameters at the GB, underscoring the critical importance of depth-resolved characterization in understanding and engineering GB-mediated functionalities in complex oxides.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：关键词“multislice electron ptychography”（多层电子叠层成像）、“depth-resolved reconstruction”（深度分辨重构）、“quantitative analysis”（定量分析）等，表明该工作基于实验表征技术。；研究对象：SrTiO₃（钛酸锶）中的Σ13(510)/[001]倾斜晶界。具体研究该晶界的三维原子结构、局部化学环境及结构转变。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 揭示了SrTiO₃晶界中隐藏的三维结构不均匀性：从对称构型（STR1）到非对称构型（STR2）的转变，并建立了三维原子结构、局部化学组分与晶格序参量之间的直接联系。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：揭示了SrTiO₃晶界中隐藏的三维结构不均匀性：从对称构型（STR1）到非对称构型（STR2）的转变，并建立了三维原子结构、局部化学组分与晶格序参量之间的直接联系。；创新点：突破了传统（扫描）透射电镜的投影限制，首次实现了对复杂氧化物晶界中氧原子柱的三维原子尺度成像，并发现了常规投影成像中隐藏的对称性破缺结构转变及其与局部化学、晶格畸变的关联。
papers.method_zh: 多层电子叠层成像（multislice electron ptychography）技术，用于同时解析阳离子和氧原子柱的三维原子位置；结合原子柱强度定量分析、原子位移场映射以及氧八面体旋转分析。

papers.title: Beyond Local Detailed Balance: Microscopic Rates Reshape Nonequilibrium Phase Behavior
papers.abstract: Local detailed balance (LDB) is a central guiding principle for modeling nonequilibrium stochastic dynamics, yet it only constrains the ratio of forward and backward transition rates and does not fix the steady state. Although the functional form of rates under the same LDB has been shown to affect correlation properties in weakly interacting systems, whether it can reshape phase behavior in strongly interacting systems remains unclear. Here, for a two-dimensional driven lattice gas with attractive nearest-neighbor interactions, we consider hopping rates with a parameter that preserves the same LDB but tunes asymmetry along the driving force. We find that this parameter controls qualitative phase behavior: in the homogeneous phase, it reverses the sign of the structure-factor discontinuity and hence the anisotropy in long-range density correlations; in the phase-separated regime, it switches the orientation of anisotropic patterns and their long-time stability. Both effects are coherently captured by an approximate fluctuating hydrodynamic equation. The results demonstrate that, in contrast to equilibrium systems, nonequilibrium phase behavior depends on specific dynamical rules even when following the same LDB.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：模型、随机动力学、流体动力学方程）；研究对象：具有吸引性最近邻相互作用的二维受驱晶格气体（a two-dimensional driven lattice gas with attractive nearest-neighbor interactions）的非平衡相变行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在遵循相同局部细致平衡（LDB）的条件下，微观跃迁速率的具体函数形式可以定性地重塑强相互作用系统的相行为，包括改变均匀相中结构因子的各向异性符号以及相分离区域中图案的取向和稳定性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在遵循相同局部细致平衡（LDB）的条件下，微观跃迁速率的具体函数形式可以定性地重塑强相互作用系统的相行为，包括改变均匀相中结构因子的各向异性符号以及相分离区域中图案的取向和稳定性。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 通过引入一个保持LDB但调节沿驱动力方向不对称性的参数，构建了受驱晶格气体的跃迁速率模型；利用近似涨落流体动力学方程（fluctuating hydrodynamic equation）对数值结果进行理论解释。

papers.title: Microfluidic Actuation by Einstein-de Haas Spin Torque
papers.abstract: We propose spin-current microfluidic actuation of a sealed liquid metal. Spin angular momentum injected from Pt contacts enters the liquid as an Einstein-de Haas torque and is converted through micropolar angular-momentum balance into viscous flow without pressure drive, moving walls, magnetic fields, Lorentz forces, or charge flow through the liquid. The dc velocity obeys universal spin-diffusion scaling, and the finite-frequency spin-mechanical admittance resolves viscous momentum diffusion, spin transport, microrotation relaxation, and interface transparency of the liquid-metal channel.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中提出理论模型（“propose spin-current microfluidic actuation”），并基于角动量平衡和自旋扩散进行理论分析（“micropolar angular-momentum balance”、“universal spin-diffusion scaling”）。；研究对象：液态金属中的微流体驱动现象，具体涉及通过爱因斯坦-德哈斯（Einstein-de Haas）自旋扭矩实现密封液态金属的流动。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一种无需压力驱动、移动壁、磁场、洛伦兹力或通过液体的电荷流动，仅依靠自旋角动量注入并通过爱因斯坦-德哈斯扭矩转化为粘性流动的微流体驱动机制。该机制的直流速度遵循普适的自旋扩散标度律。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一种无需压力驱动、移动壁、磁场、洛伦兹力或通过液体的电荷流动，仅依靠自旋角动量注入并通过爱因斯坦-德哈斯扭矩转化为粘性流动的微流体驱动机制。该机制的直流速度遵循普适的自旋扩散标度律。；创新点：首次提出利用自旋电流（而非传统压力或电场）驱动密封液态金属的微流体方案，并建立了自旋角动量与流体力学之间的理论联系。摘要未突出说明与已有微流控或自旋流体力学的具体对比。
papers.method_zh: 理论建模与分析。采用自旋角动量注入（从Pt接触注入）、爱因斯坦-德哈斯扭矩、微极性流体角动量平衡方程，以及自旋扩散理论。通过有限频率自旋-力学导纳解析了粘性动量扩散、自旋输运、微旋转弛豫和液态金属通道的界面透明度。

papers.title: Non-Hermitian Twisting Theory under the open boundary condition
papers.abstract: The non-Hermitian skin effect (NHSE) is a hallmark of non-Hermitian system, yet its generalized Brillouin zone (GBZ) description is restricted to periodic systems. We develop a site-resolved theory via a local scaling transformation (LST), introducing local twisting $T_n$ to quantify metric operator $ξ$ nontriviality. This elucidates the NHSE's origin and uncovers the generalized multiple-channel skin effect (MCSE). Exploiting $T_n$'s translational independence, we define the Zahlen-Brillouin Zone (ZBZ), extending non-Hermitian band theory to nonperiodic and disordered lattices. Furthermore, we unify the $ξ$ with GBZ Riemannian geometry, establishing the metric and state correspondence (MSC) as the principle for real-space localization. With a global skin index $\mathbfΓ$ for phase transitions, our results provide a universal paradigm for non-Hermitian physics in both crystalline and amorphous media.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中提及“develop a site-resolved theory”、“introducing local twisting”、“define the Zahlen-Brillouin Zone”、“establishing the metric and state correspondence”等，均为理论构建与数学推导，未涉及实验或计算模拟。；研究对象：非厄米系统中的非厄米趋肤效应（NHSE）及其在非周期和无序晶格中的推广，具体包括广义布里渊区（GBZ）的局限性、多通道趋肤效应（MCSE）以及实空间局域化原理。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过局域标度变换（LST）引入局域扭曲量 \( T_n \)，揭示了非厄米趋肤效应的起源，并发现了广义多通道趋肤效应（MCSE）。进一步定义了Zahlen-布里渊区（ZBZ），将非厄米能带理论推广至非周期和无序晶格，并建立了度规与态对应（MSC）作为实空间局域化的基本原理。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过局域标度变换（LST）引入局域扭曲量 \( T_n \)，揭示了非厄米趋肤效应的起源，并发现了广义多通道趋肤效应（MCSE）。进一步定义了Zahlen-布里渊区（ZBZ），将非厄米能带理论推广至非周期和无序晶格，并建立了度规与态对应（MSC）作为实空间局域化的基本原理。；创新点：突破了传统广义布里渊区（GBZ）仅适用于周期系统的限制，提出了适用于非周期和无序晶格的非厄米能带理论（ZBZ），并建立了度规与态对应（MSC）作为实空间局域化的统一原理。摘要未突出说明与具体实验或数值方法的对比。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架：局域标度变换（LST）、局域扭曲 \( T_n \) 的引入、Zahlen-布里渊区（ZBZ）的定义、度规算子 \( \xi \) 与GBZ黎曼几何的统一、全局趋肤指数 \( \mathbf{\Gamma} \) 的构建。

papers.title: Effects of Band Symmetry on Spin-Dependent Transport in Noncollinear Antiferromagnetic Tunnel Junctions
papers.abstract: Antiferromagnetic tunnel junctions (AFMTJs) can exhibit large tunneling magnetoresistance (TMR), making them promising candidates for ultrafast and field-robust spintronic devices. Here, we elucidate the role of band symmetry in governing spin-dependent transport in AFMTJs. Using first-principles density-functional theory combined with quantum-transport calculations, we investigate Mn3NiN/LaAlO3/Mn3NiN (001) junctions based on the noncollinear $Γ_{4g}$ antiferromagnetic phase of Mn3NiN. Although Mn3NiN exhibits a large momentum-dependent spin polarization due to broken $PT$ symmetry, we show that the tunneling conductance is critically controlled by band symmetry of the electrode Bloch states and their symmetry-selective coupling to evanescent states in the LaAlO3 barrier. Orbital-symmetry selection rules suppress interband transmission in the parallel configuration, whereas the antiparallel configuration enables symmetry-compatible interband tunneling along the diagonal directions of the two-dimensional Brillouin zone. These additional transmission channels enhance the antiparallel conductance and reduce the TMR relative to predictions based solely on spin polarization. Nevertheless, the TMR remains exceptionally large, exceeding 2000%, while band symmetry controls the attainable magnitude of TMR in AFMTJs. Our results establish band-symmetry filtering as an essential ingredient of spin-dependent tunneling in AFMTJs.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据关键词：first-principles density-functional theory combined with quantum-transport calculations（第一性原理密度泛函理论结合量子输运计算）。；研究对象：非共线反铁磁隧道结（AFMTJ），具体材料体系为 Mn₃NiN/LaAlO₃/Mn₃NiN (001) 异质结，基于 Mn₃NiN 的 Γ₄g 非共线反铁磁相。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 尽管 Mn₃NiN 因 PT 对称性破缺而具有显著的动量依赖自旋极化，但隧道结的隧穿电导和隧穿磁电阻（TMR）并非仅由自旋极化决定，而是受电极布洛赫态的能带对称性及其与势垒层（LaAlO₃）中倏逝态之间的对称选择性耦合的严格控制。能带对称性过滤效应是决定 AFMTJ 中自旋相关隧穿的关键因素。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：尽管 Mn₃NiN 因 PT 对称性破缺而具有显著的动量依赖自旋极化，但隧道结的隧穿电导和隧穿磁电阻（TMR）并非仅由自旋极化决定，而是受电极布洛赫态的能带对称性及其与势垒层（LaAlO₃）中倏逝态之间的对称选择性耦合的严格控制。能带对称性过滤效应是决定 AFMTJ 中自旋相关隧穿的关键因素。；创新点：揭示了能带对称性（而非仅自旋极化）在非共线反铁磁隧道结隧穿磁电阻效应中的主导作用，指出轨道对称性选择定则抑制了平行构型下的带间隧穿，而反平行构型则允许沿二维布里渊区对角线方向的对称性兼容的带间隧穿，从而降低了 TMR 相对于仅基于自旋极化预测的数值。摘要未突出说明与以往 AFMTJ 研究相比的具体理论或方法创新。
papers.method_zh: 第一性原理密度泛函理论（DFT）结合量子输运计算。

papers.title: Anomalous Subsurface Vacancy Stabilization Dictated by Geometry-Electronic Decoupling on Metal Surfaces
papers.abstract: Vacancy formation energetics fundamentally govern the structural integrity and catalytic behavior of metal surfaces. Contrary to conventional coordination-dependent broken-bond models, we identify an anomalous thermodynamic inversion on close-packed surfaces across Ir, Pt, Au with face-centered cubic (FCC) lattice and Be, Zn, Cd with hexagonal close-packed (HCP) lattice, where subsurface vacancies are intrinsically more stable than surface ones. Using high-throughput DFT calculations and machine learning force fields, we demonstrate that the physical origins of this anomaly are fundamentally decoupled between the two crystal systems. For the FCC trio, pronounced surface relaxation and a profound real-space electronic localization induce directional, covalent-like intralayer bonding, materializing a "geometry-electronic decoupling" mechanism. Crucially, this unconventional thermodynamic hierarchy enables a dynamic "self-healing" mechanism on Pt(111) that preserves an intact topmost layer and prevents catalytic degradation during hydrogen evolution and oxygen reduction reactions. It also successfully decoding the critical defect threshold (~8%) for lifting the Au(100) surface reconstruction. Our work challenges classical scalar defect models and provides a fresh paradigm for engineering catalyst surface integrity.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章（关键词：high-throughput DFT calculations, machine learning force fields）；研究对象：金属表面（具体为面心立方（FCC）晶格的Ir、Pt、Au，以及六方密堆积（HCP）晶格的Be、Zn、Cd）的亚表面空位稳定性反常现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在密堆积金属表面，亚表面空位在热力学上比表面空位更稳定，这一反常现象源于“几何-电子退耦合”机制，并由此揭示了Pt(111)表面的动态“自修复”机制和Au(100)表面重构的临界缺陷阈值。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在密堆积金属表面，亚表面空位在热力学上比表面空位更稳定，这一反常现象源于“几何-电子退耦合”机制，并由此揭示了Pt(111)表面的动态“自修复”机制和Au(100)表面重构的临界缺陷阈值。；创新点：挑战了传统的基于配位数的断键模型，首次识别并解释了FCC和HCP两类密堆积金属中普遍存在的亚表面空位反常热力学稳定性，并提出了“几何-电子退耦合”这一新物理机制。摘要未突出说明该机制是否在其他晶格或材料中普遍适用。
papers.method_zh: 高通量密度泛函理论（DFT）计算与机器学习力场（MLFF）相结合。

papers.title: Thermal PBE in warm dense matter: Does it matter and is it accurate?
papers.abstract: Conditional probability density functional theory has recently been used to derive the temperature dependence of the Perdew-Burke-Ernzerhof (PBE) generalized gradient approximation (GGA) for the exchange-correlation (XC) free energy. We implement and systematically benchmark thermal PBE within Kohn-Sham density functional theory calculations of warm dense matter. Comparisons with the local density approximation (LDA) and PBE functionals, as well as thermal LDA, show that thermal PBE significantly improves the description of warm dense matter properties, including energies, forces, pressures, and electronic charge densities. In particular, thermal PBE exhibits close agreement with path integral Monte Carlo (PIMC) reference data at negligible additional computational cost. This work demonstrates the practical utility of thermal PBE as an accurate semilocal functional for simulations in the warm dense regime.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章（关键词：density functional theory calculations、benchmark、path integral Monte Carlo reference data）；研究对象：温稠密物质（warm dense matter）中的电子交换关联自由能描述
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 热PBE泛函（thermal PBE）在描述温稠密物质的能量、力、压强和电子电荷密度方面显著优于传统LDA和PBE泛函，且与路径积分蒙特卡洛（PIMC）参考数据高度一致，计算成本几乎不增加。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：热PBE泛函（thermal PBE）在描述温稠密物质的能量、力、压强和电子电荷密度方面显著优于传统LDA和PBE泛函，且与路径积分蒙特卡洛（PIMC）参考数据高度一致，计算成本几乎不增加。；创新点：首次将温度依赖的PBE泛函系统应用于温稠密物质模拟，并证明其作为精确半局域泛函的实用价值。
papers.method_zh: 基于条件概率密度泛函理论推导出PBE广义梯度近似（GGA）的温度依赖形式，并在Kohn-Sham密度泛函理论框架内实现和系统基准测试热PBE，与LDA、PBE及热LDA进行对比，并以PIMC数据作为参考。

papers.title: Non-local low energy neutral excitations in a strongly disordered triangular Mott magnet Cr$_3$Se$_2$Br$_5$
papers.abstract: Understanding if low-energy excitations can remain itinerant in the presence of strong disorder remains a central challenge in frustrated quantum magnets, where disorder is generally expected to localize excitations through Anderson-like mechanisms. Here we report the emergence of charge-neutral itinerant excitations in a van der Waals compound Cr$_3$Se$_2$Br$_5$, a strongly disordered $S = 3/2$ Mott insulator with a frustrated triangular lattice. Structural analysis reveals substantial intrinsic disorder arising from Cr-site deficiency and Se/Br-site mixing, which appear to be fixed and cannot be readily tuned. No long-range magnetic order or conventional glassy behavior is observed. In addition to its highly insulating nature, the magnetic specific heat C_mag/T and thermal conductivity \k{appa}_xx/T both exhibit linear temperature dependencies with substantial finite intercepts. In particular, a sizeable field-independent residual term $κ/T \approx 0.03~\mathrm{W\,m^{-1}\,K^{-2}}$ is observed, providing compelling evidence of itinerant low-energy excitations that carry entropy without charge. These findings conceptually advance our understanding of quantum matter by demonstrating a rare regime where the interplay of disorder, frustration, and electronic correlations actively reshapes the nature of low-energy excitations, allowing itinerant neutral excitations to coexist with strong intrinsic disorder.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“结构分析揭示”、“观察到”等实验发现，并报告了比热和热导率等具体实验测量结果。；研究对象：强无序三角晶格Mott磁体Cr₃Se₂Br₅中的低能中性激发。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在强无序的三角晶格Mott绝缘体Cr₃Se₂Br₅中，观察到电荷中性的巡游低能激发，表现为磁比热C_mag/T和热导率κ_xx/T均呈线性温度依赖且具有显著的非零截距，特别是场无关的残余热导率项κ/T ≈ 0.03 W·m⁻¹·K⁻²，表明存在携带熵但不携带电荷的巡游激发。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在强无序的三角晶格Mott绝缘体Cr₃Se₂Br₅中，观察到电荷中性的巡游低能激发，表现为磁比热C_mag/T和热导率κ_xx/T均呈线性温度依赖且具有显著的非零截距，特别是场无关的残余热导率项κ/T ≈ 0.03 W·m⁻¹·K⁻²，表明存在携带熵但不携带电荷的巡游激发。；创新点：在强无序和几何阻挫共存的Mott绝缘体中，首次实验证实了电荷中性巡游激发的存在，打破了传统认知中无序会通过安德森局域化机制完全局域化低能激发的预期，揭示了无序、阻挫和电子关联相互作用可重塑低能激发的本质。
papers.method_zh: 结构分析（确定Cr位缺陷和Se/Br位混合无序）、磁比热测量、热导率测量（κ_xx/T），以及可能的相关输运和磁性表征（摘要未明确列出所有技术细节）。

papers.title: Imaging Surface Magnetization in Altermagnetic MnTe Films
papers.abstract: Altermagnets with pronounced spin-splitting band structure, unconventional magnetic and crystal symmetries, and exotic magneto-transport properties have received immense interest in cutting-edge spintronics, materials science, and condensed matter physics research. Microscopic imaging of spontaneous magnetic domains and phases in altermagnets constitutes an important step for investigating their underlying material properties, mechanisms, and spin behaviors. Taking advantage of scanning-probe quantum microscopy, here we report nanoscale quantum sensing of a prototypical altermagnet candidate $α$-MnTe. We visualize evanescent magnetization and the associated magnetic domains in epitaxial MnTe films, which allows external magnetic fields to control the intrinsic altermagnetic order and configurations. By evaluating a series of MnTe films with different thicknesses down to the atomic scale, we further present evidence for the interfacial origin of the observed weak magnetization and show its correlation with the anomalous Hall effect in MnTe film. Our results advance the current understanding of emergent altermagnetism, providing insights into future material design of altermagnet-integrated spintronic devices.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键词：imaging、scanning-probe quantum microscopy、visualize、measurements。；研究对象：外延生长的α-MnTe薄膜中的反铁磁序（altermagnetic order）及其表面磁化与磁畴。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 利用扫描探针量子显微镜在α-MnTe薄膜中实现了对表面弱磁化及磁畴的纳米尺度成像，并发现该弱磁化起源于界面效应，且与薄膜的反常霍尔效应相关。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：利用扫描探针量子显微镜在α-MnTe薄膜中实现了对表面弱磁化及磁畴的纳米尺度成像，并发现该弱磁化起源于界面效应，且与薄膜的反常霍尔效应相关。；创新点：首次在实空间对反铁磁候选材料α-MnTe的表面磁化与磁畴进行纳米级成像，并直接揭示了弱磁化的界面起源及其与反常霍尔效应的关联。
papers.method_zh: 扫描探针量子显微镜（scanning-probe quantum microscopy）进行纳米尺度量子传感成像；通过外延生长制备不同厚度（直至原子尺度）的MnTe薄膜；结合外加磁场调控与反常霍尔效应测量。

papers.title: Composition-Driven High-Entropy Alloys with Enhanced Magnetocaloric Properties
papers.abstract: High entropy alloys (HEAs) are promising magnetocaloric materials with tunable operating temperature conditions using compositional modifications. Here, we combine experiments and first principles based spin modelling to engineer magnetocaloric response in single-phase cubic HEAs consisting of earth-abundant elements such as Fe, Ni, Co, Cr, and Cu. An equiatomic (Fe20Ni20Co20Cr20Cu20) and a Fe and Co rich non equiatomic (Fe34Ni17.7Co24.8Cr15.2Cu8.3) show a continuous ferromagnetic to paramagnetic transition with Curie temperature (TC)=110 K and TC=420 K for non equiatomic. Under the 1.6 Tesla magnetic field, the investigated alloy shows the entropy change =1.24 J per kgK with relative cooling power (RCP) =92 J per kg due to a broader effective cooling span. Density functional theory simulations reveal that reducing Cu enhances the spin-polarized Fe, Co, or Ni, 3d weight near fermi level, consistent with stronger ferromagnetic exchange. Exchange couplings mapped onto a classical Heisenberg model and solved by atomistic Monte Carlo to theoretically predict TC of both the investigated alloys. A controlled theoretical Cu sweep in equimolar further confirms that increasing Cu monotonically dilutes the magnetic sublattice and lowers TC, providing a quantitative design guideline to tune magnetocaloric operating temperatures in transition metal HEAs.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验与计算结合）。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“combine experiments and first principles based spin modelling”，即结合了实验与基于第一性原理的自旋建模。；研究对象：高熵合金（HEAs）的磁热效应。具体材料为单相立方结构、由地壳丰富元素（Fe, Ni, Co, Cr, Cu）组成的高熵合金，包括等原子比（Fe20Ni20Co20Cr20Cu20）和非等原子比（Fe34Ni17.7Co24.8Cr15.2Cu8.3）两种成分。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过成分调控（特别是Cu含量），可以系统性地调节高熵合金的居里温度（TC）和磁热效应。非等原子比合金在1.6特斯拉磁场下实现了1.24 J/kgK的熵变和92 J/kg的相对制冷能力（RCP），其居里温度（420 K）远高于等原子比合金（110 K）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过成分调控（特别是Cu含量），可以系统性地调节高熵合金的居里温度（TC）和磁热效应。非等原子比合金在1.6特斯拉磁场下实现了1.24 J/kgK的熵变和92 J/kg的相对制冷能力（RCP），其居里温度（420 K）远高于等原子比合金（110 K）。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。但可推断其创新点在于：通过实验与理论计算相结合，定量揭示了Cu含量对高熵合金磁性子晶格的稀释作用及其对居里温度的调控规律，为设计具有特定工作温度范围的过渡金属高熵合金磁热材料提供了定量的设计准则。
papers.method_zh: 1.  **实验手段**：制备了两种成分的高熵合金样品，并测量了其磁热响应（磁熵变、相对制冷能力）。

papers.title: Dynamical susceptibility and quantum Fisher information in the Su-Schrieffer-Heeger model with Hatsugai-Kohmoto interactions
papers.abstract: We investigate the dynamical spin and charge susceptibilities and the associated quantum Fisher information in a class of interacting lattice models, with a primary focus on the Su-Schrieffer-Heeger model in the presence of Hatsugai-Kohmoto interactions. To provide a rigorous analytical benchmark, we contrast the response properties of the SSH-HK system with those of the single-band Hubbard and SSH-Hubbard models, treated within the random-phase approximation. While standard Hubbard-type interactions typically suppress excitation strength, we demonstrate that the SSH-HK model displays qualitatively distinct physical behavior arising from the interplay between SSH dimerization and the momentum-diagonal nature of the HK interaction. Leveraging the exact solvability of the HK term, we derive closed-form expressions for the dynamical susceptibility, revealing unique filling-controlled characteristics such as a finite response at zero wave vector and a pronounced restructuring of spectral weight across integer and fractional filling sectors. We show that the quantum Fisher information, defined as the frequency integral of the imaginary part of the susceptibility, serves as an efficient probe of these filling sectors, exhibiting distinct piecewise behavior that distinguishes integer from fractional fillings. Notably, our results indicate that the quantum Fisher information remains insensitive to topological transitions within uniform-density regimes, highlighting the limitations of standard dynamical response functions in characterizing band topology. These findings establish the SSH-HK model as a powerful analytical platform for exploring the competition between topology and strong correlations, demonstrating how dynamical susceptibilities and the quantum Fisher information provide complementary, experimentally accessible probes of many-body physics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：investigate、derive closed-form expressions、analytical benchmark、random-phase approximation。；研究对象：Su-Schrieffer-Heeger（SSH）模型在引入Hatsugai-Kohmoto（HK）相互作用后的动力学自旋和电荷磁化率，以及相关的量子Fisher信息。对比体系为单带Hubbard模型和SSH-Hubbard模型。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: SSH-HK模型展现出与标准Hubbard型相互作用截然不同的物理行为：HK相互作用与SSH二聚化的耦合导致零波矢处存在有限响应，并在整数和分数填充区域出现谱权重重构；量子Fisher信息对填充数表现出分段行为，可有效区分整数与分数填充，但对均匀密度区域内的拓扑跃迁不敏感。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：SSH-HK模型展现出与标准Hubbard型相互作用截然不同的物理行为：HK相互作用与SSH二聚化的耦合导致零波矢处存在有限响应，并在整数和分数填充区域出现谱权重重构；量子Fisher信息对填充数表现出分段行为，可有效区分整数与分数填充，但对均匀密度区域内的拓扑跃迁不敏感。；创新点：建立了SSH-HK模型作为研究拓扑与强关联竞争的分析平台，揭示了动力学磁化率与量子Fisher信息作为互补的、实验可观测的多体物理探针的潜力，并指出标准动力学响应函数在表征能带拓扑方面的局限性。
papers.method_zh: 利用HK项精确可解性，推导动力学磁化率的闭式表达式；对SSH-Hubbard和Hubbard模型采用随机相位近似（RPA）处理作为对比基准。

papers.title: Exploring Multi-Transition-Metal NASICON Frameworks as High-Performance Cathodes for Sodium-Ion Batteries
papers.abstract: The search for sustainable, high-performance cathodes has driven a growing interest in sodium superionic conductor (NASICON)-type phosphates for sodium-ion batteries (SIBs). To identify promising NASICONs containing earth-abundant transition metals (TMs) and to systematically examine the role of multiple TMs in influencing the various properties of NASICON cathodes, we employ density functional theory calculations to investigate nine NASICON compositions containing Mn, Cr, and/or Fe, and spanning unary, binary, and ternary combinations. Our calculations reveal that unary systems, in terms of their Na intercalation phase behavior, exhibit well-defined stabilization at intermediate Na contents ($x$ in Na$_x$TM$_2$(PO$_4$)$_3$), while binary and ternary systems display more complex phase behavior, with some systems showing a shift of thermodynamic minima from $x$ = 3 to 2. Intercalation voltages highlight the dominant role of Fe$^{4+}$/Fe$^{3+}$ redox activity in elevating average voltages ($\sim$4.0 V), while Mn and Cr introduce intermediate-to-low voltage redox activity. Electronic structure data demonstrate non-systematic changes in the band gap, especially in systems containing multiple TMs. Na$^+$ mobility results identify mixed-TM frameworks as favorable, achieving Na$^+$ migration barriers in the 0.3-0.4 eV range. Importantly, we identify Na$_x$MnFe$_{0.5}$Cr$_{0.5}$(PO$_4$)$_3$ to be a promising ternary composition for subsequent experimental validation, offering an optimal intersection of phase stability, voltages, thermodynamic (meta)stability, and Na$^+$ migration barriers. Together, our study provides fundamental insights into the interplay between compositional complexity, thermodynamic stability, electronic structure, and ionic transport in NASICONs, and offers actionable design principles for utilising multi-TM NASICONs as high performance SIB cathodes.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据关键词：density functional theory calculations（密度泛函理论计算）。；研究对象：含多种过渡金属（Mn、Cr、Fe）的NASICON型磷酸盐正极材料（NaₓTM₂(PO₄)₃），包括一元、二元和三元组合。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 混合过渡金属（多TM）NASICON框架可同时实现低Na⁺迁移势垒（0.3–0.4 eV）和较高平均电压（~4.0 V，由Fe⁴⁺/Fe³⁺主导），其中NaₓMnFe₀.₅Cr₀.₅(PO₄)₃被识别为最有前景的三元组分。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：混合过渡金属（多TM）NASICON框架可同时实现低Na⁺迁移势垒（0.3–0.4 eV）和较高平均电压（~4.0 V，由Fe⁴⁺/Fe³⁺主导），其中NaₓMnFe₀.₅Cr₀.₅(PO₄)₃被识别为最有前景的三元组分。；创新点：首次系统比较了从一元到三元过渡金属组合对NASICON正极多项关键性能（相稳定性、电压、热力学稳定性、离子迁移）的综合影响，并提出了基于多TM协同作用的设计原则。
papers.method_zh: 采用密度泛函理论（DFT）计算，系统研究了九种NASICON组分的相行为、插层电压、电子结构（带隙）和Na⁺迁移势垒。

papers.title: First-passage time distribution of a Brownian particle harmonically confined in a viscoelastic bath
papers.abstract: We investigate theoretically and experimentally the first passage-time properties of a spherical Brownian particle that is harmonically trapped at thermal equilibrium in a fluid at constant temperature. By using the overdamped version of the generalized Langevin equation, we derive a general expression for the probability density function of the time that the particle takes to reach for the first time the minimum of the potential starting from an arbitrary position. We show that such a first-passage time distribution can be implicitly expressed in terms of the friction memory kernel that encodes the interaction of the particle with its surroundings, and correctly reduces to previously found expressions in the case of a Markovian viscous bath. We validate our theoretical results by measuring the first-passage time of colloidal beads optically trapped in non-Markovian baths such as viscoelastic polymer and micellar solutions, as well as in a viscous glycerol/water mixture and water, which behave as Markovian media, having quantitative agreement with the derived expressions. In particular, we find that the mean first-passage time in a viscoelastic bath can surpass that in a viscous medium of the same zero-shear viscosity due to the emergence of slowly decaying tails in the first-passage time probability density of the former.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（理论推导 + 实验验证）。关键词：theoretically and experimentally、derive a general expression、validate our theoretical results by measuring。；研究对象：在粘弹性浴中受简谐势约束的布朗粒子的首次通过时间分布。具体体系包括：光学捕获的胶体球在粘弹性聚合物溶液、胶束溶液、粘性甘油/水混合物及水中的运动。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 推导出非马尔可夫浴中布朗粒子首次通过时间概率密度函数的一般表达式，并实验验证。发现粘弹性浴中的平均首次通过时间可超过相同零剪切粘度的粘性介质，原因是前者首次通过时间概率密度出现缓慢衰减的尾部。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：推导出非马尔可夫浴中布朗粒子首次通过时间概率密度函数的一般表达式，并实验验证。发现粘弹性浴中的平均首次通过时间可超过相同零剪切粘度的粘性介质，原因是前者首次通过时间概率密度出现缓慢衰减的尾部。；创新点：将首次通过时间分布与摩擦记忆核（friction memory kernel）显式关联，并首次通过实验在非马尔可夫浴中定量验证该理论表达式，揭示了粘弹性浴中平均首次通过时间反常增大的机制。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架：过阻尼广义朗之万方程（overdamped generalized Langevin equation）。实验手段：光学镊子（optically trapped）捕获胶体球，测量其在粘弹性浴（聚合物、胶束溶液）及马尔可夫浴（甘油/水混合物、水）中的首次通过时间。

papers.title: Lattice polarons with extended interactions
papers.abstract: Lattice impurities have recently emerged as a platform in which polarons unveil new quantum many-body states absent in free space and can serve to probe strongly correlated matter. In this work, we investigate two-dimensional lattice polarons with strong on-site repulsion and tunable nearest-neighbor interactions using a variational approach including up to one excitation of the medium. We show that extended interactions qualitatively modify the quasiparticle structure beyond the conventional attractive and repulsive polaron picture. A direct analysis of the eigenvalue spectrum reveals the presence of dark impurity states, orthogonal to the bare impurity and therefore spectroscopically dark. These states exhibit nontrivial internal structure, including dipolar symmetries in real space. Our results demonstrate that long-range interactions generate multiple quasiparticle excitations with distinct symmetry properties, highlighting the crucial role of interaction range and lattice geometry. This work opens new avenues for probing hidden quasiparticle states in lattice systems through spectroscopic and wave-function-resolved measurements.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：variational approach、eigenvalue spectrum analysis）；研究对象：二维晶格极化子，特别是具有强在位排斥和可调最近邻相互作用的体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 扩展相互作用（最近邻相互作用）会超越传统的吸引型和排斥型极化子图像，产生具有偶极对称性等非平凡内部结构的暗杂质态，并生成多种具有不同对称性的准粒子激发。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：扩展相互作用（最近邻相互作用）会超越传统的吸引型和排斥型极化子图像，产生具有偶极对称性等非平凡内部结构的暗杂质态，并生成多种具有不同对称性的准粒子激发。；创新点：揭示了长程相互作用（最近邻相互作用）在晶格极化子中导致具有不同对称性的多重准粒子激发，并发现了与裸杂质正交的、光谱上不可见的暗杂质态。摘要未突出说明与之前工作的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 变分方法（variational approach），包含介质中最多一个激发的近似。

papers.title: Light-Driven Intrinsic Perfect Superconducting Diode Effect
papers.abstract: We demonstrate the perfect superconducting diode effect (SDE) -- unidirectional supercurrent with 100% diode efficiency -- in light-driven nonequilibrium systems. Although the perfect SDE is difficult to achieve in equilibrium, monochromatic light induces the perfect SDE in systems lacking inversion and time-reversal symmetries. More strikingly, multi-frequency light enables the perfect SDE even in centrosymmetric systems via dynamical symmetry breaking. Our results establish a general principle for realizing unidirectional superconducting transport based on nonequilibrium control and symmetry engineering.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：demonstrate（理论论证）、light-driven nonequilibrium systems、symmetry engineering。；研究对象：超导二极管效应（SDE），特别是光驱动非平衡系统中的完美（100%效率）超导二极管效应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在非平衡条件下，通过单色光可在同时缺乏反演对称性和时间反演对称性的系统中实现完美超导二极管效应；更引人注目的是，通过多频光动态破缺对称性，即使在中心对称系统中也能实现完美超导二极管效应。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在非平衡条件下，通过单色光可在同时缺乏反演对称性和时间反演对称性的系统中实现完美超导二极管效应；更引人注目的是，通过多频光动态破缺对称性，即使在中心对称系统中也能实现完美超导二极管效应。；创新点：建立了基于非平衡控制和对称性工程实现单向超导输运的一般原理，首次提出在中心对称系统中通过多频光动态破缺对称性实现完美超导二极管效应的方案。
papers.method_zh: 基于对称性分析和非平衡控制的理论框架，通过光场（单色光和多频光）对系统进行动态对称性调控，未使用具体数值计算方法（摘要未明确说明具体理论模型或计算手段）。

papers.title: Unfrustrated Self-Morphing of Bulk Liquid Crystal Elastomers
papers.abstract: Precise manipulation of shape-morphing responsive materials is crucial for applications in soft robotics and adaptive structures. While notable precision has been achieved in thin two-dimensional sheets, an accurate volumetric shape-morphing remains a major challenge due to geometric frustration, which inevitably generates complex, residual elastic stresses. In this work, we extend the geometric approach used for thin sheets to bulk Liquid Crystal Elastomers (LCEs). By examining their reference Ricci curvature, we formulate the minimal set of conditions required for a three-dimensional nematic director field to undergo stress-free, frustration-free deformations upon actuation. Through this mathematical framework, we identify two distinct classes of geometrically compatible bulk systems. The first class comprises twistless director fields that remain frustration-free across all temperatures, leading to holographic design principles demonstrated through "Planar" and "Smectic" LCE subfamilies. The second class features twisted configurations that exhibit unique, temperature-selective compatibility, leading to non-monotonic accumulation of internal elastic stresses that relax completely at a predefined target temperature. Our framework establishes a firm mathematical foundation for robust forward and inverse design protocols in bulk LCEs.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中提及“数学框架”“几何方法”“条件推导”等关键词，未涉及实验或计算模拟。；研究对象：块体液晶弹性体（bulk Liquid Crystal Elastomers, LCEs）在驱动下的无应力、无几何受挫的三维形状变形行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过分析参考里奇曲率，推导出块体LCE在驱动下实现无应力、无受挫变形所需的最小条件，并识别出两类几何兼容的体系统：无扭曲场（全温度无受挫）和扭曲场（温度选择性兼容，内应力在预设目标温度完全释放）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过分析参考里奇曲率，推导出块体LCE在驱动下实现无应力、无受挫变形所需的最小条件，并识别出两类几何兼容的体系统：无扭曲场（全温度无受挫）和扭曲场（温度选择性兼容，内应力在预设目标温度完全释放）。；创新点：将原本仅适用于薄片的几何方法系统推广至块体LCE，并首次从数学上严格定义了块体LCE中无受挫变形的两类可行构型，为块体LCE的正向与逆向设计提供了数学基础。
papers.method_zh: 采用几何方法，将薄片形状变形理论扩展到块体LCE，通过分析参考里奇曲率（reference Ricci curvature）建立数学框架，推导三维向列指向场在驱动下实现无应力变形的条件。

papers.title: First-principles finite-size correction schemes for point defects of Cu$_3$N
papers.abstract: Point defects play a key role in determining semiconductor properties, such as electrical conductivity and photoluminescence, and often enable functional behavior. Accurate first-principles supercell simulations of point defects require reliable finite-size corrections. In this study, we combine PBE+U structural relaxations with HSE hybrid-functional calculations to determine defect formation energies and thermodynamic transition levels of Cu$_3$N.
