Finite-size trends are quantified using $Γ$-point calculations in supercells containing 256, 864, and 2048 atoms. We assess and extend the Makov-Payne and Lany-Zunger correction schemes by introducing additional $1/L^n$ terms, together with core-level potential alignment and defect-specific scaling models. Using Cu$_3$N as a case study, we show that charged vacancies with strongly localized defect states are accurately described by the Makov-Payne-type scaling ($1/L + 1/L^{3}$), whereas interstitial defects with shallow or weakly localized electronic character are better captured by a hydrogenic impurity model that accounts for defect-band dispersion. Residual trends for neutral or weakly localized defects are described by higher-order polynomial fits in $1/L^{3}$ and $1/L^{4}$. Hybrid-functional energetics corrected using PBE+U-based finite-size trends confirm the intrinsic $p$-type character of Cu$_3$N under the conditions considered and demonstrate that no single finite-size correction can be transferred across all defect types.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：first-principles supercell simulations、PBE+U、HSE hybrid-functional calculations。；研究对象：Cu₃N中的点缺陷（包括带电空位和间隙缺陷）及其形成能和热力学转变能级。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: Cu₃N在所述条件下呈现本征p型导电特性，且不存在适用于所有缺陷类型的单一有限尺寸修正方案。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：Cu₃N在所述条件下呈现本征p型导电特性，且不存在适用于所有缺陷类型的单一有限尺寸修正方案。；创新点：针对Cu₃N体系系统评估并扩展了有限尺寸修正方案，提出了针对不同缺陷类型（强局域化空位、浅能级/弱局域化间隙缺陷、中性/弱局域化缺陷）的差异化修正策略（Makov-Payne型标度、氢杂质模型、高阶多项式拟合）。
papers.method_zh: 采用PBE+U进行结构弛豫，结合HSE杂化泛函计算缺陷形成能和热力学转变能级；在包含256、864和2048个原子的超胞中进行Γ点计算以量化有限尺寸趋势；引入额外的1/Lⁿ项扩展了Makov-Payne和Lany-Zunger修正方案，并结合芯能级势对齐和缺陷特异性标度模型。

papers.title: A particle-resolved rheological study of chirality transfer and odd transport
papers.abstract: Chirality, or the breaking of mirror symmetry, appears across all scales in nature, from molecular conformations to the dynamics of bacterial collectives. Environments composed of such symmetry-breaking constituents can give rise to emergent physical phenomena, particularly in the transport and response of embedded tracers. Yet it remains unclear how chiral environments influence such tracers and through which microscopic mechanisms anomalous responses emerge. Here, we present a particle-resolved study of these systems, demonstrating chirality transfer and odd transport of an object embedded in a chiral active bath. In a rheological experiment, a symmetric passive tracer is driven through collisions with the particles of a non-equilibrium chiral bath. Combining table-top experiments, many-body simulations, and a reduced coarse-grained theory, we demonstrate that local collisions transfer chiral active dynamics to the tracer, which displays circular trajectories. We show that the same mechanism gives rise to a systematic transverse drift under a constant pulling force. Crucially, we identify nonlinear friction as an essential factor that rectifies these transferred chiral active fluctuations into a macroscopic odd response. Our results reveal a microscopic mechanism for odd transport in chiral active matter and provide general insights into transverse transport in driven non-equilibrium systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验+计算+理论）。判断依据：摘要明确提到“table-top experiments, many-body simulations, and a reduced coarse-grained theory”。；研究对象：手性活性浴中嵌入的对称被动示踪粒子的手性传递与奇输运现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 被动示踪粒子通过与手性活性浴粒子的局域碰撞获得手性活性动力学，从而呈现圆形轨迹；在恒定拉力下，非线性摩擦将传递的手性活性涨落整流为宏观的横向漂移（奇输运）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：被动示踪粒子通过与手性活性浴粒子的局域碰撞获得手性活性动力学，从而呈现圆形轨迹；在恒定拉力下，非线性摩擦将传递的手性活性涨落整流为宏观的横向漂移（奇输运）。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 桌面流变学实验（驱动对称被动示踪粒子穿过非平衡手性活性浴）、多体数值模拟、以及粗粒化约化理论模型。

papers.title: Orbital-Engineered Altermagnetism in Two-Dimensional Square Lattices
papers.abstract: Altermagnetism is characterized by even-parity spin-momentum locking in spin-split bands despite zero net magnetization and negligible spin-orbit coupling. Here, we formulate a microscopic framework that links altermagnetic splitting in two-dimensional (2D) square lattices to orbital character. Using tight-binding models and symmetry analysis, we show that, within the minimal antiferromagnetic square-lattice model, single-orbital lattices remain spin-degenerate, whereas interwoven dual-orbital configurations lift Kramers degeneracy and generate d-wave or g-wave altermagnetic states. The spin-splitting originates from orbital anisotropy in the same-spin hopping channels. Guided by this framework, we identify M-TCNX (M = Cr, Mn, Fe; TCNX = TCNE, TCNQ) metal-organic framework monolayers with mcm topology as candidate g-wave altermagnets. Our work provides a symmetry-explicit wavefunction-level design framework for orbital-controlled altermagnetism in 2D square lattices.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：关键词包括“formulate a microscopic framework”、“tight-binding models”、“symmetry analysis”。；研究对象：二维四方晶格中的轨道工程交变磁性（altermagnetism），具体包括单轨道与双轨道四方晶格模型，以及M-TCNX（M = Cr, Mn, Fe；TCNX = TCNE, TCNQ）金属有机框架单层。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在最小反铁磁四方晶格模型中，单轨道晶格保持自旋简并，而交织的双轨道构型可解除Kramers简并，产生d波或g波交变磁性态；自旋劈裂源于同自旋跳跃通道中的轨道各向异性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在最小反铁磁四方晶格模型中，单轨道晶格保持自旋简并，而交织的双轨道构型可解除Kramers简并，产生d波或g波交变磁性态；自旋劈裂源于同自旋跳跃通道中的轨道各向异性。；创新点：提出了一个对称性明确的、基于波函数层次的设计框架，用于在二维四方晶格中实现轨道控制的交变磁性。摘要未突出说明与已有工作的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 采用紧束缚模型与对称性分析，从微观框架出发建立轨道特征与交变磁性劈裂之间的关联，并基于该框架识别候选材料。

papers.title: Intrinsic Topological Control of the Orbital Hall Effect in Buckled Dirac Materials
papers.abstract: We study the orbital Hall response in buckled two-dimensional Dirac materials using a unified framework that includes an antiferromagnetic exchange field, a perpendicular electric field, and intrinsic spin-orbit coupling. We show that the orbital Hall conductivity is considerably boosted around band-inversion points and shows different signatures across multiple electronic phases using a low-energy massive Dirac model in conjunction with Berry-curvature-based linear response theory. We find a series of quantum spin Hall, valley Hall, and anomalous Hall regimes by methodically adjusting external fields, and demonstrate how the evolution of the orbital response is controlled by the redistribution of Berry curvature between spin and valley sectors. We examine the impacts of finite temperature in more detail and find that although the response s size is suppressed by thermal broadening, the distinctive phase-dependent features remain robust. Our findings demonstrate that orbital Hall conductivity offers a sensitive band topology probe in Dirac systems and emphasize buckled two-dimensional materials as a flexible platform for engineering tunable orbital currents for orbitronic applications.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：使用低能有效模型（massive Dirac model）和基于贝里曲率的线性响应理论（Berry-curvature-based linear response theory）进行计算分析。；研究对象：褶皱二维狄拉克材料（buckled two-dimensional Dirac materials）中的轨道霍尔效应（Orbital Hall Effect）。具体考虑了反铁磁交换场、垂直电场和本征自旋-轨道耦合的共同作用。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 轨道霍尔电导率在能带反转点（band-inversion points）附近显著增强，并且其在不同电子相（如量子自旋霍尔相、谷霍尔相、反常霍尔相）中表现出不同的特征。轨道霍尔效应可作为狄拉克体系中灵敏的能带拓扑探针。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：轨道霍尔电导率在能带反转点（band-inversion points）附近显著增强，并且其在不同电子相（如量子自旋霍尔相、谷霍尔相、反常霍尔相）中表现出不同的特征。轨道霍尔效应可作为狄拉克体系中灵敏的能带拓扑探针。；创新点：揭示了轨道霍尔响应如何受自旋和谷自由度之间贝里曲率重新分布的控制，并证明了褶皱二维材料可作为工程化可调轨道电流的灵活平台。摘要未突出说明与具体实验或先前理论工作的定量对比。
papers.method_zh: 采用低能大质量狄拉克模型（low-energy massive Dirac model）结合基于贝里曲率的线性响应理论（Berry-curvature-based linear response theory）计算轨道霍尔响应。通过系统调节外场（反铁磁交换场、垂直电场）来扫描不同的电子相。

papers.title: Cascaded Four-Wave Mixing on Quantum Paraelectrics for On-chip Cryogenic Microcombs
papers.abstract: Here, we demonstrate an on-chip cryogenic microwave frequency-comb on a planar superconducting resonator fabricated on Strontium titanate(STO), a quantum paraelectric material. The material's Kerr-type nonlinearity arising from the quantum paraelectric phase, an underexplored state, enables pronounced resonance shifts, Duffing-like bifurcations and comb generation via cascaded foure-wave mixing. Our results establish STO resonators as a low power, cryogenically compatible platforms for nonlinear microwave photonics, with applications in scalable quantum control and on-chip frequency synthesis.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键词：demonstrate、fabricated、experimental results。；研究对象：基于钛酸锶（STO）量子顺电材料制成的平面超导谐振器，以及在该体系中通过级联四波混频产生的片上低温微波频率梳。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在STO量子顺电相中，其Kerr型非线性导致显著的共振频移、Duffing-like分岔以及通过级联四波混频产生频率梳，从而实现了片上低温微波频率梳。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在STO量子顺电相中，其Kerr型非线性导致显著的共振频移、Duffing-like分岔以及通过级联四波混频产生频率梳，从而实现了片上低温微波频率梳。；创新点：首次利用量子顺电材料（STO）的Kerr非线性在片上超导谐振器中实现低温微波频率梳，为非线性微波光子学提供了低功耗、低温兼容的新平台。
papers.method_zh: 实验制备了基于钛酸锶（STO）的平面超导谐振器，并在低温条件下测量其非线性响应，观察共振频移、分岔行为及频率梳生成。

papers.title: Topological metal-insulator transitions in one-dimensional non-Hermitian quasicrystals: beyond PT-symmetry
papers.abstract: One-dimensional non-Hermitian quasicrystals with parity and time-reversal (PT) symmetry can simultaneously exhibit localization-delocalization transition, topological phase transition, and PT-symmetry-breaking transition. This motivates this work to investigate how the absence of PT symmetry impacts topological metal-insulator transitions in non-Hermitian quasicrystals. We propose a non-Hermitian quasiperiodic model that generally does not preserve PT symmetry and demonstrate that, in most parameter regions, such a system supports triple phase transitions that encompass localization, topology, and degeneracy-breaking. The system may also exhibit a particular type of localization-delocalization transition analogous to the Hermitian case, namely, without activating topological phase transitions or degeneracy-breaking transitions. Our work extends the topological metal-insulator transitions previously studied in PT-symmetric systems to a more general class of non-Hermitian setting, and further reveals that non-Hermitian systems can host distinct types of localization behavior.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：propose a non-Hermitian quasiperiodic model, demonstrate, extend。；研究对象：一维非厄米准晶中的拓扑金属-绝缘体相变，特别关注无PT对称性（parity and time-reversal symmetry）的情况。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在大多数参数区域，无PT对称性的非厄米准晶仍支持包含局域化、拓扑和简并破缺的三重相变；此外，系统还可能表现出类似厄米情况下的局域化-退局域化转变，而不激活拓扑相变或简并破缺相变。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在大多数参数区域，无PT对称性的非厄米准晶仍支持包含局域化、拓扑和简并破缺的三重相变；此外，系统还可能表现出类似厄米情况下的局域化-退局域化转变，而不激活拓扑相变或简并破缺相变。；创新点：将此前仅在PT对称非厄米准晶中研究的拓扑金属-绝缘体相变推广到更一般的无PT对称性非厄米体系，并揭示了非厄米系统可存在不同类型的局域化行为。
papers.method_zh: 提出一个一般不具有PT对称性的非厄米准周期模型，通过理论分析研究其局域化、拓扑和简并破缺相变行为。

papers.title: Assessment of a GW-BSE approximation scheme on an asymmetric two-dimensional interacting electron system in a perpendicular magnetic field
papers.abstract: A GW-BSE approximation scheme is assessed by applying it to a model of asymmetric two-dimensional (2D) interacting electron system. The model is assumed to have a parabolic band characterized by two independent effective mass parameters. A perpendicular magnetic field is applied to the asymmetric 2D electron system, and the well-known Kohn's theorem is still valid, i.e., the cyclotron resonance is not affected by the electron-electron interaction. This theorem imposes a constraint on the approximation scheme employed in the treatment of electron-electron interaction. In the present study, the Green's function is calculated in the self-consistent Hartree-Fock approximation. The electron density correlation function is calculated by solving a Bethe-Salpeter equation (BSE) in the ladder diagram approximation. It is found that, the excitation frequency near the cyclotron resonance frequency approaches a value that is lower than the cyclotron resonance frequency at small wave vectors, when two effective masses are different. When two effective masses are the same, the excitation frequency approaches the cyclotron resonance frequency at small wave vectors as required. Our findings suggest that the approximation scheme used in this theoretical investigation fails to satisfy the requirement due to the Kohn's theorem, and one should go beyond this approximation scheme.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：GW-BSE approximation scheme、self-consistent Hartree-Fock approximation、Bethe-Salpeter equation。；研究对象：一个具有两个独立有效质量参数的抛物线型能带的不对称二维相互作用电子系统，并施加垂直磁场。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 当两个有效质量不同时，该GW-BSE近似方案在小波矢下计算出的激发频率低于回旋共振频率，违反了Kohn定理的要求；只有当两个有效质量相同时，结果才符合Kohn定理。这表明该近似方案不满足Kohn定理的约束。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：当两个有效质量不同时，该GW-BSE近似方案在小波矢下计算出的激发频率低于回旋共振频率，违反了Kohn定理的要求；只有当两个有效质量相同时，结果才符合Kohn定理。这表明该近似方案不满足Kohn定理的约束。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用自洽Hartree-Fock近似计算格林函数，并通过梯形图近似的Bethe-Salpeter方程（BSE）计算电子密度关联函数，从而评估GW-BSE近似方案。

papers.title: Superconductivity in Al-based high-entropy alloys TiHfNbTaAl and TaNbHfZrAl
papers.abstract: Since the first report of a high entropy alloy (HEA) superconductor in 2014, HEAs have continued to captivate the interest of superconducting researchers. Owing to the significant degree of disorder inherent in these systems, they serve as exemplary models for examining the properties of materials that exist in states intermediate between crystalline and amorphous structures. Here we present the superconductivity properties and crystal structure of TaNbHfZrAl and TiHfNbTaAl HEAs, which both have the VEC of 4.2 and body centered cubic (BCC) structure. Through resistivity, magnetic, and specific heat measurements, we prove that both samples are the bulk type-II superconductors with a critical temperature Tc of 5.5 K for TaNbHfZrAl and Tc of 3.2 K for TiHfNbTaAl. The Tc of HEA superconductors is influenced by the VEC and the element composition. And the incorporation of Al in high disorder HEA superconductors causes a more crystallinelike Tc dependence.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“通过电阻率、磁性和比热测量”（resistivity, magnetic, and specific heat measurements）。；研究对象：两种铝基高熵合金超导体：TaNbHfZrAl 和 TiHfNbTaAl，均为体心立方（BCC）结构，价电子浓度（VEC）为4.2。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 两种合金均为体第二类超导体，临界温度 Tc 分别为 5.5 K（TaNbHfZrAl）和 3.2 K（TiHfNbTaAl）。高熵合金超导体的 Tc 受 VEC 和元素组成共同影响，且 Al 的引入使高无序体系中的 Tc 表现出更类似晶体的依赖关系。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：两种合金均为体第二类超导体，临界温度 Tc 分别为 5.5 K（TaNbHfZrAl）和 3.2 K（TiHfNbTaAl）。高熵合金超导体的 Tc 受 VEC 和元素组成共同影响，且 Al 的引入使高无序体系中的 Tc 表现出更类似晶体的依赖关系。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 电阻率测量、磁性测量、比热测量。

papers.title: Lateral Shift as a Control Knob for Localization Transitions in a Quasiperiodic Ladder
papers.abstract: This work reports rich localization-delocalization transitions in a quasiperiodic ladder, of which the two legs are subject to the same quasiperiodic onsite potential but can be shifted laterally relative to each other. It is found that the lateral shift between the two legs effectively generates a magnetic flux in the reciprocal momentum space. The lateral shift thus offers a control knob, allowing us to access and simulate rich phenomena including magnetic-flux-enhanced localization, magnetic-flux-suppressed localization, and magnetic-flux-induced reentrant localization transitions. The underlying physical mechanisms as well as the phase boundaries separating localized, mixed, and extended phases are both qualitatively and quantitatively understood, based on a band-structure analysis that employs a commensurate approximation to the quasiperiodic potential, requiring only unit cells of small to modest sizes. Our work provides a highly tunable platform for exploring localization physics with promising applications such as quantum switching, and a broadly applicable approach for understanding localization-delocalization transitions in quasiperiodic systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：关键词“reports”、“based on a band-structure analysis”、“commensurate approximation”。；研究对象：准周期梯子模型（quasiperiodic ladder），其两条腿受到相同的准周期在位势，但两条腿之间可以发生横向偏移（lateral shift）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 两条腿之间的横向偏移在倒易动量空间中有效产生一个磁通，从而可以作为控制旋钮，实现磁通增强局域化、磁通抑制局域化以及磁通诱导的重入局域化转变。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：两条腿之间的横向偏移在倒易动量空间中有效产生一个磁通，从而可以作为控制旋钮，实现磁通增强局域化、磁通抑制局域化以及磁通诱导的重入局域化转变。；创新点：首次提出利用准周期梯子中两条腿之间的横向偏移作为控制局域化转变的旋钮，并揭示了该偏移在动量空间等效于磁通，从而为模拟磁通相关的局域化现象提供了高度可调的平台。
papers.method_zh: 基于对准周期势的“可公度近似”（commensurate approximation），仅需使用小到中等尺寸的单胞进行能带结构分析（band-structure analysis），从而定性和定量地理解局域化-退局域化转变的物理机制及相边界。

papers.title: Target-Distribution-Guided Cross-Functional Fine-Tuning of Machine-Learning Interatomic Potentials
papers.abstract: Cross-functional fine-tuning of machine-learning interatomic potentials (MLIPs) is often treated as a relabeling problem, where configurations generated at one density-functional level are relabeled using a higher-fidelity target functional. However, the resulting training data may be drawn from the wrong equilibrium distribution, because the statistical weights of configurations change across exchange--correlation functionals. Here we address this distribution mismatch using a target-distribution-guided workflow based on self-learning hybrid Monte Carlo (SLHMC), in which trial configurations are proposed by a machine-learning potential and accepted or rejected using target-functional density-functional-theory energies. Using rutile TiO$_2$ as a test system, we fine-tune the MACE-MP-0 foundation potential toward PBE, r$^2$SCAN, and HSE06 target functionals. The resulting adapted potentials reproduce target-anchored nearest-neighbor Ti--O distributions, radial distribution functions, and the NPT cell metrics examined here more accurately than the foundation-model and off-target relabeling controls considered in this work. In particular, HSE06-guided fine-tuning improves structural and thermodynamic properties that are difficult to access with direct hybrid-functional molecular dynamics because of the computational cost of exact exchange. These results indicate that target-distribution coverage is an essential component of cross-functional MLIP transfer, and that accurate target-level labels alone may be insufficient when the configurational distribution is mismatched.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：machine-learning interatomic potentials (MLIPs)、density-functional theory (DFT)、self-learning hybrid Monte Carlo (SLHMC)。；研究对象：金红石型二氧化钛（rutile TiO₂）作为测试体系，研究机器学习原子间势（MLIP）在不同交换关联泛函（PBE、r²SCAN、HSE06）之间的跨功能微调。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 跨功能微调MLIP时，仅使用高精度目标泛函重新标记配置（relabeling）是不够的，因为配置的统计权重会随泛函改变，导致分布失配。采用目标分布引导的工作流（基于自学习混合蒙特卡洛）可以纠正这一失配，使微调后的势函数更准确地复现目标泛函下的结构性质（如最近邻Ti-O分布、径向分布函数、NPT晶胞参数）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：跨功能微调MLIP时，仅使用高精度目标泛函重新标记配置（relabeling）是不够的，因为配置的统计权重会随泛函改变，导致分布失配。采用目标分布引导的工作流（基于自学习混合蒙特卡洛）可以纠正这一失配，使微调后的势函数更准确地复现目标泛函下的结构性质（如最近邻Ti-O分布、径向分布函数、NPT晶胞参数）。；创新点：明确指出跨功能微调中配置分布失配（distribution mismatch）是关键问题，并提出基于目标分布引导的SLHMC工作流来系统解决该问题，而非简单依赖高精度标签。
papers.method_zh: 采用自学习混合蒙特卡洛（SLHMC）方法，其中试探配置由机器学习势（MACE-MP-0基础势）生成，并用目标泛函（PBE、r²SCAN、HSE06）的DFT能量进行接受/拒绝判断，从而生成符合目标分布的训练数据。

papers.title: Programmable dipolar interaction geometry selects stripe-family order in a molecular lattice quantum simulator
papers.abstract: Microwave-dressed polar molecules offer a route to lattice quantum simulators in which the angular form of long-range dipolar interactions, not only their overall strength, can be engineered. We study this setting in a minimal hard-core Bose lattice model on a square optical lattice, with particles interacting through a sign-changing non-axisymmetric dipolar tail \mathcal V(\mathbf r)\propto (x^2-y^2)/(x^2+y^2)^{5/2} that is repulsive along one lattice axis and attractive along the other. Using worm-algorithm path-integral quantum Monte Carlo simulations, supported by a hard-core spin mapping and a Gutzwiller soft-mode diagnostic, we find two regimes controlled by t/V: at larger t/V the system remains superfluid but develops a pronounced directional stiffness anisotropy, while at smaller t/V it forms a stripe solid selected in the (q,0) axial family, corresponding to real-space stripes parallel to y. The leading ordering wave vector remains in this axial family but reorganizes with filling, showing that the robust ordered object is a family of stripe states rather than one fixed commensurate Bragg peak. Near the closure of the stripe lobe, averaged observables can mimic a narrow supersolid signal; measurement-resolved stripe structure-factor histograms instead reveal first-order switching between superfluid and stripe-solid sectors. NaCs lattice estimates place the relevant V/t window within reach of modest effective dressed dipole moments, linking the predicted stripe-family order and its experimental diagnostics to accessible molecular quantum-simulation scales.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章（关键词：worm-algorithm path-integral quantum Monte Carlo simulations、Gutzwiller soft-mode diagnostic、hard-core spin mapping）；研究对象：微波修饰的极性分子在方形光学晶格中形成的硬核玻色晶格量子模拟器，其长程偶极相互作用的角分布可编程，具体研究由符号变化的非轴对称偶极尾势 \(\mathcal V(\mathbf r)\propto (x^2-y^2)/(x^2+y^2)^{5/2}\) 驱动的条纹序。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在较小 \(t/V\) 区域，系统形成沿 \(y\) 方向平行的实空间条纹固态，且有序态属于 \((q,0)\) 轴向族而非单一公度布拉格峰；在条纹相边界附近，平均观测量可能模拟出窄超固体的信号，但测量分辨的结构因子直方图揭示超流体与条纹固态之间的一阶切换。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在较小 \(t/V\) 区域，系统形成沿 \(y\) 方向平行的实空间条纹固态，且有序态属于 \((q,0)\) 轴向族而非单一公度布拉格峰；在条纹相边界附近，平均观测量可能模拟出窄超固体的信号，但测量分辨的结构因子直方图揭示超流体与条纹固态之间的一阶切换。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 使用蠕虫算法路径积分量子蒙特卡洛模拟，辅以硬核自旋映射和古茨威勒软模诊断。

papers.title: Rheotaxis of microswimmers in colloid-laden channel flow
papers.abstract: Microswimmers are often found in heterogeneous and crowded environments within narrow conduits under external flow conditions, enabling them to perform interesting translational and rotational maneuvers, such as swimming in the upstream direction, following walls, and oscillatory motion. Studying such systems helps us understand the motility behaviors of microswimmers (pushers, pullers, or neutrals) and develop applications such as targeted drug delivery. To study the motion of microswimmers in a channel flow with the presence of hard, monodisperse spherical colloids, we adopted the spherical squirmer model to represent the microswimmers, along with a mesoscale simulation framework, multi-particle collision dynamics (MPCD), to represent the background fluid. In the absence of colloids, a squirmer in a microchannel flow develops an increased probability of moving away from the walls and oscillates between the walls as the flow speed increases compared to the squirmer speed, with a dominant upstream orientation near the walls. However, the presence of the colloids makes the pusher swim towards the center of the channel and upstream direction, and the puller swim away from the center of the channel at low flow speeds. At high flow speeds, the flow carries all the squirmers, resulting in a dominant upstream direction in the channel center. We observe that this leads to a decrease in the local velocity of the squirmer in the flow direction for pusher, neutral, and puller-type squirmers. We also observe that, for a constant colloidal packing fraction, the local velocity magnitude of the puller along the flow direction is less than that of the pusher.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：multi-particle collision dynamics (MPCD)、mesoscale simulation framework、spherical squirmer model。；研究对象：微游泳体（pusher、puller、neutral）在含有硬球胶体的通道流中的流变趋性（rheotaxis）行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在无胶体时，微游泳体随流速增加倾向于远离壁面并在壁间振荡，且近壁处主导上游取向；加入胶体后，pusher型游泳体在低流速下向通道中心和上游方向游动，puller型则远离中心；高流速下所有游泳体均被流场携带，在通道中心呈现上游主导取向，导致沿流向的局部速度下降，且puller的局部速度幅值小于pusher。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在无胶体时，微游泳体随流速增加倾向于远离壁面并在壁间振荡，且近壁处主导上游取向；加入胶体后，pusher型游泳体在低流速下向通道中心和上游方向游动，puller型则远离中心；高流速下所有游泳体均被流场携带，在通道中心呈现上游主导取向，导致沿流向的局部速度下降，且puller的局部速度幅值小于pusher。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用球形squirmer模型模拟微游泳体，结合多粒子碰撞动力学（MPCD）介观模拟框架描述背景流体，在含有硬单分散球形胶体的通道流中进行数值模拟。

papers.title: Processing-Controlled Structural Uniformity and Oxide-Ion Conduction in Na0.52Bi0.47TiO3 Ceramics Probed by Eu3+ Photoluminescence
papers.abstract: Sodium bismuth titanate (NBT) is a promising oxide-ion conductor,but its electrical conductivity is highly sensitive to small changes in A-site stoichiometry and processing history.This sensitivity can reduce sample-to-sample reproducibility.Here we examine how precursor mixing controls structural uniformity and ionic transport in Na0.52Bi0.47TiO3 ceramics.Dry grinding,wet grinding with ethanol,and ball milling were compared by X-ray diffraction,electron microscopy,energy-dispersive spectroscopy,Eu3+ photoluminescence excitation spectroscopy,and electrochemical impedance spectroscopy.All processed powders and ceramics form the perovskite NBT phase within the detection limit of XRD.However,the microstructure,surface A-site cation ratio,Eu3+ excitation spectra,and electrical response change strongly with the mixing route.Continuous monitoring of Eu3+ excitation spectra at different emission wavelengths reveals different distributions of local Eu3+ environments.Larger spectral-shape variations are consistent with lower structural uniformity and stronger local distortion.Dry-ground samples show higher bulk conductivity than wet-ground samples,whereas wet-ground samples show much lower grain-boundary resistance.At 600 \u2103,the dry-60 min sample reaches a bulk conductivity of 13.54 mS cm-1,while wet-30 min shows the highest grain-boundary conductivity of 13.72 mS cm-1.These results suggest a processing-driven trade-off between bulk defect generation and grain-boundary blocking.Based on this processing understanding,Ca was introduced at the A site in Na0.52Bi0.47-xCaxTiO3.The x=0.04 sample reaches 8.35 mS cm-1 at 500 \u2103 and 18.98 mS cm-1 at 600 \u2103.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确描述了多种实验手段（XRD、SEM、EDS、光致发光激发光谱、电化学阻抗谱）和样品制备过程（干磨、湿磨、球磨）。；研究对象：Na₀.₅₂Bi₀.₄₇TiO₃（NBT）陶瓷的氧离子导电性，以及前驱体混合方式对结构均匀性和离子输运的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 前驱体混合方式（干磨、湿磨、球磨）显著影响NBT陶瓷的微观结构、表面A位阳离子比例、Eu³⁺局域环境分布以及电学性能，导致体电导率和晶界电导率之间存在加工驱动的权衡关系。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：前驱体混合方式（干磨、湿磨、球磨）显著影响NBT陶瓷的微观结构、表面A位阳离子比例、Eu³⁺局域环境分布以及电学性能，导致体电导率和晶界电导率之间存在加工驱动的权衡关系。；创新点：利用Eu³⁺光致发光激发光谱作为局域结构探针，系统揭示了不同机械混合方式对NBT陶瓷中A位阳离子分布均匀性和局域畸变的敏感影响，并基于此加工理解引入Ca掺杂优化了导电性能。
papers.method_zh: X射线衍射（XRD）、扫描电子显微镜（SEM）、能量色散X射线光谱（EDS）、Eu³⁺光致发光激发光谱（PLE）、电化学阻抗谱（EIS）。通过监测不同发射波长下的Eu³⁺激发光谱来表征局域结构均匀性。

papers.title: Efficient cooling by ferroelectric or ferromagnetic hysteresis loops
papers.abstract: An efficient cooling effect is put forward, by means of external electric or magnetic fields along hysteresis loops. A simplified model of hysteresis is used for numerical illustration. The model is based upon a second-order expansion of the energy in powers of polarization and external field. The electrocaloric effect along hysteresis loops is discussed for comparison.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中使用了“put forward”（提出）、“simplified model”（简化模型）、“numerical illustration”（数值示例）等关键词，表明该工作主要基于理论建模和数值计算。；研究对象：铁电或铁磁材料在电滞回线或磁滞回线驱动下的冷却效应（电卡效应）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一种利用沿电滞回线或磁滞回线施加外电场或外磁场来实现高效冷却的新机制。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一种利用沿电滞回线或磁滞回线施加外电场或外磁场来实现高效冷却的新机制。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。但相对于传统的电卡/磁卡效应研究（通常关注绝热温变或等温熵变），该工作创新性地聚焦于沿完整滞回线循环过程中的冷却效率。
papers.method_zh: 采用基于极化强度和外场幂次展开的二阶能量模型，对滞回线过程进行简化建模，并通过数值计算进行示例说明。

papers.title: Strong Correlation Effect and In-gap State in the Doped Electron-Hole Two-Band Hubbard Model Based on the Dynamical Mean-Field Theory
papers.abstract: We investigate the strong correlation effect in the spinless electron-hole two-band Hubbard model using the dynamical mean-field theory. At half filling, both the renormalization factor $Z$ and the number of conduction electrons (valence holes) $n_c$ decrease with increasing the interband Coulomb interaction $U$ down to $Z\sim 0.15$ and $n_c\sim 0.1$ for $U_c \sim \mbox{bandwidth}$ at which the first-order Lifshitz transition occurs from a correlated semimetal with a large effective mass $m^*/m=Z^{-1}$ to a band insulator with a finite gap due to the Hartree shift. A slight hole doping $x$ in the band insulator with a large $U>U_c$ yields a remarkable correlated semimetal with $Z\sim 0.1$ at $x\sim 0.01$, where in-gap states emerge above the valence band top and those weights increase with increasing $x$ together with the increase in $Z$ similar to the in-gap states observed in doped Mott insulators.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：关键词“dynamical mean-field theory”（动力学平均场理论）、“investigate”（理论研究）、“model”（模型）。；研究对象：自旋无关的电子-空穴双带Hubbard模型，具体研究其掺杂后的强关联效应和带隙内态（in-gap state）行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在半填充时，随着带间库仑相互作用U增大到约等于带宽时，系统发生一级Lifshitz相变，从关联半金属转变为带绝缘体；在U大于临界值的带绝缘体中引入少量空穴掺杂（x~0.01），会重新产生关联半金属态，并在价带顶上方出现类似掺杂Mott绝缘体中的带隙内态。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在半填充时，随着带间库仑相互作用U增大到约等于带宽时，系统发生一级Lifshitz相变，从关联半金属转变为带绝缘体；在U大于临界值的带绝缘体中引入少量空穴掺杂（x~0.01），会重新产生关联半金属态，并在价带顶上方出现类似掺杂Mott绝缘体中的带隙内态。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 动力学平均场理论（DMFT）。

papers.title: Edge Dislocation Mediated Anomalous Charge Transfer in Face Centered Cubic High Entropy Alloys
papers.abstract: Charge transfer in concentrated alloys governs their structural stability and functional response, and can be strongly perturbed by lattice defects. In high-entropy alloys, the interaction between edge dislocations and volume misfit plays a central role in solid-solution strengthening models; however, the influence of dislocations on the local charge transfer has not been explicitly investigated. In this work, large-scale ab initio calculations are employed to examine the dislocation-mediated charge transfer in CoNi, CoCrNi and CoCrFeMnNi alloys. The calculations reveal an anomalous charge redistribution near edge dislocation cores, including deviation from the conventional electronegativity trend. The observed behavior is shown to originate from collective electronegativity equalisation effects rather than simple pairwise atomic interactions. Furthermore, the asymmetric atomic volume response within the compressive and tensile regions of the dislocation field is rationalised in terms of anomalous magneto-volume fluctuations. These results establish a direct coupling between dislocation-induced electronic redistribution and local volumetric response in chemically complex alloys. The demonstrated coupling between dislocation-mediated charge transfer and atomic volume fluctuations provides a pathway toward electronically informed solid-solutions strengthening models and defect-aware alloy design strategy for chemically complex alloys. These findings further suggest that local electronic redistribution near dislocation-cores can play a critical role in governing the deformation behavior and defect-enbergetics in high-entropy alloys.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：关键词“large-scale ab initio calculations”（大规模从头算计算）。；研究对象：面心立方高熵合金（CoNi、CoCrNi、CoCrFeMnNi）中刃型位错介导的电荷转移现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在刃型位错核心附近存在反常的电荷重新分布，偏离了传统的电负性趋势；这种反常行为源于集体电负性均衡效应，而非简单的原子对相互作用。同时，位错场压缩区和拉伸区的不对称原子体积响应可用反常磁-体积涨落来解释。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在刃型位错核心附近存在反常的电荷重新分布，偏离了传统的电负性趋势；这种反常行为源于集体电负性均衡效应，而非简单的原子对相互作用。同时，位错场压缩区和拉伸区的不对称原子体积响应可用反常磁-体积涨落来解释。；创新点：首次明确研究了高熵合金中位错对局域电荷转移的影响，揭示了位错介导的电子重新分布与局域体积响应之间的直接耦合，为建立电子学视角的固溶强化模型和缺陷感知合金设计策略提供了新途径。
papers.method_zh: 大规模从头算（ab initio）计算，具体为基于密度泛函理论（DFT）的第一性原理计算，用于模拟刃型位错附近的电子结构和电荷转移。

papers.title: Revisiting spin Hamiltonian parameters in a Kitaev material via Bayesian optimization of magnetization curves
papers.abstract: Determining the spin Hamiltonian of a magnetic compound is crucial for understanding its magnetic properties. A standard approach is to derive model parameters from $ab$ $initio$ calculations based on the crystal structure. However, the resulting Hamiltonian can depend sensitively on methodological details of the $ab$ $initio$ procedure. This issue is particularly evident in $α$-RuCl$_3$, a candidate Kitaev material. Here, we present an alternative, data-driven approach to determine the spin Hamiltonian parameters of $α$-RuCl$_3$ by Bayesian optimization of experimental magnetization curves along the $b$- and $c$-axis directions. We optimize five parameters, namely the Kitaev interaction $K$, off-diagonal interactions $Γ$ and $Γ'$, the Heisenberg interaction $J$, and the $c$-axis $g$-factor $g_c$. The parameter set that minimizes the cost function is $(K,Γ,Γ',J,g_c)=(-6.0,\,7.5,\,-0.3,\,-1.75,\,2.3)$, where the exchange couplings are in meV. We find that the cost function is insensitive to the absolute value of the Kitaev coupling $K$. Thus, the magnetization data alone do not determine its energy scale. The cost function also depends only weakly on $Γ'$ and $J$, while the optimization favors a large positive $Γ$. By computing the static spin structure factor, magnetic susceptibility, and specific heat, we show that these quantities favor the large-$Γ$ scenario over the small-$g_c$ scenario and that the parameter set that minimizes the cost function yields good agreement with experiment. The combination of Bayesian optimization and accurate low-energy solvers provides an effective approach for determining parameters of spin Hamiltonians. This methodology opens a systematic route to determining spin Hamiltonians in quantum magnets from experimental data.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。关键词：Bayesian optimization（贝叶斯优化）、data-driven approach（数据驱动方法）、计算自旋结构因子、磁化率、比热。；研究对象：α-RuCl₃，一种候选Kitaev材料。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过贝叶斯优化实验磁化曲线，得到一组最优自旋哈密顿参数 (K, Γ, Γ', J, g_c) = (-6.0, 7.5, -0.3, -1.75, 2.3) meV，并发现磁化数据对Kitaev耦合K的绝对值不敏感，优化倾向于大正Γ值。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过贝叶斯优化实验磁化曲线，得到一组最优自旋哈密顿参数 (K, Γ, Γ', J, g_c) = (-6.0, 7.5, -0.3, -1.75, 2.3) meV，并发现磁化数据对Kitaev耦合K的绝对值不敏感，优化倾向于大正Γ值。；创新点：提出了一种替代传统第一性原理计算的数据驱动方法，通过贝叶斯优化直接从实验磁化数据确定自旋哈密顿参数，并揭示了磁化数据对某些参数（如K）的不敏感性。
papers.method_zh: 采用贝叶斯优化方法，对α-RuCl₃沿b轴和c轴方向的实验磁化曲线进行拟合，优化五个参数（Kitaev相互作用K、非对角相互作用Γ和Γ'、海森堡相互作用J、c轴g因子g_c）。随后通过计算静态自旋结构因子、磁化率和比热来验证参数集的合理性。

papers.title: Tuning quantum tunneling in WSe$_2$ via strain engineering
papers.abstract: We present a comprehensive theoretical study of strain-engineered quantum transport in monolayer tungsten diselenide (WSe$_2$) in the presence of an electrostatic scalar potential. By incorporating strain effects within a low-energy Dirac framework, we analyze their impact on spin- and valley-resolved transmission, conductance, and polarization. The applied potential barrier partitions the system into three distinct regions, allowing for an analytical derivation of the wave functions in each domain. Enforcing continuity conditions at the interfaces yields exact expressions for the transmission and reflection amplitudes. The transmission probability is evaluated from the corresponding current densities, while the conductance is obtained using the Landauer-Büttiker formalism, enabling a quantitative determination of spin and valley polarizations. Our numerical analysis reveals that strain acts as a powerful tuning parameter that reshapes the electronic dispersion and strongly modifies transport characteristics. In particular, the transmission and conductance exhibit pronounced oscillatory behavior driven by quantum interference and resonant tunneling mechanisms. More importantly, both spin and valley polarizations display substantial and highly controllable variations as functions of strain, barrier height, and incident energy. These results demonstrate that strain and electrostatic engineering provide an efficient and versatile platform for manipulating spin-valley degrees of freedom in WSe$_2$. The ability to tailor polarization and interference effects suggests promising opportunities for the design of next-generation spintronic, valleytronic, and optoelectronic devices based on two-dimensional transition-metal dichalcogenides.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“theoretical study”、“low-energy Dirac framework”、“analytical derivation”等关键词，未涉及实验或计算模拟。；研究对象：单层二硒化钨（WSe₂）在静电标量势和应变作用下的自旋与谷分辨量子输运现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 应变可作为有效调控参数，显著改变WSe₂的电子色散和输运特性，使自旋与谷极化产生大幅且高度可控的变化，为自旋电子学和谷电子学器件设计提供新平台。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：应变可作为有效调控参数，显著改变WSe₂的电子色散和输运特性，使自旋与谷极化产生大幅且高度可控的变化，为自旋电子学和谷电子学器件设计提供新平台。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 基于低能Dirac框架引入应变效应，通过分区静电势垒模型解析推导各区域波函数，利用界面连续性条件得到透射与反射振幅的精确表达式，并采用Landauer-Büttiker公式计算电导及自旋/谷极化。

papers.title: Prediction of 1:1 kagome metals with superconductivity and band topology
papers.abstract: Kagome superconductors featuring topologically nontrivial band structures have attracted extensive research interest. FeSn and CoSn is a new kind of kagome material with intrinsic magnetism, which suppresses the emergence of superconductivity. Here, we theoretically predict a new kind of 1:1 kagome MSn (M=transition metal), which exhibit intrinsic superconductivity and nontrivial band topology by first-principles calculations. Among twenty-seven candidates, MSn (M= Mo, Hf, Nb, Ta, W, Ti) are theoretically identified as both dynamically and thermodynamical stable. And, five non-magnetic MSn (M= Mo, Hf, Nb, Ta, W) exhibit phonon-mediated superconductivity. Especially, the d orbitals bands display Dirac points and van Hove singularities near the Fermi level, which contribute to the emergence of topology and the electron-phonon coupling (EPC). More interestingly, MoSn, HfSn and NbSn show nontrivial topological band structure at the Fermi level. Thus, the predicted MSn establish a platform integrating superconductivity and topological order.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：关键词“first-principles calculations”（第一性原理计算）、“theoretically predict”（理论预测）。；研究对象：1:1 型 kagome 金属 MSn（M=过渡金属），具体包括 MoSn、HfSn、NbSn、TaSn、WSn 等候选材料，以及其超导电性与拓扑能带结构。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 预测了一类新型非磁性 1:1 kagome 金属 MSn，其中五种（M=Mo, Hf, Nb, Ta, W）表现出声子介导的超导电性，且 MoSn、HfSn 和 NbSn 在费米能级处具有非平庸拓扑能带结构，实现了超导与拓扑序的共存。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：预测了一类新型非磁性 1:1 kagome 金属 MSn，其中五种（M=Mo, Hf, Nb, Ta, W）表现出声子介导的超导电性，且 MoSn、HfSn 和 NbSn 在费米能级处具有非平庸拓扑能带结构，实现了超导与拓扑序的共存。；创新点：在已有磁性 kagome 材料（如 FeSn、CoSn）中，磁性抑制了超导；本工作预测了一类非磁性的 1:1 kagome 金属 MSn，首次在该体系中实现本征超导电性与非平庸拓扑能带结构的共存，为研究超导与拓扑序的相互作用提供了新平台。
papers.method_zh: 采用第一性原理计算（first-principles calculations），对27种候选材料进行动力学和热力学稳定性筛选，并分析其电子结构、声子谱、电子-声子耦合（EPC）以及拓扑能带性质。

papers.title: Analytic Origin of Green-Function Compression in the Intermediate Representation
papers.abstract: Information compression plays a central role in diverse fields of modern science and technology, from communication theory to machine learning. In condensed-matter physics, the intermediate representation (IR) basis has recently been developed as an efficient method for compressing imaginary-time Green functions, which are fundamental quantities for describing quantum many-body systems. This compression relies on the rapid decay of the singular values with the basis index and the unusually weak growth of the effective rank with inverse temperature. Because of these useful features, the IR basis is now widely used as a standard method in quantum many-body calculations. However, the analytic origin of its compression capability has remained unclear. Here we uncover a finite-Laplace-transform structure underlying the IR kernel, which reveals that the eigenfunctions of the IR kernel admit a natural expansion in terms of classical special functions, the oblate spheroidal wave functions. This finite-Laplace-transform structure also enables us to analytically clarify the compression mechanism of the IR basis. Our results provide a mathematical foundation for the compression of imaginary-time Green functions, connecting quantum many-body physics with theories of information compression and finite integral transforms.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：analytic origin、mathematical foundation、finite integral transforms。；研究对象：虚时格林函数（imaginary-time Green functions）的压缩问题，具体涉及中间表示（Intermediate Representation, IR）基的压缩机制。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 揭示了IR核（IR kernel）的有限拉普拉斯变换结构，证明其本征函数可自然展开为经典特殊函数——扁球面波函数，从而从数学上阐明了IR基压缩能力的分析起源。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：揭示了IR核（IR kernel）的有限拉普拉斯变换结构，证明其本征函数可自然展开为经典特殊函数——扁球面波函数，从而从数学上阐明了IR基压缩能力的分析起源。；创新点：首次从解析角度揭示了IR基压缩能力的数学起源，将量子多体物理中的格林函数压缩与信息压缩理论及有限积分变换理论联系起来。
papers.method_zh: 采用解析数学方法，通过分析IR核的有限拉普拉斯变换结构，建立其与扁球面波函数之间的内在联系，并据此推导压缩机制。

papers.title: Native defects and erbium impurities in CaWO4
papers.abstract: We perform hybrid density functional calculation to study the energetics, electronic properties, optical transitions, and migration barriers of native defects in CaWO$_4$. Oxygen and calcium vacancies are most likely to form in the absence of doping, but interstitials could also incorporate. Tungsten-related defects are unlikely to be present. The positively charged $V_{\rm O}$ and the negatively charged $V_{\rm Ca}$ are likely to form complexes. Calculated optical transition levels indicate that experimentally observed absorption and emission peaks can be attributed mainly to oxygen-related defects. Calculations of migration barriers allow us to conclude that Ca$_i^{2+}$, $V_{\rm O}^{2+}$ and O$_i^{2-}$ are highly mobile, even below room temperature. We have also examined Er dopants, finding that erbium easily substitutes on the Ca site in a positive charge state. Erbium can form complexes with $V_{\rm Ca}$ and O$_i$, which would deactivate the Er. If Er is introduced by implantation, Er interstitials are likely present, which will produce emission that is prone to spectral diffusion and blinking. Our calculated properties of Er$_i$ explain why annealing at modest temperatures allows the interstitials to move into substitutional sites and point defects to move away, resulting in stable emission.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据关键词：hybrid density functional calculation（杂化密度泛函计算）。；研究对象：论文研究的具体材料为CaWO₄（白钨矿）中的本征缺陷（氧空位、钙空位、间隙原子等）以及掺入的铒（Er）杂质。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 氧空位和钙空位是CaWO₄中最易形成的本征缺陷，且带正电的氧空位与带负电的钙空位易形成复合体；铒杂质倾向于占据钙位并带正电，但可与钙空位或氧间隙形成复合体而失活，而间隙铒在退火后可迁移至替代位，实现稳定发光。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：氧空位和钙空位是CaWO₄中最易形成的本征缺陷，且带正电的氧空位与带负电的钙空位易形成复合体；铒杂质倾向于占据钙位并带正电，但可与钙空位或氧间隙形成复合体而失活，而间隙铒在退火后可迁移至替代位，实现稳定发光。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用杂化密度泛函理论（hybrid DFT）计算，研究缺陷的形成能、电子性质、光学跃迁能级以及迁移势垒。

papers.title: Photoluminescence Identification of Multiple Local Eu3+ Environments in BaTiO3 Ceramics
papers.abstract: BaTiO3 is a model ferroelectric perovskite whose properties are highly sensitive to local structure, defect chemistry, and dopant distribution. However, conventional diffraction mainly probes the average lattice and can miss subtle changes in the local coordination environment. Here we use Eu3+ photoluminescence as a local optical probe for BaTiO3 ceramics prepared at 1250, 1300, and 1350 °C. X-ray diffraction and Raman spectra show that all samples retain the tetragonal BaTiO3 phase within the detection limits of these techniques. Electron microscopy reveals a porous ceramic microstructure with temperature-dependent grain growth, and elemental mapping confirms a spatially distributed Eu signal. The Eu3+ excitation and emission spectra show strong sensitivity to the processing temperature. The sample sintered at 1250 °C gives the highest emission intensity, while higher sintering temperatures change the relative intensity of the charge-transfer band and the 4f-4f transitions. Most importantly, the 5D0 to 7F0 emission contains two reproducible components near 579.5 nm and 582.2 nm. Their relative weights vary with sintering temperature, and double-exponential decay at 612 nm further supports the presence of multiple Eu-related local environments. These results show that Eu3+ luminescence provides a sensitive route to track local structural heterogeneity in BaTiO3 ceramics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据关键词：X-ray diffraction, Raman spectra, Electron microscopy, photoluminescence, excitation and emission spectra。；研究对象：BaTiO₃陶瓷中Eu³⁺离子的多个局域环境。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: Eu³⁺的光致发光对烧结温度高度敏感，在579.5 nm和582.2 nm处存在两个可重复的⁵D₀→⁷F₀发射组分，表明BaTiO₃陶瓷中存在多个与Eu相关的局域结构环境。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：Eu³⁺的光致发光对烧结温度高度敏感，在579.5 nm和582.2 nm处存在两个可重复的⁵D₀→⁷F₀发射组分，表明BaTiO₃陶瓷中存在多个与Eu相关的局域结构环境。；创新点：利用Eu³⁺作为局域光学探针，揭示了传统衍射方法难以探测的BaTiO₃陶瓷中局域配位环境的细微变化，并证实了多个Eu³⁺局域环境的存在。
papers.method_zh: X射线衍射、拉曼光谱、电子显微镜、元素分布图、Eu³⁺激发与发射光谱、⁵D₀→⁷F₀发射谱线分析、612 nm处双指数衰减拟合。

papers.title: High-fidelity EDSR in Si/SiGe Wiggle Wells
papers.abstract: Si/SiGe quantum wells that incorporate Ge concentration oscillations, known as long-period Wiggle Wells, have previously been shown to enhance the Dresselhaus spin-orbit coupling (SOC) of conduction-band electrons. Such intrinsic SOC is desirable when performing spin-qubit gate operations based on electric dipole spin resonance (EDSR) because it eliminates the need for external micromagnets. However, random-alloy disorder plays a key role in the valley physics of this materials system by spatially randomizing the valley phase $φ_{s,s}$, and has not been fully accounted for in recent EDSR analyses. Here, we show that alloy disorder affects EDSR in two main ways. First, the Rabi frequency $Ω$ acquires a dependence on the valley phase, given by $\cosφ_{s,s}$, which causes spatial randomization of $Ω$. Despite this variability, we show that fast EDSR can be achieved at most locations across a given sample. Second, a new Rabi driving mechanism emerges, enabled by valley dipoles that result from disorder and the hybridization of ground and excited valley states in response to an EDSR driving field. This mechanism is dominant in regions of low valley splitting. Alloy disorder can therefore strengthen EDSR, but it can also cause gradients in $Ω$ that lead to dephasing in the rotating frame. We explore this problem by first identifying "sweet spots," where EDSR is relatively insensitive to electric-field fluctuations. We then show that high-fidelity Rabi oscillations can be achieved in the presence of realistic charge noise. Our results demonstrate that the Wiggle Well is a promising platform for high-quality, micromagnet-free gate operations.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：show、explore、demonstrate，基于理论分析和数值计算，无实验数据描述）；研究对象：Si/SiGe量子阱中的“Wiggle Well”（长周期Ge浓度振荡结构），以及基于电偶极自旋共振（EDSR）的自旋量子比特门操作。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 合金无序通过影响谷相位使Rabi频率产生空间随机化，但同时引入一种由谷偶极子驱动的新Rabi机制，可在低谷劈裂区域增强EDSR；通过识别“甜点”并考虑实际电荷噪声，仍可实现高保真度Rabi振荡。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：合金无序通过影响谷相位使Rabi频率产生空间随机化，但同时引入一种由谷偶极子驱动的新Rabi机制，可在低谷劈裂区域增强EDSR；通过识别“甜点”并考虑实际电荷噪声，仍可实现高保真度Rabi振荡。；创新点：首次系统分析了合金无序对Si/SiGe Wiggle Well中EDSR的双重影响（空间随机化与新驱动机制），并证明在无序存在下仍可实现高保真度、无需微磁体的量子门操作。
papers.method_zh: 理论建模与分析：考虑随机合金无序对谷相位φ_{s,s}的影响，推导Rabi频率Ω对cosφ_{s,s}的依赖关系；识别电场波动不敏感的“甜点”；模拟电荷噪声下的Rabi振荡保真度。

papers.title: Charge dynamics at nitrogen impurities and nitrogen-vacancy centers in diamond
papers.abstract: The nitrogen-vacancy (NV) center in diamond is the prototype quantum defect that enables a variety of diamond-based quantum technologies. However, charge-state instability and spectral diffusion, often induced by substitutional nitrogen impurities (N$_{\rm C}$), remain key challenges for device performance. Here, we employ first-principles density functional theory calculations to quantitatively investigate nonradiative carrier capture processes mediated by multiphonon emission at both the NV center and the N$_{\rm C}$ impurity. For relevant cases, we also compute the rates of radiative and thermal emission processes. For N$_{\rm C}^0$ $\to$ N$_{\rm C}^-$, we obtain an electron capture coefficient of $2.2 \times 10^{-8}$ cm$^3$s$^{-1}$ at 300 K. Both the magnitude and temperature dependence are in excellent agreement with experimentally measured capture cross sections. Electron capture at N$_{\rm C}^+$ is even faster, with a capture coefficient of $1.0 \times 10^{-4}$ cm$^3$s$^{-1}$ at 300 K. For the NV center, we find that carrier capture rates involving only the ground states of NV$^0$ and NV$^-$ are negligibly slow. However, capture into the excited states (NV$^{0*}$ and NV$^{-*}$) is significantly faster. In particular, the capture coefficient for the hole capture process NV$^-$ $\to$ NV$^{0*}$ is as large as $1.8 \times 10^{-7}$ cm$^3$s$^{-1}$ and largely temperature-independent. Hole capture at NV$^-$ will thus occur via nonradiative capture into an excited state of NV$^{0}$ followed by fast radiative decay to the NV$^0$ ground state. Similarly, electron capture at NV$^0$ will occur via the NV$^0$ $\to$ NV$^{-*}$ $\to$ NV$^-$ pathway, but with a lower nonradiative capture coefficient ($2.1 \times 10^{-9}$ cm$^3$s$^{-1}$ at 300 K). Our calculated capture coefficients and rates provide essential information for analyzing charge-state dynamics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章（关键词：first-principles density functional theory calculations、quantitatively investigate、computed rates）；研究对象：金刚石中的氮杂质（N_C）和氮-空位（NV）色心的电荷动力学过程，特别是非辐射载流子俘获机制。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 氮杂质（N_C）的电子俘获系数与实验测量值高度吻合；NV中心的载流子俘获主要通过激发态路径（NV^0 → NV^{-*} → NV^- 或 NV^- → NV^{0*} → NV^0）进行，而基态间的直接俘获速率极慢。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：氮杂质（N_C）的电子俘获系数与实验测量值高度吻合；NV中心的载流子俘获主要通过激发态路径（NV^0 → NV^{-*} → NV^- 或 NV^- → NV^{0*} → NV^0）进行，而基态间的直接俘获速率极慢。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 基于第一性原理密度泛函理论（DFT）计算，定量研究多声子发射介导的非辐射载流子俘获过程，并计算了辐射和热发射过程的速率。

papers.title: Proton-electron coupled catalyst for ionomer-free electrochemical energy conversion
papers.abstract: Efficient electrochemical energy devices are vital to renewable energy technology, yet coordinating the effective flow of electrons, ions, and chemical species continues to be a major challenge. In conventional proton-exchange membrane fuel cell (PEMFC) catalyst layers, proton and electron transport are supplied separately through percolating carbon networks and ionomer binders, rendering the catalyst largely passive and imposing fundamental trade-offs between reactant accessibility, ionic conductivity, and catalyst activity. Here, we introduce a one-dimensional proton-electron coupled catalyst (PECC) design, a transport-integrated electrocatalyst architecture in which the catalyst itself simultaneously supplies electronic and protonic transport to catalyst active sites. Using this PECC, PEMFCs can have an ionomer-free cathode catalyst layer (CCL), resulting in a dramatic 95% reduction in non-Fickian oxygen transport and boosting power density by 34% and 85% compared to traditional CCLs, with cathode Pt loadings of approximately 0.090 mg/cm^2 and 0.037 mg/cm^2, respectively. Meanwhile, PECC retains 65% of its mass activity and exhibits 32% higher power density than its ionomer-based CCL counterpart after 30k accelerated stressed test. Similar mass transport improvements have been observed in the electrochemical hydrogen pump (EHP) using PECC in the catalyst layers. Molecular dynamics simulations show the PECC's proton conductivity is 249% higher than Nafion. This PECC catalyst structure addresses core transport problems in PEMFCs, leading to almost 20% improvement in fuel efficiency and opens up new possibilities for designing high-performance, cost-effective electrochemical devices.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（关键词：introduce a one-dimensional proton-electron coupled catalyst design、demonstrate、molecular dynamics simulations）；研究对象：质子-电子耦合催化剂（PECC）及其在无离聚物阴极催化层（CCL）的质子交换膜燃料电池（PEMFC）和电化学氢泵（EHP）中的应用。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: PECC设计使催化剂自身同时提供电子和质子传输，从而允许PEMFC使用无离聚物阴极催化层，大幅降低非菲克氧传输阻力（减少95%），提升功率密度（34%至85%），并在加速老化测试后保持更高性能。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：PECC设计使催化剂自身同时提供电子和质子传输，从而允许PEMFC使用无离聚物阴极催化层，大幅降低非菲克氧传输阻力（减少95%），提升功率密度（34%至85%），并在加速老化测试后保持更高性能。；创新点：提出一种传输集成的电催化剂架构，将电子和质子传导功能直接集成到催化剂本身，取代传统催化层中依赖离聚物和碳网络的分离传输路径，从根本上解决反应物可及性、离子电导率和催化活性之间的权衡问题。
papers.method_zh: 实验制备PECC催化剂并组装PEMFC和EHP器件进行电化学性能测试；采用分子动力学模拟计算PECC的质子电导率（比Nafion高249%）。

papers.title: Redox behaviour of Fe impurities in BaTiO$_3$ based on many-body calculations
papers.abstract: Based on detailed electronic structure and spectroscopy obtained using DFT-based many-body techniques, the redox behavior of Fe impurities in BaTiO$_3$ is investigated. It is observed that Fe impurities exhibit a mixed valence nature, comprising mostly Fe$^{2+}$ ($3d^6$) and Fe$^{3+}$ ($3d^5$) configurations, and such configurations can be tuned via oxygen vacancies which favor Fe$^{2+}$. The origin of such a redox behavior can be attributed to the charge transfer caused by shifting of the $d_{3z^2-r^2}$ orbitals. Furthermore, x-ray photoemission spectroscopy is evaluated by solving the Wannier function-derived local atomic Hamiltonian using the crystal field multiplet approach, with good agreements with recent experimental measurements.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章（关键词：DFT-based many-body techniques、crystal field multiplet approach、Wannier function-derived local atomic Hamiltonian）；研究对象：BaTiO₃中Fe杂质的氧化还原行为（具体体系：Fe掺杂钛酸钡）
papers.abstract_summary_zh: Fe杂质在BaTiO₃中呈现混合价态（主要为Fe²⁺和Fe³⁺），且氧空位可调控其价态偏向Fe²⁺；该氧化还原行为的根源在于d₃z²⁻r²轨道位移引起的电荷转移。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：Fe杂质在BaTiO₃中呈现混合价态（主要为Fe²⁺和Fe³⁺），且氧空位可调控其价态偏向Fe²⁺；该氧化还原行为的根源在于d₃z²⁻r²轨道位移引起的电荷转移。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 基于DFT的多体计算方法（具体包括：Wannier函数推导的局域原子哈密顿量、晶体场多重态方法），并模拟X射线光电子能谱（XPS）与实验对比。

papers.title: Quantum Printing: Laguerre-Gaussian Beam Induced Topological Magnetic Textures
papers.abstract: Structured light has become a practical tool for controlling matter by applying tailored, space- and time-dependent electromagnetic fields. We show that Laguerre-Gaussian pulses imprint non-collinear magnetic textures via the spatial structure of optical magnetic field. Our route offers a direct spatial selectivity determined by the optical features without relying on material anisotropic interactions. The proposed printing approach does not require interfacial anisotropy or bulk chirality, current-driven torques, or thermal quenching. We use micromagnetic simulations to demonstrate the potential to create topological charge density emerging during the pulse and reveal control through the optical topological properties and polarization. These results suggest structured-light quantum printing as a viable approach for magnonics and motivate studies toward reconfigurable topological textures enabled by ultrafast THz optics and non-thermal control.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。关键词：micromagnetic simulations（微磁模拟）、demonstrate、reveal control。；研究对象：由拉盖尔-高斯光束（Laguerre-Gaussian pulses）在磁性材料中诱导产生的非共线磁织构（non-collinear magnetic textures）及拓扑电荷密度（topological charge density）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过拉盖尔-高斯脉冲的光学磁场空间结构，可以直接在磁性材料中印刻出非共线磁织构，并利用光束的拓扑性质与偏振控制拓扑电荷密度的产生。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过拉盖尔-高斯脉冲的光学磁场空间结构，可以直接在磁性材料中印刻出非共线磁织构，并利用光束的拓扑性质与偏振控制拓扑电荷密度的产生。；创新点：提出了一种不依赖材料各向异性相互作用（如界面各向异性、体手性）、无需电流驱动或热淬火的直接光控磁织构打印方法，利用光的空间选择性实现拓扑磁结构的可重构控制。摘要未突出说明与已有光控磁化方法的具体性能对比。
papers.method_zh: 微磁模拟（micromagnetic simulations），结合对结构化光（structured light）中光学磁场空间分布的分析。

papers.title: Ab-initio Crystal Structure Determination from Powder X-Ray Diffraction
papers.abstract: Determining crystal structures from powder X-ray diffraction (PXRD) has been a significant challenge in materials science, particularly when experimental data contain noise or the target structure has a high complexity. While recent AI generative models show promise for rapid structure generation, they predominantly employ data-driven approaches to learn direct mappings between PXRD patterns and crystal structures, often failing on complex or out-of-distribution cases. In this work, we present a hybrid ab-initio approach that decomposes structure determination into a two-stage optimization problem: (1) discrete selection of space group symmetry, unit cell parameters, and Wyckoff site combinations; and (2) continuous optimization of atomic coordinates within the selected Wyckoff positions. By integrating AI-based techniques for peak profile analysis, density estimation and energy minimization with physics-informed constraints, our method systematically overcomes limitations of purely data-driven PXRD solvers. We demonstrate that this hierarchical optimization framework enables robust structure determination even for challenging cases with high structural complexity or limited experimental data quality. Our approach provides a principled pathway for incorporating crystallographic knowledge into AI models for more reliable and generalizable crystal structure determination.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（计算+理论）。判断依据：结合了AI生成模型、密度估计、能量最小化等计算方法，以及基于晶体学知识的物理约束（physics-informed constraints），属于计算与理论结合的混合方法。；研究对象：粉末X射线衍射（PXRD）数据的晶体结构确定问题，研究对象为任意晶体材料，尤其关注高复杂度或实验数据质量有限的情况。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出一种将结构确定分解为离散对称性选择与连续原子坐标优化的两阶段混合方法，能够克服纯数据驱动方法在复杂或分布外情况下的失效问题，实现更鲁棒的结构确定。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出一种将结构确定分解为离散对称性选择与连续原子坐标优化的两阶段混合方法，能够克服纯数据驱动方法在复杂或分布外情况下的失效问题，实现更鲁棒的结构确定。；创新点：将晶体学知识（空间群、Wyckoff位置等）显式嵌入AI模型，构建分层优化框架，而非单纯学习PXRD图谱到结构的直接映射，从而提升对复杂或低质量数据的泛化能力。
papers.method_zh: 采用混合从头算（hybrid ab-initio）方法，具体包括：（1）基于AI的峰形分析、密度估计和能量最小化技术；（2）结合物理约束（如空间群对称性、晶胞参数、Wyckoff位置组合的离散选择）；（3）对选定Wyckoff位置内的原子坐标进行连续优化。

papers.title: Theoretical study of superconductivity in freestanding infinite-layer nickelate membranes under pressure: mitigation of excess correlation enhances $T_c$
papers.abstract: We theoretically investigate a freestanding membrane of infinite-layer nickelate Nd$_{0.85}$Sr$_{0.15}$NiO$_2$ under pressure by constructing a seven-orbital effective model based on first-principles calculations. By performing the fluctuation exchange (FLEX) approximation, we demonstrate that the seven-orbital model explains a monotonic increase in $T_c$ reported in a recent experiment. This enhancement of superconductivity is attributed to the mitigation of excessively strong electron correlations caused by exceptionally low valence of Ni atom. Furthermore, we examine the dynamical stability of the crystal structure under pressure through phonon calculation.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。关键词：theoretically investigate、first-principles calculations、fluctuation exchange (FLEX) approximation、phonon calculation。；研究对象：无限层镍酸盐Nd₀.₈₅Sr₀.₁₅NiO₂的自支撑薄膜在压力下的超导电性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 压力下超导转变温度（T_c）的单调升高归因于Ni原子异常低价态导致的过强电子关联被缓解。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：压力下超导转变温度（T_c）的单调升高归因于Ni原子异常低价态导致的过强电子关联被缓解。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 基于第一性原理计算构建七轨道有效模型，采用涨落交换（FLEX）近似分析超导配对，并通过声子计算检验晶体结构在压力下的动力学稳定性。

papers.title: Application and Performance Assessment of Annealing Methods for Electrostatic-Energy-Based Configuration Search in Mixed Crystals
papers.abstract: In first-principles design of solid solutions and disordered materials, exhaustive evaluation of all possible substitutional configurations is often impractical because the number of site occupations increases exponentially. Here, we develop a framework for pre-screening mixed-crystal configurations using annealing methods, where the Ewald electrostatic energy is used as the objective function. Substitutional occupations are represented by binary variables, allowing the Ewald energy to be mapped onto an Ising-type Hamiltonian and the search for low-energy configurations to be formulated as a combinatorial optimization problem. We implement this formulation using simulated annealing (SA) and quantum annealing (QA), and benchmark their performance against exhaustive search. For the small-scale system CaYAlO$_4$, SA achieved a speed-up of about 30 times, while QA achieved a speed-up of more than 100 times; both methods identified all lowest-energy configurations. For the medium-scale system $β$-KSbF$_4$ and the large-scale Ba-doped SiAlON system, SA achieved speed-ups of about 200-300 times while robustly identifying the lowest-energy structures. In contrast, QA was effective for the small-scale case but showed limited speed-up for medium-scale problems and missed some low-energy configurations due to chain breaks. These results indicate that SA is currently the most robust and general-purpose approach for rapid pre-screening of mixed-crystal configurations based on electrostatic energy. The proposed formulation can be implemented automatically using publicly available libraries and provides a practical route for accelerating candidate-structure generation before first-principles calculations.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：关键词“first-principles design”、“Ewald electrostatic energy”、“simulated annealing (SA)”、“quantum annealing (QA)”、“benchmark their performance”。；研究对象：混合晶体（mixed crystals）中的替代构型（substitutional configurations），具体包括小尺度体系CaYAlO₄、中尺度体系β-KSbF₄以及大尺度Ba掺杂SiAlON体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 基于静电能的模拟退火（SA）方法在中小尺度和大尺度混合晶体构型预筛选中均能稳健识别最低能量结构，速度提升约30-300倍；量子退火（QA）在小尺度上有效（速度提升超100倍），但在中尺度上因链断裂（chain breaks）而效果有限。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：基于静电能的模拟退火（SA）方法在中小尺度和大尺度混合晶体构型预筛选中均能稳健识别最低能量结构，速度提升约30-300倍；量子退火（QA）在小尺度上有效（速度提升超100倍），但在中尺度上因链断裂（chain breaks）而效果有限。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 将混合晶体中替代占位映射为伊辛型哈密顿量（Ising-type Hamiltonian），以Ewald静电能为目标函数，将低能构型搜索转化为组合优化问题，分别采用模拟退火（SA）和量子退火（QA）实现，并与穷举搜索（exhaustive search）进行性能对比。

papers.title: Manipulation of information flow and thermodynamic performance in nonreciprocal quantum dot information engines
papers.abstract: Quantum information engines leverage information as a thermodynamic resource to facilitate energy conversion. In the operation of such engines, the information flow between the working substance and the controller is pivotal, however, strategies for its efficient manipulation remain largely unexplored. Here, we investigate an autonomous information engine based on a double-quantum-dot setup, where a downstream dot coupled to two reservoirs acts as the working substance, and an upstream dot coupled to a single reservoir serves as the controller. By extending the second law of thermodynamics to incorporate the effects of nonreciprocal couplings between the dots and their electronic reservoirs, we develop a thermodynamic framework that allows us to demonstrate that nonreciprocity can significantly modulate the inter-dot information flow, thereby providing a robust control mechanism. We show that the influence of nonreciprocity can be equivalently understood through a mapping to an effective reciprocal system upon a reparameterization of chemical potentials and the electron-electron coupling strength. We further analyze the impact of nonreciprocity on the engine's performance and operation regime. Our findings establish nonreciprocal coupling as an effective control knob for designing and optimizing quantum dot information engines, surpassing the capabilities of conventional reciprocal configurations.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中提及“develop a thermodynamic framework”、“demonstrate”、“analyze”等理论推导与分析关键词，未涉及实验或计算模拟细节。；研究对象：基于双量子点（double-quantum-dot）的非互易信息引擎（nonreciprocal information engine），其中下游量子点作为工作物质，上游量子点作为控制器，研究信息流与热力学性能的调控。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 非互易耦合（nonreciprocal couplings）能够显著调控量子点间的信息流，从而为量子点信息引擎提供一种超越传统互易构型的有效控制机制。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：非互易耦合（nonreciprocal couplings）能够显著调控量子点间的信息流，从而为量子点信息引擎提供一种超越传统互易构型的有效控制机制。；创新点：首次提出将非互易耦合作为量子点信息引擎中信息流与性能的调控手段，并建立了相应的热力学理论框架，揭示了非互易性在信息引擎设计中的优势。
papers.method_zh: 通过扩展热力学第二定律，将量子点与电子库之间的非互易耦合效应纳入框架，建立热力学理论模型；并利用映射方法将非互易系统等效为有效互易系统（通过重新参数化化学势和电子-电子耦合强度）。

papers.title: Rare events of small-noise Doob conditioned processes
papers.abstract: Doob fixed-time conditioning enables the sampling of rare trajectories of Markov processes by modifying the drift so that reaching a prescribed target at a given time is guaranteed. We study the statistics of this conditioned path ensemble through the moment generating function in the weak-noise large deviation regime. Since the Doob drift is rarely available in closed form, we reinterpret the conditioned ensemble as the original process post-selected on the terminal constraint, thereby avoiding explicit construction of the Doob transform. This viewpoint then yields an optimal-control representation for the leading exponential contribution to the generating function, expressed as a variational principle with terminal boundary conditions set by the Doob end-point constraint. We illustrate the framework with two analytical examples and with an application to heat dissipation of a minimal model of biomolecular folding.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：large deviation regime、variational principle、optimal-control representation。；研究对象：Doob固定时间条件化（Doob fixed-time conditioning）下马尔可夫过程的稀有轨迹统计，以及弱噪声大偏差区间的矩生成函数。具体应用包括生物分子折叠的最小模型中的热耗散。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过将条件化系综重新解释为原始过程在终端约束下的后选择（post-selection），避免了显式构造Doob变换，并得到了矩生成函数主导指数贡献的最优控制表示，该表示以Doob端点约束为终端边界条件的变分原理形式给出。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过将条件化系综重新解释为原始过程在终端约束下的后选择（post-selection），避免了显式构造Doob变换，并得到了矩生成函数主导指数贡献的最优控制表示，该表示以Doob端点约束为终端边界条件的变分原理形式给出。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架：大偏差理论、Doob变换、最优控制表示（变分原理）。通过两个解析例子和一个生物分子折叠最小模型的热耗散应用进行说明。

papers.title: Nonunitary triplet superconductivity in the Z2 topological metal SrPd2As2
papers.abstract: In Z2 topological metals, nontrivial band topology and strong spin-orbit coupling (SOC) impose symmetry constraints that can stabilize unconventional superconducting states, even when thermodynamic probes indicate an isotropic gap. Here, we investigate the superconducting ground state of such a material, SrPd2As2, using muon spin rotation and relaxation (muSR), first-principles calculations, and Ginzburg-Landau analysis. Transverse-field muSR indicates a fully gapped superconducting state below Tc = 0.94 K, while zero-field muSR detects spontaneous internal magnetic fields below Tc, establishing time-reversal symmetry (TRS) breaking. Electronic structure calculations identify SrPd2As2 as a Z2 topological metal with surface states crossing the Fermi level. Standard anisotropic Migdal-Eliashberg calculations predict a nodal gap and overestimate Tc, indicating that a purely phonon-mediated pairing mechanism is insufficient. We resolve this apparent contradiction by showing that the interplay of SOC, tetragonal symmetry, and an open Fermi surface topology stabilizes a nonunitary triplet superconducting state whose symmetry-imposed nodes lie in momentum-space regions devoid of electronic states. This yields a fully gapped thermodynamic response while naturally breaking TRS. Our results establish SrPd2As2 as a clean platform for bulk nonunitary triplet pairing and a promising candidate for intrinsic topological superconductivity.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验+计算+理论）。关键词：muon spin rotation and relaxation (muSR)、first-principles calculations、Ginzburg-Landau analysis、Migdal-Eliashberg calculations。；研究对象：Z2拓扑金属SrPd2As2的超导基态，特别是其非常规超导配对对称性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: SrPd2As2在超导转变温度Tc=0.94 K以下表现为完全能隙的超导态，但零场muSR实验探测到自发内磁场，表明时间反演对称性破缺。通过自旋-轨道耦合、四方对称性和开放费米面拓扑的协同作用，系统稳定了一种非幺正三重态超导态，其对称性要求的节点位于动量空间中无电子态的区域，从而在热力学上表现为全能隙，同时自然破缺时间反演对称性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：SrPd2As2在超导转变温度Tc=0.94 K以下表现为完全能隙的超导态，但零场muSR实验探测到自发内磁场，表明时间反演对称性破缺。通过自旋-轨道耦合、四方对称性和开放费米面拓扑的协同作用，系统稳定了一种非幺正三重态超导态，其对称性要求的节点位于动量空间中无电子态的区域，从而在热力学上表现为全能隙，同时自然破缺时间反演对称性。；创新点：首次在块体材料SrPd2As2中实验证实并理论解释了非幺正三重态超导配对，解决了热力学全能隙响应与时间反演对称性破缺之间的表观矛盾，并指出该材料是内禀拓扑超导的候选体系。
papers.method_zh: 实验上采用横向场和零场μ子自旋旋转与弛豫（muSR）技术；理论上结合第一性原理电子结构计算、标准各向异性Migdal-Eliashberg计算以及Ginzburg-Landau分析。

papers.title: Emergent Dispersive Multipolar Excitations in NaErSe$_{2}$
papers.abstract: In most condensed-matter systems, local and collective excitations remain decoupled due to their distinct energy scales. Here, we identify coupled local-collective excitations in the triangular antiferromagnet NaErSe$_2$ by combining neutron spectroscopy with total angular momentum modeling. The low-lying crystalline electric field (CEF) doublets include a dipolar $Γ_4$ ground state forming stripe-$x$ order and a $Γ_{5,6}$ excited state with dipole-octupole character. High-resolution spectra reveal emergent symmetry-selected dispersions, where magnon branches from the ground state are replicated on higher $Γ_4$ levels but couple with the $Γ_{5,6}$ levels to form a distinct multipolar band. An applied magnetic field reconstructs the CEF wavefunctions and polarizes the system into a multipolar ferromagnet, further reshaping the spectra. This study demonstrates the emergent coupling of local and collective excitations driven by strong spin-orbit coupling and establishes NaErSe$_2$ as a platform for field-tunable multipolar excitations in frustrated magnets.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（关键词：neutron spectroscopy、neutron spectroscopy with total angular momentum modeling）；研究对象：三角晶格反铁磁体NaErSe₂中的局域-集体耦合激发及多极激发行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在NaErSe₂中，由于强自旋-轨道耦合，局域晶场激发与集体磁激发（如磁振子）发生耦合，产生了对称性选择的新色散分支，并形成独特的多极能带；外加磁场可重构晶场波函数，将体系极化成为多极铁磁体，从而重塑激发谱。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在NaErSe₂中，由于强自旋-轨道耦合，局域晶场激发与集体磁激发（如磁振子）发生耦合，产生了对称性选择的新色散分支，并形成独特的多极能带；外加磁场可重构晶场波函数，将体系极化成为多极铁磁体，从而重塑激发谱。；创新点：首次在三角晶格反铁磁体中实验观察到局域晶场激发与集体磁激发的耦合，并揭示了由此产生的对称性选择的多极色散模式，以及磁场对多极激发的可调谐性。摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 中子散射实验结合总角动量建模（total angular momentum modeling）。

papers.title: Synchronization of Bloch Oscillations in array of parallel Josephson Junctions
papers.abstract: We demonstrate the synchronization of current quantization in a parallel array of weakly coupled Josephson Junctions operating in the regime of the coherent quantum phase slip. The first quantized current step on the voltage-current characteristic of 69 parallel Josephson junctions, under microwave excitation at a frequency of f = 19.325 GHz, is observed at 426 nA. Experiments show that accuracy of quantization does not degrade with increasing number of combined Josephson junctions. This demonstration addresses the issue of quantized current amplitude requirements adopted for a practical quantum standard, while leaving the question of accuracy for further research. At present, the quantum current standard of accepted metrological accuracy in the triangle of electrical units is under development. The other two, the Volt and Ohm standards based on the Josephson and Quantum Hall effects, respectively, are already well established in metrology.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“Experiments show”、“observed at 426 nA”等实验观测描述。；研究对象：并联约瑟夫森结阵列中的布洛赫振荡同步现象，具体为弱耦合约瑟夫森结在相干量子相位滑移（coherent quantum phase slip）机制下的电流量子化行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在69个并联约瑟夫森结的阵列中，于19.325 GHz微波激励下观测到第一个量子化电流台阶（426 nA），且量子化精度不随结数量增加而退化。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在69个并联约瑟夫森结的阵列中，于19.325 GHz微波激励下观测到第一个量子化电流台阶（426 nA），且量子化精度不随结数量增加而退化。；创新点：解决了实用量子电流标准中量子化电流幅值要求的关键问题，验证了并联结数量增加时量子化精度保持稳定，为发展基于量子相位滑移的电流标准提供了实验基础。摘要未突出说明与已有同步布洛赫振荡实验的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 实验手段：对并联约瑟夫森结阵列施加微波激励（f=19.325 GHz），测量电压-电流特性曲线以观测量子化电流台阶。摘要未明确说明具体制备工艺或测量设备细节。

papers.title: Strong Eigenstate Thermalization from Mean-Ergodic Non-chaotic Dynamics
papers.abstract: We report an example of a many-body system, derived from the double kicked top (DKT), with non-chaotic yet mean-ergodic dynamics that displays \textit{strong} eigenstate thermalization hypothesis (ETH) in the quantum regime. The analysis addresses a key open question: whether \textit{strong} ETH is a quantum analog of ergodicity (or mean-ergodicity). Despite non-chaotic dynamics, the fluctuations of the diagonal matrix elements of an observable scale as $D^{-1/2}$, where $D$ denotes the Hilbert space dimension. Furthermore, the off-diagonal matrix elements show Gaussian statistics together with a smooth function $f_O(\bar{E}, ω)$ that becomes nearly uniform in the large-$k_θ$ domain. Our findings show that even mean-ergodic and non-chaotic systems can exhibit \textit{strong} ETH.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：分析、量子 regime、统计性质。；研究对象：基于双 kicked top（DKT）的多体系统，研究其非混沌但均值遍历的动力学，以及强本征态热化假说（strong ETH）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 即使系统动力学是非混沌的，只要满足均值遍历性，仍可表现出强本征态热化假说（strong ETH），即对角矩阵元涨落按希尔伯特空间维度 D 的 -1/2 次方标度，且非对角矩阵元呈现高斯统计与近乎均匀的平滑函数。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：即使系统动力学是非混沌的，只要满足均值遍历性，仍可表现出强本征态热化假说（strong ETH），即对角矩阵元涨落按希尔伯特空间维度 D 的 -1/2 次方标度，且非对角矩阵元呈现高斯统计与近乎均匀的平滑函数。；创新点：回答了强 ETH 是否可视为量子遍历性（或均值遍历性）的类比这一关键开放问题，首次证明非混沌但均值遍历的系统也能满足强 ETH。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析，具体包括：对双 kicked top 模型进行量子力学分析，计算可观测量的对角矩阵元涨落标度（D^{-1/2}），并检验非对角矩阵元的统计分布（高斯统计）及平滑函数 f_O(Ē, ω) 在 large-k_θ 区域的均匀性。

papers.title: Implicit Binarization via Complex Phase Dynamics in Combinatorial Optimization
papers.abstract: We introduce a physics-inspired continuous relaxation framework that yields substantially improved solutions for NP-hard combinatorial optimization problems, including Quadratic Unconstrained Binary Optimization (QUBO), binary sparse coding, and planted-solution Ising models. By parameterizing discrete binary variables as continuous wave-like states on the complex unit circle, we inherently smooth highly non-convex energy landscapes. We show that representing binary variables as complex phases reveals an implicit regularization mechanism that promotes convergence toward discrete states. Extracting this mechanism yields significant improvements even within standard real-valued optimization frameworks, using this regularizer explicitly. Empirically, this regularization yields vastly higher ground-state convergence rates than standard real-valued alternatives. Our models achieved zero error in large-scale 160x160 QUBO tasks under severe noise (sigma=0.25), and outperformed traditional algorithms (OMP and LASSO) in underdefined sparse coding with perfect recovery at sigma=0.15. The solver's robustness was further validated by recovering exact ground-state configurations in 8 out of 11 rigorously engineered planted-solution benchmarks.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。关键词：continuous relaxation framework、optimization、regularization mechanism。；研究对象：NP-hard组合优化问题，包括二次无约束二元优化（QUBO）、二元稀疏编码和植入解伊辛模型。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过将离散二元变量参数化为复单位圆上的连续波状态，揭示了隐式正则化机制，该机制促进收敛到离散态，从而显著提高NP-hard组合优化问题的求解质量。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过将离散二元变量参数化为复单位圆上的连续波状态，揭示了隐式正则化机制，该机制促进收敛到离散态，从而显著提高NP-hard组合优化问题的求解质量。；创新点：首次将二元变量的复相位表示与隐式正则化机制联系起来，并证明该机制可显式提取并应用于标准实值优化框架，从而在噪声环境下实现远高于传统方法的基态收敛率。
papers.method_zh: 提出一种受物理启发的连续松弛框架，将二元变量表示为复相位，并从中提取隐式正则化机制，将其显式应用于标准实值优化框架中。通过数值实验验证了该方法在QUBO、稀疏编码和植入解伊辛模型上的性能。

papers.title: Techno-economic Analysis of Light Isotope-enriched Elements for Lightweighting Applications
papers.abstract: Lightweighting is critical to mass-sensitive applications such as aircraft and space transportation. Conventional lightweight strategies often rely on new designs of materials and structures. An alternative approach is to enrich the lightest stable isotopes in an element to reduce the elements atomic mass while having little effect on structural and chemical properties. However, the economic feasibility of this concept remains unclear. Here we present a techno-economic analysis of light isotope-enriched elements for lightweighting applications by estimating isotope enrichment cost and the economic gain from mass reduction. The enrichment cost is scaled from established large-scale processes. Twelve common aerospace-relevant elements are considered, including Li, B, C, Mg, Cl, Ti, Ni, Fe, Cu, Zn, Mo, and Sn. We find that nine elements, especially Li, B, Zn, Ni, Mo, and Sn, show potentially attractive economic benefit at moderate enrichment levels, whereas C, Mg, and Fe provide little or no benefit. With the optimized enrichment levels, an Airbus A380 is expected to save approximately USD 700 K over a 30-year operational lifetime, a SpaceX Falcon 9 could save USD 516 K, and a SpaceX Starship is expected to save USD 2.37 million over its whole lifetime. While the exact enrichment cost needs to be further investigated, these results provide an initial screening of promising candidate elements and highlight isotopic mass reduction as a potential drop-in lightweighting strategy.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（技术经济分析，结合成本估算与工程应用评估）。判断依据关键词：techno-economic analysis、cost estimation、economic gain。；研究对象：轻同位素富集元素（Li, B, C, Mg, Cl, Ti, Ni, Fe, Cu, Zn, Mo, Sn）在航空航天轻量化应用中的经济可行性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在中等富集水平下，Li、B、Zn、Ni、Mo、Sn等九种元素具有潜在的经济效益，而C、Mg、Fe几乎没有或完全没有收益。以优化富集水平计算，一架空客A380在30年运营期内可节省约70万美元，SpaceX星舰全生命周期可节省237万美元。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在中等富集水平下，Li、B、Zn、Ni、Mo、Sn等九种元素具有潜在的经济效益，而C、Mg、Fe几乎没有或完全没有收益。以优化富集水平计算，一架空客A380在30年运营期内可节省约70万美元，SpaceX星舰全生命周期可节省237万美元。；创新点：首次系统评估轻同位素富集作为“即插即用”轻量化策略的经济可行性，并对12种常见航空航天元素进行初步筛选。摘要未突出说明与已有轻量化策略（如新材料设计）的具体对比。
papers.method_zh: 技术经济分析：从已有大规模同位素富集工艺进行成本缩放估算，结合质量减轻带来的经济收益进行对比分析。摘要未明确说明具体富集工艺（如离心法、激光法）或计算模型细节。

papers.title: The peculiar response of Kelvin-Voigt chains with a free end
papers.abstract: We exactly solve a model of a heterogeneous chain of overdamped, harmonically coupled particles with momentum-conserving dissipation. Despite being governed by a non-symmetric drift operator, the system admits an analytical diagonalization by use of a forward-difference transformation. In case of one free end, the response matrix shows a peculiar staircase form: the response of particle i to a force acting on particle j is independent of the properties and the length of the chain-part between i and j. For rank-deficient interaction matrices, the state space is decomposed into free and constrained subspaces. We demonstrate that this separation has clear physical consequences: the free subspace governs steady state responses, while the constraint subspace governs the relaxation after cessation of forcing. These results establish a framework for analyzing heterogeneous overdamped dynamics with momentum conservation.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：关键词“exactly solve”、“analytical diagonalization”、“demonstrate that this separation has clear physical consequences”。；研究对象：具有动量守恒耗散的非均匀过阻尼谐振耦合粒子链（Kelvin-Voigt链），特别关注一端自由的情况。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在自由端条件下，响应矩阵呈现奇特的阶梯形式：粒子i对作用于粒子j的力的响应，与i和j之间链段的性质及长度无关。此外，状态空间可分解为自由子空间和约束子空间，分别控制稳态响应和撤力后的弛豫过程。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在自由端条件下，响应矩阵呈现奇特的阶梯形式：粒子i对作用于粒子j的力的响应，与i和j之间链段的性质及长度无关。此外，状态空间可分解为自由子空间和约束子空间，分别控制稳态响应和撤力后的弛豫过程。；创新点：揭示了非均匀过阻尼动力学中响应矩阵的阶梯结构，并建立了自由/约束子空间分解与稳态/弛豫物理过程的对应关系。摘要未突出说明与已有研究的具体对比。
papers.method_zh: 通过前向差分变换对非对称漂移算子进行解析对角化，精确求解了该过阻尼异质链模型。

papers.title: Multi-Source Domain Transfer Learning for Accurate Property Prediction in Two-Dimensional Materials
papers.abstract: Machine learning has revolutionized materials discovery, but data scarcity remains a critical bottleneck for complex functional properties. As emerging systems, two-dimensional (2D) materials possess limited overall data volumes. Evaluating their diverse functional properties requires time-consuming simulations, hindering unified high-throughput screening. Furthermore, restrictions in known structural prototypes lead to highly fragmented data distributions. To address these challenges, we propose a multi-source domain transfer learning framework to extract generalizable and complementary knowledge from diverse crystalline systems. To mitigate data scarcity, the framework employs a shared feature extractor that integrates adversarial transfer learning with maximum mean discrepancy, mapping crystal structures into a domain-invariant latent space while preserving underlying physical correlations. To resolve distribution fragmentation, a sample-adaptive weighted ensemble strategy is subsequently utilized to dynamically aggregate predictions from multiple source domains. Relying solely on crystal structures, the framework predicts 2D carrier mobilities with an R2 score exceeding 0.90. The framework successfully screened 55 novel high-mobility 2D semiconductors, which were validated via first-principles electron-phonon coupling analysis, confirming their exceptional transport properties and stability. This work can potentially accelerate machine learning-assisted materials design and discovery with less data restriction.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：machine learning、transfer learning、first-principles electron-phonon coupling analysis。；研究对象：二维材料的载流子迁移率（carrier mobilities）预测与筛选。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出多源域迁移学习框架，仅基于晶体结构即可高精度预测二维材料载流子迁移率（R² > 0.90），并成功筛选出55种经第一性原理验证的高迁移率二维半导体。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出多源域迁移学习框架，仅基于晶体结构即可高精度预测二维材料载流子迁移率（R² > 0.90），并成功筛选出55种经第一性原理验证的高迁移率二维半导体。；创新点：针对二维材料数据稀缺且分布碎片化的问题，首次将多源域迁移学习与对抗域适应相结合，实现从多种晶体系统向二维材料的知识迁移，并采用自适应加权集成缓解分布碎片化。
papers.method_zh: 采用多源域迁移学习框架，包含：1）共享特征提取器，结合对抗迁移学习与最大均值差异（MMD）将晶体结构映射到域不变隐空间；2）样本自适应加权集成策略，动态聚合多个源域的预测结果；3）第一性原理电子-声子耦合分析验证筛选结果。

papers.title: Emergence of Triplet Superconductivity from Cavity Vacuum Fluctuations
papers.abstract: Engineering quantum materials with cavity fields has emerged as a powerful route to manipulate phases of quantum matter in solids. Here we demonstrate that cavity vacuum fluctuations alone can drive the emergence of triplet superconductivity in an otherwise singlet superconductor. The vacuum field renormalizes the electronic band structure in a polarization dependent manner, reshaping the Fermi surface and altering the competition among symmetry allowed pairing channels.
