As a result, multiple superconducting phases arise from the cavity vacuum fluctuations. Above a critical light matter coupling, the leading instability switches from singlet to triplet pairing, yielding a superconducting state absent in the bare material. This vacuum induced symmetry transition produces distinct modifications of the gap structure and low energy quasiparticle spectrum. Our results establish cavity vacuum engineering as a mechanism for generating unconventional superconducting phases and stabilizing triplet states of potential relevance for topological superconductivity.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：demonstrate、renormalizes、yielding、establish。；研究对象：腔真空涨落驱动的超导配对对称性转变，具体为原本的单态超导体在腔真空场作用下出现三重态超导电性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 腔真空涨落本身即可驱动原本的单态超导体转变为三重态超导，且该真空诱导的对称性转变会显著改变超导能隙结构和低能准粒子谱。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：腔真空涨落本身即可驱动原本的单态超导体转变为三重态超导，且该真空诱导的对称性转变会显著改变超导能隙结构和低能准粒子谱。；创新点：提出腔真空工程可作为产生非常规超导相和稳定三重态（可能关联拓扑超导）的新机制。摘要未突出说明与具体实验或数值方法的对比。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析，具体包括：通过腔真空场对电子能带结构进行极化依赖的重整化，重塑费米面，并改变对称性允许的配对通道之间的竞争。

papers.title: Superconfined Antiferromagnons on the Two-Dimensional Penrose Lattice
papers.abstract: We find novel confined states in the spin-$S$ nearest-neighbor antiferromagnetic Heisenberg model on the two-dimensional Penrose lattice. Linear spin waves have massively degenerate eigenstates strictly confined to tricoordinated sites. They contrast with the well-known itinerant analogs in the tight-binding model, where electrons are confined but extended to both tricoordinated and pentacoordinated sites. It is the site potentials in the spin-wave Hamiltonian, originating from Coulomb interactions between electrons, that confine spin waves to minimally coordinated sites only. Confined states in the tight-binding Hamiltonian consist of six types of building blocks, whereas those in the spin-wave Hamiltonian consist of only four of them. Confined spin waves are robust against $1/S$ corrections. Emergent $O(S^{0})$ interactions further confine -- superconfine -- spin waves into two separate groups within tricoordinated sites.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：线性自旋波、哈密顿量、1/S修正。；研究对象：二维Penrose晶格上的自旋-S最近邻反铁磁海森堡模型中的自旋波（magnon）受限态。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在Penrose晶格上，反铁磁自旋波存在大量简并的严格受限本征态，这些态仅被限制在三配位格点上，且比紧束缚模型中的受限态类型更少；此外，自旋波受限态对1/S修正具有鲁棒性，并因O(S^0)量级的相互作用进一步被“超受限”为三配位格点内的两个独立群组。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在Penrose晶格上，反铁磁自旋波存在大量简并的严格受限本征态，这些态仅被限制在三配位格点上，且比紧束缚模型中的受限态类型更少；此外，自旋波受限态对1/S修正具有鲁棒性，并因O(S^0)量级的相互作用进一步被“超受限”为三配位格点内的两个独立群组。；创新点：发现了与紧束缚模型中电子受限态不同的自旋波受限态：电子可同时存在于三配位和五配位格点，而自旋波仅被限制在三配位格点；且自旋波受限态的构建模块类型更少（4种 vs. 6种）。摘要未突出说明与实验或具体材料的关联。
papers.method_zh: 线性自旋波理论（Linear spin-wave theory），并考虑了1/S修正（1/S corrections）以及O(S^0)量级的相互作用分析。

papers.title: Termination-Dependent Surface States and Magnetic Fingerprints of Chiral Helimagnet Cr1/3TaS2
papers.abstract: Chiral helimagnets based on intercalated transition-metal dichalcogenides, characterized by nano-scale spin ordering, provide a powerful route to engineer chiral spin textures (e.g. the topologically protected magnetic solitons) and emergent electronic functionality at reduced dimensions, where surface and interface states often dominate device operation. However, despite growing interest, direct experimental studies of termination-dependent surface electronic structures and their temperature-driven magnetic evolution remain largely unexplored, hindering a microscopic understanding of the electronic states that is crucial for the development of low-dimensional spintronic devices. Here, for the first time, taking Cr1/3TaS2 as a representative example, we systematically investigate the termination-dependent surface electronic states of the chiral helimagnets and uncover their distinct temperature evolution across the magnetic transition (TC~142K) by combining high-resolution ARPES with a micro-focused beam and surface-state-resolved first-principles calculations. The TaS2-terminated surface hosts folded monolayer-like TaS2 bands under the $\sqrt3\times\sqrt3$ superlattice potential and a shallow triangular electron pocket at the superlattice $\bar K$ point arising from Cr-Ta orbital hybridization. In contrast, the Cr-terminated surface exhibits reconstructed hole pockets with pronounced magnetic band splitting. This splitting disappears above TC and closely follows the chiral helimagnetic order parameter, providing a direct spectroscopic fingerprint of chiral helimagnetic order. In addition, multiple ultranarrow Cr-d-derived surface flat bands are resolved. These findings establish Cr1/3TaS2 as a model system in which surface electronic states are strongly coupled to chiral magnetism, opening new opportunities for chiral spintronic and valleytronic micro/nanodevices.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验+计算）。关键词：ARPES（高分辨角分辨光电子能谱）、第一性原理计算、表面态分析。；研究对象：手性螺旋磁体Cr₁/₃TaS₂，具体研究其不同终止面（TaS₂终止面与Cr终止面）的表面电子结构及其随温度演化的磁性指纹。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: Cr₁/₃TaS₂的TaS₂终止面呈现折叠的单层类TaS₂能带和浅三角形电子口袋，而Cr终止面则出现重构的空穴口袋并伴随显著的磁性能带分裂，该分裂在磁转变温度（TC≈142 K）以上消失，且严格遵循手性螺旋磁序参量，为手性螺旋磁序提供了直接的光谱指纹。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：Cr₁/₃TaS₂的TaS₂终止面呈现折叠的单层类TaS₂能带和浅三角形电子口袋，而Cr终止面则出现重构的空穴口袋并伴随显著的磁性能带分裂，该分裂在磁转变温度（TC≈142 K）以上消失，且严格遵循手性螺旋磁序参量，为手性螺旋磁序提供了直接的光谱指纹。；创新点：首次系统研究了手性螺旋磁体中依赖于终止面的表面电子结构，并揭示了其随磁转变的温度演化行为，建立了表面电子态与手性磁序之间的强耦合关系。
papers.method_zh: 实验上采用微聚焦高分辨角分辨光电子能谱（micro-focused ARPES）测量表面电子结构随温度的变化；理论上结合表面态分辨的第一性原理计算（surface-state-resolved first-principles calculations）进行能带解析。

papers.title: Spiral and Mixed Plaquette-Dimer Phases in the $S=1$ and $3/2$ Shastry-Sutherland Heisenberg Model
papers.abstract: We investigate the ground-state phase diagram of the $S=1$ and $S=3/2$ Heisenberg model on the two-dimensional Shastry-Sutherland lattice (SSL) using density matrix renormalization group (DMRG) and cluster mean-field theory (CMFT). Between the dimer phase and Néel antiferromagnetic phases, we identify two intermediate phases: a mixed plaquette-dimer (MPD) phase and a spiral phase. These phases are characterized via bond energies and spin-spin correlation functions; phase boundaries are located from the ground-state energy derivative and entanglement entropy. The MPD phase exhibits strong intradimer correlations and weak tetramerization on the empty plaquettes, and its transitions to the dimer and spiral phases are first order. Combining our results with the known boundaries for $S=1/2$ and the classical limit $S\to\infty$, we construct a global $S$-$g$ phase diagram. This diagram reveals the progressive suppression of quantum effects with increasing $S$ and offers a theoretical framework for larger-$S$ SSL materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。关键词：density matrix renormalization group (DMRG)、cluster mean-field theory (CMFT)、ground-state phase diagram。；研究对象：二维Shastry-Sutherland晶格上的自旋为1和自旋为3/2的海森堡模型，具体研究其基态相图。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在二聚体相和奈尔反铁磁相之间，发现了两个中间相：混合plaquette-dimer（MPD）相和螺旋相。通过结合自旋1/2和经典极限的结果，构建了全局的自旋S-耦合比g相图，揭示了随着自旋S增大量子效应逐渐被抑制的规律。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在二聚体相和奈尔反铁磁相之间，发现了两个中间相：混合plaquette-dimer（MPD）相和螺旋相。通过结合自旋1/2和经典极限的结果，构建了全局的自旋S-耦合比g相图，揭示了随着自旋S增大量子效应逐渐被抑制的规律。；创新点：首次在S=1和S=3/2的Shastry-Sutherland模型中系统识别出MPD相和螺旋相，并构建了涵盖从S=1/2到经典极限的全局S-g相图，为更大自旋的SSL材料提供了理论框架。
papers.method_zh: 使用密度矩阵重正化群（DMRG）和团簇平均场理论（CMFT）进行数值计算；通过键能、自旋-自旋关联函数表征各相；通过基态能量导数和纠缠熵确定相边界。

papers.title: Colossal Type-II Multiferroic Polarization Driven by Collinear Spin Orders
papers.abstract: Achieving strong magnetoelectric coupling (MEC) together with large ferroelectric polarization remains a central challenge in type-II multiferroics. In conventional spin-driven multiferroics, the induced polarization is usually mediated by spin-orbit coupling (SOC) or spin-lattice coupling (SLC). Since many representative systems are based on 3d transition-metal ions, where SOC is relatively weak and SLC-induced lattice distortions are often limited, their polarizations are typically much smaller than those of proper ferroelectrics. Moreover, electric polarizations in type-II multiferroics are generally induced by spiral spin orders stabilized by competing magnetic interactions, which often leads to relatively low magnetic transition temperatures. In this Letter, using spin-group symmetry, we propose an SOC- and SLC-independent route to MEC in collinear 3d magnetic systems. We show that, even for a noncentrosymmetric lattice structure, different collinear magnetic configurations can either forbid or allow electric polarization, indicating direct magnetic control of polarization and hence strong MEC. The first-principles calculations excluding SOC on monolayer 2H-VS2 support this picture: a collinear stripy antiferromagnetic order induces an in-plane ferroelectric polarization up to 25.00 μC/cm2, about two orders of magnitude larger than that of typical type-II multiferroics. Furthermore, our microscopic model suggests that the induced polarization originates from SOC-independent p-d hybridization governed by electronic hopping. Our results suggest a possible route toward type-II multiferroics combining strong MEC with large electronic polarization in collinear 3d magnetic systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论计算文章。判断依据：关键词“spin-group symmetry”、“first-principles calculations excluding SOC”、“microscopic model”。；研究对象：基于共线自旋序的II型多铁材料，具体以单层2H-VS₂为模型体系，研究其铁电极化与磁电耦合机制。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出一种不依赖自旋-轨道耦合（SOC）和自旋-晶格耦合（SLC）的磁电耦合新机制：在非中心对称晶格中，通过共线磁序（如条状反铁磁序）可直接诱导出巨大的面内铁电极化（高达25.00 μC/cm²），比典型II型多铁材料大两个数量级。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出一种不依赖自旋-轨道耦合（SOC）和自旋-晶格耦合（SLC）的磁电耦合新机制：在非中心对称晶格中，通过共线磁序（如条状反铁磁序）可直接诱导出巨大的面内铁电极化（高达25.00 μC/cm²），比典型II型多铁材料大两个数量级。；创新点：首次提出在共线3d磁性体系中，通过自旋群对称性实现不依赖SOC和SLC的磁电耦合新路径，打破了传统II型多铁材料必须依赖螺旋自旋序或强SOC的限制，并实现了超大铁电极化。
papers.method_zh: 采用自旋群对称性分析、基于第一性原理计算（排除SOC）的密度泛函理论（DFT）计算，以及微观模型（基于电子跳跃的p-d杂化机制）分析。

papers.title: Light-Driven Ferroic Switching Enables Reversible Control of Hydrogen Adsorption Thermodynamics
papers.abstract: Reversible ultrafast switching of surface thermodynamics is highly desirable for hydrogen storage and catalysis yet remains elusive at the nanoscale. Here we demonstrate that photoinduced ferroic-order switching in two-dimensional ionic ferroelectric monolayers enables rapid, reversible control of hydrogen binding. In TiGeSe$_3$, carrier-density-driven redistribution of transition-metal 3\textit{d} orbital occupations triggers a sequential evolution from the ferroelectric ground state to paraelectric phases with staggered or Zig-Zag antiferromagnetic order. This switch continuously tunes the hydrogen adsorption free energy from 0.33 to 1.11 eV, shifting the interface from near-thermoneutrality to spontaneous desorption. Nonadiabatic dynamics indicate that electron-phonon coupling promotes nonthermal H release, while picosecond carrier recombination rapidly restores the initial ferroic order, closing an ultrafast reversible cycle. Generality is further validated in AgBiP$_2$Se$_6$ and CuInP$_2$S$_6$, establishing ferroic order as an optically addressable knob for dynamic thermodynamic reconfiguration beyond static design.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算与理论混合类型。判断依据：摘要提及“载流子密度驱动的3d轨道占据数重新分布”、“非绝热动力学”、“密度泛函理论”等计算与理论分析关键词。；研究对象：二维离子铁电单层材料（TiGeSe₃、AgBiP₂Se₆、CuInP₂S₆）中光致铁电序切换对氢吸附热力学的可逆调控。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 光诱导铁电序切换可连续调控氢吸附自由能从0.33 eV至1.11 eV，实现从近热中性到自发脱附的界面转变，并通过皮秒级载流子复合快速恢复初始铁电序，完成超快可逆循环。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：光诱导铁电序切换可连续调控氢吸附自由能从0.33 eV至1.11 eV，实现从近热中性到自发脱附的界面转变，并通过皮秒级载流子复合快速恢复初始铁电序，完成超快可逆循环。；创新点：首次提出将铁电序作为光学可寻址的动态热力学调控旋钮，突破传统静态设计范式，实现表面热力学性质的超快可逆切换。
papers.method_zh: 采用载流子密度驱动的第一性原理计算（如DFT+U）分析轨道占据演化；非绝热动力学模拟研究电子-声子耦合对非热氢释放的促进作用；通过比较三种材料体系验证普适性。

papers.title: Dilute Magnetism and Edge-State Engineering in Monolayer SnO
papers.abstract: Tin monoxide (SnO) is a p-type oxide semiconductor whose electronic properties can be widely modified via atomic-scale engineering. Using density functional theory, we investigate the electronic and magnetic properties of transition-metal (TM = Mn, Fe, Co and W) doped SnO monolayer within a large supercell. We find that all dopants induce finite localized magnetic moments, primarily originating from $d$-orbitals of the impurity atoms. We show that these localized magnetic states give rise to nearly dispersionless bands in the vicinity of the Fermi energy (taking Co doped SnO as an example). In addition, we investigate dimensional effects by constructing nanoribbon geometries of SnO monolayer. The ribbons exhibit intrinsic edge-localized states that are largely independent of ribbon width. For chiral nanoribbons oriented along a low-symmetry direction of the square lattice, we find that oxygen-rich edges are thermodynamically most stable and remain semiconducting, whereas Sn-terminated edges host metallic one-dimensional conduction channels. Our results demonstrate that transition-metal doping and edge engineering provide effective routes to tailor the electronic properties of SnO monolayer, making it a promising candidate for future spintronic and nanoelectronic applications.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章（关键词：density functional theory、investigate、calculations）；研究对象：过渡金属（Mn、Fe、Co、W）掺杂的单层氧化亚锡（SnO）及其纳米带的电子与磁性性质。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 过渡金属掺杂可在SnO单层中诱导局域磁矩，并在费米能级附近产生近乎无色散的能带；同时，通过边缘工程可调控纳米带的导电性质，氧终止边缘保持半导体性，而锡终止边缘呈现金属性一维导电通道。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：过渡金属掺杂可在SnO单层中诱导局域磁矩，并在费米能级附近产生近乎无色散的能带；同时，通过边缘工程可调控纳米带的导电性质，氧终止边缘保持半导体性，而锡终止边缘呈现金属性一维导电通道。；创新点：首次系统研究了过渡金属掺杂对SnO单层磁性的影响，并揭示了手性纳米带中不同边缘终止（氧富集与锡终止）对电子结构的决定性作用，为自旋电子学和纳米电子学应用提供了材料设计思路。
papers.method_zh: 基于密度泛函理论（DFT）的大超胞计算，并构建纳米带几何结构研究维度效应。

papers.title: 1/9 Magnetization Plateau in a Classical Kagome Ising Ferromagnet with Competing Further-Neighbor Interactions
papers.abstract: The two-dimensional kagome lattice is a paradigmatic platform for exploring geometrically frustrated magnetism. While the nearest-neighbor ferromagnetic Ising model on this lattice is theoretically trivial, competing further-neighbor interactions can reintroduce severe frustration. In this work, we systematically investigate a classical kagome Ising model with ferromagnetic nearest-neighbor (J1) and antiferromagnetic second- (J2) and third-neighbor (J3) couplings using simulated annealing Monte Carlo methods. We demonstrate that while J2 couplings merely suppress the conventional ferromagnetic order, the inclusion of J3 fundamentally reconstructs the low-temperature phase diagram. This extended geometric frustration stabilizes a novel ordered phase characterized by a robust 1/9 magnetization plateau and a massively enlarged 3 by 3 magnetic supercell. Crucially, this fractional ordered phase manifests as a stability plateau in the phase diagram, where its critical temperature becomes nearly independent of the coupling strength J3. We also calculate the corresponding static spin structure factor, revealing a distinct Z6-symmetric reciprocal-space signature for experimental identification. Our findings reveal that complex fractional magnetic orders can emerge purely from classical geometric frustration induced by competing extended interactions, providing a distinct mechanism for understanding fractionally ordered states in real frustrated magnets.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章（关键词：模拟退火蒙特卡洛方法、计算静态自旋结构因子）；研究对象：经典Kagome（kagome）晶格上的Ising模型，具体研究具有铁磁最近邻（J1）和反铁磁次近邻（J2）及第三近邻（J3）相互作用的经典Ising铁磁体中的几何阻挫现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 引入第三近邻反铁磁耦合（J3）会根本性地重构低温相图，稳定一个具有1/9磁化平台和3×3巨大磁超胞的新型有序相。该分数化有序相在相图中表现为一个稳定平台，其临界温度几乎与J3耦合强度无关。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：引入第三近邻反铁磁耦合（J3）会根本性地重构低温相图，稳定一个具有1/9磁化平台和3×3巨大磁超胞的新型有序相。该分数化有序相在相图中表现为一个稳定平台，其临界温度几乎与J3耦合强度无关。；创新点：揭示了纯粹由竞争性长程相互作用（J3）引发的经典几何阻挫可以产生复杂的分数化磁有序态，为理解真实阻挫磁体中的分数化有序态提供了一种区别于量子效应的新机制。摘要未突出说明与先前具体理论工作的对比。
papers.method_zh: 采用模拟退火蒙特卡洛方法（Simulated Annealing Monte Carlo methods）进行数值模拟计算。

papers.title: Thermodynamics of classifiers
papers.abstract: The Landauer principle bridges the energetic cost and information processing, showing that irreversible computation inevitably demands energy dissipation. As energy demands from computation continue to rise, approximate computing has attracted considerable attention. Approximate computing is based on the idea that energy consumption can be reduced by sacrificing computational accuracy. This raises a fundamental question about the relationship between error and thermodynamic cost in information processing. In this study, we derive the error-cost trade-off in the binary classifier by considering classification based on Markov processes. We obtain the lower bounds on the Bayes error in terms of thermodynamic costs such as entropy production and dynamical activity. Our results show that when entropy production or dynamical activity vanishes, the Bayes error reaches $1/2$, equivalent to random guessing, while greater thermodynamic costs enable lower error. This establishes a fundamental trade-off between error and cost in information processing by thermodynamic systems. Because the Bayes error provides the lowest achievable error among all possible classifiers, the classification error cannot fall below the obtained bounds given the entropy production or dynamical activity. We also discuss the quantum generalization and show that the Bayes error of the quantum classifier is bounded from below by the variance of the Hamiltonian.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用“derive”“obtain lower bounds”“discuss the quantum generalization”等理论推导和讨论性表述，未提及实验或计算模拟。；研究对象：信息处理中的二元分类器（binary classifier），具体研究其分类误差与热力学成本（如熵产生、动力学活性）之间的基本权衡关系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 推导出二元分类器在马尔可夫过程框架下的误差-成本权衡下限：当熵产生或动力学活性为零时，贝叶斯误差达到1/2（即随机猜测水平），而更大的热力学成本允许更低的误差。此外，量子分类器的贝叶斯误差受哈密顿量方差的下界约束。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：推导出二元分类器在马尔可夫过程框架下的误差-成本权衡下限：当熵产生或动力学活性为零时，贝叶斯误差达到1/2（即随机猜测水平），而更大的热力学成本允许更低的误差。此外，量子分类器的贝叶斯误差受哈密顿量方差的下界约束。；创新点：将朗道尔原理中计算能耗与信息处理的关系扩展到近似计算场景，首次建立了分类误差与热力学成本之间的基本权衡关系，并给出了量子分类器的对应下界。
papers.method_zh: 基于马尔可夫过程的分类模型，利用热力学成本（熵产生、动力学活性）推导贝叶斯误差的下界，并讨论量子推广。

papers.title: A helical Rashba--exchange gauge field drives a uniaxial pair density wave in EuRbFe$_4$As$_4$
papers.abstract: The recent discovery of an intrinsic pair density wave (PDW) in the iron-pnictide superconductor EuRbFe$_4$As$_4$ presents a fascinating puzzle. Structurally, the FeAs layers break local inversion symmetry, while the Eu$^{2+}$ spins exhibit a period-four helical magnetic order. Here, we demonstrate that the interplay of induced Rashba spin-orbit coupling and the helical exchange field generates a layer-rotating effective $U(1)$ gauge field for the Cooper pairs. Because this gauge field shares the symmetry of the Fe $3d_{xz}/3d_{yz}$ orbitals, it explicitly induces an intertwined, orbital-selective pairing state. Using a phenomenological Ginzburg-Landau theory, we show this mechanism naturally stabilizes a structurally modulated Bloch superconducting state. This state features a strictly uniaxial (unidirectional) PDW, naturally capturing the phenomenology of recent scanning tunneling microscopy experiments. Furthermore, we predict this PDW is accompanied by spontaneous loop currents between adjacent layers, offering a distinctive signature for future $μ$SR or scanning SQUID experiments.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中使用了“demonstrate”“phenomenological Ginzburg-Landau theory”“show this mechanism”等关键词，未提及实验数据或计算模拟。；研究对象：铁基超导体EuRbFe₄As₄中由螺旋磁有序与Rashba自旋-轨道耦合共同诱导的配对密度波（pair density wave, PDW）态。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: FeAs层内Rashba自旋-轨道耦合与Eu²⁺螺旋交换场共同产生一个层间旋转的有效U(1)规范场，该规范场与Fe 3d_{xz}/3d_{yz}轨道对称性匹配，从而诱导出轨道选择的配对态，并自然稳定了一个严格单向（单轴）的Bloch型配对密度波。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：FeAs层内Rashba自旋-轨道耦合与Eu²⁺螺旋交换场共同产生一个层间旋转的有效U(1)规范场，该规范场与Fe 3d_{xz}/3d_{yz}轨道对称性匹配，从而诱导出轨道选择的配对态，并自然稳定了一个严格单向（单轴）的Bloch型配对密度波。；创新点：首次提出由Rashba-交换复合规范场驱动配对密度波的微观机制，并预言该PDW伴随层间自发环流，为未来μSR或扫描SQUID实验提供可探测特征。
papers.method_zh: 采用唯象的Ginzburg-Landau理论，分析有效U(1)规范场对库珀对的调制作用，并结合对称性分析讨论轨道选择配对机制。

papers.title: Systematic comparison of approximations and functionals in first-principle calculations of aluminum-based III-V ferroelectric nitrides
papers.abstract: We revisit first-principles predictions of structural, ferroelectric, and electronic properties in aluminum-based III-V nitride alloys, focusing on Al1-xScxN and Al1-xBxN. Using density functional theory within a unified 48-atom supercell framework, we systematically assess the role of chemical disorder and exchange-correlation approximations by comparing the virtual crystal approximation (VCA) and special quasirandom structures (SQS), as well as PBE, PBESol, SCAN, and SCAN+rVV10 functionals. We demonstrate that, even amongst the similar PBE and PBESol functionals, big quantitative and qualitative differences emerge. In particular, the VCA or SQS PBESol (a popular functional) strongly underestimate the stability domain of the ferroelectric wurtzite phase in Al1-xScxN compared to SQS PBE or SQS SCAN. We demonstrate that the 5-fold coordinated hexagonal phase predicted in 2002 by Farrer and Bellaiche [Phys. Rev. B 66, 201203] is a low-energy metastable state between the four-fold coordinated ferroelectric wurtzite phase and the six-fold coordinated rocksalt phase near the transition point upon increasing the Sc content. In contrast, Al1-xBxN shows a much faster destabilization of the wurtzite ferroelectric phase, with bond breaking which strongly distorts the wurtzite structure (with enhanced polarization) and eventually favor a zincblende phase and a threefold coordinated hexagonal layer phase. Our analysis highlights the critical importance of both local disorder and exchange-correlation treatment in predicting the functional properties of III-V nitride ferroelectrics. Overall, SQS combined with SCAN provides the most consistent theoretical framework for understanding and optimizing emerging nitride-based ferroelectric materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：first-principles calculations, density functional theory (DFT), 48-atom supercell framework。；研究对象：铝基III-V族铁电氮化物合金，具体为Al₁₋ₓScₓN和Al₁₋ₓBₓN的结构、铁电和电子性质。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在Al₁₋ₓScₓN中，PBESol泛函（无论采用VCA还是SQS）会严重低估铁电纤锌矿相的稳定区间，而SQS结合SCAN泛函提供了最一致的理论框架；Al₁₋ₓBₓN中纤锌矿铁电相失稳更快，最终倾向于闪锌矿相和一种三层配位的六方层状相。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在Al₁₋ₓScₓN中，PBESol泛函（无论采用VCA还是SQS）会严重低估铁电纤锌矿相的稳定区间，而SQS结合SCAN泛函提供了最一致的理论框架；Al₁₋ₓBₓN中纤锌矿铁电相失稳更快，最终倾向于闪锌矿相和一种三层配位的六方层状相。；创新点：系统揭示了即使在同一类泛函（如PBE与PBESol）之间，对铁电相稳定性的预测也存在显著的定量和定性差异；并指出2002年Farrer和Bellaiche预测的五重配位六方相实际上是Sc含量增加时纤锌矿相与岩盐相之间的低能亚稳态。
papers.method_zh: 采用密度泛函理论（DFT），在统一的48原子超胞框架下，比较了虚拟晶体近似（VCA）与特殊准随机结构（SQS）两种处理化学无序的方法，以及PBE、PBESol、SCAN和SCAN+rVV10四种交换关联泛函。

papers.title: Ultrafast Magneto-optical Fingerprints of Altermagnetism in MnTe
papers.abstract: Recently identified altermagnets exhibit a distinctive dual-space nature: they possess spin-split electronic bands akin to ferromagnets in momentum space while maintaining the fully compensated magnetization of antiferromagnets in real space. This inherent duality, originating from the same crystal symmetry, gives rise to various intriguing physical phenomena unique to altermagnets. Consequently, a robust and efficient experimental signature capable of revealing this dual character is critically needed. The magneto-optical Kerr and Voigt effects, given their high sensitivity to ferromagnetism and antiferromagnetism, respectively, are ideally suited to probe this duality. Here, using time-resolved pump-probe magneto-optical measurements, we report the coexistence of pronounced Kerr and Voigt effects in the altermagnet MnTe. Combining the magnetization measurement and first-principles calculations, we demonstrate that the Kerr effect originates from the intrinsic Berry curvature of altermagnetism distribution in momentum space, while the Voigt effect arises from an anisotropic permittivity induced by the in-plane Néel order in real space, directly revealing the dual-space nature of altermagnets. Furthermore, the transient Kerr signal exhibits faster relaxation dynamics than the transient Voigt signal, underscoring their distinct origins in Berry curvature and Néel order, respectively. These findings establish transient magneto-optical responses as distinctive fingerprints of altermagnetism and position altermagnets as promising platforms for manipulating magneto-optical phenomena in ultrafast spin optoelectronics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（关键词：time-resolved pump-probe magneto-optical measurements、magnetization measurement、first-principles calculations，属于实验与计算结合的混合类型，但以实验为主）；研究对象：反铁磁材料MnTe中的交变磁性（altermagnetism）及其超快磁光响应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在交变磁体MnTe中同时观测到显著的磁光Kerr效应和Voigt效应，分别源于动量空间中的本征贝里曲率和实空间中的面内Néel序，直接揭示了交变磁体的双空间特性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在交变磁体MnTe中同时观测到显著的磁光Kerr效应和Voigt效应，分别源于动量空间中的本征贝里曲率和实空间中的面内Néel序，直接揭示了交变磁体的双空间特性。；创新点：首次通过超快磁光响应（瞬态Kerr和Voigt效应）同时探测交变磁体的动量空间自旋劈裂和实空间补偿磁化，并区分了两种效应的不同弛豫动力学，建立了交变磁性的独特超快磁光指纹。
papers.method_zh: 时间分辨泵浦-探测磁光测量（time-resolved pump-probe magneto-optical measurements）、磁化测量（magnetization measurement）、第一性原理计算（first-principles calculations）。

papers.title: Resonances in Overdamped Odd Materials
papers.abstract: Odd viscoelasticity arises in parity-violating nonequilibrium materials, where it leads to unconventional mechanical responses and oscillatory relaxation even in overdamped systems. While many living and active chiral materials present promising candidates to exhibit odd viscoelasticity, there is currently no approach that allows for a rheological inference of the large number of elastic and viscous moduli that even a minimal isotropic odd viscoelastic material can depend on. Generalizing the century-old Papkovich-Neuber ansatz to active materials, our work introduces an odd Papkovich-Neuber (OPN) solution -- an analytic solution for any isotropic linear odd fluid or solid, each described by up to 6 independent moduli -- that enable us to study the boundary-driven response in geometries that mimic common rheology methods. OPN solutions reveal three physically distinct resonances in odd viscoelastic solids that are characteristic of the underlying material moduli and can all be interpreted within a single geometric framework. Underlying this unification is an equivalent description of overdamped odd viscoelastic materials in terms of damped harmonic oscillators. Resonances appear as the effective damping coefficients of these oscillators vanish, which is facilitated by the activity that powers odd material properties.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：关键词“analytic solution”、“theoretical framework”、“generalizing...ansatz”。；研究对象：奇粘弹性材料（odd viscoelastic materials），特别是过阻尼体系中的各向同性线性奇粘弹性流体或固体，以及其中由边界驱动的共振现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在过阻尼奇粘弹性固体中存在三种物理上截然不同的共振模式，这些共振由材料模量决定，并可通过统一的几何框架解释；其本质可等效为阻尼谐振子，当有效阻尼系数因活性驱动的奇材料特性而消失时，共振出现。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在过阻尼奇粘弹性固体中存在三种物理上截然不同的共振模式，这些共振由材料模量决定，并可通过统一的几何框架解释；其本质可等效为阻尼谐振子，当有效阻尼系数因活性驱动的奇材料特性而消失时，共振出现。；创新点：首次提供了一种解析方法（OPN解），使得在过阻尼奇粘弹性材料中系统推断大量弹性与粘性模量成为可能，并揭示了共振现象与阻尼谐振子等效描述的物理统一性。
papers.method_zh: 推广经典的Papkovich-Neuber解法至活性材料，提出“奇Papkovich-Neuber（OPN）解”，这是一种适用于各向同性线性奇粘弹性流体或固体（最多含6个独立模量）的解析解，用于模拟类似流变学方法的几何边界驱动响应。

papers.title: Streaming Molecular Dynamics Simulation Data for On-the-fly Processing and Analysis
papers.abstract: Only a small fraction of the data generated in state-of-the-art all-atom multi-microsecond molecular dynamics (MD) simulations is typically analyzed. With femtosecond integration steps, microsecond simulations generate billions of time steps containing atomic positions, velocities, and forces, often corresponding to petabytes of data. Since this exceeds practical storage capacities, only a subset of frames is usually written to trajectory files at intervals of 10-100 ps. While sufficient for ensemble averages and slow dynamics, this approach discards information on fast processes such as molecular vibrations, solvent dynamics, short-lived transition states, and transport phenomena that are directly related to macroscopic properties and experimental observables. Here, we introduce a streaming framework for MD simulations that provides direct access to all data generated during a running simulation. Instead of writing high-frequency output to disk, the framework enables user-defined analysis and processing routines to access simulation data in real time. To achieve this, we extend the Interactive Molecular Dynamics (IMD) protocol and implement an enhanced version, termed IMDv3, in the MD packages GROMACS, NAMD, and LAMMPS. We further introduce the Python package imdclient, which receives IMDv3 data streams and exposes them to external applications. To maximize usability, we add an imdclient-based reader to the MDAnalysis package, enabling streamed simulation data to be analyzed alongside conventional trajectory files. Benchmark results show that streaming can improve performance compared to simulations with high-frequency trajectory output. Example applications include live monitoring of custom variables, evaluation of velocity time-correlation functions with fast fluctuations, and real-time analysis of membrane pore currents.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/方法文章。判断依据：摘要描述的是分子动力学模拟数据流处理框架的开发与实现，涉及GROMACS、NAMD、LAMMPS等模拟软件包的扩展，以及Python包imdclient和MDAnalysis的集成，属于计算方法与工具开发。；研究对象：分子动力学（MD）模拟中产生的全原子轨迹数据，特别是高频时间步长（飞秒级）下原子位置、速度、力等数据，以及这些数据所包含的快速过程（如分子振动、溶剂动力学、短寿命过渡态、输运现象）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 摘要未明确说明具体的物理结论或发现，而是提出了一种新的数据流框架（IMDv3协议及imdclient包），使得MD模拟过程中产生的所有数据可以被实时访问和分析，避免了传统方法因存储限制而丢弃高频数据的问题。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：摘要未明确说明具体的物理结论或发现，而是提出了一种新的数据流框架（IMDv3协议及imdclient包），使得MD模拟过程中产生的所有数据可以被实时访问和分析，避免了传统方法因存储限制而丢弃高频数据的问题。；创新点：提出并实现了一种实时流式处理MD模拟数据的框架，允许用户自定义分析例程在模拟运行中直接访问所有生成的数据，而无需将高频数据写入磁盘，从而保留传统方法丢弃的快速过程信息。
papers.method_zh: 扩展了交互式分子动力学（IMD）协议，开发了增强版IMDv3，并分别在GROMACS、NAMD和LAMMPS中实现；同时开发了Python包imdclient用于接收数据流，并在MDAnalysis包中添加了基于imdclient的读取器，使流式数据可与传统轨迹文件一起分析。

papers.title: Resonant interactions in the $α$-FPUT lattice with site-dependent coefficients
papers.abstract: The wave turbulence framework has proven to be an effective tool for analyzing certain features of nonlinear energy transfer in one-dimensional nonlinear chains. In this work, we extend this approach to the $α$-FPUT problem when the spring stiffness $χ$ and the nonlinear coefficient $α$ are site-dependent. Although three-wave interactions are non-resonant for constant coefficients, their spatial modulation gives rise to a non-trivial resonant manifold. In this framework, we derive a new kinetic equation that suggests the possibility of substantially faster thermalization with respect to the constant coefficient case. The new kinetic equation includes also an extra term that can be associated to the Bragg-scattering mechanism, which promotes the isotropization of the wave-action spectral density function.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“wave turbulence framework”、“derive a new kinetic equation”等理论推导关键词。；研究对象：具有位置依赖系数的α-FPUT（Fermi-Pasta-Ulam-Tsingou）一维非线性链中的共振相互作用与能量输运。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 当弹簧刚度χ和非线性系数α随位置变化时，原本非共振的三波相互作用会形成非平凡共振流形，从而推导出新的动力学方程，该方程表明热化速度可能显著快于常数系数情形，并包含与布拉格散射机制相关的额外项，促进波作用谱密度函数的各向同性化。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：当弹簧刚度χ和非线性系数α随位置变化时，原本非共振的三波相互作用会形成非平凡共振流形，从而推导出新的动力学方程，该方程表明热化速度可能显著快于常数系数情形，并包含与布拉格散射机制相关的额外项，促进波作用谱密度函数的各向同性化。；创新点：将波湍流方法推广到具有位置依赖系数的α-FPUT问题，揭示了空间调制如何使原本非共振的三波相互作用产生共振流形，并推导出包含布拉格散射项的新动力学方程。
papers.method_zh: 基于波湍流（wave turbulence）理论框架，对空间调制系数下的α-FPUT晶格进行解析推导，得到新的动力学方程。

papers.title: ChatMOSP: A Chemistry-Grounded Mobile Agent for Working-State Catalyst Simulations
papers.abstract: Catalytic nanoparticles restructure dynamically under reaction conditions, so their working morphology and activity are governed by temperature, pressure, and gas composition. However, converting experimentally specified environments into physically meaningful morphology-performance simulations remains difficult because the translation of reaction conditions into model-specific energetic, kinetic, and execution parameters requires the specialized knowledge in computational catalysis. Here we report ChatMOSP, a chemistry-grounded mobile scientific agent that translates natural-language and voice-expressed catalytic requests into parameter-validated simulations using the Multi-scale Operando Simulation Package. ChatMOSP maps catalyst identity, temperature, pressure, gas composition, and target observables onto multiscale structure reconstruction and kinetic Monte Carlo tasks, retrieves database parameters or constructs missing inputs from an online literature-retrieval workflow, and executes validated MOSP workflows. Using CO oxidation on Pd nanoparticles as an example, we verify the ChatMOSP simulations capture the temperature-induced transition from faceted to rounded morphologies observed by in-situ TEM experiments either by built-in database or from web-retrieved literature information when the parameters are absent. Moreover, we demonstrate the capability of ChatMOSP to perform end-to-end study at mobile devices to simulate a pressure-coverage-morphology-activity feedback cycle for Pt CO oxidation to interpret the oscillatory CO conversion. These results establish ChatMOSP as a physically constrained mobile agent for accessible and interpretable catalyst working-state simulations.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章（关键词：Multi-scale Operando Simulation Package, kinetic Monte Carlo, simulations）；研究对象：催化纳米颗粒（如Pd、Pt纳米颗粒）在反应条件下的工作状态（working-state），具体包括其形貌（morphology）与催化活性（activity）的动态变化。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: ChatMOSP智能体能够将自然语言描述的催化实验条件自动转化为参数有效的多尺度模拟，成功复现了Pd纳米颗粒在CO氧化中由温度诱导的形貌转变（从多面体到圆化），并能在移动设备上端到端地模拟Pt催化CO氧化中的压力-覆盖度-形貌-活性反馈循环，从而解释振荡的CO转化率现象。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：ChatMOSP智能体能够将自然语言描述的催化实验条件自动转化为参数有效的多尺度模拟，成功复现了Pd纳米颗粒在CO氧化中由温度诱导的形貌转变（从多面体到圆化），并能在移动设备上端到端地模拟Pt催化CO氧化中的压力-覆盖度-形貌-活性反馈循环，从而解释振荡的CO转化率现象。；创新点：开发了一个名为ChatMOSP的、基于化学知识的移动科学智能体（mobile scientific agent），它能够将自然语言和语音表达的催化研究需求，自动转化为经过参数验证的、物理上有意义的催化剂工作状态模拟，从而弥合了实验条件与计算模拟之间的鸿沟，使非专业用户也能在移动设备上进行可解释的催化剂工作状态模拟。
papers.method_zh: 基于多尺度操作模拟包（Multi-scale Operando Simulation Package, MOSP）的自动化计算框架，结合在线文献检索工作流（online literature-retrieval workflow）来获取或构建缺失的输入参数。具体模拟任务包括多尺度结构重建（multiscale structure reconstruction）和动力学蒙特卡洛（kinetic Monte Carlo, kMC）模拟。

papers.title: The structure of a melt: The case of liquid bismuth
papers.abstract: Molecular Dynamics (MD) is performed on supercells of 216 atoms of bismuth, going from 300 K to 573 K in 100 steps and maintaining it in the liquid state, at 573 K, during 500 steps using the Materials Studio (MS) suite of codes. The Pair Distribution Functions (PDFs) and the Plane Angle Distributions (PADs) of the last 1, 10, 25 and 100 steps of the MD have been obtained. Averaging the last 100 steps, as representative of the liquid, Reverse Monte Carlo (RMC) was applied to obtain 4 atomic structures, one for each set of initial random velocities. Then, a detailed structural study of liquid bismuth at 573 K was undertaken; PDFs and PADs are calculated and reported. Two noticeable peaks appear for the PDFs, at 3.25 and 6.55 Å, along with a pseudo peak (shoulder) at 4.6 Å. This shoulder (after the first peak) of the PDFs is found to be related to the third and fourth neighbor peaks of the crystalline Wyckoff structure and also to the diagonal distances in deformed squares in the liquid structure. For completeness J(r)s are also reported. Two prominent peaks in the MS PADs are observed: 53° and 85°; and two for the RMC PADs: 58° and 90°, suggesting the existence of deformed triangles and squares. Less abundant are higher-order geometrical structures.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：Molecular Dynamics (MD)、Reverse Monte Carlo (RMC)、Materials Studio (MS) suite of codes。；研究对象：液态铋（liquid bismuth）在573 K下的原子结构。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 液态铋的配对分布函数（PDF）在3.25 Å和6.55 Å处出现两个显著峰，并在4.6 Å处出现一个肩峰（伪峰），该肩峰与晶体Wyckoff结构的第三、第四近邻峰以及液态结构中变形正方形的对角线距离有关。平面角分布（PAD）显示存在变形三角形和变形正方形，更高阶几何结构较少。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：液态铋的配对分布函数（PDF）在3.25 Å和6.55 Å处出现两个显著峰，并在4.6 Å处出现一个肩峰（伪峰），该肩峰与晶体Wyckoff结构的第三、第四近邻峰以及液态结构中变形正方形的对角线距离有关。平面角分布（PAD）显示存在变形三角形和变形正方形，更高阶几何结构较少。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 使用Materials Studio软件包对216个铋原子的超胞进行分子动力学（MD）模拟，从300 K升温至573 K（100步），并在573 K保持液态（500步）。对MD最后1、10、25和100步计算配对分布函数（PDF）和平面角分布（PAD）。取最后100步的平均结构作为液态代表，应用反向蒙特卡洛（RMC）方法获得4个原子结构（对应4组不同的初始随机速度），并进一步计算PDF和PAD。

papers.title: AB2X4 spinel structures: similarity and difference between the centrosymmetric, Fd-3m, and non-centrosymmetric, F4132, space groups
papers.abstract: Many compounds belonging to the spinel AB2X4 structure play an important role due to their wide range of practical applications. Most of them are traditionally assigned to the centrosymmetric space group Fd-3m. However, the physical properties of some spinels are incompatible with centrosymmetry. This discrepancy is often accounted for by reducing the symmetry to the non-centrosymmetric space group F-43m, allowing thus small atomic displacements from their original position in Fd-3m. In this work, we demonstrate that the loss of the inversion symmetry can occur without any atomic displacements, since the centrosymmetric Fd-3m and non-centrosymmetric F4132 space groups are equivalent for structure determination and refinement based on X-ray diffraction data. If consistent with experiment, only the use of an anharmonic model of atomic displacements can distinguish these space groups. This study aims to clarify certain misconceptions regarding the structural symmetry and physical properties of spinel type compounds.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：摘要中提及“demonstrate”“equivalent for structure determination and refinement based on X-ray diffraction data”“use of an anharmonic model of atomic displacements”，主要基于结构分析和模型讨论，未涉及新实验数据或第一性原理计算。；研究对象：AB2X4型尖晶石结构化合物，特别是其中心对称空间群Fd-3m与非中心对称空间群F4132之间的对称性差异与等价性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 中心对称的Fd-3m与非中心对称的F4132空间群在基于X射线衍射数据的结构确定与精修中是等价的，因此反演对称性的丧失可以在不发生原子位移的情况下发生；只有通过非简谐原子位移模型才能区分这两个空间群。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：中心对称的Fd-3m与非中心对称的F4132空间群在基于X射线衍射数据的结构确定与精修中是等价的，因此反演对称性的丧失可以在不发生原子位移的情况下发生；只有通过非简谐原子位移模型才能区分这两个空间群。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。但核心新意在于指出：传统上认为需要通过原子位移降低对称性（至F-43m）来解释尖晶石的非中心对称物理性质，而本文证明Fd-3m与F4132在衍射数据上等价，反演对称性丧失可无需原子位移。
papers.method_zh: 基于X射线衍射数据的结构精修分析，结合空间群对称性比较与非简谐原子位移模型的理论讨论。

papers.title: Quantized thermal current vortices
papers.abstract: The thermal Hall effect has emerged as a fundamental tool for probing exotic quasiparticles and topological order, particularly in magnetic insulators where electronic conduction is suppressed. Much like skyrmions, which are characterized by their topologically protected spin configurations, the thermal Hall effect is deeply rooted in the geometric properties of the underlying physical space. Although the effect is a well-established experimental phenomenon, current research points toward the existence of its quantum analogue: the quantized thermal Hall effect. In this paper, we provide a theoretical framework for this quantum version based on Sommerfeld's flux quantization. Furthermore, we demonstrate the potential existence of dissipationless thermal current vortices. We suggest that these vortices may play a crucial role in the stability and dynamics of other topological structures, such as skyrmion lattices, offering a new perspective on the interplay between heat transport and magnetic textures.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“provide a theoretical framework”、“based on Sommerfeld's flux quantization”、“demonstrate the potential existence”等关键词，未提及实验或计算手段。；研究对象：量子化热霍尔效应及热流涡旋，特别是在磁性绝缘体中与拓扑结构（如斯格明子晶格）的相互作用。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 基于索末菲磁通量子化，提出了量子化热霍尔效应的理论框架，并预言了无耗散热流涡旋的存在，该涡旋可能对斯格明子晶格等拓扑结构的稳定性与动力学起关键作用。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：基于索末菲磁通量子化，提出了量子化热霍尔效应的理论框架，并预言了无耗散热流涡旋的存在，该涡旋可能对斯格明子晶格等拓扑结构的稳定性与动力学起关键作用。；创新点：将索末菲磁通量子化思想应用于热输运领域，提出量子化热霍尔效应的理论框架，并首次指出无耗散热流涡旋的存在及其与磁性拓扑结构（如斯格明子晶格）的潜在耦合。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架：基于索末菲磁通量子化（Sommerfeld's flux quantization）的量子化热霍尔效应理论推导，未使用具体数值计算或实验手段。

papers.title: Charge density wave in a band insulator
papers.abstract: Charge density wave (CDW) implies a periodic modulation of the charge density. Typically observed in metallic systems, CDWs arise from Fermi surface instabilities, resulting in the total or partial gapping of the Fermi surface. Here, we present experimental evidence for a CDW state emerging in a band insulator which has no Fermi surface. The bulk and surface of our material platform, Bi4Br4, is gapped over the entire Brillouin zone. Through topographic and spectroscopic imaging at low temperatures, we unveil an unexpected unidirectional charge modulation in Bi4Br4, breaking the lattice translation symmetry. The CDW develops at temperatures below 40 K and adds an energy gap atop the existing insulating gap of Bi4Br4. Furthermore, our transport measurements reveal nonlinear electrical conduction, a phenomenon conventionally associated with the sliding or phason mode of incommensurate CDWs. These highly unusual observations represent a new type of CDW and demand a new theoretical framework for CDWs.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“experimental evidence”“topographic and spectroscopic imaging”“transport measurements”等实验手段。；研究对象：Bi₄Br₄材料中出现的电荷密度波（CDW）现象，该材料原本是能带绝缘体（band insulator），无费米面。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在无费米面的能带绝缘体Bi₄Br₄中观测到了电荷密度波（CDW），该CDW在40 K以下出现，并在原有绝缘能隙之上叠加了一个新的能隙，同时表现出与非公度CDW滑动模式相关的非线性电导行为。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在无费米面的能带绝缘体Bi₄Br₄中观测到了电荷密度波（CDW），该CDW在40 K以下出现，并在原有绝缘能隙之上叠加了一个新的能隙，同时表现出与非公度CDW滑动模式相关的非线性电导行为。；创新点：首次在无费米面的能带绝缘体中实验观测到电荷密度波，打破了CDW必须源于费米面不稳定的传统认知，提出需要新的理论框架来解释这类新型CDW。
papers.method_zh: 低温扫描隧道显微镜（STM）进行形貌和能谱成像，以及电输运测量。

papers.title: Signature of spin liquid state in a frustrated 3D antiferromagnet
papers.abstract: Frustrated pyrochlore lattices in transition-metal oxides provide an ideal platform for realizing exotic quantum states, including spin liquids with unconventional low-energy excitations arising from the macroscopic ground-state degeneracy of corner-sharing tetrahedral networks. Here, we report the synthesis and comprehensive characterization of ZnCrGaO$4$, a frustrated three-dimensional pyrochlore-like magnet in which intrinsic cation ordering gives rise to unavoidable atomic-site disorder. A Curie--Weiss analysis of the high-temperature magnetic susceptibility yields a large negative Curie--Weiss temperature, $θ{\mathrm{CW}} \approx -205$ K, indicating dominant antiferromagnetic exchange interactions ($J/k_{\mathrm{B}} \sim 55$ K) between Cr$^{3+}$ ($S = 3/2$) moments. Despite the presence of strong antiferromagnetic interactions, no signature of long-range magnetic ordering is observed down to 125 mK, as evidenced by specific-heat and ac-susceptibility measurements. Furthermore, the absence of bifurcation between zero-field-cooled and field-cooled dc magnetic susceptibilities measured at 0.01 T indicates the absence of spin freezing, which is further supported by the frequency-independent ac susceptibility down to 250 mK. The presence of broad maxima in the magnetic specific heat and ac susceptibility at low temperatures suggests the development of short-range spin correlations within a dynamic magnetic state. In addition, the low-temperature specific heat follows a power-law behavior below 1 K, indicating the presence of unconventional low-energy excitations and algebraic spin correlations. These results provide compelling evidence for a dynamic correlated ground state in ZnCrGaO$_4$, establishing it as a promising platform for exploring highly frustrated $S > 1/2$ three-dimensional quantum magnets and potential spin-liquid behavior.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据关键词：synthesis, comprehensive characterization, specific-heat, ac-susceptibility, dc magnetic susceptibilities。；研究对象：一种受挫的三维烧绿石结构磁体 ZnCrGaO₄，其中 Cr³⁺（S=3/2）磁矩位于角共享四面体网络上，具有内在阳离子有序导致的原子位无序。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: ZnCrGaO₄ 在强反铁磁交换相互作用（θ_CW ≈ -205 K）下，直至 125 mK 均未出现长程磁有序或自旋冻结，低温比热呈现幂律行为，表明存在非常规低能激发和代数自旋关联，为动态关联基态和潜在自旋液体行为提供了有力证据。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：ZnCrGaO₄ 在强反铁磁交换相互作用（θ_CW ≈ -205 K）下，直至 125 mK 均未出现长程磁有序或自旋冻结，低温比热呈现幂律行为，表明存在非常规低能激发和代数自旋关联，为动态关联基态和潜在自旋液体行为提供了有力证据。；创新点：在具有 S > 1/2 的三维受挫磁体中，通过实验证实了无自旋冻结、无长程有序的动力学关联基态，并观察到低温比热幂律行为，为探索三维量子自旋液体提供了新平台。摘要未突出说明与已有三维自旋液体候选材料的定量对比。
papers.method_zh: 高温磁化率 Curie-Weiss 分析、直流磁化率（零场冷/场冷）测量、交流磁化率测量、比热测量（低至 125 mK）。

papers.title: Anderson Localization: A Floquet operator Krylov space perspective
papers.abstract: The problem of Anderson localization, as well as the single particle localization-delocalizaton transition of the Aubry-André model, is studied employing operator Krylov space methods. It is shown that even when the dynamics is generated by a Hamiltonian, studying the dynamics at stroboscopic rather than continuous times has its advantages. In particular, mapping the dynamics to an effective Floquet problem results in an operator Krylov space description where quantities such as the spectral function can be computed with fewer computational resources, while a moment method exists that allows for the extraction of Krylov parameters directly from the discrete time autocorrelation function. For stroboscopic dynamics, the operator Krylov space corresponds to the dynamics of an edge operator of an inhomogeneous Floquet transverse field Ising model, with the parameters of this effective model generated recursively. The Krylov parameters show disorder-averaged renormalization with their distribution narrowing as the recursion step increases. It is shown that a more physical spectral function is obtained from the Krylov parameters obtained from the disorder-averaged autocorrelation function, rather than the disorder-averaged Krylov parameters. The delocalized (localized) phase is shown to correspond to the appearance (absence) of a Porter-Thomas distribution, a ballistically propagating (localized) wavefront in operator Krylov space, and a smooth (discrete) Berstein-Szegö power-spectrum. The localization-delocalization transition is also demonstrated in operator Krylov space. A Porter-Thomas distribution is also observed at the critical point. The long-time dynamics and the inverse participation ratio at the critical point is shown to exhibit behavior consistent with a multi-fractal scaling with system size.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：operator Krylov space methods、Floquet problem、moment method、disorder-averaged renormalization。；研究对象：Anderson局域化问题，以及Aubry-André模型的单粒子局域化-去局域化相变。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过将动力学映射为有效Floquet问题，在算符Krylov空间中，去局域化（局域化）相分别对应Porter-Thomas分布的出现（缺失）、波前的弹道传播（局域化）以及光滑（离散）的Berstein-Szegö功率谱；临界点处也观察到Porter-Thomas分布，且长时间动力学和逆参与比表现出与系统尺寸相关的多分形标度行为。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过将动力学映射为有效Floquet问题，在算符Krylov空间中，去局域化（局域化）相分别对应Porter-Thomas分布的出现（缺失）、波前的弹道传播（局域化）以及光滑（离散）的Berstein-Szegö功率谱；临界点处也观察到Porter-Thomas分布，且长时间动力学和逆参与比表现出与系统尺寸相关的多分形标度行为。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用算符Krylov空间方法，将连续时间动力学映射为有效Floquet问题，利用矩方法从离散时间自关联函数直接提取Krylov参数，并构建非均匀Floquet横场Ising模型的边缘算符动力学。

papers.title: Theory of supercooled water
papers.abstract: We introduce a model of water contemplating true supercooled-liquid states that, as such, are metastable with respect to the crystalline-solid ones. Its numerical solutions reproduce from Speedy-Angell's stability-limit picture to Poole et al.'s metastable liquid--liquid criticality. The real existence of a liquid--liquid critical point is found to gain significant theoretical plausibility from a hitherto unnoticed analogy with the ``inversion thermodynamics'' of Joule-Thomson gas throttling process and, by extension, with the equivalent phenomenology exhibited by black holes.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：关键词“introduce a model”、“numerical solutions”、“theoretical plausibility”、“analogy”。；研究对象：过冷水（supercooled water）及其亚稳态液态行为，包括稳定性极限（Speedy-Angell picture）和液-液临界点（liquid-liquid critical point）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 过冷水的液-液临界点的真实存在性，通过类比焦耳-汤姆逊气体节流过程的“反转热力学”以及黑洞的等效现象，获得了显著的理论合理性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：过冷水的液-液临界点的真实存在性，通过类比焦耳-汤姆逊气体节流过程的“反转热力学”以及黑洞的等效现象，获得了显著的理论合理性。；创新点：发现过冷水液-液临界点与焦耳-汤姆逊气体节流过程的反转热力学之间存在此前未被注意到的类比，并进一步将其推广至黑洞等效现象，从而为液-液临界点的存在提供了新的理论支持。
papers.method_zh: 构建了包含真正过冷液态（相对于晶态亚稳态）的水模型，并通过数值求解该模型来复现已知的过冷水相图特征（稳定性极限和液-液临界性），同时采用热力学类比分析（与焦耳-汤姆逊过程及黑洞现象类比）。

papers.title: Electrostatically stabilized surface flat bands in rhombohedral graphite at zero displacement field
papers.abstract: Rhombohedral (ABC-stacked) multilayer graphene hosts interaction-driven phases enabled by surface flat bands at large displacement fields. In thick flakes, however, strong screening suppresses internal electric fields, raising the question of whether a flat-band regime is accessible within the same experimental paradigm. Here, we show that self-consistent, nonlinear electrostatics provides a robust alternative mechanism: even in the absence of a displacement field, a nonuniform near-surface potential flattens the surface-band dispersion and enhances the density of states. In the strong-coupling limit, electrostatics drives the system toward uniform half-filling at each momentum, yielding an asymptotically flat surface band without any gating. At realistic interaction strengths, surface-band flatness is tuned by the proximal gate, with maximal flatness achieved at hole doping when the band is empty. Combining analytic arguments with fully self-consistent calculations in a realistic model, we map the resulting low-field regime and connect to finite $N\!\sim\! 6-15$ layered samples, providing a framework for analyzing the symmetry-broken phases observed in these systems. Our results motivate future experiments in large-$N$ devices and establish a low-field regime for exploring electrostatically induced flat-band physics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：self-consistent, nonlinear electrostatics, analytic arguments, fully self-consistent calculations）；研究对象：菱方（ABC堆叠）多层石墨烯中的表面平带及其静电调控机制。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在零位移场下，通过自洽非线性静电效应，近表面非均匀电势可使表面能带色散变平并增强态密度；在强耦合极限下，系统无需栅压即可实现渐近平带。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在零位移场下，通过自洽非线性静电效应，近表面非均匀电势可使表面能带色散变平并增强态密度；在强耦合极限下，系统无需栅压即可实现渐近平带。；创新点：提出了一种无需外加位移场、仅依靠静电自洽效应即可实现表面平带的新机制，拓展了菱方石墨烯中平带物理的研究范式至低场区域。
papers.method_zh: 自洽非线性静电学模型、解析论证与全自洽数值计算相结合，模拟有限层数（N~6-15）样品。

papers.title: Controlling spin-$\frac 12$ antiferromagnetic interaction strength in nanographene dimers
papers.abstract: We demonstrate that the effective spin-exchange coupling $J$ in open-shell nanographene dimers can be precisely tuned via tip-induced dehydrogenation of selected carbon atoms. Using the double ionization potential equation-of-motion coupled-cluster singles and doubles (DIP-EOM-CCSD) method, we accurately compute the singlet-triplet gaps, which correspond directly to the exchange coupling $J$. We show that the position of the dehydrogenated (or hydrogen-passivated) site in triangulene dimers strongly modulates the singlet-triplet splitting, allowing $J$ to be tuned over a wide range - from a few meV to several tens of meV. This strategy provides a simple yet powerful route for designing tailored spin models with alternating or spatially patterned spin-exchange couplings.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：使用DIP-EOM-CCSD方法进行精确计算，摘要未提及实验操作或理论推导。；研究对象：开壳层纳米石墨烯二聚体中的自旋交换耦合强度调控，具体为三角烯二聚体。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过尖端诱导对选定碳原子进行脱氢，可以精确调控开壳层纳米石墨烯二聚体中的有效自旋交换耦合强度J，使其在几meV到几十meV的宽范围内变化。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过尖端诱导对选定碳原子进行脱氢，可以精确调控开壳层纳米石墨烯二聚体中的有效自旋交换耦合强度J，使其在几meV到几十meV的宽范围内变化。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用双电离势运动方程耦合簇单双激发（DIP-EOM-CCSD）方法，精确计算单重态-三重态能隙，该能隙直接对应交换耦合J。

papers.title: Pressure and Size Dependence of Roton Emission and Vortex Creation by Moving Objects in He~II in $T \to 0$ Limit: Generalized Nonlocal Gross-Pitaevskii Model
papers.abstract: In the framework of generalized, nonlocal Gross-Pitaevskii (GP) model, we study numerically the pressure- and size-dependent mechanisms of roton emission and vortex nucleation by objects moving in superfluid $^4$He. As far as the authors are aware, this is the first attempt to analyze the pressure dependence of these mechanisms and the associated critical velocities within a single theoretical framework. For each of several pressures in the range from 0 to the solidification pressure of $\approx25$~bar, we chose the parameters of the interatomic interaction potential such that the resulting excitation spectrum for the generalized, nonlocal GP equation approximates fairly accurately the pressure-dependent dispersion curve determined experimentally by Godfrin \textit{et al.}, Phys. Rev. B \textbf{103}, 104516 (2021). In the two-dimensional approximation, for circular obstacles (disks) moving in quiescent $^4$He, we calculated two critical velocities -- one corresponding to the roton emission and the other to the nucleation of quantized vortices -- as functions of pressure and the obstacle's size. We also comment briefly on three-dimensional simulations of the roton emission and vortex nucleation by moving spherical obstacles.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：numerically study、generalized nonlocal Gross-Pitaevskii model、two-dimensional approximation、three-dimensional simulations。；研究对象：超流⁴He（He II）中运动物体（圆盘形障碍物和球形障碍物）在极低温（T→0）下激发旋子（roton）和产生量子化涡旋的机制，以及这些机制对压力和障碍物尺寸的依赖关系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在广义非局域Gross-Pitaevskii模型框架下，首次在单一理论框架内系统分析了从0 bar到约25 bar凝固压力范围内，旋子发射和涡旋成核的临界速度随压力和障碍物尺寸的变化规律。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在广义非局域Gross-Pitaevskii模型框架下，首次在单一理论框架内系统分析了从0 bar到约25 bar凝固压力范围内，旋子发射和涡旋成核的临界速度随压力和障碍物尺寸的变化规律。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用广义非局域Gross-Pitaevskii（GP）模型进行数值模拟。通过选择原子间相互作用势参数，使模型计算出的激发谱与Godfrin等人（Phys. Rev. B 103, 104516, 2021）实验测得的压力依赖色散曲线精确匹配。在二维近似下计算圆盘障碍物的两个临界速度（旋子发射和涡旋成核），并简要讨论了三维球形障碍物的模拟结果。

papers.title: Universal classification of continuous phase transitions with two order parameters
papers.abstract: The continuous phase transition, indicated by the macroscopic order parameter and the occurrence of the spontaneous symmetry breaking, is well illustrated based on the Ginzburg-Landau's paradigm. In systems described by one order parameter, the phase diagram is only composed of the normal phase and the ordered phase. However, in systems with two or more order parameters, much richer phase diagrams and critical phenomena may emerge. According to coupling terms of the free energy, we classify the systems with two order parameters into several categories, featuring different patterns of phase diagrams and critical scalings respectively. Our work propose the new avenue to studying and evaluating the complex systems only based on the coupling terms in expressions of free energy.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中提及“基于Ginzburg-Landau范式”、“根据自由能耦合项进行分类”、“提出新途径”等关键词，属于理论分析框架构建。；研究对象：具有两个序参量的连续相变系统。具体涉及此类系统中丰富的相图与临界现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 根据自由能中序参量之间的耦合项形式，可将具有两个序参量的系统分为若干类别，每种类别对应不同的相图模式和临界标度行为。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：根据自由能中序参量之间的耦合项形式，可将具有两个序参量的系统分为若干类别，每种类别对应不同的相图模式和临界标度行为。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 基于Ginzburg-Landau理论范式，通过分析自由能表达式中两个序参量之间的耦合项，对系统进行分类研究。

papers.title: Radiation conduction in polaritonic nanowires
papers.abstract: Phonon polaritons have attracted increasing interest as a means to offset the reduction in phonon thermal conductivity in nanostructures caused by enhanced boundary scattering. However, the interpretation of the limited experimental data on phonon polariton-mediated conduction is hindered by the lack of comprehensive full-wave models for predicting thermal electromagnetic transport in solid-state systems. Here, the radiative thermal conductivity in the diffusive regime along SiO2 nanowires near room temperature is predicted using the fluctuational electrodynamics-based discrete system Green's function method. At 400 K, for nanowire diameters of 66 nm and 132 nm, modest radiative conductivities of 0.0264 W/m-K and 0.0165 W/m-K, respectively, are obtained, with contributions dominated by surface phonon polaritons. In contrast, the kinetic theory combined with nanowire dispersion relations derived from Maxwell's equations predicts conductivities that can be nearly two orders of magnitude larger than those obtained from fluctuational electrodynamics, and are largely dominated by bulk phonon polaritons propagating within the nanowire volume. Improved agreement between the kinetic theory and fluctuational electrodynamics for the total radiative conductivity can be achieved by introducing an effective mean free path that accounts for the reduced mean free path of bulk phonon polaritons outside the Reststrahlen spectral bands of SiO2. However, even with this correction, the kinetic theory fails to accurately capture the spectral distribution of radiative conductivity. This work establishes a solid foundation for the development of phonon polariton-based systems for thermal management in micro/nanoelectronic devices.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用“预测”“fluctuational electrodynamics-based discrete system Green's function method”“kinetic theory”等理论计算方法。；研究对象：SiO₂纳米线中由声子极化激元（phonon polaritons）介导的辐射热传导现象，具体关注近室温下扩散输运区间的辐射热导率。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 基于涨落电动力学方法预测的SiO₂纳米线辐射热导率（如66 nm直径下0.0264 W/m-K）远小于动力学理论预测值（可高出近两个数量级），且前者主要由表面声子极化激元贡献，后者则主要来自体声子极化激元。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：基于涨落电动力学方法预测的SiO₂纳米线辐射热导率（如66 nm直径下0.0264 W/m-K）远小于动力学理论预测值（可高出近两个数量级），且前者主要由表面声子极化激元贡献，后者则主要来自体声子极化激元。；创新点：首次利用全波涨落电动力学模型系统预测了室温附近SiO₂纳米线中声子极化激元介导的辐射热导率，揭示了动力学理论在预测该体系辐射热导率时存在显著高估及光谱分布失真的问题，为微纳电子器件热管理中的极化激元系统开发奠定了理论基础。
papers.method_zh: 采用基于涨落电动力学的离散系统格林函数方法（discrete system Green's function method）预测扩散区间的辐射热导率；同时使用结合麦克斯韦方程组导出的纳米线色散关系的动力学理论（kinetic theory）进行对比分析，并引入有效平均自由程修正。

papers.title: Supersymmetry Without Time-Reversal Invariance in Model A: A FRG perspective
papers.abstract: We show that, contrary to common belief, supersymmetry alone is not sufficient in Model A dynamics to ensure relaxation toward a stationary state satisfying time-reversal invariance (TRI). An additional condition on top of supersymmetry is required for TRI, which we analyze in detail. We explicitly construct a model that is supersymmetric but violates TRI, and argue that, at least perturbatively, TRI nevertheless emerges as an effective large-scale symmetry. Using the functional renormalization group (FRG), we further show that the dynamical effective action, $Γ[\varphi,\tilde\varphi]$, contains the derivative of the equilibrium effective action, $Γ^{\mathrm{eq}}[\varphi]$, whose renormalization-group flow is identical to that of the equilibrium theory order by order in the derivative expansion. Finally, extending the same line of reasoning, we show that the probability distribution of the total magnetization in the Ising model can be recovered within the Model A framework.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：functional renormalization group (FRG)、Model A dynamics、supersymmetry、time-reversal invariance。；研究对象：Model A 动力学（一种描述非守恒序参量弛豫的经典统计场论），以及其中超对称性与时间反演不变性的关系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 超对称性本身不足以保证 Model A 动力学系统弛豫到满足时间反演不变性的稳态，还需额外条件；但至少在微扰论下，时间反演不变性仍作为有效的大尺度对称性出现。此外，Ising 模型总磁化强度的概率分布可在 Model A 框架内恢复。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：超对称性本身不足以保证 Model A 动力学系统弛豫到满足时间反演不变性的稳态，还需额外条件；但至少在微扰论下，时间反演不变性仍作为有效的大尺度对称性出现。此外，Ising 模型总磁化强度的概率分布可在 Model A 框架内恢复。；创新点：推翻了“超对称性自动保证时间反演不变性”的普遍认知，明确指出了超对称性之外的必要条件，并构造了违反时间反演不变性的超对称模型。摘要未突出说明该工作是否首次提出这一观点。
papers.method_zh: 采用泛函重整化群（FRG）分析动力学有效作用量 Γ[φ,φ̃] 的结构，并将其与平衡态有效作用量 Γ^eq[φ] 的导数相联系，在导数展开下逐阶证明两者重整化群流相同。

papers.title: Towards terahertz excitons in hydrogenated graphene superlattices
papers.abstract: Carbon nanostructures, such as nanotubes and graphene nanoribbons, exhibit unique electronic and optical properties that make them very promising candidates for terahertz components. However, carbon nanotube and nanoribbon monolithic on-chip integration is challenging because it may results in significant change of their intrinsic properties after an embedment into a substrate. We investigate with first principles theoretical methods the successful routes of such integration and calculate electronic and optical properties of the integrated structures -- two-dimensional graphene superlattices, where quasi-metallic and dielectric regions alternate by selective hydrogenation of graphene. It is shown that chemical engineering of the graphene surface can lead to strong and well-isolated excitonic absorption peaks in the far-infrared and possibly even terahertz frequencies.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据关键词：first principles theoretical methods（第一性原理理论方法）、calculate electronic and optical properties（计算电子和光学性质）。；研究对象：氢化石墨烯超晶格，即通过选择性氢化在石墨烯表面形成准金属区和介电区交替排列的二维超晶格结构。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过化学工程对石墨烯表面进行选择性氢化，可以在远红外乃至太赫兹频率范围内产生强且孤立的激子吸收峰。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过化学工程对石墨烯表面进行选择性氢化，可以在远红外乃至太赫兹频率范围内产生强且孤立的激子吸收峰。；创新点：提出并验证了一种通过选择性氢化石墨烯实现二维超晶格单片集成的新路径，避免了碳纳米管或石墨烯纳米带在衬底集成中固有性质改变的问题，并首次预言该结构可在太赫兹频段产生强激子吸收。
papers.method_zh: 第一性原理理论方法（first principles theoretical methods），具体为基于密度泛函理论（DFT）的电子结构和光学性质计算。

papers.title: Rounding Almost Commuting Hamiltonians
papers.abstract: Commuting Hamiltonians lie at the boundary between classical constraint satisfaction and quantum many-body physics, exhibiting rich quantum structure while remaining more tractable than general noncommuting models. In contrast, physical Hamiltonians are rarely exactly commuting, which naturally motivates the study of almost commuting Hamiltonians. Despite their relevance, the implications of approximate commutation are only poorly understood. In this work, we show how to efficiently approximate any almost commuting $2$-local qubit Hamiltonian by a commuting one: we give a locality-preserving algorithmic rounding technique that maps any $2$-local Hamiltonian $H=\sum_{i=1}^m h_i$ with $\|[h_i,h_j]\| \leq ε$ to a nearby Hamiltonian $\hat{H}$ whose terms pair-wise commute, and which is within overall distance $\|H-\hat{H}\| = O(m\,ε^{1/6})$. As a consequence, we show that $δ$-approximations to the ground energy for $ε$-almost commuting $2$-local qubit Hamiltonians lie in $\mathsf{NP}$ when $δ\gg mε^{1/6}$, extending the classical containment well beyond the commuting setting. Finally, we present two applications of our rounding framework: Gibbs sampling and fast Hamiltonian simulation for almost commuting systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：algorithmic rounding technique、理论分析、复杂度类（NP）讨论。；研究对象：几乎对易的2-局域量子比特哈密顿量（almost commuting 2-local qubit Hamiltonians），以及它们与严格对易哈密顿量之间的关系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一种保持局域性的算法舍入技术，可以将任意几乎对易的2-局域量子比特哈密顿量高效地近似为一个严格对易的哈密顿量，近似误差为 \( O(m\varepsilon^{1/6}) \)。这一结果将基态能量的经典可验证性（NP类）从对易情形扩展到了几乎对易情形。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一种保持局域性的算法舍入技术，可以将任意几乎对易的2-局域量子比特哈密顿量高效地近似为一个严格对易的哈密顿量，近似误差为 \( O(m\varepsilon^{1/6}) \)。这一结果将基态能量的经典可验证性（NP类）从对易情形扩展到了几乎对易情形。；创新点：首次给出了将几乎对易的2-局域量子比特哈密顿量系统性地近似为严格对易哈密顿量的高效算法，并证明了在特定误差范围内，其基态能量近似问题属于NP类，突破了传统上仅对严格对易系统成立的经典可验证性边界。此外，还展示了该框架在吉布斯采样和快速哈密顿量模拟中的应用。
papers.method_zh: 采用算法舍入（algorithmic rounding）技术，将几乎对易的哈密顿量映射到附近的一个严格对易的哈密顿量，并分析映射前后的距离上界。同时结合复杂度理论分析基态能量近似问题的可验证性。

papers.title: Absolute measurement of the intrinsic helicity in nanophotonics
papers.abstract: Helicity is a universal quantity describing the internal rotation of an object or a field. Whether it characterizes fundamental properties such as the spin of elementary particles or leads to practical consequences such as the toxicity or harmlessness of chiral molecules, defining and measuring it is essential. However, this remains ambiguous in the case of chiral photonic systems such as plasmonic nanoparticles or photonic metasurfaces, where contrary to common knowledge, the observation of circularly polarized dependent optical properties is not a relevant measure for the helicity. We demonstrate experimentally and theoretically that the helicity can be rigorously defined and measured in a nanophotonic system emitting circularly polarized light after excitation in the near-field by a focused electron beam. In the case of a model system composed of two plasmonic dipoles (Born-Kuhn systems), we show that the helicity of photonic modes takes on a very intuitive form and can be simply measured by symmetrizing the geometry of excitation and detection. The method could be extended to a variety of chiral photonic systems, whose locally enhanced properties make them promising for the engineering of local chirality.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验与理论）。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“We demonstrate experimentally and theoretically...”。；研究对象：手性光子系统的本征手性（intrinsic helicity），具体模型系统为两个等离激元偶极子组成的Born-Kuhn系统，以及发射圆偏振光的纳米光子结构。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在纳米光子系统中，观测圆偏振依赖的光学性质（如圆二色性）并不能直接作为手性的有效度量。本工作通过实验和理论证明，在近场电子束激发下，可以通过对称化激发与探测的几何构型来严格定义并测量光子模式的本征手性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在纳米光子系统中，观测圆偏振依赖的光学性质（如圆二色性）并不能直接作为手性的有效度量。本工作通过实验和理论证明，在近场电子束激发下，可以通过对称化激发与探测的几何构型来严格定义并测量光子模式的本征手性。；创新点：摘要未突出说明与已有研究的具体差异，但核心创新在于：1）明确指出圆偏振依赖的光学响应不能直接等同于手性度量；2）提出并实验验证了一种通过对称化激发-探测几何来绝对测量本征手性的方法，该方法可推广至多种手性光子体系。
papers.method_zh: 实验上采用聚焦电子束在近场激发纳米光子结构，测量其发射的圆偏振光；理论上基于等离激元偶极子模型（Born-Kuhn系统）进行解析推导，并引入激发与探测几何的对称化操作来提取本征手性。

papers.title: Everything at Every Scale: Scale-Invariant Diffusion with Continuous Super-Resolution
papers.abstract: Creating images from noise is image generation; reconstructing fine details from coarse inputs is super-resolution. Despite their practical differences, both can be understood as reversing information loss across scales. We introduce $\textbf{SKILD}$, a $\textbf{S}$cale-invariant $\textbf{K}$-Space $\textbf{I}$mage $\textbf{L}$earning $\textbf{D}$iffusion model that unifies generation and continuous super-resolution within a single unconditional framework. Both natural images and critical physical systems exhibit scale invariance, and we leverage it to design a forward process that attenuates image content from fine to coarse scales while injecting spectrum-matched Gaussian noise, making scale an explicit coordinate of the diffusion dynamics. The same trained reverse process performs generation and continuous super-resolution by varying only the starting timestep: $\textit{no task-specific architecture, no conditioning branch, no classifier-free guidance, no retraining per scale factor}$. Empirically, SKILD reaches FID $2.65$ and Inception Score $9.63$ on unconditional CIFAR-10, performs $2\times$--$8\times$ super-resolution on ImageNet from a single unconditional checkpoint while outperforming conditional models across perceptual metrics, and reconstructs critical Ising models whose connected four-point correlations closely track the ground truth.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算方法文章。关键词：diffusion model（扩散模型）、scale-invariant（尺度不变性）、unconditional framework（无条件框架）。；研究对象：论文研究的是图像生成与连续超分辨率重建的统一框架，并以自然图像（CIFAR-10、ImageNet）和临界物理系统（Ising模型）作为测试体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出一种尺度不变的K空间图像学习扩散模型（SKILD），通过将尺度作为扩散动力学的显式坐标，实现了在单一无条件框架下统一图像生成与连续超分辨率任务，无需任务特定架构或条件分支。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出一种尺度不变的K空间图像学习扩散模型（SKILD），通过将尺度作为扩散动力学的显式坐标，实现了在单一无条件框架下统一图像生成与连续超分辨率任务，无需任务特定架构或条件分支。；创新点：首次将尺度作为扩散过程的显式坐标，实现了生成与超分辨率的无条件统一，无需条件分支、无分类器引导、无需针对不同尺度因子重新训练。
papers.method_zh: 基于扩散模型的生成框架，设计了一个前向过程：从精细尺度到粗糙尺度逐步衰减图像内容，同时注入与频谱匹配的高斯噪声。反向过程通过仅改变起始时间步长，即可同时执行生成与连续超分辨率任务。模型在K空间（傅里叶空间）中操作，利用自然图像与物理系统的尺度不变性。

papers.title: Uncovering multi-channel magnetic hopfion annihilation via a single-node, billion-spin-scale atomistic framework
papers.abstract: Modern atomistic spin simulations combine long stochastic trajectories, thermodynamic sampling, static optimization and multi-image transition-path workflows, all of which rely on repeated evaluation of spin Hamiltonians and become computationally prohibitive on the large lattices required for three-dimensional magnetic textures. We introduce SpinX, a GPU-native atomistic spin simulation framework built around a unified Hamiltonian interface and multiple user-selectable computational backends. Its core is a crystallographic sublattice decomposition that reformulates translationally invariant spin interactions as multi-channel tensor convolutions, enabling dense, sparse and FFT-based convolution backends, while irregular systems are handled by pair-list evaluation and long-range dipolar fields by reciprocal-space FFT. Implemented in JAX, SpinX supports deterministic and stochastic Landau-Lifshitz-Gilbert dynamics, Monte Carlo sampling, static optimization, dynamical spectroscopy and string and geodesic nudged elastic band transition-path calculations on heterogeneous accelerator platforms. A validated mixed-precision mode combines fp32 field evaluation with fp64 spin-state propagation. We validate SpinX against analytical single-spin dynamics, finite-size thermodynamics of bcc Fe and transverse dynamic structure factors. Performance benchmarks show peak throughput exceeding 10 billion spin-site operations per second on a single accelerator and aggregate single-node workloads of over 1 billion atomic spins. Applying this framework to an exchange-stabilized magnetic hopfion, we uncover two competing annihilation channels on a million-spin atomistic lattice: a previously reported axial-collapse pathway and a distinct lateral-rupture pathway with a different transition morphology and activation barrier.(Due to arXiv's limit, the abstract shown here is a shortened version)
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：关键词“atomistic spin simulations”、“GPU-native atomistic spin simulation framework”、“performance benchmarks”。；研究对象：三维磁性纹理，特别是交换稳定磁霍普夫子（magnetic hopfion）的湮灭过程。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在百万原子尺度的晶格上，发现交换稳定磁霍普夫子存在两种相互竞争的湮灭通道：一种为先前报道的轴向塌缩路径，另一种为具有不同跃迁形态和激活势垒的横向断裂路径。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在百万原子尺度的晶格上，发现交换稳定磁霍普夫子存在两种相互竞争的湮灭通道：一种为先前报道的轴向塌缩路径，另一种为具有不同跃迁形态和激活势垒的横向断裂路径。；创新点：1）提出了一个基于统一哈密顿量接口和多计算后端的、可扩展至十亿自旋尺度的GPU原生模拟框架（SpinX）。2）利用该框架，在原子尺度上首次揭示了磁霍普夫子湮灭的两种竞争通道，特别是发现了一种不同于已知轴向塌缩的横向断裂湮灭路径。
papers.method_zh: 开发了名为SpinX的GPU原生原子自旋模拟框架。该框架基于JAX实现，核心方法包括：1）通过晶学子格分解将平移不变的自旋相互作用重写为多通道张量卷积；2）支持稠密、稀疏和基于FFT的卷积后端；3）对不规则系统采用配对列表评估，对长程偶极场采用倒易空间FFT。框架实现了确定性和随机性Landau-Lifshitz-Gilbert动力学、蒙特卡洛采样、静态优化、动力学谱以及弦和测地线微动弹性带过渡路径计算，并采用了混合精度模式（fp32场评估 + fp64自旋态传播）。

papers.title: Native topological readout on qubit hardware: a Fibonacci-chain benchmark of measurement-compilation trade-offs
papers.abstract: Recent demonstrations of non-Abelian braiding of graph vertices on noisy intermediate-scale quantum (NISQ) superconducting processor, and the experimental realization of topological order in general on various quantum hardware platforms necessitate an important question: when does a native (topological) fusion readout genuinely help for topological anyonic Hamiltonians implemented on NISQ hardware? We use the Fibonacci anyons chain as a concrete model for understanding the trade-off between measurement cost and compilation cost in that setting. The comparison is made against a simple grouped-Pauli baseline, and is scored by a covariance-aware mean-squared-error (MSE) of the full energy estimator. We based our benchmark on two different important classes of quantum circuits, namely Floquet time-evolved and variational quantum eigensolver quantum circuits, with the underlying Hamiltonian consisting of both braiding and fusion interaction. Our analysis found that there is not a uniform best method across both problems: the fusion readout method performed better on Floquet-type circuits on both the MSE and covariance-aware sampling variance, while the grouped Pauli method performed better on VQE on the MSE but worse on sampling variance. We derive scaling laws, and compute shot-budget crossover points, where one method is operationally favored above the other. The relevance of this work extends beyond Fibonacci chains to two-dimensional topological models compiled on superconducting and other qubit-native platforms, and can be used as a guide in answering the question of when one should measure in the native operator basis of the target physics, or when it is better to fall back on Pauli-basis reconstruction.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。关键词：benchmark、analysis、scaling laws、shot-budget crossover points。；研究对象：Fibonacci任意子链模型，以及在该模型上实现的拓扑（融合）读出方法与分组Pauli基线方法的比较。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 不存在适用于所有问题的统一最优方法：对于Floquet时间演化电路，融合读出方法在均方误差和协方差感知采样方差上表现更好；对于变分量子本征求解器电路，分组Pauli方法在均方误差上表现更好，但在采样方差上更差。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：不存在适用于所有问题的统一最优方法：对于Floquet时间演化电路，融合读出方法在均方误差和协方差感知采样方差上表现更好；对于变分量子本征求解器电路，分组Pauli方法在均方误差上表现更好，但在采样方差上更差。；创新点：系统量化了在含噪中等规模量子处理器上实现拓扑任意子哈密顿量时，原生拓扑读出与Pauli基重构之间的测量成本与编译成本权衡，并给出了具体的交叉点标度律。摘要未突出说明与已有工作的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 以Fibonacci任意子链为具体模型，对比“原生拓扑融合读出”与“简单分组Pauli基线”两种测量方案。使用协方差感知的均方误差作为评分指标，基于两类量子电路（Floquet时间演化电路和变分量子本征求解器电路）进行基准测试，底层哈密顿量包含编织和融合相互作用。推导了标度律并计算了操作上偏好某一方法的预算交叉点。

papers.title: UNATE: UNsupervised ATomic Embedding for crystal structures property prediction
papers.abstract: Accurately predicting crystal properties is critical for accelerating materials discovery, but it is often limited by scarce labeled data and costly theoretical calculations. To alleviate this, we propose UNATE (Unsupervised Atomic Embedding), a framework that leverages structural information extracted from unlabeled crystal structures. UNATE integrates an unsupervised denoising autoencoder with self-supervised contrastive learning to learn robust atomic representations, which are then used as input features for downstream property prediction. Experimental results show that replacing raw atomic numbers with UNATE-pretrained node embeddings yields a 2.7\% improvement over the full-data baseline. Notably, the benefits become more pronounced in scenarios with limited labeled data, reaching improvements of up to 10\% when only 25\% of the labeled data is used.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章（关键词：unsupervised denoising autoencoder, self-supervised contrastive learning, pretrained node embeddings）；研究对象：晶体结构（crystal structures）及其性质预测（property prediction）
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过无监督学习预训练的原子嵌入（UNATE）替代原始原子序数作为输入特征，可在全数据条件下提升性质预测准确率2.7%，在仅使用25%标注数据的低数据场景下提升高达10%。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过无监督学习预训练的原子嵌入（UNATE）替代原始原子序数作为输入特征，可在全数据条件下提升性质预测准确率2.7%，在仅使用25%标注数据的低数据场景下提升高达10%。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 无监督去噪自编码器（unsupervised denoising autoencoder）结合自监督对比学习（self-supervised contrastive learning），从无标注晶体结构中提取结构信息，学习鲁棒的原子表示（atomic representations），再作为下游性质预测模型的输入特征。

papers.title: Sideband fingerprints of antibunched light in cascaded quantum wave mixing
papers.abstract: Quantum wave mixing on a single superconducting qubit produces a hierarchy of coherent side peaks associated with elastic multiphoton scattering pathways. In a cascaded source--probe geometry these pathways become sensitive to the photon statistics of the radiation emitted by the source qubit. We develop an analytical theory of this effect starting from the cascaded master equation in the weak-driving regime. In the coherent-filtering limit $γ_{\rm s}\ggγ_{\rm pr}$, the standard coherent--coherent wave-mixing hierarchy is recovered. In the opposite limit $γ_{\rm pr}\ggγ_{\rm s}$, side peaks associated with multiphoton absorption from the antibunched source field are parametrically suppressed. Numerical solutions confirm the analytical scaling laws. The resulting sideband hierarchy provides a frequency-domain fingerprint of antibunched itinerant microwave light.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：analytical theory、cascaded master equation、weak-driving regime、numerical solutions）；研究对象：基于单个超导量子比特的级联量子波混频体系中，由弹性多光子散射路径产生的相干边峰结构，以及这些边峰对源量子比特辐射光子统计的敏感性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在级联源-探针结构中，当探针弛豫率远大于源弛豫率时，与反聚束源场多光子吸收相关的边峰被参数化抑制；该边峰层级结构可作为反聚束行波微波光的频域指纹。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在级联源-探针结构中，当探针弛豫率远大于源弛豫率时，与反聚束源场多光子吸收相关的边峰被参数化抑制；该边峰层级结构可作为反聚束行波微波光的频域指纹。；创新点：揭示了级联量子波混频中边峰强度对源场光子统计（反聚束特性）的依赖关系，并建立了从频域边峰指纹识别反聚束微波光的理论框架。
papers.method_zh: 从级联主方程出发，在弱驱动条件下建立解析理论；通过数值求解验证解析标度律；对比两种极限情况（γ_s≫γ_pr 和 γ_pr≫γ_s）下的边峰行为。

papers.title: Machine Learning Multiscale Interactions
papers.abstract: Realistic physical systems are characterised by emergent interactions across multiple length and time scales, posing a significant challenge for predictive machine learning (ML) models. Most scientific ML models focus on a narrow range of interactions. While machine learning force fields (MLFFs) offer near-quantum accuracy, the ubiquitous message-passing layers miss long-range many-body effects. Here we introduce the Multiscale Structural Ensemble (MuSE), a hierarchical model that uses Soft Coarse-Graining Pooling to construct coarse representations from smooth fractional assignments of atoms to coarse nodes, enabling MLFF modules to operate across multiple scales. MuSE is architecture-agnostic and coupled with SO3krates, MACE, and PaiNN MLFFs for both molecules and materials. We demonstrate the power of MuSE through Hessian-based benchmarks, folding trajectories for biomolecules, and energy profiles in molecule-graphene nanostructures, where MuSE accurately captures quantum-mechanical interactions at relevant scales -- unlike other recent long-range ML models.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。关键词：machine learning force fields (MLFFs)、hierarchical model、Soft Coarse-Graining Pooling。；研究对象：多尺度物理系统中的相互作用，具体包括分子、生物分子（如折叠轨迹）以及分子-石墨烯纳米结构。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一种名为MuSE（Multiscale Structural Ensemble）的分层模型，能够通过软粗粒化池化方法构建多尺度表示，使机器学习力场（MLFF）模块在多个尺度上准确捕捉量子力学相互作用，优于其他近期长程机器学习模型。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一种名为MuSE（Multiscale Structural Ensemble）的分层模型，能够通过软粗粒化池化方法构建多尺度表示，使机器学习力场（MLFF）模块在多个尺度上准确捕捉量子力学相互作用，优于其他近期长程机器学习模型。；创新点：MuSE模型是架构无关的，能够将MLFF模块扩展到多尺度相互作用，弥补了传统消息传递层无法捕捉长程多体效应的缺陷。摘要未突出说明与具体实验或理论框架的对比细节。
papers.method_zh: 采用Soft Coarse-Graining Pooling（软粗粒化池化）方法，将原子平滑地分配到粗粒化节点上，构建分层结构；并与SO3krates、MACE、PaiNN三种MLFF架构耦合，用于分子和材料体系。通过Hessian矩阵基准测试、生物分子折叠轨迹以及分子-石墨烯纳米结构的能量分布进行验证。

papers.title: Pulse magnet of 10 T for power laser experiments with x-ray free-electron laser diagnostics
papers.abstract: The importance of investigating magnetized plasmas/solids in extreme conditions has grown over the last decades, particularly in the field of high energy density physics (HEDP), such as laboratory astrophysics and inertial confinement fusion. However, up to now, the unique capabilities of an X-ray free-electron laser (XFEL), such as high brilliance and low divergence have never been exploited for this type of research. In this paper, we present the first platform developed at SACLA, Japan, that combines a high-power optical laser for generating matter under extreme conditions of pressure and temperature, an XFEL probe, and an external magnetic field. The high current is produced using a 2 kV, 4.8 kJ pulsed power system giving a maximum current of 10 kA which is synchronized with the optical laser and XFEL in a vacuum environment. It flows through a split-pair coil to generate a high magnetic field (10 T at 6 kA) which has 1 cm access every 45$^{\circ}$ in the equatorial plane and 90$^{\circ}$ in the poloidal one. This platform offers new opportunities to study high-energy-density matter in strong magnetic fields, including shock propagation, instability growth, and turbulent plasma dynamics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键词：platform developed（平台开发）、pulsed power system（脉冲电源系统）、experiment（实验）。；研究对象：在极端条件下（高温高压）的磁化等离子体/固体，具体涉及高能量密度物理（HEDP）领域，如实验室天体物理和惯性约束聚变中的冲击波传播、不稳定性增长和湍流等离子体动力学。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 成功开发了首个将高功率激光、X射线自由电子激光（XFEL）探针和外部强磁场（10 T）相结合的实验平台，为研究强磁场下的高能量密度物质提供了新机会。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：成功开发了首个将高功率激光、X射线自由电子激光（XFEL）探针和外部强磁场（10 T）相结合的实验平台，为研究强磁场下的高能量密度物质提供了新机会。；创新点：首次将XFEL的高亮度和低发散度等独特能力应用于磁化等离子体/固体研究，并成功在SACLA（日本）搭建了集高功率激光、XFEL探针和强磁场于一体的综合实验平台。
papers.method_zh: 实验方法。具体包括：使用2 kV、4.8 kJ脉冲电源系统产生最大10 kA的电流；采用分裂对线圈（split-pair coil）在真空中产生高达10 T的磁场；该磁场在赤道面每45°、极向每90°提供1 cm的访问窗口；系统与高功率光学激光器和XFEL探针实现同步。

papers.title: Balancing structure and randomness: maximum entropy networks for context-dependent computations
papers.abstract: Understanding how network function constrains neural connectivity is a central challenge in neuroscience. An influential approach is to train neural networks with gradient descent on cognitive tasks and characterize the resulting connectivity. A key limitation is that the resulting structure depends on the details of the training procedure. Here we propose a complementary normative approach based on the maximum entropy principle for network connectivity, independent of any particular learning algorithm. We describe connectivity as a probability distribution over single-neuron weights, express task requirements as constraints on this distribution, and determine the unique distribution maximizing Shannon entropy subject to these constraints.
