A weight scale parameter controls the balance between randomness and task-induced structure. We apply this framework to context-dependent input-selection tasks in 2-layer feed-forward networks, and show that maximum entropy inference becomes analytically tractable by mapping nonlinear networks onto gain-modulated linear models. Starting from an a priori homogeneous distribution, we find that maximizing entropy under task constraints leads to the emergence of populations of neurons, each defined by its pattern of contextual gain modulation. Increasing the number of contexts drives a transition from context-specialized to unspecialized, random populations. Increasing the weight scale drives a parallel transition from structured to random stimulus selectivity. Strikingly, this maximum entropy connectivity matches both qualitatively and quantitatively the structure of networks trained with gradient descent across different learning regimes. Our results suggest that the interplay between task constraints and entropy maximization provides a fundamental principle for understanding the relationship between structure and function in neural networks.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：maximum entropy principle、normative approach、analytically tractable）；研究对象：神经网络连接性与上下文依赖计算任务之间的关系，具体为2层前馈网络中的上下文依赖输入选择任务。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在任务约束下最大化香农熵，会导致神经元群体涌现出上下文增益调制的特定模式；该最大熵连接性与梯度下降训练得到的网络结构在定性和定量上均一致，表明任务约束与熵最大化之间的相互作用是理解神经网络结构与功能关系的基本原理。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在任务约束下最大化香农熵，会导致神经元群体涌现出上下文增益调制的特定模式；该最大熵连接性与梯度下降训练得到的网络结构在定性和定量上均一致，表明任务约束与熵最大化之间的相互作用是理解神经网络结构与功能关系的基本原理。；创新点：提出了一种独立于特定学习算法的互补性规范方法，避免了梯度下降训练结果对训练细节的依赖，并揭示了从结构化到随机群体转变的相变行为。
papers.method_zh: 基于最大熵原理的规范理论框架，将连接性描述为单神经元权重的概率分布，通过约束条件最大化熵，并将非线性网络映射为增益调制的线性模型以实现解析求解。

papers.title: Superfluid fraction and effective ion mass in the crystalline crust of a neutron star: role of interband response
papers.abstract: Neutron superfluidity in the inner crust of a neutron star is further investigated, focusing on the role of the interband response in the superfluid fraction and the effective mass of crustal ions induced by their motion through the superfluid. Calculations are performed within the linear response theory of the self-consistent time-dependent Hartree-Fock-Bogoliubov equations with Skyrme nuclear energy density functionals in the Bardeen-Cooper-Schrieffer approximation. The absence of interband response in previous analyses is clarified. The neutron superfluid density is formally shown to be consistent with the entrainment matrix derived earlier in homogeneous neutron-proton superfluid mixture, thus providing a unified description of entrainment effects in the inner crust and outer core of a neutron star within the same microscopic framework. The relative importance of the intraband and interband responses in different regions of the crust is numerically assessed from three-dimensional band-structure calculations, taking into account quantum zero-point motion of ions about their equilibrium position. The neutron superfluid fraction is found to be enhanced by the interband response, resulting in effective ion masses that remain close to the mass of quantum mechanically bound nucleons for realistic neutron pairing gaps. Results are compared to predictions from classical hydrodynamics with different prescriptions for the permeability of ions to superfluidity.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：线性响应理论、自洽含时Hartree-Fock-Bogoliubov方程、Skyrme核能量密度泛函、BCS近似等理论框架关键词。；研究对象：中子星内壳层晶体地壳中的中子超流性，特别是超流分数和由超流运动诱导的晶格离子有效质量。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 发现带间响应会增强中子超流分数，使得在真实中子配对能隙下，离子的有效质量仍接近量子力学束缚核子的质量。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：发现带间响应会增强中子超流分数，使得在真实中子配对能隙下，离子的有效质量仍接近量子力学束缚核子的质量。；创新点：澄清了以往分析中缺失的带间响应作用，并形式化证明了中子超流密度与先前在均匀中子-质子超流混合物中导出的曳引矩阵一致，从而在同一微观框架下统一描述了中子星内壳层和外壳层中的曳引效应。
papers.method_zh: 基于自洽含时Hartree-Fock-Bogoliubov方程的线性响应理论，采用Skyrme核能量密度泛函和BCS近似，结合三维能带结构计算，并考虑了离子围绕平衡位置的量子零点运动。

papers.title: Hydrodynamics constrain choanoflagellate collar geometry
papers.abstract: As the closest living relatives of animals, choanoflagellates exhibit remarkable diversity. Even their microvilli collar, used to filter and capture food, varies significantly among species. This diversity suggests either strong environmental adaptation or an insensitivity to the collar geometry. Previous hydrodynamic studies have suggested that the pressure change across the collar is similar across species. In this study, we show that hydrodynamics imposes additional geometric constraints on the choanoflagellate collar. We create a simplified, reduced-order model that neglects finite collar length to investigate how the microvillus radius and the gap between microvilli influence the flow. Comparing with biological data reveals significant variation in the pressure drop between species. Additionally, a ridge emerges in the microvilli radius-gap phase space, along which both effective flux and power dissipation are maximised. Notably, several species cluster near the flux ridge but lie away from the power dissipation ridge. These observations suggest that choanoflagellate collars do not necessarily share a similar pressure drop. Instead, their geometry is influenced by the competing demands of maximising flux and minimising power costs. The broad variation observed among species is made possible by these ridge-like structures.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。关键词：hydrodynamic studies、reduced-order model、phase space分析。；研究对象：领鞭毛虫（choanoflagellate）的微绒毛领（microvilli collar）几何结构，具体研究微绒毛半径与微绒毛间隙对流体过滤和捕食效率的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 领鞭毛虫的微绒毛领几何结构并非在所有物种中具有相似的压力降，而是受到最大化有效通量与最小化能量消耗这两种竞争需求的共同约束；在微绒毛半径-间隙相空间中存在一条“通量脊”，多个物种聚集在该脊附近，但远离“耗散脊”。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：领鞭毛虫的微绒毛领几何结构并非在所有物种中具有相似的压力降，而是受到最大化有效通量与最小化能量消耗这两种竞争需求的共同约束；在微绒毛半径-间隙相空间中存在一条“通量脊”，多个物种聚集在该脊附近，但远离“耗散脊”。；创新点：摘要未突出说明，但相对于此前认为不同物种间领压力降相似的观点，本研究揭示了物种间压力降存在显著差异，并发现相空间中的脊状结构（通量脊与耗散脊）是解释物种间几何多样性的关键机制。
papers.method_zh: 建立简化降阶模型（reduced-order model），忽略有限领长度效应，通过流体动力学分析微绒毛半径和间隙对流动的影响，并与生物学数据进行比较。

papers.title: A DMFT approach to evaluate electronic frictional effects near solid surfaces of strongly correlated systems
papers.abstract: Electronic friction-Langevin dynamics (EF-LD) provides an efficient framework for capturing nonadiabatic effects at solid surfaces, with particular relevance to electrochemistry and molecular electronics. In this work, we investigate electronic friction in the two-dimensional Hubbard-Holstein model employing dynamical mean-field theory (DMFT), where the full density-matrix numerical renormalization group (FDM-NRG) serves as the impurity solver. Our results are benchmarked against mean-field theory (MFT). DMFT yields two distinct peaks in the electronic friction, arising from electron attachment/detachment resonances with the solid Fermi level, whereas MFT is unable to capture this Fermi resonance. We further examine the dynamics of electronic friction via EF-LD simulations. Our simulations uncover significant discrepancies mainly in the electronic population evolution predicted by MFT versus DMFT, indicating that MFT is inadequate for describing nonadiabatic dynamics in strongly correlated systems. Thanks to its flexibility and computational efficiency, the proposed DMFT-based approach can be readily extended to a broad range of applications.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。关键词：DMFT、FDM-NRG、EF-LD模拟、MFT基准对比。；研究对象：强关联体系（二维Hubbard-Holstein模型）在固体表面附近的电子摩擦效应，以及非绝热动力学过程。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: DMFT计算显示电子摩擦谱中存在两个由电子附着/脱离与固体费米能级共振引起的独立峰，而平均场理论（MFT）无法捕捉这一费米共振；EF-LD模拟表明MFT在描述强关联体系的非绝热动力学（尤其是电子布居演化）时存在显著偏差。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：DMFT计算显示电子摩擦谱中存在两个由电子附着/脱离与固体费米能级共振引起的独立峰，而平均场理论（MFT）无法捕捉这一费米共振；EF-LD模拟表明MFT在描述强关联体系的非绝热动力学（尤其是电子布居演化）时存在显著偏差。；创新点：首次将DMFT框架应用于强关联体系固体表面电子摩擦的计算，揭示了MFT无法描述的费米共振双峰结构，并证明了DMFT在非绝热动力学模拟中的必要性与计算效率优势。
papers.method_zh: 采用动力学平均场理论（DMFT）结合全密度矩阵数值重整化群（FDM-NRG）作为杂质求解器，计算二维Hubbard-Holstein模型中的电子摩擦；并通过电子摩擦-朗之万动力学（EF-LD）模拟进行动力学分析，以平均场理论（MFT）作为基准对比。

papers.title: Accelerated Simulation Algorithms for Extreme First-Passage Problems with General Emission Profiles
papers.abstract: Fastest arrival events, where the first among many diffusing particles reaches a target, are central in triggering signal initiation in molecular stochastic systems. Classical approaches to simulate such events rely on full trajectory generation of all particles, leading to prohibitive computational costs in the large particle number regime. In this work, we present a general simulation framework for efficiently generating order statistics of arrival times by exploiting asymptotic first-passage distributions. This framework applies to diffusion processes in bounded domains with localized absorbing targets, for which short-time first-passage asymptotics are available, such as Brownian motion in dimensions one, two, and three. Starting with the case of instantaneous emission, we derive and implement a recursive inverse transform algorithm to simulate the first $k$ arrivals without tracking particle trajectories. We extend this algorithm to time-dependent emission profiles via an iterative approach, enabling the simulation of extreme statistics in systems with temporal injection, ranging from rapid to prolonged emission. Additionally, we provide asymptotic estimates of the mean fastest arrival time. To conclude, the present acceleration algorithm which bypasses Brownian simulations of trajectories can be used for spatial reaction networks, rare event detection, or diffusion-controlled activation.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。关键词：simulation algorithms, asymptotic distributions, recursive inverse transform algorithm。；研究对象：极端首次通过问题（Extreme First-Passage Problems），具体指大量扩散粒子中首个（或前k个）粒子到达目标位置的统计事件。物理背景是分子随机系统中的信号触发。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一种无需追踪所有粒子轨迹即可高效模拟大量扩散粒子首次到达时间顺序统计量的通用算法框架，并给出了平均最快到达时间的渐近估计。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一种无需追踪所有粒子轨迹即可高效模拟大量扩散粒子首次到达时间顺序统计量的通用算法框架，并给出了平均最快到达时间的渐近估计。；创新点：通过利用渐近首次通过分布，绕过了传统方法中生成所有粒子完整轨迹的步骤，从而在粒子数很大的情况下实现了计算加速。摘要未突出说明与具体已有算法的性能对比细节。
papers.method_zh: 利用有界域内局部吸收目标上短时首次通过渐近分布，开发了递归逆变换算法（用于瞬时发射情况）和迭代扩展算法（用于时间依赖发射情况）。该方法适用于一、二、三维布朗运动。

papers.title: Exact Variance and Fano Factor for Arbitrary Level Crossings in Stationary Gaussian Processes
papers.abstract: Understanding the statistics of level crossings in stochastic processes is crucial across many scientific disciplines. The traditional Kac-Rice formula gives the mean rate of level crossings and has found broad use. However, that mean rate captures only a coarse summary of the crossing process. It depends entirely on local properties of the stochastic process at a given instant and is therefore blind to the correlation structure of the process over time. To understand whether crossing events, such as neuronal spikes, tend to cluster in time, spread apart, or exhibit more complex temporal organization, one must go beyond the mean rate and study higher-order crossing statistics. Here we go beyond the mean by deriving the exact analytical formulae for the variance and Fano factor of arbitrary level crossings in smooth stationary Gaussian processes. Our exact solution reveals how the full temporal correlation structure dictates whether crossings cluster or become regular. In systems with oscillatory correlations, such as a stochastic damped harmonic oscillator, a recent crossing suppresses an immediate subsequent one, producing sub-Poissonian statistics. However, as damping increases and oscillations disappear, a large and slow excursion above the threshold can produce multiple closely spaced crossings, yielding super-Poissonian statistics. In purely relaxational, non-oscillatory systems, such as a mean-reverting process driven by Ornstein-Uhlenbeck noise, the competition between the timescales of the driving noise and system relaxation produces a richer landscape, including reentrant transitions between sub- and super-Poissonian statistics as the threshold level is varied. Taken together, the exact variance and Fano factor derived here complement the Kac-Rice mean rate, enabling more robust parameter estimation and model selection across any setting where Gaussian processes are used.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“推导出精确解析公式”“exact analytical formulae”，属于纯理论推导。；研究对象：平稳高斯过程中任意水平穿越（level crossings）的统计特性，特别是穿越事件的方差和Fano因子。物理背景包括随机阻尼谐振子、均值回复过程等随机过程。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 推导出了平稳高斯过程中任意水平穿越的方差和Fano因子的精确解析公式，揭示了时间相关结构如何决定穿越事件是聚集（超泊松统计）还是规则化（亚泊松统计），并发现非振荡系统中驱动噪声与系统弛豫时间尺度的竞争可导致阈值依赖的重入式亚/超泊松统计转变。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：推导出了平稳高斯过程中任意水平穿越的方差和Fano因子的精确解析公式，揭示了时间相关结构如何决定穿越事件是聚集（超泊松统计）还是规则化（亚泊松统计），并发现非振荡系统中驱动噪声与系统弛豫时间尺度的竞争可导致阈值依赖的重入式亚/超泊松统计转变。；创新点：传统Kac-Rice公式仅给出穿越的平均率，完全依赖于瞬时局部性质，无法反映时间相关结构。本文首次给出了任意水平穿越的方差和Fano因子的精确解析解，从而能够刻画穿越事件的时间聚类或规则化行为，补充了平均率无法提供的更高阶统计信息。
papers.method_zh: 基于随机过程理论，对光滑平稳高斯过程进行精确解析推导，得到方差和Fano因子的闭式表达式。具体框架涉及Kac-Rice公式的推广，以及时间相关函数的全信息利用。

papers.title: Extracting Universal Entanglement Scaling from Mixed Fermionic Gaussian States via Entanglement Projected Entropy
papers.abstract: Identifying spatial quantum correlations in mixed states is challenging because thermal mixed-state contributions obscure the entanglement encoded in subsystem entropy. Here, we introduce the entanglement projected entropy, a diagnostic for extracting boundary-sensitive quantum correlations from mixed fermionic Gaussian states. By resolving subsystem entropy into Gaussian entanglement channels and projecting their purification partners onto the physical complement, we obtain a closed-form expression in terms of the physical covariance matrix. In a one-dimensional free-fermion chain, it removes the volume-law mixed-state background and recovers the zero-temperature conformal scaling with the $c/3$ coefficient. In a two-dimensional half-filled $π$-flux model, it reveals a universal finite-temperature scaling collapse governed by an effective Dirac infrared length. These results establish entanglement projected entropy as a Gaussian spatial filter for boundary-sensitive quantum correlations hidden in mixed-state entropy.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中提出新的理论诊断方法（entanglement projected entropy），并基于协方差矩阵推导闭式表达式，未涉及实验或数值计算细节。；研究对象：混合费米子高斯态中的空间量子关联，具体在一维自由费米子链和二维半填充π-通量模型中进行验证。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 纠缠投影熵能够从混合态熵中提取出边界敏感的量子关联，在一维体系中恢复零温共形场论的c/3标度，在二维π-通量模型中揭示由有效狄拉克红外长度控制的普适有限温度标度塌缩。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：纠缠投影熵能够从混合态熵中提取出边界敏感的量子关联，在一维体系中恢复零温共形场论的c/3标度，在二维π-通量模型中揭示由有效狄拉克红外长度控制的普适有限温度标度塌缩。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 理论推导：通过将子系统熵分解为高斯纠缠通道，并将纯化伙伴投影到物理补集，得到基于物理协方差矩阵的闭式表达式。在一维和二维自由费米子模型中验证其标度行为。

papers.title: Dissipative preparation of injective tensor network states
papers.abstract: The preparation of tensor network states is a fundamental prerequisite for a wide range of quantum simulation tasks. While many unitary protocols for preparing these states have been investigated, dissipative state preparation provides a powerful alternative since it can be robust to noise and initialization errors. In this paper, we construct both continuous-time and discrete-time geometrically local dissipative processes whose unique steady state is a given injective tensor network state. Our method prepares all injective matrix product states on $N$ sites to an error $\varepsilon$ in $O(\log (N/\varepsilon))$ time, yielding an exponential improvement over previously known dissipative preparation schemes. For two and higher-dimensional tensor network states, we prove that when the tensors of the state are \emph{highly injective}, the constructed dissipative processes are rapid-mixing i.e., they prepare a state $\varepsilon$-close to the $N$-site target state in $O( \log (N/\varepsilon))$ time. For these states, our approach provides a polynomial speedup over known unitary methods for states defined on lattices and an exponential speedup for states on general bounded-degree graphs. We corroborate our theoretical results with numerical studies that indicate that the dissipative protocol can rapidly prepares states outside the high-injectivity assumption.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：construct、prove、numerical studies。；研究对象：张量网络态（tensor network states）的耗散制备，具体包括单射矩阵乘积态（injective matrix product states）和高维单射张量网络态。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 构造了连续时间和离散时间的几何局域耗散过程，其唯一稳态为给定的单射张量网络态；对于N个格点的单射矩阵乘积态，可在O(log(N/ε))时间内制备到误差ε，相比已知耗散方案实现指数加速；对于高维高度单射张量网络态，同样达到O(log(N/ε))的快速混合时间。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：构造了连续时间和离散时间的几何局域耗散过程，其唯一稳态为给定的单射张量网络态；对于N个格点的单射矩阵乘积态，可在O(log(N/ε))时间内制备到误差ε，相比已知耗散方案实现指数加速；对于高维高度单射张量网络态，同样达到O(log(N/ε))的快速混合时间。；创新点：首次提出针对任意单射张量网络态的耗散制备协议，并证明其混合时间对数标度，在低维实现指数加速，在高维对一般有界度图实现多项式加速（对晶格态）和指数加速（对一般图）。
papers.method_zh: 理论构造：设计几何局域的耗散过程（连续时间Lindblad主方程和离散时间量子信道），利用单射张量网络态的代数性质证明稳态唯一性，并分析混合时间（rapid-mixing）的标度；数值模拟验证了在超出高度单射假设条件下协议仍能快速制备。

papers.title: Separable Force Matching of PBE0 Hybrid-Functional Reference Forces for Path-Integral Simulations of Liquid Water
papers.abstract: Force-matched water models provide a practical route from first-principles reference data to long classical and path-integral molecular simulations. Previous flexible four-site potentials in the spirit of q-TIP4P/F showed that fitting analytic models to density-functional-theory forces can reproduce key structural features of liquid water while retaining the efficiency required for quantum-nuclear sampling. Here we introduce two refinements aimed at making this strategy more accurate and more reproducible for molecular simulation. First, the production fit is based on PBE0 hybrid-functional reference forces and therefore includes the Hartree--Fock exact-exchange contribution in the electronic-structure target. Second, the parametrization is formulated as a separable nonlinear least-squares problem in which all linear force-field amplitudes are eliminated analytically for every trial set of nonlinear shape parameters. The resulting force-matching protocol lowers the dimension of the nonlinear search, reduces compensation between heterogeneous parameters, and enables a controlled comparison of Lennard-Jones and Buckingham oxygen--oxygen repulsion terms. Applied to CP2K reference forces for liquid water, the projected optimization reproduces target force distributions and yields radial distribution functions close to first-principles and neutron-scattering benchmarks. The Buckingham representation gives a more flexible short-range repulsive wall than a purely Lennard-Jones form, and the final flexible model remains stable in path-integral simulations. The method provides a transparent workflow for deriving simulation-ready water potentials from accurate hybrid density-functional reference forces.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“force-matched water models”、“first-principles reference data”、“density-functional-theory forces”、“path-integral simulations”等关键词，属于基于第一性原理参考数据的力场拟合与分子模拟计算。；研究对象：液态水（liquid water），具体为基于PBE0杂化泛函参考力的可分离力匹配水模型，用于经典和路径积分分子模拟。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过将力匹配参数化问题表述为可分离非线性最小二乘问题，并采用PBE0杂化泛函参考力，能够更准确、更可重复地构建适用于路径积分模拟的柔性水势，所得径向分布函数接近第一性原理和中子散射基准。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过将力匹配参数化问题表述为可分离非线性最小二乘问题，并采用PBE0杂化泛函参考力，能够更准确、更可重复地构建适用于路径积分模拟的柔性水势，所得径向分布函数接近第一性原理和中子散射基准。；创新点：1）首次将PBE0杂化泛函参考力用于力匹配水模型构建，引入Hartree-Fock精确交换贡献；2）将参数化问题转化为可分离非线性最小二乘问题，线性力场振幅可解析消去，降低了非线性搜索维度，减少了异质参数间的补偿效应，并实现了对Lennard-Jones与Buckingham排斥项的可控比较。
papers.method_zh: 采用可分离非线性最小二乘法（separable nonlinear least-squares），对PBE0杂化泛函（包含Hartree-Fock精确交换贡献）参考力进行力匹配（force matching），构建柔性四站点水模型（类似q-TIP4P/F），并比较Lennard-Jones与Buckingham氧-氧排斥项的表现。模拟基于CP2K软件包。

papers.title: Thermal Spin Polarization Driven by Nuclear Spin-Orbit Coupling in Neutron Star Pasta
papers.abstract: We discuss anomalous spin polarization on the surface of nuclear pasta in a neutron star, driven by a nuclear spin-orbit interaction. We present an effective two-band model of surface-localized neutrons near the nuclear pasta. The central point is the emergence of a Rashba-type spin-orbit hybridization generated by the neutron--nucleus spin-orbit force in the presence of the strong density gradient normal to the pasta surface. Starting from a single-particle Hamiltonian with a central potential and a standard nuclear spin-orbit interaction, we show that the surface spin polarization occurs due to the thermal inhomogeneity even in the absence of a magnetic field. Our study links neutron-star physics and solid-state spintronics and would contribute to understanding the interplay between spin dynamics and strong magnetic fields.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：discuss、present an effective two-band model、show、starting from a single-particle Hamiltonian。；研究对象：中子星核意面（nuclear pasta）表面的反常自旋极化现象，具体由核自旋-轨道耦合驱动。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在中子星核意面表面，即使不存在外磁场，仅凭热不均匀性（thermal inhomogeneity）即可通过中子-原子核自旋-轨道力产生类似Rashba型的自旋-轨道杂化，从而驱动表面自旋极化。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在中子星核意面表面，即使不存在外磁场，仅凭热不均匀性（thermal inhomogeneity）即可通过中子-原子核自旋-轨道力产生类似Rashba型的自旋-轨道杂化，从而驱动表面自旋极化。；创新点：将中子星物理与固态自旋电子学联系起来，揭示了核自旋-轨道耦合在无磁场条件下通过热梯度驱动自旋极化的新机制。摘要未突出说明与已有中子星自旋极化研究的定量对比。
papers.method_zh: 构建了一个有效两带模型来描述核意面表面局域中子，从包含中心势和标准核自旋-轨道相互作用的单粒子哈密顿量出发进行理论推导。

papers.title: Reinforcement Learning for Laser Additive Manufacturing Scan-Order Optimisation: A Bilevel Proxy--FEA Diagnostic Framework for Reward and World-Model Diagnosis
papers.abstract: Reinforcement learning offers a promising approach for scan-order optimisation in laser additive manufacturing, where sequential scan decisions critically influence thermal accumulation, residual stress, distortion, and final part quality. A central challenge in applying RL to this domain lies in reward and world-model fidelity: full finite-element analysis is computationally prohibitive for dense in-the-loop evaluation, while cheap thermo-inspired proxy metrics, though efficient, may capture only partial aspects of the true thermo-mechanical objectives. This paper investigates a bilevel Proxy--FEA diagnostic framework for reward and world-model diagnosis in reinforcement-learning-guided scan-order optimisation. The lower level employs lightweight scan-path and thermo-inspired proxies for rapid candidate generation and preliminary policy-side screening, while the upper level utilises sparse Abaqus FEA simulations to provide simulation-based reference labels. The framework is examined on a simplified whole-track heating LDED32 stripe benchmark comprising ten representative scan strategies. Final-cooling residual Mises stress, U3 vertical distortion, and PEEQ plasticity metrics reveal an observed stress--distortion trade-off rather than a single monotonic quality objective. Within the evaluated set, the center_out strategy emerges as a robust compromise candidate, while raster_left_to_right and edge_in form opposing endpoints of the trade-off. Proxy--FEA alignment analysis shows that current cheap path-based metrics predominantly capture distortion-related (U3) behaviour and exhibit only weak correlation with the sparse FEA reference labels. These findings highlight that proxy-only reward designs risk misalignment in future RL training and underscore the value of sparse FEA reference signals for diagnostic-guided reward and world-model refinement prior to large-scale policy optimisation.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据关键词：reinforcement learning（强化学习）、finite-element analysis（有限元分析）、simulation（模拟）、diagnostic framework（诊断框架）。；研究对象：激光增材制造（laser additive manufacturing）中的扫描顺序优化问题，具体针对简化全轨迹加热LDED32条带基准（simplified whole-track heating LDED32 stripe benchmark）中的热-力学行为，包括热积累、残余应力、变形和塑性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在评估的十种代表性扫描策略中，存在残余应力与垂直变形之间的权衡（stress–distortion trade-off），而非单一单调的质量目标；中心向外（center_out）策略是稳健的折中方案，而光栅从左到右（raster_left_to_right）和边缘向内（edge_in）策略构成权衡的两端。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在评估的十种代表性扫描策略中，存在残余应力与垂直变形之间的权衡（stress–distortion trade-off），而非单一单调的质量目标；中心向外（center_out）策略是稳健的折中方案，而光栅从左到右（raster_left_to_right）和边缘向内（edge_in）策略构成权衡的两端。；创新点：提出了一个双层诊断框架，用于在强化学习训练前诊断奖励函数和世界模型的保真度，揭示了当前廉价路径基代理指标主要捕捉变形相关行为而与稀疏FEA参考标签弱相关，从而指出仅依赖代理奖励设计可能导致未来强化学习训练中的目标失配。
papers.method_zh: 采用双层代理-有限元分析（bilevel Proxy–FEA）诊断框架：下层使用轻量级扫描路径和热启发代理（thermo-inspired proxies）进行快速候选生成和策略侧初步筛选；上层使用稀疏的Abaqus有限元分析（FEA）模拟提供基于仿真的参考标签。评估指标包括最终冷却残余Mises应力、U3垂直变形和PEEQ塑性指标。

papers.title: Time-Symmetry of Lagrangian Coherent Structures in Active Turbulence
papers.abstract: Active flows are central to mixing and transport across living systems. While Newtonian fluids remain laminar, diffusive and predictable at the microscale, living fluids like dense bacterial suspensions can exhibit highly chaotic flows like active turbulence, with anomalous transport capabilities. The underlying spatiotemporally persistent structures that drive mixing in active flows, however, remain uncharted. Using Lagrangian Coherent Structures, we now uncover networks of attracting and repelling hyperbolic surfaces. We study changes in the distribution and spectra of Finite-Time Lyapunov Exponent fields in response to increasing activity. Despite the dominance of vorticity in the flow, extreme forward and backward time chaotic mixing is found to originate from straining regions, emphasizing the role of saddles. Fractal dimensions of ridges reveal a morphological simplification of LCS networks with increasing activity, while retaining isotropic crossing. Throughout our work, we also probe a hitherto unasked question-Are signatures of Lagrangian irreversibility manifest in attracting and repelling LCS? To the contrary, we find there is a striking time-symmetry. Our work takes the first steps towards linking flow structures in active turbulence to invariant mixing surfaces. These findings will crucially help in designing activity modulation protocols to seed or inhibit flow structures, and thence mixing, in a bid to tame active turbulence for varied applications.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。关键词：Lagrangian Coherent Structures、Finite-Time Lyapunov Exponent fields、Fractal dimensions。；研究对象：活性湍流（active turbulence）中的拉格朗日相干结构（Lagrangian Coherent Structures），具体为密集细菌悬浮液等活性流体中的混沌流动与混合机制。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在活性湍流中，尽管涡度占主导，但极端混沌混合源于应变区域（鞍点）；吸引性与排斥性拉格朗日相干结构表现出显著的时间对称性，而非预期的拉格朗日不可逆性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在活性湍流中，尽管涡度占主导，但极端混沌混合源于应变区域（鞍点）；吸引性与排斥性拉格朗日相干结构表现出显著的时间对称性，而非预期的拉格朗日不可逆性。；创新点：首次将活性湍流中的流动结构与不变混合表面（LCS）联系起来，并揭示了吸引性与排斥性LCS之间出乎意料的时间对称性，挑战了活性流动中拉格朗日不可逆性的直觉。
papers.method_zh: 采用拉格朗日相干结构（LCS）方法，通过计算有限时间李雅普诺夫指数（FTLE）场的分布与谱，分析脊线的分形维数，并对比正向与反向时间演化下的混沌混合特征。

papers.title: DNA end tethering through break-induced DNA--protein condensation
papers.abstract: Cells deploy robust mechanisms to repair DNA damage, safeguarding genomic stability and cellular health, but the physical principles underlying these processes remain incompletely understood. Experiments show \emph{in vitro} that upon a DNA double-strand break, a DNA--protein condensate can tether the broken DNA ends before they disperse away, a critical step for subsequent repair biochemistry. However, it remains puzzling how such condensation reliably achieves spatiotemporal localization at the break site and captures both broken ends despite intrinsic stochasticity. Here, we propose that broken DNA ends can trigger a conversion of proteins from a soluble state to a condensate-competent state. Combining this idea with Brownian dynamics simulations and theory, we propose a physical mechanism for reliable DNA-end tethering. Simulations show that such break-induced conversion can drive local DNA--protein condensation with two possible outcomes: successful or failed tethering. To rationalize this, we construct an effective free energy landscape, identify the corresponding stationary states, and demonstrate that tethering is governed by a kinetic competition between polymer relaxation and condensation dynamics. Together, our study shows that DNA end-dependent conversion, coupled with DNA--protein condensation, can reliably tether broken DNA ends.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（结合计算）。判断依据：提出物理机制、构建自由能景观、使用布朗动力学模拟。；研究对象：DNA双链断裂后，由DNA-蛋白质凝聚体（condensate）介导的断裂末端拴系（end tethering）过程。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 断裂的DNA末端可以触发蛋白质从可溶态向凝聚态转化，这种转化与DNA-蛋白质凝聚过程耦合，通过聚合物松弛与凝聚动力学之间的竞争，可靠地实现断裂末端的拴系。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：断裂的DNA末端可以触发蛋白质从可溶态向凝聚态转化，这种转化与DNA-蛋白质凝聚过程耦合，通过聚合物松弛与凝聚动力学之间的竞争，可靠地实现断裂末端的拴系。；创新点：提出了“断裂诱导的蛋白质状态转换”这一新机制，解释了在内在随机性下，DNA-蛋白质凝聚体如何可靠地在断裂位点实现时空定位并捕获两个断裂末端。
papers.method_zh: 布朗动力学模拟（Brownian dynamics simulations）与理论分析（构建有效自由能景观、识别稳态）。

papers.title: Defect Conformal Manifolds along RG Domain Walls between $\mathbb Z_N$-Parafermions and Minimal Models
papers.abstract: We investigate the renormalization group (RG) domain walls interpolating between the $\mathbb{Z}_N$ parafermion theory (the critical $N$-state Potts model) and the Virasoro minimal model $\mathcal{M}_{N+1}$. These flows are genuinely non-perturbative and an explicit construction of Gaiotto type RG domain wall remains elusive. We bypass this limitation by employing a bottom-up approach centered on the emergence of ``phantom currents". By tracking the preserved non-invertible symmetries ($\mathfrak{so}(3)_N$) along the flow, we extract the exact spectrum of these currents localized on the defect. We demonstrate that the presence of a spin-1 phantom current allows the interface to be marginally deformed, dynamically generating a continuous defect conformal manifold. Furthermore, we show that an extra spin-2 operator, crucially as a $W^{(3)}$-algebra descendant of the spin-1 phantom current, rigidly constrains the UV-IR stress tensor mixing via the cluster decomposition principle. This algebraic framework enables the exact computation of the parameter-dependent transmission rate across the conformal manifold, which we observe strictly vanishes in the large-$N$ limit as a consequence of macroscopic target space collapse.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：investigate、bottom-up approach、algebraic framework、exact computation。；研究对象：研究的是重整化群（RG）畴壁，具体插值于 $\mathbb{Z}_N$ 抛物费米子理论（临界 $N$ 态 Potts 模型）与 Virasoro 极小模型 $\mathcal{M}_{N+1}$ 之间的界面。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 发现沿 RG 流存在自旋为1的“幻影流”，使得界面可被边际形变，从而动态生成一个连续的缺陷共形流形；同时，一个自旋为2的算子（作为 $W^{(3)}$ 代数的后代）通过团簇分解原理严格约束了紫外-红外应力张量的混合，并允许精确计算流形上依赖于参数的透射率，该透射率在大 $N$ 极限下严格为零。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：发现沿 RG 流存在自旋为1的“幻影流”，使得界面可被边际形变，从而动态生成一个连续的缺陷共形流形；同时，一个自旋为2的算子（作为 $W^{(3)}$ 代数的后代）通过团簇分解原理严格约束了紫外-红外应力张量的混合，并允许精确计算流形上依赖于参数的透射率，该透射率在大 $N$ 极限下严格为零。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用自下而上的方法，核心是追踪沿 RG 流保持的非可逆对称性（$\mathfrak{so}(3)_N$），从而提取局域在缺陷上的幻影流的确切谱，并利用代数框架（涉及 $W^{(3)}$ 代数）计算透射率。

papers.title: Geometry, elasticity, and activity in the transport of self-propelled filaments in turbulence
papers.abstract: We investigate the transport of elastic active filaments in two-dimensional turbulence, focusing on how propulsion geometry and elasticity determine vortex trapping and transport. Using a bead-spring model with activity applied at the filament head, we compare propulsion that follows the instantaneous filament conformation with propulsion imposed along a fixed external direction. We find that activity does not generically enhance transport: when propulsion remains coupled to the filament backbone, vortex trapping remains dominant and motion stays effectively diffusive, whereas fixed-direction propulsion enables persistent excursions across flow structures and leads to superdiffusive transport. In both cases, activity shifts filament conformations toward more extended states, effectively opposing elastic relaxation without eliminating preferential sampling of coherent vortical regions. At low Weissenberg number, this conformational change is amplified: activity cooperates with elasticity to enhance preferential sampling of vortical regions and strengthen vortex trapping. Transport therefore emerges from a competition between activity, elasticity, and flow-induced deformation, with elasticity determining how effectively activity-induced extensions can persist against turbulent trapping. These results establish propulsion geometry as the key control parameter for transport, with elasticity and activity acting cooperatively rather than independently to shape filament dynamics in turbulent flows.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：使用bead-spring模型进行数值模拟，分析活性、弹性与湍流耦合的动力学行为。；研究对象：二维湍流中自推进弹性细丝（self-propelled elastic filaments）的输运行为，重点研究推进几何（propulsion geometry）与弹性如何决定涡旋捕获与输运。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 活性并不普遍增强输运：当推进方向与细丝骨架耦合时，运动保持扩散性；当推进方向固定于外部方向时，可实现超扩散输运。弹性与活性协同作用，而非独立影响细丝在湍流中的动力学。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：活性并不普遍增强输运：当推进方向与细丝骨架耦合时，运动保持扩散性；当推进方向固定于外部方向时，可实现超扩散输运。弹性与活性协同作用，而非独立影响细丝在湍流中的动力学。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用bead-spring模型，在细丝头部施加活性力，比较两种推进方式：一种沿瞬时细丝构型方向推进，另一种沿固定外部方向推进。通过分析构型变化、涡旋优先采样及输运行为（扩散/超扩散）进行研究。

papers.title: Machine-learned atomistic simulations reveal the basis of hydrogen-induced crack-plane transition in alpha-Fe
papers.abstract: Hydrogen-related fracture in body-centered cubic Fe and ferritic steels often appears as transgranular quasi-cleavage rather than purely intergranular failure, especially at low to moderate hydrogen contents. Fractography has suggested that hydrogen may change the dominant cleavage faceting from {100} toward {110}, but atomic-scale evidence for this possible crack-plane transition remains unclear. Here we construct an efficient neural-network potential for α-Fe/H and combine large-scale, three-dimensional molecular dynamics with grand-canonical Monte Carlo (GCMC), allowing the near-tip crack-surface region and crack tip within a defined GCMC domain to exchange hydrogen with a reservoir at fixed chemical potential. A comparison of four crack systems identifies the controlling response: (100)[010], (100)[011], and (110)[001] remain cleavage-dominated, whereas the (110)[1-10] crack changes from dislocation emission in pure Fe to cleavage under hydrogen charging. The energetic origin is twofold. Hydrogen lowers the Griffith cleavage threshold of the {110} cleavage-plane family more strongly than that of {100}, and, for the controlling crack, a Rice-type energetic descriptor indicates that the surface-energy-controlled cleavage resistance decreases faster than the unstable-stacking-fault-controlled emission resistance, consistent with a weakened dislocation-emission shield. These results provide a thermodynamically consistent atomistic basis for a hydrogen-induced transgranular crack-plane transition in Fe.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“machine-learned atomistic simulations”、“neural-network potential”、“molecular dynamics”、“grand-canonical Monte Carlo”等计算模拟方法。；研究对象：氢致α-Fe（体心立方铁）中穿晶解理裂纹面从{100}向{110}转变的物理现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 氢的引入会改变α-Fe中裂纹的扩展模式：对于(110)[1-10]裂纹体系，氢使其从纯铁中的位错发射转变为解理断裂；其能量学根源在于氢对{110}解理面的Griffith阈值降低作用强于{100}面，且表面能控制的解理阻力下降速度快于不稳定层错能控制的位错发射阻力。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：氢的引入会改变α-Fe中裂纹的扩展模式：对于(110)[1-10]裂纹体系，氢使其从纯铁中的位错发射转变为解理断裂；其能量学根源在于氢对{110}解理面的Griffith阈值降低作用强于{100}面，且表面能控制的解理阻力下降速度快于不稳定层错能控制的位错发射阻力。；创新点：首次在原子尺度上为氢致α-Fe中穿晶解理裂纹面从{100}向{110}的转变提供了热力学一致的原子级证据，并定量揭示了其能量学机制（Griffith阈值与Rice型能量描述符的竞争）。
papers.method_zh: 构建了α-Fe/H体系的神经网络势函数，结合大规模三维分子动力学与巨正则蒙特卡洛方法，使裂纹尖端区域在固定化学势下与氢储库交换氢原子，并对比了四种裂纹体系：(100)[010]、(100)[011]、(110)[001]和(110)[1-10]。

papers.title: Vacuum-Sealed Thermal Treatment Regulates Trap States and Red Persistent Luminescence in CaTiO3: Pr3+,Al3+ Phosphors
papers.abstract: Red persistent phosphors remain less mature than green and blue-green systems because their afterglow is often weak and decays rapidly. Here, CaTiO3:0.3%Pr3+,0.3%Al3+ phosphors were prepared by a high-temperature solid-state route under either air or vacuum-sealed quartz-tube (QT) conditions. The effects of processing atmosphere and sintering temperature on phase structure, microstructure, steady-state photoluminescence, afterglow, thermoluminescence, and excited-state decay were examined. X-ray diffraction and Raman spectra show that all samples retain the orthorhombic CaTiO3 perovskite phase, with no detectable secondary phase. SEM observations show particle coarsening at higher QT temperatures, while EDS mapping indicates a homogeneous distribution of Ca, Ti, O, Pr, and Al within the examined region. The QT-treated samples exhibit stronger Pr3+ red emission near 612 nm and markedly improved afterglow compared with the air-treated sample. The QT-1300 sample shows the best afterglow among the present samples, with a reported 3.6-fold higher intensity at 1200 s than Air-1200°C. Thermoluminescence results indicate that QT treatment increases the population of thermally active traps and enhances the deeper trap component. These results suggest that a low-oxygen sealed environment regulates defect-related traps, most likely involving oxygen-vacancy-associated centers, and improves carrier storage and release through the Pr3+ and Ti4+ intervalence charge-transfer pathway. This work provides a practical processing strategy for improving CaTiO3-based red persistent phosphors and offers insight into trap-state regulation under low-oxygen thermal treatment.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“制备”、“X射线衍射”、“拉曼光谱”、“扫描电镜”、“光致发光”、“余辉”、“热释光”等实验手段。；研究对象：CaTiO₃: Pr³⁺, Al³⁺ 红色长余辉荧光粉，具体研究其陷阱态调控与红色持续发光性能。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 真空密封石英管（QT）热处理能显著增强CaTiO₃: Pr³⁺, Al³⁺荧光粉的Pr³⁺红色发光（~612 nm）和余辉性能，其中QT-1300℃样品的余辉强度在1200秒时比空气烧结样品（Air-1200℃）高出3.6倍。该处理通过增加热活性陷阱的填充和加深陷阱组分来改善载流子存储与释放。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：真空密封石英管（QT）热处理能显著增强CaTiO₃: Pr³⁺, Al³⁺荧光粉的Pr³⁺红色发光（~612 nm）和余辉性能，其中QT-1300℃样品的余辉强度在1200秒时比空气烧结样品（Air-1200℃）高出3.6倍。该处理通过增加热活性陷阱的填充和加深陷阱组分来改善载流子存储与释放。；创新点：提出低氧密封热处理（真空石英管）作为一种实用加工策略，通过调控氧空位相关缺陷陷阱来改善CaTiO₃基红色长余辉荧光粉的性能，并揭示了Pr³⁺与Ti⁴⁺之间的价间电荷转移路径在载流子存储与释放中的作用。
papers.method_zh: 高温固相法（分别在空气和真空密封石英管条件下制备）；X射线衍射（XRD）、拉曼光谱（Raman）表征相结构；扫描电镜（SEM）及能谱（EDS）分析微观形貌与元素分布；稳态光致发光（PL）、余辉（afterglow）、热释光（TL）及激发态衰减测量。

papers.title: Self-consistent analysis of the Kuramoto model with higher-order interactions
papers.abstract: The Kuramoto model with higher-order interactions has recently been shown to exhibit bistability, explosive synchronization transitions, and rich collective dynamics. Existing analytical approaches, however, typically rely on all-to-all coupling or mean-field approximations of the underlying hypergraph structure. While these methods describe typical networks in the thermodynamic limit, they generally fail to capture the effects of finite hypergraph and oscillator frequency realizations. To address this limitation, we develop a self-consistent analytical framework for the Kuramoto model with dyadic and triadic interactions on hypergraphs. We introduce generalized local order parameters that capture the combined effects of dyadic and triadic phase correlations, and derive a hierarchy of approximation schemes for the local and global synchronization order parameters. Using these approximations, we determine critical coupling strengths for the onset of synchronization and bistability. In particular, we show that the critical triadic coupling strength governing the onset of bistability depends on correlations between the eigenvectors of the dyadic adjacency matrix and the triadic interaction structure. Numerical simulations on homogeneous and heterogeneous hypergraphs validate the theory and illustrate the distinct regimes of applicability of the approximation schemes.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：self-consistent analytical framework, derive a hierarchy of approximation schemes, numerical simulations）；研究对象：具有高阶相互作用的Kuramoto模型，具体研究超图（hypergraph）上二元（dyadic）和三元（triadic）相互作用下的同步动力学。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 发现了控制双稳态（bistability）出现的临界三元耦合强度依赖于二元邻接矩阵的特征向量与三元相互作用结构之间的相关性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：发现了控制双稳态（bistability）出现的临界三元耦合强度依赖于二元邻接矩阵的特征向量与三元相互作用结构之间的相关性。；创新点：现有方法通常依赖全耦合或平均场近似，无法捕捉有限超图和振荡器频率实现的具体效应；本工作提出的自洽框架能够克服这一局限，并揭示了特征向量相关性对临界耦合强度的影响。
papers.method_zh: 发展了一个自洽解析框架，引入广义局部序参量以捕捉二元和三元相位关联的联合效应，并推导了局部和全局同步序参量的近似方案层次。通过数值模拟在均匀和非均匀超图上验证理论。

papers.title: Memory Uncertainty Relation and Harmonic Memory in Random Recurrent Networks
papers.abstract: We present an inequality that bounds the short-term memory capability of dynamical systems from below. It can be interpreted as an uncertainty relation between a measure of short-term memory and that of the size of state fluctuations induced by input signals. The lower bound can be achieved by a readout weight and thus represents a suboptimal memory called harmonic memory. We examine analytically and numerically the inequality in a number of reservoir systems subject to input noise. We illustrate cases in which equality is achieved exactly, equality holds asymptotically, and the inequality is strict. We also study the effect of a state-space regularization to elucidate the inequality in terms of the fluctuation structure of the state-space. We find that a certain strength of input noise induces extra memory under the regularization, and we refer to this phenomenon as noise-induced memory. We observe that the memory uncertainty relation does not hold in general for the regularized memory and harmonic memory. This fact is explained in terms of the mechanism of noise-induced memory.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：inequality、uncertainty relation、analytically and numerically、reservoir systems）；研究对象：随机递归网络（random recurrent networks）中的短期记忆能力与状态涨落之间的不确定性关系，以及谐波记忆（harmonic memory）和噪声诱导记忆（noise-induced memory）现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 推导出一个下界不等式，将短期记忆能力与输入信号引起的状态涨落大小联系起来，可视为一种“记忆不确定性关系”；在状态空间正则化下，一定强度的输入噪声会诱导出额外记忆（噪声诱导记忆），此时原记忆不确定性关系不再普遍成立。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：推导出一个下界不等式，将短期记忆能力与输入信号引起的状态涨落大小联系起来，可视为一种“记忆不确定性关系”；在状态空间正则化下，一定强度的输入噪声会诱导出额外记忆（噪声诱导记忆），此时原记忆不确定性关系不再普遍成立。；创新点：首次提出并证明了动态系统短期记忆能力与状态涨落之间的不确定性关系，并发现噪声诱导记忆这一新现象，揭示了正则化下该关系失效的机制。
papers.method_zh: 理论推导（不等式证明）、解析分析（equality exact/asymptotic cases）、数值模拟（reservoir systems with input noise）、状态空间正则化分析。

papers.title: Dissipative acousto-mechanical parametric interface between high-overtone acoustics and flexural phonons
papers.abstract: High-overtone bulk acoustic wave resonators (HBARs) promise advanced phononics, yet achieving nonlinearity remains challenging. We demonstrate a radiation-pressure-type parametric interaction between GHz HBARs and low-frequency flexural modes in a suspended silicon nitride membrane, where mechanical displacement modulates the external dissipation rate to enable dissipative acousto-mechanical coupling. Benefiting from the high quality factor, the system enters the resolved-sideband regime at room temperature, yielding acousto-mechanically induced transparency. We observe tunable Kerr nonlinearity and generate coherent HBAR frequency combs via two-tone driving. Notably, our dissipative coupling strength is 20 times larger than the dispersive coupling, the highest ratio among reported hybrid dissipative-dispersive coupling systems, resulting in the experimental observation of amplification in the reflection spectra under red-sideband driving. The ability to interface dense HBAR modes with a common mechanical resonator provides a scalable on-chip platform for multimode phononic information processing, with quantum phononics potentially achievable at sub-Kelvin temperatures.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用了“We demonstrate”（我们展示了）、“We observe”（我们观察到）等描述实验操作和观测结果的动词，并提及了具体的实验现象（如诱导透明、频率梳、反射谱放大）。；研究对象：论文研究的具体物理系统是：由高频（GHz）高次泛音体声波谐振器（HBAR）与悬浮氮化硅薄膜中的低频弯曲模式（flexural phonons）构成的混合声子体系。核心物理现象是耗散型声-机械参量耦合。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该工作实现了室温下HBAR与低频弯曲模式之间的耗散型声-机械参量耦合，其耦合强度是色散型耦合的20倍，并在此体系中观测到了可调谐的Kerr非线性和相干HBAR频率梳。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该工作实现了室温下HBAR与低频弯曲模式之间的耗散型声-机械参量耦合，其耦合强度是色散型耦合的20倍，并在此体系中观测到了可调谐的Kerr非线性和相干HBAR频率梳。；创新点：该工作的主要新意在于：1. 在HBAR体系中实现了以耗散耦合为主导的声-机械参量相互作用，其耗散耦合强度与色散耦合强度之比（20倍）是目前报道的混合耗散-色散耦合系统中的最高值。2. 在室温下即进入了可解析边带（resolved-sideband）区域，并观测到声-机械诱导透明和可调谐Kerr非线性。3. 为将密集的HBAR模式与公共机械谐振器接口连接，提供了一个可扩展的片上多模声子信息处理平台。
papers.method_zh: 具体实验手段包括：利用悬浮氮化硅薄膜上的HBAR构建混合声子体系；通过机械位移调制外部耗散率来实现耗散型声-机械耦合；采用双音驱动（two-tone driving）产生频率梳；通过测量反射谱来表征耦合效应（如边带冷却下的放大现象）。

papers.title: Algebraic Tomography of Non-Hermitian Floquet Systems from Observable Traces
papers.abstract: We formulate a framework of Floquet algebraic tomography for finite-dimensional non-Hermitian monodromy matrices from observable trace sequences $ζ_n^{(O)}={\rm Tr}(OM^n)$. Since these sequences are constrained by the characteristic polynomial of $M$, the inverse problem is a finite-dimensional algebraic reconstruction problem rather than a generic exponential fit. We organize the reconstruction through the observable resolvent, spectral determinant, and Dirichlet spectral data, separating the common spectral skeleton from observable-dependent dressing. Cayley--Hamilton and Hankel methods recover the similarity-invariant spectral data, while multi-observable and Liouville-space extensions connect the construction to realization theory and tomography reconstruction. We further clarify the limits of identifiability from restricted observable algebras: the data determine a visible representative, micromotion can enlarge the sampled visible operator space, and exact symmetries impose residual invisible sectors. Two examples, a driven transmon qutrit and a finite non-Hermitian Floquet SSH chain, demonstrate leakage-induced visibility expansion, observable-dependent phase response, EP-accessible branch geometry, and disorder/probe-dependent observable-dimension readouts.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：formulate a framework、algebraic reconstruction、theoretical framework。；研究对象：非厄米Floquet系统的单值矩阵（monodromy matrices）的代数层析成像（algebraic tomography），具体涉及有限维非厄米Floquet系统，并以驱动transmon qutrit和有限非厄米Floquet SSH链为例。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 从可观测量迹序列中重构非厄米Floquet系统单值矩阵的逆问题本质上是有限维代数重构问题，而非一般的指数拟合；通过可观测量解析函数、谱行列式和Dirichlet谱数据，可将公共谱骨架与可观测量依赖的修饰分离，并明确了受限可观测量代数下的可辨识性极限。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：从可观测量迹序列中重构非厄米Floquet系统单值矩阵的逆问题本质上是有限维代数重构问题，而非一般的指数拟合；通过可观测量解析函数、谱行列式和Dirichlet谱数据，可将公共谱骨架与可观测量依赖的修饰分离，并明确了受限可观测量代数下的可辨识性极限。；创新点：提出了非厄米Floquet系统的代数层析成像方法，将逆问题从指数拟合转化为有限维代数重构，并系统分析了可观测量代数受限下的可辨识性边界，包括微运动扩展和对称性导致的不可见扇区。摘要未突出说明与已有层析成像方法的具体对比。
papers.method_zh: 代数层析成像框架：利用Cayley-Hamilton定理和Hankel方法恢复相似性不变的谱数据；通过多可观测量和Liouville空间扩展将构造与实现理论及层析成像重建联系起来；分析了微运动（micromotion）对可观测量空间扩展的影响以及精确对称性导致的不可见扇区。

papers.title: Fermi-Dirac machines as quantizations of neurons
papers.abstract: Fermi-Dirac machines were proposed recently as an approach to solving semidefinite optimization problems on quantum computers. Here, we reinterpret them as canonical quantizations of classical neurons. By viewing a classical neuron as an activation function applied to a parameterized classical Hamiltonian, we quantize this model by replacing classical variables with operators whose eigenvalues encode their possible values. This follows the standard approach to canonical quantization in quantum mechanics. Crucially, when the Hamiltonian consists of commuting operators, our construction reduces exactly to a classical neuron. More generally, our approach yields an activation observable, defined as an activation function applied to a parameterized quantum Hamiltonian. The output of this quantized neuron is a random variable with expectation value equal to that of the activation observable with respect to an input state. We develop efficient hybrid quantum-classical algorithms for evaluating outputs and gradients of our quantized neurons, enabling evaluation and training. These algorithms rely on basic primitives that include random sampling, Hamiltonian simulation, and the Hadamard test. We also quantize a whole host of other activation functions, including the smooth rectified linear unit (ReLU), sigmoid linear unit, Gaussian-smoothed ReLU, and Gaussian error linear unit (GeLU), which are known to be useful for deep learning applications. Numerical experiments indicate that neurons based on quantum Hamiltonians can learn functions that classical neurons cannot. We further define a computational decision problem based on Fermi-Dirac neurons and prove that it is BQP-complete, providing complexity-theoretic evidence against efficient classical simulation. Finally, we generalize our approach to continuous quantum variables and sketch two different ways of composing these neurons into networks.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：quantization、canonical quantization、quantum Hamiltonian、BQP-complete）；研究对象：经典神经元的量子化模型，具体为Fermi-Dirac机器作为经典神经元的正则量子化推广，涉及多种激活函数（如ReLU、GeLU等）的量子对应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过将经典神经元中的变量替换为量子算符，实现了经典神经元的正则量子化；基于量子哈密顿量的神经元能够学习经典神经元无法学习的函数，且相关决策问题被证明是BQP完全的，暗示其无法被经典计算机高效模拟。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过将经典神经元中的变量替换为量子算符，实现了经典神经元的正则量子化；基于量子哈密顿量的神经元能够学习经典神经元无法学习的函数，且相关决策问题被证明是BQP完全的，暗示其无法被经典计算机高效模拟。；创新点：首次将Fermi-Dirac机器重新解释为经典神经元的正则量子化，并系统推广到多种激活函数；通过BQP完全性证明提供了反对经典模拟的计算复杂性证据。
papers.method_zh: 采用正则量子化框架，将经典神经元的激活函数应用于参数化经典哈密顿量，替换为量子算符后得到激活可观测量；开发了基于随机采样、哈密顿量模拟和Hadamard测试的混合量子-经典算法，用于评估输出和梯度。

papers.title: Dynamical self-dual criticality in Fibonacci-monitored quantum Ising chains
papers.abstract: For the quantum phase transition in the transverse-field Ising chain, Kramers-Wannier duality not only protects its critical properties but also pinpoints the location of the phase transition. Its role in out-of-equilibrium, monitored dynamics, however, remains largely unexplored beyond time-periodic Floquet protocols where self-duality turns into a statistical average symmetry. Here we explore the emergence of dynamical self-duality in the absence of time-translation symmetry by investigating the monitored dynamics of one-dimensional Ising/Majorana chains where measurements are arranged in a quasiperiodic Fibonacci sequence. We find that the dynamical extension of this non-invertible symmetry to an out-of-equilibrium setting allows one to organize the dynamical phase diagram of entangled phases, both predicting the transition locations and protecting universal critical behavior. Analytically and numerically, we identify two distinct critical lines, both related to the golden ratio, for Born-rule weak measurements and for random Clifford projective measurements. The latter coincides with the transition of a pure imaginary-time evolution, which can be viewed as a post-selected trajectory. The universality classes of the long-time critical steady states at Fibonacci times are determined, while the transient dynamics between Fibonacci times is deformed by measurements, realizing dynamical measurement-altered quantum criticality in real time.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：analytically and numerically, universality classes, dynamical phase diagram）；研究对象：一维横场伊辛链/马约拉纳链在准周期斐波那契序列测量下的受监测量子动力学，以及其中涌现的动力学自对偶临界性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在缺乏时间平移对称性的受监测动力学中，非可逆的Kramers-Wannier对偶性可扩展为动力学自对偶，从而组织纠缠相的动力学相图，预测相变位置并保护普适临界行为。发现了与黄金比例相关的两条不同临界线，分别对应Born规则弱测量和随机Clifford投影测量。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在缺乏时间平移对称性的受监测动力学中，非可逆的Kramers-Wannier对偶性可扩展为动力学自对偶，从而组织纠缠相的动力学相图，预测相变位置并保护普适临界行为。发现了与黄金比例相关的两条不同临界线，分别对应Born规则弱测量和随机Clifford投影测量。；创新点：将通常用于平衡态或周期驱动Floquet系统的自对偶性，首次推广到无时间平移对称性的准周期测量动力学中，揭示了动力学自对偶临界性的涌现及其对相变位置和普适类的决定作用。
papers.method_zh: 解析分析与数值模拟相结合，研究准周期斐波那契序列排列的测量下的一维伊辛/马约拉纳链动力学。具体涉及Born规则弱测量和随机Clifford投影测量，并分析了后选择轨迹对应的纯虚时间演化。

papers.title: Harnessing AtomisticSkills for Agentic Atomistic Research
papers.abstract: Computational materials science and chemistry span vast knowledge domains and fractured software ecosystems. Although large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated research capabilities, scaling monolithic agents to manage the rigor and complexity of atomistic research remains a challenge. Here, we introduce AtomisticSkills, an open-source harness framework that empowers general-purpose AI coding agents to conduct atomistic research across materials science, chemistry, and drug discovery. By hierarchically decomposing scientific workflows into agent skills and tools, AtomisticSkills provides agents with modular, extensible, and plug-and-play research capabilities. The framework integrates more than 100 human-curated multidisciplinary skills, including database access, thermodynamics and kinetics modeling, and diverse simulation engines employing machine learning interatomic potentials (MLIPs) and density functional theory (DFT). We validate its functional coverage against scientific literature and demonstrate robust orchestration capabilities across diverse scientific campaigns: generative design of Li-ion solid-state electrolytes, high-throughput screening of metal-organic frameworks for CO2 capture, autonomous MLIP benchmarking and fine-tuning, multi-stage structure-based virtual screening for drug design, multimodal X-ray diffraction pattern analysis, and screening of Fe-oxide catalysts for oxygen evolution reaction. AtomisticSkills provides a critical agent infrastructure towards building fully autonomous AI scientists.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：computational materials science、large language models、agentic framework、machine learning interatomic potentials、density functional theory。；研究对象：该论文不研究具体的材料或物理现象，而是研究一个用于原子尺度计算研究的通用AI代理框架（AtomisticSkills），其应用覆盖材料科学、化学和药物发现中的多种体系，如锂离子固态电解质、金属有机框架、铁氧化物催化剂等。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 摘要未明确说明具体的物理结论或发现。该框架通过将科学工作流分层分解为代理技能和工具，使通用AI编码代理能够执行原子尺度研究，并展示了在多个科学任务中的鲁棒编排能力。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：摘要未明确说明具体的物理结论或发现。该框架通过将科学工作流分层分解为代理技能和工具，使通用AI编码代理能够执行原子尺度研究，并展示了在多个科学任务中的鲁棒编排能力。；创新点：该工作的主要新意在于提出了一个分层、模块化、可扩展且即插即用的开源框架，将通用AI编码代理的能力系统性地应用于原子尺度研究，解决了现有单体代理难以管理原子研究严谨性和复杂性的挑战，并朝着构建完全自主的AI科学家迈出了关键一步。
papers.method_zh: 该论文提出并实现了一个名为AtomisticSkills的开源框架，集成了超过100个人工策划的多学科技能，包括数据库访问、热力学与动力学建模、以及使用机器学习原子间势（MLIP）和密度泛函理论（DFT）的多种模拟引擎。验证方式包括与科学文献的功能覆盖对比，以及在多个科学任务中的演示（如生成式设计、高通量筛选、自主MLIP基准测试与微调、多阶段虚拟筛选、多模态X射线衍射分析、催化剂筛选）。

papers.title: Modelling the photocatalytic oxidation of methane and other air pollutants for applications in ventilation systems
papers.abstract: Photocatalytic oxidation (PCO) is a promising strategy for indoor air purification and outdoor pollutant abatement, potentially offering treatment for climate- and health-relevant pollutants such as methane (CH$_4$), nitrogen oxides (NO$_\text{x}$) and volatile organic compounds (VOCs). In this work, we present experiments evaluating the PCO of CH$_4$ (2 to 10 ppm) under varying UV-C light intensities (4 to 59 W/m$^2$), using titanium dioxide (TiO$_2$) as the photocatalyst. At 2 ppm CH$_4$, TiO$_2$ achieves a maximum conversion efficiency of 24.4% and a maximum apparent quantum yield of $0.013$\% over the tested UV-C light intensities, demonstrating activity at environmentally relevant concentrations. We develop a model to interpret the experimental results and assess the potential of PCO for ventilation applications. The model is validated against our CH$_4$ data and literature results for formaldehyde (HCHO) and NO$_\text{x}$. While laboratory-scale configurations achieve high conversions (e.g., 24.4% for CH$_4$), ventilation-scale performance is predicted to be limited by thin concentration boundary layers and short residence times, with conversion efficiencies dropping to around $0.017$%. Finally, we estimate the climate impact of CH$_4$ removal in terms of CO$_2$e emission rates, demonstrating that TiO$_2$-based PCO in ventilation applications can yield a net climate benefit (i.e., a net-negative CO$_2$e emissions rate) when the modelled CO$_2$e removal rate exceeds the emissions from catalyst material production and UV operation, particularly when pre-existing UV-C irradiation is leveraged.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验+模型计算）。关键词：experiments evaluating、develop a model、validated against data。；研究对象：二氧化钛（TiO₂）光催化氧化甲烷（CH₄）、甲醛（HCHO）和氮氧化物（NOₓ）等空气污染物，应用于通风系统。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: TiO₂在环境相关浓度（2 ppm CH₄）下可实现24.4%的转化效率，但通风系统尺度下因边界层薄和停留时间短，转化效率降至约0.017%；若利用已有UV-C光源，TiO₂基光催化可产生净气候效益（净负CO₂e排放率）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：TiO₂在环境相关浓度（2 ppm CH₄）下可实现24.4%的转化效率，但通风系统尺度下因边界层薄和停留时间短，转化效率降至约0.017%；若利用已有UV-C光源，TiO₂基光催化可产生净气候效益（净负CO₂e排放率）。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 实验：不同UV-C光强（4–59 W/m²）下测试CH₄（2–10 ppm）的光催化氧化，使用TiO₂光催化剂。模型：开发了用于解释实验结果并评估通风应用潜力的模型，并用CH₄实验数据及文献中HCHO和NOₓ结果进行验证。

papers.title: Sensing Intelligence as a Trainable Metamaterial Property
papers.abstract: In biological systems, sensing is not performed by the brain alone: the body deforms, vibrates, and filters external stimuli before they are transduced into neural signals. In engineered systems, this processing burden is placed largely on electronics and computation, while the mechanical body is usually designed only for strength and stability. Here, we present sensing intelligence as a trainable property of the body. We show that the geometry of a metamaterial can be optimized to reshape external stimuli into internal signals that are easier for a neural network to interpret. Rather than hand-designing this physical preprocessing, we let the neural network train its own body for sensing by backpropagating the sensing loss to the body's design parameters through differentiable simulation. Across numerical and experimental sensing scenarios, the optimized body improves sensing accuracy by up to fivefold or reduces the number of required electronic sensors by nearly an order of magnitude.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（数值模拟与实验验证）。关键词：differentiable simulation（可微模拟）、numerical and experimental sensing scenarios（数值与实验传感场景）。；研究对象：力学超材料（metamaterial）的几何结构，及其作为可训练物理感知体的设计方法。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过可微模拟将神经网络感知损失反向传播至超材料几何参数，可优化超材料结构，使其自动将外部刺激重塑为更易被神经网络解释的内部信号，从而将“感知智能”训练为材料本身的可设计属性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过可微模拟将神经网络感知损失反向传播至超材料几何参数，可优化超材料结构，使其自动将外部刺激重塑为更易被神经网络解释的内部信号，从而将“感知智能”训练为材料本身的可设计属性。；创新点：提出并实现了“感知智能”作为超材料可训练属性的概念，即让神经网络通过反向传播自主设计材料的物理预处理功能，而非人工设计。该方法可将传感精度提升至五倍，或将所需电子传感器数量减少近一个数量级。
papers.method_zh: 可微模拟（differentiable simulation）结合神经网络反向传播优化超材料几何参数；实验验证传感场景。

papers.title: GDP-Driven Structural and Dynamical Heterogeneity in the Synchronization of Chaotic Macroeconomic Networks
papers.abstract: We investigate the emergence of synchronization in a network of coupled chaotic macroeconomic systems. Each node represents an economy characterized by three key variables savings, gross domestic product (GDP), and foreign capital inflows. These economies interact or are connected through a fitness-based probability that depends on the potential GDP of each node. This formulation allows both structural heterogeneity, arising from uneven network connectivity, and dynamical heterogeneity, due to differences in local parameters, to be explored within a unified framework. Using both numerical simulations and a mean-field approximation, by varying the coupling strength and the degree of heterogeneity of both network topology and dynamical behavior of the nodes, we analyze synchronization transitions. Our results show that the mean-field approach accurately captures the collective dynamics in homogeneous and fully connected networks even with heterogeneity within the intrinsic dynamic of the nodes but fails when strong heterogeneity in the structure of the network is introduced. In heterogeneous networks, the system exhibits partial synchronization and on--off intermittency, where coherent phases of global synchronization alternate with abrupt desynchronization bursts. The distribution of laminar phase durations follows a power-law scaling, consistent with theoretical predictions for intermittent synchronization. From an economic perspective, these results suggest that global business cycle synchronization is inherently fragile: strong integration can promote temporary coordination among economies, but structural and dynamical disparities inevitably lead to intermittent breakdowns of collective behavior.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到使用了“数值模拟”和“平均场近似”作为主要研究手段。；研究对象：耦合混沌宏观经济网络的同步现象。具体体系为：每个节点代表一个由储蓄、国内生产总值（GDP）和外国资本流入三个变量表征的经济体，节点间通过基于潜在GDP的适应度概率连接。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 平均场近似在均匀全连接网络中能准确描述集体动力学，但在网络结构强异质性下失效。异质网络中系统表现出部分同步和开-关间歇性，即全局同步的相干阶段与突然的失同步爆发交替出现，且层流相持续时间服从幂律分布。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：平均场近似在均匀全连接网络中能准确描述集体动力学，但在网络结构强异质性下失效。异质网络中系统表现出部分同步和开-关间歇性，即全局同步的相干阶段与突然的失同步爆发交替出现，且层流相持续时间服从幂律分布。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。但该工作在一个统一框架内同时探讨了由网络连接不均匀导致的结构异质性和由局部参数差异导致的动力学异质性对同步的影响，并揭示了异质网络中同步的间歇性本质及其幂律标度行为。
papers.method_zh: 数值模拟与平均场近似。通过改变耦合强度、网络拓扑结构的异质性以及节点内在动力学的异质性，分析同步转变过程。

papers.title: Universal cumulants and conformal invariance in annihilating random walks with pair deposition
papers.abstract: We consider annihilating random walks on the finite one-dimensional integer torus with deposition of pairs of particles, conditioned on an atypical jump activity. All cumulants of the activity, defined as the number of particle jumps up to some time t, are obtained in closed form to leading order in system size L at the critical point, where in the thermodynamic limit the conditioned process undergoes a phase transition in the universality class of the one-dimensional quantum Ising model in a transverse field. The generating function of the cumulants at a distance of order 1/L away from the critical point is proved to be given by two universal quantities, viz., by the central charge c = 1/2 of the Virasoro algebra that characterizes the Ising universality class and by an explicit universal scaling function.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：考虑、证明、universal scaling function（普适标度函数）、conformal invariance（共形不变性）。；研究对象：一维有限整数环上的湮灭随机游走，并伴有粒子对沉积过程，且条件于非典型的跳跃活动。该体系在热力学极限下会发生相变，属于横向场下一维量子伊辛模型的普适类。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在临界点处，系统跳跃活动的所有累积量（至时间t的粒子跳跃次数）在系统尺寸L的领头阶下均获得了闭式解。在距临界点距离为1/L量级处，累积量的生成函数由两个普适量给出：即表征伊辛普适类的Virasoro代数的中心荷c=1/2，以及一个显式的普适标度函数。

papers.method_zh: 理论分析。通过条件于非典型跳跃活动，对有限一维整数环上的湮灭随机游走与粒子对沉积过程进行数学推导，利用共形场论框架（Virasoro代数、中心荷）和普适标度函数来刻画临界行为。
